discussions.title: dsh-proxy — hot-swappable outbound proxy for every DSH request (manual / system / direct, zero restarts)
discussions.body:
![demo](https://github.com/tr1v3r/dsh-proxy/raw/master/docs/assets/proxy-switch-demo.gif)

I made a DSH plugin that routes **every in-process outbound request** — LLM providers, `web_search` / `web_fetch`, streamable-http MCP — through a proxy you can switch **at runtime, without restarting dsh**. One hot-reloaded settings section picks the strategy:

```yaml
# ~/.config/dsh/settings.yaml
dsh-proxy:
  mode: manual        # direct | system | manual
  proxy: socks5://127.0.0.1:1080
  noProxy: [localhost, .internal.example]
  exportEnv: true
```

- **`manual`** — route through your `proxy` URL: `http(s)://` CONNECT or `socks5://` (URL credentials supported, `socks5h://` accepted), with a `noProxy` bypass list
- **`system`** — just follow the host: `HTTP_PROXY`/`HTTPS_PROXY`/`ALL_PROXY`/`NO_PROXY` env everywhere (socks `ALL_PROXY` included), falling back to the macOS System Settings network proxy (`scutil --proxy`) when env is unset; re-detected on every save
- **`direct`** — no proxy

Every save takes effect immediately — proxy on, off, re-pointed at another server, or switched between manual and system. The GIF above is a real recording walking all three; the full boot-verified flow (settings watcher → dispatcher swap → live fetch) is in the repo's probe.

**How it works**: DSH and pi-ai issue requests via `globalThis.fetch`, which reads undici's well-known global dispatcher slot. The plugin owns that slot.

- `http(s)://` → `EnvHttpProxyAgent` (CONNECT tunneling); `socks5://` → undici's native `Socks5ProxyAgent`
- One shared noProxy matcher for both protocols (bare entries match host + dot-boundary subdomains, `host:port` pins a port, `*` bypasses all); ambient `NO_PROXY`/`HTTP_PROXY` env is deliberately ignored in manual mode so routing is fully settings-driven
- `exportEnv` (manual mode) mirrors the switch into child-process env — `curl`/`git`/stdio MCP servers spawned after a switch follow along; operator-set variables are never clobbered
- Invalid config keeps traffic direct and logs why; proxy credentials are redacted in logs

**Known limits**: Windows registry / PAC / Linux-desktop proxy detection not yet covered in `system` mode; pi-ai's Bedrock route manages its own proxying via AWS SDK env; the built-in browser host is a separate process and is not routed.

```sh
# in ~/.config/dsh/profiles/<name>/package.json
"dependencies": { "@tr1v3r/dsh-proxy": "^0.1.2" },
"dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": ["@deepseek-ai/dsh-base", "@tr1v3r/dsh-proxy"] } }

dsh plugin --profile <name> install --no-frozen-lockfile
```

Restart once to mount — after that, never again for switching.

- GitHub: https://github.com/tr1v3r/dsh-proxy
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@tr1v3r/dsh-proxy

discussions.title: Bug report: dsh-client-ui-settings-plugins (0.1.3-alpha.2) - Subagent / Web search config cards vanish when clicked in 插件配置
discussions.body:
### 环境
- 包：`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-settings-plugins` `0.1.3-alpha.2`（master 最新发布）
- 入口：Web 设置 → 插件 → 插件配置

### 复现
1. 打开 设置 → 插件 → 插件配置。
2. 卡片列表含：插件市场、图像生成、终端、Agent 循环、Subagent、网页搜索、Codex Connect、Univer Office、视觉引擎、搜索引擎。
3. 点击「Subagent」（`subagent-model-selection`）卡片标题 → 该卡整张从列表消失，下方卡片上移。
4. 点击「网页搜索」（`web-search-deepseek`）卡片标题 → 同样消失。

### 实际 vs 期望
- 实际：这两张卡点击后从列表消失，无法展开其配置表单。
- 期望：像「终端」「Agent 循环」等卡一样，点击仅展开配置表单、卡片保留。
- 其它卡（终端、Agent 循环等）点击均正常展开，仅这两张受影响。

### 关键事实（宿主侧命名空间是已服务的）
- `web-search-deepseek` 是内置搜索组件，宿主导早已注册该命名空间。
- `subagent-model-selection` 的宿主服务也存在：`subagent` 工具带 `provider/model/reasoning_effort` 参数，且 `list_subagent_models` 工具存在。
- 因此这两张卡不是「宿主未组装/未提供命名空间」，展开时却是卡片 `available` 快照翻转，触发 `PluginCard` 在 `!state.available` 时 `return null`。

### 疑似根因
与包 README 记录的限制一致：
> The served namespaces re-read on two signals only — the wire announces settings-document commits and connection resets, not registrations, so a namespace whose owner registers after the tab's read joins the list on the next document commit or reconnect.

「已服务命名空间」仅在 settings 文档提交 / 连接重置时重读，注册本身不触发刷新；这两张卡在点开时因这一时序导致 `available` 判为不可用而被丢弃。

### 附注（相关，避免误判）
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-search-deepseek` 是内置组件；把它加入 profile 的 `dsh.profile.bundles` 会导致重复注册并**启动退出**，因此它不应被当作可注册插件。

discussions.title: BUG(dsh 0.1.3-alpha.2):启动崩溃 — connection 的 rpc 通道注册访问未声明的 owner.webServer(附一行修复)
discussions.body:
## 现象

本地编译 dsh 0.1.3-alpha.2(commit `b0a7d2ce3b` 附近)后启动 `dsh web`,启动失败,堆栈指向 `packages/client/connection/src/rpc-host.ts` 的 rpc 通道注册——该处 `owner.webServer` 为 `undefined`,后续 `.register(route)` 直接抛错。

## 根因

`rpc-host.ts` 的 `register()`:

```ts
return owner.effect(
  () => owner.webServer.register(route),
  `client-connection: ${channel} rpc channel`,
)
```

`owner` 是调用方 fiber 的 Context,但它并没有声明 `webServer` 依赖——按 Cordis 的服务读取规则,**未声明服务的属性访问是静默 `undefined`**,于是 `undefined.register(route)` 崩掉。

这一轮 alpha 把 webServer 改成了「可选载体」:`packages/client/modules` 自己已经改成 `ctx.get('webServer')` 判空 + 可选 `ctx.inject` 的写法,但 `client/connection` 这一处漏改了。

## 修复(与 client/modules 的官方模式一致,本地已验证)

```diff
     return owner.effect(
-      () => owner.webServer.register(route),
+      () => {
+        const webServer = owner.get('webServer')
+        if (webServer === undefined) {
+          throw new Error(`connection: rpc channel ${JSON.stringify(channel)} requires the webServer service`)
+        }
+        return webServer.register(route)
+      },
       `client-connection: ${channel} rpc channel`,
     )
```

改后:服务可用时正常注册;不可用时给出**指名道姓的报错**,而不是裸 TypeError。

## 环境

- Windows 11 + Git Bash,本地编译(`pnpm install && pnpm run build`)
- 触发版本:`b0a7d2ce3b`(0.1.3-alpha.2+106);**最新 master `c389f96bf3` 该行仍未修**
- 打上本补丁后 `dsh web` 启动正常(本地已验证)

需要的话我可以直接提 PR;官方按自己喜欢的形态修掉这处也完全没问题。

discussions.title: [core/agent] 'compact' SessionStartSource is reserved but never emitted — no lifecycle signal for plugins to re-seed context after compaction
discussions.body:
Summary

`agent/session-start` is the documented extension point for seeding model-facingcontext (`agent.inject()` at session start). Its `SessionStartSource` type reservesa `'compact'` value, but compaction never re-fires `agent/session-start`, so a pluginwhose seeded context is later elided by compaction has **no clean lifecycle hook** tore-seed it. This is acknowledged in the maintainers' own Dev Note as pending work.

## Evidence (source, `0.1.2-rc.1`)

* `packages/core/agent/src/runtime-types.ts:69` — `export type SessionStartSource = 'startup' | 'resume' | 'clear' | 'compact'`.
* `packages/core/agent/README.md:179` (maintainers' Dev Note, non-authoritative) — *"the `SessionStartSource` values `'clear'`/`'compact'` are reserved with no emitter yet, pending the driving subsystems."*
* `agent/session-start` fires once, before the first turn, with `startup`/`resume` only (index.ts:181, runtime-types.ts:214-224).
* Compaction runs and *does* record the fact, but only as durable **session log events**: `session.append('compaction/start' | 'compaction/summary' | 'compaction/end', …)` (`packages/compaction/compaction-basic/src/region.ts:191,217,225`). These are log entries observed via `agent.session.snapshotEvents()`; they are **not** dispatched as an agent-subject lifecycle event (`emitAgentEvent`), so `ctx.on('agent/…')` listeners never see a "compaction finished" callback.
* Compaction is head-anchored (`selectCompactableRange` returns `{ start: surfaceNodes[0], … }`, region.ts:132-135), i.e. it elides from the **oldest** nodes forward — which is exactly where a session-start-injected context block sits. So a plugin's injected block is among the first things removed, with no re-injection notification.

## Why it matters

Any plugin that seeds persistent context at session start — memory / RAG / standinginstructions / background-knowledge injectors — silently loses that context once thesurface compacts, and has no supported trigger to restore it. This is a growing class:the platform's own `agent.inject()` seam is designed for exactly this seeding.

## Current workaround (plugin side)

Poll: on `agent/pre-step`, after `await next()`, test whether the seeded block is stillvisible on the agent surface (`agent.session.surface.nodes` / inbox / current-stepmessages); if not, re-`inject()` it. This works but is (a) O(steps) busywork, (b) apresence heuristic the plugin must reinvent, and (c) timing-sensitive to the waterfallorder relative to the compactor.

## Suggested directions (not prescriptive)

1. **Honor the reserved emission**: after a compaction transaction commits(`compaction/end` without error), re-emit `agent/session-start` with`source: 'compact'` for the affected agent. The enum value and the durable eventalready exist; this mostly wires the two.
2. **Or expose a dedicated agent-subject event** (e.g. `agent/compacted`) carrying the`compactionId` / the seq range removed, dispatched through `emitAgentEvent` so`ctx.on('agent/compacted', …)` listeners can react.
3. Either way, a short doc note pointing plugins at the intended re-seed hook wouldremove the need for the pre-step polling workaround.

## Environment

* `@deepseek-ai/dsh`: 0.1.2-rc.1
* OS: Windows 11 25H2, Node.js LTS
* Observed building a context-injection plugin against `agent/session-start` + `agent.inject()`; verified against `compaction-basic`.

## Note

Filed as an enhancement, not a defect — the platform behaves as currently documented(compaction records durable events; the `'compact'` source is explicitly reserved-not-implemented). The ask is a plugin-facing notification seam for an ecosystem need.

discussions.title: [docs] session.jsonl.zstd stores concatenated zstd frames; single-shot decompressors read only the first frame without error
discussions.body:
Observation

A persisted session file (`session.jsonl.zstd`) is written as a **sequence of zstdframes** (one frame appended per flush), not a single frame. This is valid per thezstd format (frames may be concatenated), and DSH's own reader handles it.

The friction is for **external tooling**: common one-shot decompressors decode only thefirst frame and **stop silently** — no error, no indication of trailing data. For exampleNode's `zlib.zstdDecompressSync()` (and libzstd's single-shot `ZSTD_decompress`) returnjust the first flush's bytes; a maintainer or third-party auditing/backup script thatassumes "one file = one frame" will read a truncated, seemingly-valid-but-mostly-emptysession with no warning. The streaming / CLI path (`zstd -d`, or a loop over frames)decodes all frames correctly.

## How it was discovered

While parsing a real session log externally, `zstdDecompressSync` yielded a single event.Scanning for the zstd magic `28 B5 2F FD` revealed multiple frame start offsets in thesame file; decompressing each frame's sub-array recovered the full event stream.

## Impact

* Third-party inspection, export, or backup tooling silently under-reads sessions.
* The failure is *silent* (valid output, wrong scope), which is the worst kind to debug.

## Suggested directions

1. A short doc note on the on-disk session format stating it is a **concatenated multi-frame zstd stream**, and that consumers must decode frame-by-frame (streaming decoderor a magic-offset loop), not one-shot.
2. Optional: mention the recommended decode approach for the two common ecosystems(Node `zlib` streaming, liblzma/libzstd CLI) so external tooling gets it right first try.

## Environment

* `@deepseek-ai/dsh`: 0.1.2-rc.1
* OS: Windows 11 25H2, Node.js LTS (no zstd CLI installed; used Node built-in zlib)

## Note

Filed as a documentation gap. No functional bug in DSH — the writer produces valid zstd;the ask is documenting the multi-frame layout so external consumers don't mis-read it.

discussions.title: [dx] Session event `.data` payload shape differs by role: user/message carries the message directly, assistant/message wraps it in {turn, step, message}
discussions.body:
Observation

Plugins reading the durable event log via `agent.session.snapshotEvents()` must handletwo different payload shapes for the two message roles:

* `user/message` → `event.data` **is** the `UserMessage` itself → content at`event.data.content`.
* `assistant/message` → `event.data` is a wrapper `{ turn, step, message }` → content at`event.data.message.content`.

So a consumer iterating over messages by role can't use one accessor; it must special-casethe role to know whether `.content` is one or two levels down.

## Why it's worth a note

It's a small, recurring papercut for anything walking the event log (memory/telemetry/export plugins). If the asymmetry is intentional (assistant messages carry `turn`/`step`for correlation while user messages don't need to), a one-line entry in the eventvocabulary doc would make it discoverable instead of something every plugin rediscovers.

## Suggested directions

1. Document the per-event `.data` shape in the event vocabulary (which events carry themessage inline vs. wrapped), **or**
2. If feasible without a breaking change, normalize toward one shape (e.g. always wrap)so `data.message.content` works uniformly.

## Environment

* `@deepseek-ai/dsh`: 0.1.2-rc.1
* Encountered consuming `snapshotEvents()` from an external plugin.

## Note

Likely by design (assistant needs turn/step correlation). Raised mainly fordocumentation/consistency; low priority — fine to close with a doc pointer.

discussions.title: Brazilian Portuguese (pt-BR) locale plugin
discussions.body:
Hi! Sharing a Brazilian Portuguese language pack I built for DeepSeek Harness, following the same pattern as `dsh-locale-ru`, `dsh-locale-vi`, and `@fang2hou/dsh-locale-ja`.

**Repo:** https://github.com/tonnymoura/dsh-locale-pt-br

**Install:**
```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:tonnymoura/dsh-locale-pt-br
```

Then pick **Português (Brasil)** in Settings → General → Language.

**Coverage:**
- 32 namespaces
- ~1048 strings translated
- Full web UI: sidebar, chat, settings, trajectory, plan, subagents, workflows, tools, approvals, feedback, commands, etc.

Building this only took mapping the shape of an existing locale plugin (`dsh-locale-ru`) and translating the strings — a testament to how clean the plugin model is. Feedback on translations welcome via issues on the plugin repo.

discussions.title: [Bug] Composition-adjacent events can slip past the guard within the old 10ms window
discussions.body:
While working in the Web input editor (packages/client/ui-conversation/src/client/input/editor/keymap.ts), I ran into a narrow timing issue in the IME composition guard, separate from the candidate-window bug discussed in #3504.

Environment

OS: Windows 11
Browser: Chrome
IME: Microsoft Pinyin

Issue

The composition guard was previously set to hold for 10ms after compositionend, based on the old textarea's proven window. In practice, some IME/browser combinations fire a trailing composition-adjacent event after compositionend but slightly later than 10ms out  long enough to slip past the guard and get misread as a normal (non-composition) key event. keyCode 229 is the legacy signal these engines emit without isComposing, so it doesn't help catch the straggler either.

Fix

Widened the guard window from 10ms to 100ms to cover this trailing-event case, and updated the inline comment to explain why:

diff
- * guard for 10ms more (the old textarea's proven window); keyCode
- * 229 is the legacy signal engines emit without isComposing.
+ * guard for 100ms more (widened from the old textarea's 10ms window  some
+ * IME/browser combos fire a trailing composition-adjacent event later than
+ * that); keyCode 229 is the legacy signal engines emit without isComposing.

One file changed, 8 additions / 3 deletions. Diff/commit here: johnernestfreeman-prog/deepseek-harness@98a24d2 (branch fix/ime-composition-grace-period).

I know external PRs aren't being accepted right now, so flagging this here per the contributing guidelines  happy to answer questions or test further if it'd help narrow this down alongside the #3504 investigation, though I believe they're separate root causes (that one's about composition never starting; this is about a straggler event after it correctly ends).

discussions.title: docs: document the closed forwarded-event surface for browser plugin halves (emit vs waterfall)
discussions.body:
## Summary

Out-of-tree ("bundle") plugins that ship a **browser half** have no documentation in the extension path (`docs/user/develop/*`, `docs/cookbook/*`) describing which Host events actually reach the browser, that the set is **closed**, and the emit-vs-waterfall semantic trap. The only source of truth is an internal package README (`packages/api/remotes/README.md` → `API_REMOTE_FORWARDED_EVENTS`), which is not discoverable from the authoring guides.

## Why it matters

We built a plugin whose browser half blinks the tab title when a workspace finishes / errors / waits for the user. Two of our first three attempts failed because the authoring docs do not state:

- Only `ctx.remote.$on(...)` events listed in `API_REMOTE_FORWARDED_EVENTS` (in `dsh-api-remotes`) reach the browser. A plugin **cannot** add a host→client channel (e.g. `ctx.emit('my-custom-event')` on the host is never forwarded) — that requires the internal Typert toolchain.
- `emit` events are broadcast to every listener; `waterfall` events (e.g. `user-questions/request`, `approval/request`) are single-consumer and claimed by the official answerers in registration order, so a passive observer can silently lose them.

## Suggested documentation

A page under `docs/user/develop/` (or the extension cookbook) titled roughly "Observing Host state from a browser plugin", covering:
1. The forwarded-event allowlist and where it lives (`packages/api/remotes`, `src/remote-events.ts`).
2. That the list is fixed per release — adding an event or a custom channel requires in-repo work / Typert tooling.
3. The `emit` vs `waterfall` delivery difference and its consequence for passive observers.
4. Payload shapes (they are declared in each owner package's client-safe `./types`, cross-linked).

## Environment

- Runtime `@deepseek-ai/dsh` 0.1.2-rc.1 (and current main at time of writing).

discussions.title: Proposal: document ctx.uiSession.pendingInteractions as the browser-side signal for pending user interactions
discussions.body:
## Summary

The only reliable browser-side signal for "a session is waiting on the user" (approval or user-question pending) is the **undocumented** `ctx.uiSession.pendingInteractions` projection (`dsh-client-ui-session`). Passive out-of-tree browser plugins cannot depend on the `user-questions/request` / `approval/request` waterfall events (see discussion on the closed forwarded-event surface https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/5897): they are single-consumer and claimed by the official answerers in registration order, and the forwarded request does not carry a stable agent/session identity.

## Observed facts

- `ctx.uiSession.pendingInteractions.getSnapshot()` returns `Map<sessionId, interaction>` where `interaction.kind` ∈ `approval` | `question` | `plan-review`, fed by the official UI answerers via `registerPendingInteraction(precedence)` while they wait for the user, and cleared when the interaction resolves. It is **not mentioned anywhere in `docs/`** (0 matches).
- Depending on an incidental UI service's internal projection is fragile for third parties and undocumented for everyone.

## Suggested behavior

Document `pendingInteractions` (and `subscribe`) as the supported observation point for pending user interactions on `dsh-client-ui-session`, ideally promoted to a stable contract:
- snapshot shape (`Map<sessionId, { kind: 'approval' | 'question' | 'plan-review', ... }>`)
- precedence rule (one entry per session, highest precedence wins)
- that entries clear when the user answers
- a `label`/human description helper would also help passive notifiers.

Alternatively/additionally expose a dedicated public event or projection so observers do not reach into a UI service.

## Motivation / affected users

Community plugin authors (topic `dsh-plugin`) building attention/notification/watchdog-style browser features. Concrete consumer: https://github.com/andreagosto/dsh-tab-watchdog.

discussions.title: Suggestion: out-of-tree 'browser-half bundle' template + guide for dsh-plugin authors
discussions.body:
## Summary

Providing an out-of-tree browser-half bundle is much harder than the authoring docs imply, and there is no template or guide to copy. `docs/cookbook/adding-a-settings-card.md` even states: *"No published preset exposes this package, so a package outside this repository has to reproduce the same output format itself."* The required format (`window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })` lazy-CJS factory that exports `{ name, inject, apply }`, served via a `./client` export + `dsh.client` manifest) is only discoverable from the internal `tsdown.client.ts` preset or by reading installed bundles.

## Motivation

- Community plugins (topic `dsh-plugin`) commonly need a browser half; without the monorepo toolchain, authors must reverse-engineer the artifact format by hand.
- Git-installed TypeScript plugins cannot build (no `prepare` runs), so the community needs a path that ships committed artifacts and a tiny reproducible build step.

## Suggested deliverables

A minimal, self-contained **out-of-tree template** plus a short guide (either in `docs/user/develop/` or a new `create-dsh-plugin` / template repo):
1. `package.json` with `dsh.bundle.patch` (`cordis.patch.yml`), `dsh.client.platform: "web"`, and a `./client` export.
2. A `scripts/build.mjs` that wraps a CJS source fragment into the `__ModuleLoader__.load` closure factory (committed `lib/client.js`, so git installs work with no `prepare`).
3. The minimal Host half (`index.js`) needed to make the package a Loader entry.
4. Validation/tests (structure + a light smoke test with a fake `ctx`).

Reference implementation to model on: https://github.com/andreagosto/dsh-tab-watchdog.

discussions.title: UX: dsh plugin add should point to corepack when pnpm is missing from PATH
discussions.body:
## Summary

`dsh plugin --profile <name> add <pkg>` fails with `dsh: pnpm not found on PATH — install pnpm to manage profile plugins` and stops. The recovery is not obvious and there is no guidance toward the zero-config path.

## Reproduction

On a machine with `corepack` available (bundled with modern Node) but no `pnpm` on `PATH`:

```sh
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh@latest plugin --profile web add ./my-plugin
```

## Current behavior

Prints `dsh: pnpm not found on PATH — install pnpm to manage profile plugins` and exits non-zero. A user must know to run `corepack enable` (or install pnpm globally) before retrying.

## Expected behavior

- Detect `corepack` and either use it automatically, or print the exact recovery command, e.g.: `pnpm not found on PATH — run "corepack enable" (or "npm i -g pnpm") then retry`.
- Bonus: include `corepack pnpm` resolution so the first `dsh plugin` run works out of the box on Node ≥ 22 with corepack available.

## Environment

- `@deepseek-ai/dsh` 0.1.2-rc.1 via `npx`, Linux, Node 24, corepack present but pnpm not on PATH.

discussions.title: dsh-tab-watchdog: blink the browser tab when a workspace finishes, errors, or waits on you
discussions.body:
**dsh-tab-watchdog** — blinks a 🟢/🟡 badge in the browser tab title when one of your workspaces finishes a work round, errors out, or is waiting for you.

Repo: https://github.com/andreagosto/dsh-tab-watchdog · Topics: `dsh-plugin` · MIT

## What it does

While you work in another browser tab, DeepSeek Harness Web keeps running agents in multiple sessions. dsh-tab-watchdog watches them and makes the **tab title blink** so you notice when something needs you:

- 🟢 session **finished a round** (`api-session/status`)
- 🟡 session **errored** (`api-session/error`)
- 🟡 session is **waiting for your input/approval** (questions, approvals, plan reviews)

No favicon/theme-color games, no audio, no UI added to the harness — just the title alternating like `🟢2 🟡1 · DeepSeek Harness`.

## Why it's interesting for plugin authors

It's a **persistent two-half profile bundle** (Host + browser) built **entirely out-of-tree** — no monorepo toolchain:

- `dsh.bundle.patch` + `cordis.patch.yml` for the Host row
- browser half as a hand-built `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })` artifact (committed `lib/client.js`), generated from a CJS source by a tiny `scripts/build.mjs` — so **git installs work with no `prepare`**
- green/errors via the forwarded `emit` events (`ctx.remote.$on`)
- questions/approvals via the (undocumented) `ctx.uiSession.pendingInteractions` projection — because the `user-questions/request` / `approval/request` **waterfall** events are single-consumer and claimed by the official answerers

Building it surfaced a few docs/tooling gaps, posted here:
- [#5897](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/5897) forwarded-event surface for browser halves (emit vs waterfall)
- [#5898](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/5898) `ctx.uiSession.pendingInteractions`
- [#5899](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/5899) out-of-tree browser-half bundle template

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:andreagosto/dsh-tab-watchdog
```

then restart `dsh web`. Remove with `dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-tab-watchdog`.

Feedback welcome — issues/PRs on the repo.

discussions.title: dsh web crash: uncaught ENOENT in dsh-subprocess-local spillAll kills the whole server when the spill dir vanishes
workflow schema agents: offer one in-session corrective turn when the final message never calls structured_output (run is discarded today)
discussions.body:
## Context

The `workflow` tool's `agent(prompt, { schema })` hook runs a one-shot child whose final value is captured via the child-scoped `structured_output` tool (`attachStructuredRuntime` in `dsh-subagent-in-process-driver`). In `dsh-workflow-worker-thread`'s worker (`worker.cjs`), when the child run ends with `stopReason === "completed"` but `result.structured === void 0` (the model finished without ever calling `structured_output`), the worker returns `null` — a failed result with no retry and no signal beyond the null.

## Problem

This discards the entire child run even when the child did all of its real work. In production we drive deterministic multi-stage engineering pipelines (schema-validated stage agents with 50–200 tool calls per stage) through the workflow tool. With thinking-capable models served behind Anthropic-protocol gateways, long agentic chains occasionally end with a **thinking-only final response** — the gateway injects a placeholder text block to keep the protocol shape valid, the final assistant message is plain text, `structured` stays `undefined`, and the worker nulls the run. The orchestrator's only recourse is a full stage re-run (fresh child, all work redone).

Measured impact in our setup: re-runs caused by this failure mode accounted for roughly half of total orchestration wall time in a ~2-hour pipeline (two full IMPLEMENT re-runs in one run; the same death mode also hit other stages).

Note the asymmetry: when the model *does* call `structured_output` with invalid arguments, `ToolArgsError` surfaces validation violations and the agent loop self-corrects in-session. The only unrecoverable gap is "never called the tool at all" — which is precisely the case where all completed work is thrown away.

## Proposed fix

When `opts.schema !== void 0 && result.structured === void 0 && result.stopReason === "completed"` (run not cancelled, child still disposable): instead of returning `null` immediately, append **one** corrective user turn to the same child run/session, e.g.

> Your final answer must be reported by calling the `structured_output` tool. Re-submit your final result now as a single `structured_output` tool call. Do not redo any work and do not add explanations.

Then re-check the captured value; if still missing (cap of 1 corrective turn), fall back to today's `null` behavior. The child session already holds the full context, so the corrective turn is one cheap model call versus a complete stage re-run.

A lighter-weight alternative: expose a per-call knob (e.g. `agent(prompt, { schema, structuredRetry: 1 })`, default 0 = current behavior) so orchestrators opt in.

## Environment

- dsh 0.1.2-rc.1 (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-workflow-worker-thread`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent-in-process-driver`)
- Happy to provide anonymized orchestration traces if useful.

discussions.title: 建议在子 Agent 调用卡片和列表中显示实际生效的模型及推理强度
discussions.body:
使用 dsh 调用子 Agent 时，希望能直接看到每个子 Agent 实际使用的模型和推理强度。目前启动提示中缺少这些信息，尤其在子 Agent 继承父 Agent 设置、使用预设或提供方默认值时，很难确认最终生效的配置。

本地检查版本为 `@deepseek-ai/dsh 0.1.2-rc.1`。该版本的 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent` 已支持 `provider、model、reasoning_effort` 参数，但启动结果的文本渲染仅显示 `started subagent <id>` 或 `started background subagent job <id>`，没有附带模型和推理强度。本反馈基于该本地版本，尚未验证后续版本是否已有改进。

建议：

- 在子 Agent 启动/调用卡片和 Agent 列表中增加简洁的模型与推理强度标注，例如：代码审查 · provider/model · reasoning: high。
- 展示运行时解析后的实际生效配置，而不仅是工具调用中显式传入的参数，覆盖继承、预设和默认值的情况。
- 推理强度无法解析为具体值时显示“提供方默认”或“未知”，明确不支持时显示“不适用”，避免空白或猜测。
- 将这些信息保留在执行记录中，便于任务完成后回看。

这能帮助用户确认模型路由是否符合预期，并辅助排查子 Agent 的输出质量、耗时和成本差异。在多个子 Agent 使用不同模型或推理强度时尤其有用。

discussions.title: [Bug] A misbehaving MCP server can hang the app forever while listing its tools
discussions.body:
## EN / English
*Found earlier in our daily usage; re-verified against the current npm line (through `0.1.3-alpha.2`) before posting — still present. We publish one topic per report so each can be tracked independently; more findings will follow in the same form.*

*Authorship note: reproduced and documented by me in real-world usage; root-cause tracing and drafting assisted by AI; verification and publication by me. I have no engineering background — if any technical claim reads wrong, please call it out; I will re-verify against the toolchain and correct.*

### Summary

When the harness connects to / re-syncs an MCP server, `syncTools` drains `tools/list` pagination through a `do … while (cursor)` loop whose **only** exit is an externally-supplied, untrusted `nextCursor`. There is no page-count cap, no cursor-progress check, and no aggregate deadline — so a server that never converges pagination can spin the loop indefinitely, or (emitting distinct tool names per page) grow the definitions map until the whole process is OOM-killed, taking every session down with it.

### Trigger condition

Any MCP server whose `tools/list` does not terminate pagination:

- echoes a truthy `nextCursor` forever, or
- returns ever-new cursors, or
- emits **distinct tool names per page** (unbounded `definitions` growth → OOM), or
- returns **duplicate** tool names — which does *not* terminate gracefully either: it throws `"listed tool more than once — invalid tool list"` and fails the whole sync. That failure mode itself proves the loop has **no self-bound**: termination depends entirely on an untrusted server honoring the pagination contract.

### Impact scope (production focus)

The MCP bridge is **process-wide**. One misbehaving third-party server (a buggy integration, a misconfigured self-hosted server, or a hostile one) can either spin the loop indefinitely (CPU) or, with growing distinct names, exhaust memory and **OOM-kill the entire harness process — killing every session, including unrelated long-running agents.** This is a robustness defect on untrusted input, not a security boundary: any deployment that integrates external MCP servers is exposed.

### Repro

1. Point an MCP server config at a server whose `tools/list` returns a truthy `nextCursor` forever (emitting distinct tool names per page, or simply never terminating).
2. Let the harness connect / sync that server.
3. Observe: the loop never returns; with distinct names, resident memory grows without limit; eventually the process is OOM-killed.

### Environment

- Engine: `@deepseek-ai/dsh` `0.1.0-rc.6` / `0.1.0-rc.7`
- Also verified on: `@deepseek-ai/dsh` `0.1.1-rc.2`
- Module: `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client`
- Scenario: any MCP server that does not terminate `tools/list` pagination

---

*Detailed evidence chain (source lines) and the root-cause analysis + proposed fix follow in the comments below.*

*Reported by the **OfferKuai Team** — Founder: **Zhaofeng (Yaming)**. Website: https://www.offerkuai.com/ | Contact: contact@offerkuai.com*

---

## 中文版 / ZH

*此为我们在日常使用中较早发现的问题，发布前已对照 npm 最新线（至 0.1.3-alpha.2）复核，确认仍存在。我们按"一帖一主题"发布以便独立跟踪，后续发现也将以同样形式陆续发出。*

*协作说明：本文由我在真实使用中复现并记录；根因与成文由 AI 协助完成，我负责校验与发布。我非工程背景，技术表述如有错误，欢迎指出——我会回去用工具链重新验证后更正。*

### 摘要

当 harness 连接 / 重新同步某个 MCP server 时，`syncTools` 通过 `do … while (cursor)` 循环拉取 `tools/list` 分页，而循环的**唯一**出口是外部提供的、不可信的 `nextCursor`。这里没有页数上限、没有 cursor 前进校验、也没有聚合超时——因此一个永不收敛分页的 server 可以让循环无限旋转；若它每页放出不同的工具名，`definitions` 映射会无界增长，直到整个进程被 OOM 杀掉，连带拖垮所有会话。

### 触发条件

任何 `tools/list` 不终止分页的 MCP server：

- 永远回显真值 `nextCursor`，或
- 不断返回新 cursor，或
- **每页放出不同的工具名**（`definitions` 无界增长 → OOM），或
- 返回**重复**工具名——这也不会优雅终止：它会抛 `"listed tool more than once — invalid tool list"` 并使整个同步失败。这个失败模式本身就证明循环**毫无自我约束**：是否终止完全依赖不可信的 server 遵守分页契约。

### 影响范围（生产视角）

MCP 桥接是**进程级**的。一个行为异常的第三方 server（有 bug 的集成、配置错误的自托管 server，或恶意的）既可以让循环无限旋转（CPU），也可以在工具名持续增长时耗尽内存、**OOM 杀掉整个 harness 进程——连带杀掉所有会话，包括无关的长跑 agent**。这是针对不可信输入的健壮性缺陷，而非安全边界问题：任何集成了外部 MCP server 的部署都暴露在此风险下。

### 复现步骤

1. 将一个 MCP server 配置指向这样一个 server：其 `tools/list` 永远返回真值 `nextCursor`（每页放出不同工具名，或干脆永不终止）。
2. 让 harness 连接 / 同步该 server。
3. 观察：循环永不返回；若工具名不同，常驻内存无界增长；最终进程被 OOM 杀掉。

### 环境

- 引擎：`@deepseek-ai/dsh` `0.1.0-rc.6` / `0.1.0-rc.7`
- 另已在：`@deepseek-ai/dsh` `0.1.1-rc.2` 上验证
- 模块：`@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client`
- 场景：任何不终止 `tools/list` 分页的 MCP server

---

*完整证据链（源码行号）、根因分析与建议修复见下方跟帖。*

*本报告由 **OfferKuai（Offer快）团队**提交 —— 创始人：**Zhaofeng（Yaming）**。官网：https://www.offerkuai.com/ | 联系：contact@offerkuai.com*

---

discussions.title: Feature request: enable K3 deferred tool loading — offer deferredToolsMode + implement defer orchestration
discussions.body:
pi-ai already ships full consumer-side support for deferred tools (openai-completions.js:611 reads compat.deferredToolsMode==="kimi" → getDeferredToolNames from toolResult.addedToolNames; utils/deferred-tools.js, anthropic-messages.js:839, utils/estimate.js:99 all consume it; moonshotai.json declares deferredToolsMode:"kimi" for kimi-k3). Kimi K3 is currently the only model with official dynamic tool loading (K2.6 fails with tokenization errors).

Two walls on the dsh side prevent using it:

1. `dsh-llm-pi-ai/lib/index.js:390` lists `deferredToolsMode: "withhold"` only, and `resolveModelCompat` (L586-600) calls invalid() on model-level values not offered — so writing `deferredToolsMode: kimi` in a profile fails parsing at load time.
2. dsh has zero producers of `addedToolNames` — no tool ever gets marked deferred.

Request: offer `deferredToolsMode` in the compat gate (values none|kimi) and implement defer orchestration (marking selected tools as deferred and accumulating addedToolNames on tool results). This enables "52 tools → load-on-demand" with zero protocol cost, and pairs well with the existing tool-presentation work.

discussions.title: Bug: Chat view freezes after loading earlier history — root cause found, fix branch ready
discussions.body:
## Symptom

In the Web UI, opening a long session and clicking **Load earlier** can freeze the Chat view:

- the prepended history never renders, yet the paging button disappears as if history were complete;
- the Turn-process fold control (`N tool calls · M messages`) appears, but toggling it only changes row spacing — member rows never hide.

## Root cause

Traced with a live DOM inspection against the affected session:

1. After a prepend, `replayDependencies` replays `request-prompt`'s `start()` because its predecessor resolution changed, flipping `showsPrompt` to false.
2. `buildViewNode` then returned `null` for an already materialized `system-prompt` node, tripping the assembler's materialized-target contract: `conversation Definition "request-prompt" withdrew materialized target "chat"` (visible in the browser console).
3. That throw aborts the whole projection flush, while the event window (including `hasMore`) had already committed — so every later flush re-throws on the same Context and the view stays frozen. The fold control's member hiding rides the same stuck projection, which is why only the store-driven chrome (chevron, spacing) still responded.

## Fix

Ready on a fork branch: [`northwang-lucky:fix/chat-request-prompt-prepend-withdraw`](https://github.com/northwang-lucky/deepseek-harness/tree/fix/chat-request-prompt-prepend-withdraw) (commit `988368d6`).

- `request-prompt` keeps a materialized node mounted with `visibility: 'hidden'` instead of withdrawing it (same precedent as `assistant.ts`).
- The assembler isolates per-Context failures in all four build loops: a throwing or withdrawing Definition is reported and skipped, previously published nodes and Location data are preserved, and siblings keep publishing. The withdrawal violation becomes a report (keeping the contract guidance) rather than a fatal throw.
- A full audit found `request-prompt` to be the only Definition with a withdraw-after-materialize path.
- Tests: the prepend-flip case for `request-prompt`, plus failure-isolation cases for both build paths and both Location-data paths; `test:gui` green, and the recorded-session web replay suite passes.

Happy to open this as a PR if a maintainer can enable that path for my account (`CreatePullRequest` is currently denied), or feel free to pick the branch directly.

## Demo

Recorded from a real server booted from the fix branch, serving a byte copy of the affected session: history loads fully (turns 1–15 render) and the fold expands/collapses its member rows correctly.

![Load earlier recovers and the Turn-process fold toggles member rows](https://github.com/northwang-lucky/deepseek-harness/blob/fix-request-prompt-prepend-assets/request-prompt-prepend-fix.gif?raw=true)

discussions.title: 给 #14 补点料：两个现成记忆实现里踩过的坑
discussions.body:
看到 #14 在求 memory 方案，正好最近把两个带生产记忆的 agent 项目读了一遍（deer-flow 和腾讯的 TencentDB-Agent-Memory），说几个我印象深的点，给想实现的人省点弯路。

第一个是删除 agent 后记忆还在偷偷写。deer-flow 就踩过（issue #5037）：缓冲的抽取任务挂在全局，agent 都删了，防抖定时器到点照样把记忆写回去。他们后来加的是按 agent 取消。另一个是清空记忆和写入赛跑（#5093），也修了两轮才稳。腾讯那边踩的坑是写入粒度：Codex 一轮任务里同一个用户消息被写了 8 次（#1245），因为归档钩子挂在每个请求流的尾巴上，而 Codex 每轮工具循环都会重发历史——请求级写入、任务级语义，不事前定死事后补去重特别痛。

两家互不认识却踩了几乎同一批坑，所以我觉得这些大概率是躲不掉的坑而不是实现问题。对 DSH 来说最顺的路可能是把 memory 做成一个插件挂进 agent scope（随 agent 一起卸载，生命周期问题直接没了），后端做成可插拔的——真要把 codex/claude code 的记忆迁过来，写个 import 后端就行。

具体代码位置和 issue 都可以点进去看，我就不贴一堆了。有没有人已经在搞这块的，想拉个群聊聊。

discussions.title: [Bug] Broken sessions and v0→v1→v2 Migration Failure / 会话损坏及 v0→v1→v2 迁移失败
discussions.body:
# Duplicate Tool‑Call IDs Break Session Loading (blank session) and cause migration v0→v1→v2 failures

会话工具调用 ID 重复：导致会话加载失败（会话空白）并引发 v0→v1→v2 迁移失败

- **Anchored head (锚定版本):** `c389f96bf3` (= `origin/master`)
- **Reproduced on (复现环境):** Windows / Node 24, `dsh --profile web`, local OpenAI-compatible Responses server (llama.cpp-class)
- **Severity (严重性):** High — published sessions either cannot open or open with a blank conversation（高——已发布会话要么无法打开，要么打开后对话内容整段空白）
- **Status (状态):** Draft, not yet filed（草稿，尚未提交）

## Summary

A local OpenAI-compatible Responses server (llama.cpp-class) re-emits the **same** `call_id` and `id` pair for multiple output items **within one assistant response**. The pi-ai adapter composes the tool-call id as `` `${call_id}|${id}` `` (shaped like `call_<token>|fc_<token>`) **without de-duplication**, and this repo's pi-ai adapter layer (`packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/src/stream.ts:188,200`) passes the id through verbatim. A single assistant response therefore yields **duplicated tool-call ids**, which are persisted into the v0 session log — the v0 format enforces **no** uniqueness on tool-call ids at write time, so the corrupt data is written.

The read side, however, treats a repeated advertised tool call as a **hard error**. Once persisted, the corrupt data sits **dormant in the log file** — no fresh model output is needed: for a v2 session, **simply reopening it** trips the failure. The same corrupt data therefore trips **two different failures on two different read paths**:

1. **Mode A (v0 files):** the **v0→v1 migration refuses the whole session at load time** — the session cannot open. This was the original encounter.
2. **Mode B (v2 files):** the host restores the session fine, but the **web client's `ConversationNodeAssembler` throws** `received more than one start Match` — the entire conversation is blank and "Load earlier" is wedged. This is the current case.

<details><summary>中文摘要 (Chinese summary)</summary>

本地 OpenAI 兼容 Responses 服务器（llama.cpp 级别）会在**同一个 assistant 响应**内为多个输出项重新发出**相同的** `call_id` 与 `id` 组合。pi-ai 适配器把工具调用 ID 组合为 `` `${call_id}|${id}` ``（形如 `call_<token>|fc_<token>`），且**不做去重**；本仓库的 pi-ai 适配层（`packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/src/stream.ts:188,200`）原样透传该 ID。于是同一次 assistant 响应里就出现了**重复的工具调用 ID**，并随 v0 会话日志落盘——v0 格式在写入侧对工具调用 ID **没有任何唯一性约束**，脏数据得以落盘。

但读取侧把"重复的已通告工具调用"当作**硬错误**。一旦落盘，脏数据便**潜伏在日志文件中**——无需新的模型输出：对 v2 会话，**仅重新打开**即会触发失效。于是同一份脏数据在两条不同的读取路径上分别触发两种失效模式：

1. **失效模式 A（v0 文件）**：**v0→v1 迁移在加载时拒绝整个会话**——会话打不开。这是最初遇到的问题。
2. **失效模式 B（v2 文件）**：主机侧能正常恢复会话，但 **Web 客户端的 `ConversationNodeAssembler` 抛出** `received more than one start Match`——对话内容整段空白，"Load earlier" 卡死。这是当前遇到的情况。

</details>

## Failure modes

### Mode A: v0 files — the v0→v1 migration refuses the whole session at load time

The v0→v1 migration reuses the released validator `assertReleasedArtifactRelationships`. When it sees a `tool-call` block id in an `assistant/message` that was **already advertised**, it throws, and the entire migration — therefore the session load — fails:

- Throw site: `packages/session/session-format-v0-to-v1/src/relationships.ts:140`
  ```
  throw new SessionFormatError(`assistant/message repeats advertised tool call ${callId}`)
  ```
- Related invariants in the same file: `tool/call ... does not match one advertised tool call` (`:156`), `tool/result ... has no advertised tool lifecycle` (`:171`), `assertNoUnresolvedTools` (`:375`).

**Symptom:** the session **cannot open at all**. Driving the exact product chain (v0→v1→v2 + restore) over a dirty v0 file fails with `assistant/message repeats advertised tool call <id>`. This was the original encounter.

<details><summary>中文：失效模式 A</summary>

v0→v1 迁移复用已发布的校验器 `assertReleasedArtifactRelationships`。当它在 `assistant/message` 中遇到一个**已经通告过的** `tool-call` 块 ID 时直接抛出，整个迁移——因此整个会话加载——失败：

- 抛出点：`packages/session/session-format-v0-to-v1/src/relationships.ts:140`
  ```
  throw new SessionFormatError(`assistant/message repeats advertised tool call ${callId}`)
  ```
- 同一文件中的相关不变量：`tool/call ... does not match one advertised tool call`（`:156`）、`tool/result ... has no advertised tool lifecycle`（`:171`）、`assertNoUnresolvedTools`（`:375`）。

**症状**：会话**完全无法打开**。对产品真实使用的完整链（v0→v1→v2 + restore）跑一个带脏数据的 v0 文件，得到 `assistant/message repeats advertised tool call <id>`。这是最初遇到的失效模式。

</details>

### Mode B: v2 files — host restores fine; the web client blanks the conversation

A session that is already **v2** (e.g. `81570fca`: 1236 events, containing all 45 duplicated-id groups) does **not** traverse the v0→v1 / v1→v2 edges. The production read path uses `validation: 'transformed'` (`packages/session/session-persistence-jsonl/src/index.ts:276-280`), which is **tolerant** of duplicate ids, so the **host-side restore succeeds** (~22 ms, measured with the production `createRestore` at `validation:'transformed'`). But the web client's `ConversationNodeAssembler` throws when one conversation context receives **two `start` Matches**:

- Throw sites: `packages/client/ui-conversation/src/client/conversation/assembler.ts:513` and `:569`
  ```
  throw new Error(`conversation Context ${key} received more than one start Match`)
  ```

**Symptom:** the session "opens" but the **conversation is entirely blank**, with only a "Load earlier" button. Clicking it re-runs the assembler via `prepend`, re-throws the same error, re-enables the button, and **no content ever appears**.

<details><summary>中文：失效模式 B</summary>

已经是 **v2** 的会话（例如 `81570fca`：1236 事件，含全部 45 组重复 ID）**不走** v0→v1 / v1→v2 迁移边。生产读取路径使用 `validation: 'transformed'`（`packages/session/session-persistence-jsonl/src/index.ts:276-280`），它对重复 ID **宽容**，因此**主机侧恢复成功**（用生产 `createRestore`、`validation:'transformed'` 实测 ~22 ms）。但 Web 客户端的 `ConversationNodeAssembler` 对同一个上下文收到**两个 `start` Match** 时抛出：

- 抛出点：`packages/client/ui-conversation/src/client/conversation/assembler.ts:513` 与 `:569`
  ```
  throw new Error(`conversation Context ${key} received more than one start Match`)
  ```

**症状**：会话能"打开"，但**对话内容整段空白**，只剩 "Load earlier" 按钮；点击它走 `prepend` 重新执行装配器，再次抛出同一错误，按钮复位，但**始终没有内容出现**。

</details>

## Data shape (shared by both modes)

- Tool-call ids are shaped `call_<token>|fc_<token>` (composed from the Responses stream's `call_id` and `id`).
- Each duplicated id occurs **exactly twice**, within a **single step/turn**.
- One execution appears once on each of **four surfaces**: the `assistant/message` content block, `tool/call`, `tool/result` (`message.source.callId` and `message.content[0].toolCallId`), and `assistant/chunk` (the tool-call block's deltas and block-end).

<details><summary>中文：数据形态（两种模式共用）</summary>

- 工具调用 ID 形如 `call_<token>|fc_<token>`（由 Responses 流的 `call_id` 与 `id` 组合）。
- 每组重复 ID **恰好出现 2 次**，且出现在**同一个 step / turn 内**。
- 一次执行在**四个表面**各出现一次：`assistant/message` 的 content 块、`tool/call`、`tool/result`（`message.source.callId` 与 `message.content[0].toolCallId`）、`assistant/chunk`（tool-call 块的 delta 与 block-end）。

</details>

## Root cause

1. **Origin:** a local OpenAI-compatible Responses server (llama.cpp-class) re-emits the **same** `call_id`+`id` for multiple output items **within one assistant response**.
2. **No de-dup on composition:** pi-ai composes the id as `` `${call_id}|${id}` `` without a uniqueness check; this repo's `packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/src/stream.ts:188,200` passes `event.toolCall.id` / `known?.id` through verbatim.
3. **No write-side constraint:** the v0 format enforces **no** tool-call-id uniqueness at write time, so the corrupt data is persisted.
4. **Hard read-side validation:** the released validator treats a "repeated advertised tool call" as an invariant violation (`relationships.ts:140`). That invariant is enforced on the **read** side but never on the **write** side — the asymmetry is the root cause that lets the corruption be produced and later refused.
5. **No client degradation:** `ConversationNodeAssembler` throws on "one context, multiple starts" (`assembler.ts:513/569`) with no graceful path, blanking the whole conversation instead of skipping the corrupt block.

<details><summary>中文：根因分析</summary>

1. **来源**：本地 OpenAI 兼容 Responses 服务器（llama.cpp 级别）在**同一个 assistant 响应**中为多个输出项重新发出**相同的** `call_id`+`id`。
2. **组合无去重**：pi-ai 把工具调用 ID 组合为 `` `${call_id}|${id}` ``，不检查唯一性；本仓库 `packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/src/stream.ts:188,200` 直接透传 `event.toolCall.id` / `known?.id`，无去重。
3. **写入侧无约束**：v0 格式在写入时**不强制**工具调用 ID 唯一，脏数据得以落盘。
4. **读取侧硬校验**：已发布校验器把"重复的已通告工具调用"当作不变量违例抛出（`relationships.ts:140`）。该不变量在**读取侧**被强制，却在**写入侧**从未被强制——两侧不对称，正是脏数据能够产生并被后续拒绝的根本原因。
5. **客户端无降级**：`ConversationNodeAssembler` 对"一个上下文多个 start"直接抛错（`assembler.ts:513/569`），没有降级路径，导致整段会话空白而非仅跳过脏块。

</details>

## Evidence

| Fact (事实) | Location / command (位置 / 命令) |
|---|---|
| v0→v1 refuses the whole session（v0→v1 拒绝整个会话） | `packages/session/session-format-v0-to-v1/src/relationships.ts:140`; the full v0→v1→v2 + restore chain prints `MIGRATE_REFUSED` |
| v2 session restores host-side in ~22 ms（v2 会话主机侧 ~22 ms 恢复成功） | production `createRestore`, `validation:'transformed'` |
| Production read config tolerates duplicates（生产读取配置宽容重复） | `packages/session/session-persistence-jsonl/src/index.ts:276-280` (`recovery:'recoverable'`, `validation:'transformed'`) |
| Client assembler throws（客户端装配抛错） | `packages/client/ui-conversation/src/client/conversation/assembler.ts:513,569` |
| pi-ai passes ids through, no de-dup（pi-ai 透传 ID，无去重） | `packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/src/stream.ts:188,200` |
| Current sample（当前样本） | `81570fca`: v2, 1236 events, 45 duplicated-id groups, each exactly twice（45 组重复 ID，每组恰好 2 次） |

## Interim workaround (pure id-rename) — sidesteps the issue, does not fix it

A one-shot repair of an affected session is a **pure id-rename**, and it is easy to replicate by hand or script:

- For each duplicated id, **keep the first** execution under its original id and give **each later execution** a fresh, unique id.
- The rename must stay *pure* — rename only, never insert or delete events — so `seq` remains dense and every `sourceEventSeqs` / `surfaceOp` reference stays valid.
- Apply it in lock-step across the **four surfaces** that carry one execution (the `assistant/message` content block, `tool/call`, `tool/result`, and the `assistant/chunk` deltas) within one (turn, step, id) group, mirroring the v1→v2 `BlockAssembler` chunk mapping.
- Re-encode with the repo's own codec and re-run the full v0→v1→v2 + restore chain to confirm the session loads.

This **sidesteps** the issue (the ids no longer collide) but does **not** fix the root cause (the writer can still emit duplicate ids).

<details><summary>中文：临时修复（纯重命名，绕过而非修复）</summary>

对受影响会话的一次性修复是一次**纯 ID 重命名**，手工或写脚本都很容易复现：

- 对每个重复 ID，**保留首次执行**的原 ID，给**后续每次执行**分配一个全新的唯一 ID。
- 重命名必须保持*纯*的——只改名，不插入/删除任何事件——这样 `seq` 保持稠密，所有 `sourceEventSeqs` / `surfaceOp` 引用保持有效。
- 在一个 (turn, step, id) 组内，对承载一次执行的**四个表面**（`assistant/message` 的 content 块、`tool/call`、`tool/result`、`assistant/chunk` 的 delta）同步重命名，镜像 v1→v2 `BlockAssembler` 的 chunk 映射。
- 用仓库自身编解码器重新编码，再走完整 v0→v1→v2 + restore 链确认可加载。

该做法**规避**了问题（重复 ID 不再冲突），但**不**触及根因（写入侧仍会产生重复 ID）。

</details>

## Suggested fixes

1. **Enforce uniqueness at write time (the fix):** in the pi-ai adapter or the session writer, de-duplicate / remap tool-call ids that repeat within a step, so the corruption cannot be persisted.
2. **Read-side recovery (optional, alongside 1):** let migration/assembly take a recoverable path for "duplicated but resolvable" ids instead of refusing the whole session or blanking the whole conversation.
3. **Graceful client degradation:** on "one context, multiple starts", `ConversationNodeAssembler` should log and skip the corrupt block rather than throw and blank the entire conversation.

<details><summary>中文：建议的修复方向</summary>

1. **写入侧强制唯一（治本）**：在 pi-ai 适配层或会话写入器中，对同一步骤内重复的工具调用 ID 去重 / 重映射，使脏数据无法落盘。
2. **读取侧降级或显式恢复（可选，配合 1）**：让迁移/装配对"重复但可解析"的 ID 采用可恢复策略，而非整体拒绝或整段空白。
3. **客户端优雅降级**：`ConversationNodeAssembler` 遇到"一个上下文多个 start"时记录并跳过脏块，而不是抛出导致整段会话空白。

</details>

## Related reports & upstream status

The same root cause — model/provider-issued tool-call ids are **not unique** — already surfaces in other discussions; this report is a **different surface** (the migration / read-side acceptance condition):

- [#5732](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/5732) — a strict provider returns 400 when replaying sessions with duplicated ids.
- [#5884](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/5884) / [#4501](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/4501) / [#5296](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/5296) — the client `ConversationNodeAssembler` `received more than one start Match` wedge (Mode B above).
- ⚠ **Severity increased on current master.** `46196d6f95` ("perf(session-format): stream released v0-to-v2 migrations", in `0.1.3-alpha.2`) removed the `'target'` validation mode, so `assertReleasedArtifactRelationships` now also runs on `'current'` restoration — meaning migrated input *and* strict-current verification (worker / fixture) refuse these logs, not only the v0→v1 edge. Production daily reads still use `validation: 'transformed'` and load fine.
- A precedent for this class of fix already exists: `ReleasedRelationshipExtensions.legacyInterruptedTurnRestart` (`relationships.ts:38,82`) explicitly admits a released-writer pattern the validator would otherwise reject.

<details><summary>中文：相关报告与上游状态</summary>

同一根因——模型/服务方产出的工具调用 ID **不唯一**——在以下讨论中已有其他表现面；本报告是**不同的表现面**（迁移 / 读取侧的接受条件）：

- #5732 — 严格 provider 在回放含重复 ID 的会话时返回 400。
- #5884 / #4501 / #5296 — 客户端 `ConversationNodeAssembler` 抛出 `received more than one start Match` 的卡死（即上文失效模式 B）。
- ⚠ **当前 master 上严重度上升。** `46196d6f95`（"perf(session-format): stream released v0-to-v2 migrations"，含于 `0.1.3-alpha.2`）移除了 `'target'` 校验模式，`assertReleasedArtifactRelationships` 现在也会在 `'current'` 恢复时执行——因此迁移输入与"严格 current 校验"（worker / fixture 验证）都会拒绝此类日志，而非仅 v0→v1 一条边。生产日常读取仍走 `validation: 'transformed'`，会话本身仍可打开。
- 此类修复在代码库中已有先例：`ReleasedRelationshipExtensions.legacyInterruptedTurnRestart`（`relationships.ts:38,82`）显式放行了一种否则会被校验器拒绝的已发布写入端模式。

</details>

discussions.title: [Bug] Commands/list Flood Pins CPU / 自持式 commands/list 洪泛占满 CPU
discussions.body:
# Web client drives a `commands/list` request storm: ~55 req/s self-sustaining flood pins ~1 CPU core and wedges "Load earlier"

Web 客户端 `commands/list` 请求风暴：~55 req/s 自持重试，占满约一个 CPU 核并使 "Load earlier" 永久卡死

- **Anchored head (锚定版本):** `c389f96bf3` (= `origin/master`)
- **Reproduced on (复现环境):** Windows / Node 24, `dsh --profile web --port 3081` (isolated `DSH_HOME` copy), **any** session — including a healthy one（**任意**会话，含健康会话）
- **Severity (严重性):** High — every open session continuously burns ~1 CPU core; paged history loading can never complete（高——每个打开的会话持续烧掉约一个 CPU 核；分页加载历史永远无法完成）
- **Status (状态):** Draft, not yet filed（草稿，尚未提交）

## Summary

The web client drives a **self-sustaining request storm** on `POST /api/commands/list`: **2000** requests in 36.2 s (**~55 req/s**), of which only **442** returned 200. The rest failed with no status because the browser's per-host connection pool was exhausted (`net::ERR_INSUFFICIENT_RESOURCES` / `net::ERR_NETWORK_CHANGED` in the console). The storm is **independent of session data** — it reproduces identically on a **healthy** session.

Causality was proven **decisively** by interception: routing `commands/list` to be **aborted before reaching the server** dropped host-process CPU from **~1.08 core to 0.00**, and **even while every request was being aborted** the client still fired **1620** requests in 12 s. A second interception — **forcing every `commands/list` answer to `ok:true`** (empty catalog) — **does not stop the storm** (~57 req/s sustained), and a request-initiator trace shows **every fetch is initiated by one `commands/change` broadcast** delivered on the remote-event stream. That is a **client loop re-triggered by host-side `commands/change` broadcasts, whether the request succeeds, fails, or never leaves the browser** — not a host infinite loop, not a controlled poll, and not a failure-driven retry.

This single loop explains both symptoms:

1. **CPU burn (Mode A):** ~50 req/s × per-request host async I/O pins one **libuv pool thread** at ~1 core (main thread idle, zero `Worker`s spawned, no disk I/O churn, flat RSS).
2. **"Load earlier" hangs forever (Mode B):** the flood saturates the browser's per-host connection pool, so the `events.prepend` request that "Load earlier" issues **never gets a connection slot** and the UI stays on "Loading…".

<details><summary>中文摘要 (Chinese summary)</summary>

Web 客户端对 `POST /api/commands/list` 发起**自持的请求风暴**：36.2 秒内发出 **2000** 个请求（**~55 req/s**），其中仅 **442** 个返回 200，其余因浏览器同主机连接池耗尽而失败（无状态码；控制台出现 `net::ERR_INSUFFICIENT_RESOURCES` / `net::ERR_NETWORK_CHANGED`）。该风暴**与具体会话数据无关**——在一个**健康**会话上以相同方式复现。

因果性已用拦截实验**决定性**证明：把 `commands/list` 在到达服务器**之前**就地中止（abort）后，宿主进程 CPU 从 **~1.08 核降到 0.00 核**；并且**即使在全部请求被中止的情况下**，客户端 12 秒内仍发出 **1620** 个请求。第二个拦截——对每个 `commands/list` **强制回答** `ok:true`（空目录）——**停不了**风暴（持续 ~57 req/s）；请求发起者追踪显示**每个 fetch 都由远端事件流上送达的一条 `commands/change` 广播发起**。这是一个**由宿主侧 `commands/change` 广播再触发的客户端循环，无论请求成功、失败、还是根本没离开浏览器**——既不是宿主侧的无限循环，也不是受控轮询，更不是失败驱动的重试。

这一个循环同时解释了两类症状：

1. **CPU 燃烧（失效模式 A）**：~50 req/s × 每请求宿主侧异步 I/O，使一个 **libuv 线程池线程**持续占满约 1 核（主线程空闲、未派生任何 `Worker`、无磁盘 I/O 抖动、RSS 平稳）。
2. **"Load earlier" 永久卡死（失效模式 B）**：风暴占满浏览器同主机连接池，导致 "Load earlier" 触发的 `events.prepend` 请求**永远拿不到连接槽**，UI 永远停在 "Loading…"。

</details>

## Failure modes

### Mode A: ~1 CPU core sustained per open session (data-independent)

- With **any** session open (a healthy one suffices): host process **~1.05–1.08 core** sustained.
- With no client (`about:blank`): baseline **0.00–0.02 core**.
- The hot thread is a **libuv pool thread** doing async I/O for the request backlog; the main thread's only stack is its 2 s timer callback (fully idle).
- No `Worker` spawn, no disk I/O churn, flat RSS (~577 MB), stable handles/connections (278 / 7).

<details><summary>中文：失效模式 A</summary>

- 打开**任意**会话（健康会话即可）：宿主进程 **~1.05–1.08 核**持续。
- 无客户端（`about:blank`）：基线 **0.00–0.02 核**。
- 热线程是**做积压请求异步 I/O 的 libuv 线程池线程**；主线程唯一的栈是其 2s 周期的定时器回调（完全空闲）。
- 无 `Worker` 派生、无磁盘 I/O 抖动、RSS 平稳（~577 MB）、句柄/连接数稳定（278 / 7）。

</details>

### Mode B: "Load earlier" never completes

After clicking "Load earlier" the button becomes "Loading…" (disabled). The history-page request it triggers (`events.prepend`) **cannot get a connection** because the pool is saturated by the `commands/list` flood, so it hangs indefinitely; the button re-enables, but **nothing loads**. On a duplicated-id session (e.g. `81570fca`), the `prepend` path additionally re-triggers the client assembler's `received more than one start Match` (see the companion duplicate-tool-call-ID report, Mode B) — a double wedge.

<details><summary>中文：失效模式 B</summary>

点击 "Load earlier" 后按钮变为 "Loading…"（禁用）。其触发的历史分页请求（`events.prepend`）因连接池已被 `commands/list` 风暴占满而**无法获得连接**，无限期挂起；按钮随后复位，但**没有内容加载**。在工具调用 ID 重复的会话（如 `81570fca`）上，`prepend` 路径还会**再次**触发客户端装配器的 `received more than one start Match`（见同批“重复工具调用 ID”报告，失效模式 B）——形成双重卡死。

</details>

## Causality evidence (decisive)

| Experiment (实验) | Result (结果) |
|---|---|
| Request recorder (~36 s with a session open)（请求录制器，会话打开 ~36 s） | **All 2000** captured requests were `POST /api/commands/list`; span 36214 ms; only **442** returned 200 (rest statusless = pool-exhaustion failures)（**全部 2000** 个被捕获请求都是 `POST /api/commands/list`；跨度 36214 ms；仅 **442** 个返回 200，其余无状态码 = 池耗尽失败） |
| Interception: `page.route('**/api/commands/list', r => r.abort('failed'))`, then CPU (拦截：请求在到达服务器前中止，再测 CPU) | Host process **0.00 core** (previously ~1.08) — the flood is the **only** CPU driver（宿主进程 **0.00 核**（此前 ~1.08）——风暴即 CPU 的**唯一**驱动） |
| Client behavior while aborted (中止状态下的客户端行为) | Still **1620** requests fired in 12 s (~50 req/s) — the loop is **self-sustaining**, independent of outcomes（12 s 内仍发出 **1620** 个被中止的请求（~50 req/s）——循环**自持**，与结果无关） |
| Forced success: every `commands/list` answered with a fake `ok:true` empty catalog（强制成功：每个 `commands/list` 被强制回答为伪造的 `ok:true` 空目录） | Storm **continues at ~57 req/s** — the re-fire is independent of pull outcomes（风暴**以 ~57 req/s 持续**——再触发与拉取结果**无关**） |
| Request-initiator trace of the in-flight fetches (CDP)（在途 fetch 的请求发起者追踪（CDP）） | **Every** fetch is initiated by `pumpEvents → deliver → parallel → invalidateAll → refresh` — one `commands/change` broadcast per pull（**每一个** fetch 都由 `pumpEvents → deliver → parallel → invalidateAll → refresh` 发起——每次拉取对应一条 `commands/change` 广播） |
| Control: healthy vs corrupt session (对照：健康 vs 损坏会话) | CPU burn is **identical** (~1.08 core) — data-independent（CPU 燃烧**相同**（均 ~1.08 核）——与数据无关） |
| Main thread / Worker audit (主线程 / Worker 排查) | 2 s stack dumps = only the timer callback; a `worker_threads.Worker` patch captured **zero** `WORKER-SPAWN`（每 2 s 栈转储 = 仅定时器回调；`worker_threads.Worker` 补丁 = **零** `WORKER-SPAWN`） |

## Loop components (client source)

The storm is not a single poller; it is a self-sustaining circuit formed by several client parts:

- `packages/client/ui-commands/src/client/directory.ts` — `CommandDirectory` (session-keyed catalog cache):
  - `refresh()` marks the entry `failed` when the fetch rejects;
  - `warm()` **re-pulls** on `cold`/`failed` entries (the scope-birth prewarm hook lands here);
  - `invalidateAll()` re-pulls **every** touched key on `commands/change`;
  - `resetConnected()` drops all snapshots and prewarms on `connection/reset`.
- `packages/client/ui-commands/src/client/service.ts:82` — the fetch callback: `if (!result.ok) throw new Error(...)`, turning one failed `commands.list` RPC into the `failed` state (re-triggerable by `warm()`).
- `packages/client/ui-commands/src/client/service.ts:96` — `ctx.remote.$on('commands/change', () => this.directory.invalidateAll())`.
- `packages/client/ui-input-trigger/src/client/controller.ts:90` — `src.warm?.(projection)` at scope birth.
- Host-side `commands/change` emission: `packages/interaction/commands/src/index.ts:261` (the `ScopedLayers` callback) → `notifyChange()` (`:470`).

**Re-fire trigger pinned (client side).** A request-initiator trace shows **every** `commands/list` fetch in the storm is initiated by one `commands/change` broadcast: `pumpEvents → deliver → parallel → invalidateAll → refresh` — the Host pushes command-registry change notifications on the remote-event stream at the flood rate, and the client starts a fresh pull on **each** broadcast. `refresh()` **does not coalesce** with an in-flight pull (only `ensureReady()` does), so N broadcasts = N fresh pulls per touched key. The interception rows above pin the rest: forcing `ok:true` does **not** stop the storm, and the abort experiment shows the client keeps firing while no pull ever reaches the Host — the re-fire is **broadcast-driven, not pull-outcome-driven**, which rules out the "failed → `warm` re-pull" candidate. The one open end is the Host-side emitter of the ~50–60 req/s `commands/change` stream (consistent with the agent-scope registration storm in #2139; pinning it needs host-side instrumentation). None of this changes the classification: a **client-side self-sustaining request loop** — neither a host infinite loop nor a controlled poll.

<details><summary>中文：循环的组成部件（客户端源码）</summary>

风暴不是单个轮询器，而是多个客户端部件叠加形成的自持回路：

- `packages/client/ui-commands/src/client/directory.ts` — `CommandDirectory`（按会话键的目录缓存）：
  - `refresh()` 拉取失败时把条目置为 `failed`；
  - `warm()` 对 `cold`/`failed` 条目**再次**发起拉取（scope 出生时的预热钩子落在这里）；
  - `invalidateAll()` 在收到 `commands/change` 时对**所有**已触达键发起重拉；
  - `resetConnected()` 在 `connection/reset` 时丢弃全部快照并预热。
- `packages/client/ui-commands/src/client/service.ts:82` — 拉取回调：`if (!result.ok) throw new Error(...)`，把一次失败的 `commands.list` RPC 变成 `failed` 状态（可被 `warm()` 再触发）。
- `packages/client/ui-commands/src/client/service.ts:96` — `ctx.remote.$on('commands/change', () => this.directory.invalidateAll())`。
- `packages/client/ui-input-trigger/src/client/controller.ts:90` — scope 出生时 `src.warm?.(projection)`。
- 宿主侧 `commands/change` 的发射点：`packages/interaction/commands/src/index.ts:261`（`ScopedLayers` 回调）→ `notifyChange()`（`:470`）。

**再触发触发器已钉死（客户端侧）。** 请求发起者追踪显示风暴中**每一个** `commands/list` fetch 都由一条 `commands/change` 广播发起：`pumpEvents → deliver → parallel → invalidateAll → refresh` —— 宿主以洪泛速率在远端事件流上推送命令注册表变更通知，客户端对**每一次**广播都发起一次新拉取。`refresh()` **不与在途拉取合并**（只有 `ensureReady()` 会），因此 N 条广播 = 每个已触达键 N 次新拉取。上表的拦截行钉死了其余部分：强制 `ok:true` **停不了**风暴，中止实验又显示拉取根本到不了宿主时客户端仍在发射——再触发是**广播驱动、而非拉取结果驱动**，由此排除"失败→`warm` 再拉"候选。唯一未钉死的一端是宿主侧 ~50–60 req/s `commands/change` 流的发射者（与 #2139 的 agent 作用域注册风暴一致；钉死它需要宿主侧插桩）。这些都不改变分类：**客户端侧的自持请求循环**——既非宿主侧无限循环，也非受控轮询。

</details>

## Environment notes

- The repro's web profile `cordis.patch.yml` inserts `mcp-rss-reader` (`streamable-http` → `http://127.0.0.1:8080/mcp`), which is **not running** in the repro (no 8080 listener). It has been ruled out as the driver of the `commands/list` storm (the storm appears identically on a healthy session, and the only target path observed is `/api/commands/list`); whether the failed MCP connection **additionally** contributes load was not quantified separately, but it does not change the classification.
- The reporter's live instance (`127.0.0.1:3080`, where the MCP server may be running) was observed at **~3.3 core** — consistent with ~1 core per open session if several sessions are open at once.

<details><summary>中文：环境备注</summary>

- 复现环境的 Web profile `cordis.patch.yml` 插入了 `mcp-rss-reader`（`streamable-http` → `http://127.0.0.1:8080/mcp`），而该 MCP 服务器在复现环境中**未运行**（无 8080 监听）。已排除它是 `commands/list` 风暴的驱动源（风暴对健康会话同样出现，且观察到的唯一目标路径是 `/api/commands/list`）；MCP 连接失败是否**额外**贡献了负载未单独量化，但即便去掉它也改变不了分类。
- 报告方的线上实例（`127.0.0.1:3080`，MCP 服务器可能正在运行）观察到 **~3.3 核**——若同时打开多个会话，与每会话 ~1 核的叠加一致。

</details>

## Suggested fixes

1. **Add backoff to the client `commands/list` loop:** retry with exponential backoff after a failure (not an immediate re-pull), with a cap on consecutive failures.
2. **Coalesce invalidation broadcasts:** when `commands/change` fires rapidly, coalesce the invalidations instead of re-pulling every key on each broadcast.
3. **Client-side request throttling:** throttle or reuse concurrent/high-frequency requests to the same path so the browser's connection pool is not starved for other requests such as `events.prepend`.

<details><summary>中文：建议的修复方向</summary>

1. **为 `commands/list` 客户端循环加退避**：失败后按指数退避重试（而非立即再拉），并设置连续失败上限。
2. **合并/去抖失效广播**：`commands/change` 高频广播时合并失效，而非每次广播都触发全部键的重拉。
3. **客户端请求节流**：对同一路径的并发/高频请求做客户端侧节流或复用，避免占满浏览器连接池而饿死 `events.prepend` 等其他请求。

</details>

## Related reports

Several already-filed reports describe sibling loops in the same `commands.list` / browser-connection-pool family; none of them is this exact circuit, but they share the "unbounded client retry → pool exhaustion → whole GUI wedged" pattern:

- [#2139](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/2139) — `agent-presets` agent-scope command registrations broadcast a global `commands/change`, which drives the client `invalidateAll()` → re-pull `commands/list` feedback loop (measured 47–177 events/s). **This report pins the client half of that loop and the two symptoms it produces (CPU burn + `events.prepend` starvation); it also shows the storm reproduces on a healthy session, not only at cold start.**
- [#3082](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/3082) — a failed session resume drives an unbounded ~103 req/s retry across four APIs (`session.models`, `commands.list`, `settings.describe`, `llm.providers`), exhausting the pool and breaking every GUI feature.

<details><summary>中文：相关报告</summary>

已有多份报告描述了同一 `commands.list` / 浏览器连接池家族中的类似循环；它们都不是本报告的这条回路，但共享"无上限客户端重试 → 连接池耗尽 → 整个 GUI 卡死"的模式：

- #2139 — `agent-presets` 的 agent 作用域命令注册触发全局 `commands/change` 广播，驱动客户端 `invalidateAll()` → 重拉 `commands/list` 的正反馈回路（实测 47–177 事件/秒）。**本报告钉死了该回路的客户端一半及其两个后果（CPU 燃烧 + `events.prepend` 饿死），并展示了风暴在健康会话上同样复现，而非仅冷启动。**
- #3082 — 会话 resume 失败驱动 ~103 req/s 的无上限重试，卷入四个 API（`session.models`、`commands.list`、`settings.describe`、`llm.providers`），耗尽连接池并使 GUI 所有功能不可用。

</details>

discussions.title: RFC: decouple durable workspace identity from host-local cwd
discussions.body:
## Problem

DSH has a stable `WorkspaceId` in the workspace registry, but Session execution is still tied to a host-local `cwd`. Session headers persist that path, the workspace service rebuilds a canonical-cwd index, and API Session creation/adoption verifies and creates the directory on the Host.

That is a coherent local implementation. It becomes restrictive when a plugin wants to activate the same durable workspace in another execution world—for example a remote sandbox, a materialized local cache, or a different worker. DSH already has replaceable `ctx.fs` and `ctx.subprocess` providers, including an E2B execution world, but there is no Host-owned lifecycle joining:

- durable workspace identity;
- Session create, resume, and fork;
- preparation of an execution root or Agent-scoped capabilities;
- rollback, shutdown, and cleanup.

Without that lifecycle, an external provider must retain a permanent Host path or wrap Session/Agent internals to prepare and release its workspace safely.

Relevant current surfaces:

- [Workspace registry and canonical-cwd indexing](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/packages/workspace/workspace/src/index.ts)
- [API Session Agent creation and adoption](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/packages/api/session-controller/src/agent.ts)
- [Filesystem capability seam](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/tree/master/packages/fs)
- [E2B execution-world providers](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/tree/master/packages/e2b)

## Proposed direction

Introduce a Workspace activation capability seam with the usual Service Definition / Provider / Consumer roles. The exact API is illustrative:

~~~ts
interface WorkspaceActivationService {
  acquire(request: {
    workspaceId: WorkspaceId
    sessionId: SessionId
    mode: "read" | "write"
    signal: AbortSignal
  }): Promise<WorkspaceActivation>
}

interface WorkspaceActivation {
  workspaceId: WorkspaceId

  // A local provider can expose a Host path.
  executionRoot?: string

  // A remote provider can install Agent-scoped fs/subprocess capabilities.
  setup?(agentContext: Context): Promise<void>

  dispose(): Promise<void>
}
~~~

The existing local-directory behavior could remain the default provider. A remote provider could instead materialize content, mount storage, or install scoped `fs` and `subprocess` implementations.

## Lifecycle properties

The useful contract is primarily about ownership and ordering:

1. Session create, resume, and fork acquire a workspace through the same Consumer path.
2. Activation completes before model or tool execution can begin.
3. Setup failure or cancellation rolls back the acquired activation.
4. Agent disposal drains execution and closes durable Session writes before releasing the workspace activation.
5. A durable Session records a stable workspace reference independently of the provider's physical execution root, so resume does not need to infer identity from `cwd`.
6. Providers can report typed outcomes such as not found, unavailable, read-only, or already owned.

A provider may initially enforce one writer per workspace. This proposal does not require DSH itself to implement distributed locking.

## Why this is separate from storage and fs backends

The storage-domain seam can persist workspace registry records, but it does not own workspace materialization or Agent lifetime. The `fs` and `subprocess` seams describe operations inside an execution world, but they do not connect that world to a durable Workspace across Session create/resume/fork.

Workspace activation would compose those existing capabilities rather than replace them.

## Scope

This proposal does not require a cluster scheduler, a specific S3/NFS backend, an authentication or user model, live collaborative editing, or transparent failover of an in-flight turn. It establishes the lifecycle needed for plugins to explore those deployment shapes without wrapping controller or Agent internals.

Open design questions:

- Should the durable workspace reference live directly in the Session header or in an owned projection?
- Should an activation expose a local execution root, install Agent-scoped capabilities, or support both?
- Should write ownership belong to the Workspace activation or remain entirely provider-defined?

Would this fit the intended boundary between the Workspace domain and Agent lifecycle?

discussions.title: @deepseek-ai/dsh-llm@0.1.3-alpha.2: dsh-attachment and dsh-invariants missing from published dependencies
discussions.body:
## Summary

`@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm`'s public type surface imports directly from both `@deepseek-ai/dsh-attachment` and `@deepseek-ai/dsh-invariants`:

- `FileAttachmentRef`/`ImageAttachmentRef` from `dsh-attachment` in `src/index.ts`, `src/content.ts`, and `src/types.ts`
- `InvariantFailure`/`InvariantInstaller` from `dsh-invariants` in `src/invariant.ts`, which backs the package's own published `./invariant` subpath export

Both are declared under `devDependencies` in `packages/llm/llm/package.json` instead of `dependencies`. `devDependencies` never ship in a published npm tarball, so any consumer resolving `dsh-llm`'s types under `NodeNext`/`bundler` module resolution hits `TS2724: has no exported member` on `FileAttachmentRef` (and would hit the same on `InvariantFailure`/`InvariantInstaller` for the `./invariant` subpath).

`@deepseek-ai/cordis` correctly stays in `devDependencies` since it's already declared as a `peerDependency` — this is specifically about the two that aren't peers.

## Repro

```sh
npm view @deepseek-ai/dsh-llm@0.1.3-alpha.2 dependencies
# missing dsh-attachment / dsh-invariants

pnpm --dir packages/llm/llm pack --pack-destination /tmp/before
# tarball's package.json "dependencies" also missing both, confirming it's not
# a one-off publish glitch — the current package.json itself misclassifies them
```

Hit while upgrading a downstream consumer from `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm@0.1.1-rc.2` to `0.1.3-alpha.2`.

## Suggested fix

Move both entries from `devDependencies` to `dependencies` in `packages/llm/llm/package.json`. I verified locally that `pnpm pack` then correctly includes both in the tarball's `dependencies` at `^0.1.3-alpha.2`.

Since I understand external PRs aren't being accepted right now, I've pushed the verified fix (4-line package.json change + regenerated lockfile) on a branch here in case it's useful as a reference: https://github.com/musichen/deepseek-harness/tree/fix/dsh-llm-attachment-invariants-dependencies
