discussions.title: [Bug] 会话日志损坏：长工具调用执行期间中断回合，导致 seq 重复（中断修复路径使用了过期的 seq 基线）
discussions.body:
环境：dsh 0.1.2-rc.1、Windows、Node 24.15.0

症状：某回合中工具调用（pwsh，约 100 秒长任务）仍在运行时中断了回合；重新加载会话报错：`corrupt session log: seq gap in committed region at line 7524 (expected 51699, got 51695)`

根因（自查结论，欢迎纠正）：中断修复路径（`interruptedTurnClosers` + `commitRepair`）按「已存储日志长度」写入合成关闭事件（占位 tool/result、step/end、turn/end、end-seed），但没有推进实时会话的内存 seq 计数器。工具稍后真正完成并持久化时，复用了修复路径已写入的 seq 51695–51698（每个 seq 出现两次），加载时 seq 不再严格单调，直接判为损坏且无自愈。

已验证：删除这 4 行合成事件（全部是占位内容，零真实内容丢失）后，seq 恢复严格连续（0..70226），会话经真实加载路径（`readZstdPrefix` + `Session.fromRestore`）正常打开，且已被我重开并持续使用中。

复现步骤（基于日志取证推断，非逐步确认）：

1. 触发一个长时间运行的工具调用（如 pwsh 长 sleep）
2. 工具完成前中断该回合
3. 等待工具真正完成，其结果按原 seq 持久化
4. 重新加载会话 → 报错

附件：完整中文分析草稿、原始损坏日志、只读诊断脚本与修复脚本。对附件 07 运行 `node 04-诊断脚本.mjs 07-原始损坏日志.jsonl.zstd` 即可复现 4 个重号 seq 的全部证据。
[dsh-bug-report-session-seq-gap.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/31947577/dsh-bug-report-session-seq-gap.zip)

discussions.title: [Bug] 内置目录刷新后，settings 里引用的孤儿模型令 llm-pi-ai 整体激活失败（静默），Web 模型选择器只剩内置 DeepSeek 组 // hand-declared model absent from installed catalog silently kills the whole llm-pi-ai adapter at boot
discussions.body:
## TL;DR / 现象

Web GUI 的模型选择对话框加载不出任何已配置的模型：`session/modelCatalog` 返回的 `routableProviders` 只剩 `["deepseek-official"]`，所有通过 `llm-pi-ai` 配置的路由（zai / opencode-go / openrouter 等）全部消失，`groups` 里也没有它们的分组。

**根因**：`llm-pi-ai` 的某个 provider 路由下手声明了一个当前 pi-ai 内置目录里不存在的模型 id，而该路由又没有声明 `api`。这会让 `resolveProfiles()` 在插件激活时抛错，**整个 llm-pi-ai 适配器激活失败**——不是只禁用出问题的那个路由，而是全部路由一起失效。且该失败是完全静默的：启动输出里只有 URL 一行，没有任何 warn/error。

## 环境

- `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.3-alpha.2`（`dsh web`，web profile）
- `@earendil-works/pi-ai@0.85.x`
- macOS (darwin arm64)

## 触发链路

1. `settings.yaml` 的 `llm-pi-ai.providers.openrouter.models` 里手声明了 `stealth/ox-alpha`。配置写入时它还在内置目录里（当时能通过 `assertServiceable` 的写时校验），后来 pi-ai 内置目录刷新把这个型号移除了，settings 里留下了这个“孤儿”模型；
2. OpenRouter 内置目录本身混有两种协议（351 个 `openai-completions` + 15 个 `anthropic-messages`），`sharedCatalogApi()` 无法推出唯一默认协议 → `routeApi === undefined`；
3. 而 model schema（`modelProfile`）不包含 `api` 字段，即**无法在单个模型上声明协议**，只能在 route 级声明；
4. 于是 `resolveProfiles()` 抛出：
   ```
   llm-pi-ai: provider "openrouter" model "stealth/ox-alpha" needs an api;
   the installed catalog does not describe it, so set the route's api to the
   wire protocol its endpoint speaks
   ```
5. 该异常发生在 `apply()` 内首次调用 `profiles()` 时（`ctx.llm.registerConfigurableProviders(...)` 之前），插件 fiber 直接死亡 → 适配器没有注册任何东西 → `buildModelCatalog()` 里 `ctx.llm.listProviders()` 只能看到官方 DeepSeek 适配器 → 模型选择器空了。

## 修复

在 route 级补上协议声明（schema 不支持模型级 `api`，只能这样写）：

```yaml
llm-pi-ai:
  providers:
    openrouter:
      api: openai-completions   # ← 新增
      apiKeyEnv: OPENROUTER_API_KEY
      models:
        - id: stealth/ox-alpha
          ...
```

安全性说明：配置了 `models` 列表后，该路由实际服务的目录就是这个列表（`entries = configured.length > 0 ? configured : [...defaults]`），所以 route 级 `api` 只作用于列表里的手声明模型，不会覆盖内置目录其他模型的协议。

## 验证过程

1. 用插件自身的 `Config` + `resolveProfiles` 路径（`apply()` + mock ctx）单测：修复前稳定抛出上述错误，修复后 39 个 provider 全部注册；
2. 用 `dsh web --port 0 --no-open` 起临时实例直接调 RPC 复现/验证：
   - **坏配置启动**（与用户一致的原始状态）：`routableProviders: ["deepseek-official"]`，无任何 pi-ai 路由 —— 即“对话框加载不出模型”的准确形态；
   - **修复后**：`routableProviders: ["deepseek-official","zai","opencode-go","openrouter"]`，4 个 groups、`failures: []`，默认选择 `opencode-go/deepseek-v4-flash/max` 正常。

## 两个附带观察（可能对改进有价值）

1. **失败隔离与可观测性**：一个不可解析的手声明模型会杀死整个适配器（所有路由），且启动日志完全静默（stdout 只有 URL 一行）。建议：把路由级解析失败降级为“仅该路由失效 + 在 modelCatalog 的 `failures` 里上报”，并在激活失败时至少打一条 warn。
2. **孤儿模型的迁移/诊断**：这次事故的起点是“内置目录刷新移除了 settings 里引用的模型 id”。写时校验（`assertServiceable`）拦得住新写入，但拦不住目录回退/更新导致的存量配置失配。建议启动时对“settings 引用了目录中不存在的模型 id”给出明确诊断（甚至自动禁用该模型），而不是让整个适配器 fatal。
3. **热重载边界**（已实测）：可服务的配置变更会被热重载并即时反映到 modelCatalog；不可服务的变更会被拒绝并保留最后可用值；但**启动时就失败的插件 fiber 不会因为后续配置文件修好而复活**，必须重启 `dsh web`。这个行为目前不太直觉，值得在文档里说明。

---

**English summary**: A hand-declared model id that is absent from the installed pi-ai catalog (e.g. after a catalog refresh removed it) makes `resolveProfiles()` throw at plugin activation when its route has no `api` declared — OpenRouter's catalog is protocol-mixed so no default can be inferred, and the model schema has no per-model `api` field. The exception kills the **entire** llm-pi-ai adapter silently (no log), so the web model picker loses every configured route and only shows the built-in DeepSeek group. Fix: declare `api: openai-completions` at the route level. Suggested improvements: per-route failure isolation + surface in `modelCatalog.failures`, a startup warning, and a diagnostic for stored model ids that vanished from the catalog. Also verified: a fiber that failed at boot never recovers from later config fixes — a restart is required.

discussions.title: Plugin: let the agent type into any Windows window (+ `@窗口` mention idea)
discussions.body:
# Discussion post draft — DeepSeek Harness GitHub Discussions

> Copy this into a new Discussion (category: e.g. "Show and tell" or "Ideas").
> If you want to split the feature request out, cut the second half into its own "Ideas" post.

---

## Title: Plugin: let the agent type into any Windows window (+ `@窗口` mention idea)

Hi folks 👋

I built a small plugin that lets a Harness agent **attach to a window on the Windows desktop and type text into it** — think "agent-driven UI automation" for the local machine. It needs **no core changes**: it loads into a stock checkout via `--patch`.

**Repo (MIT):** https://github.com/linxsy-code/dsh-plugin-window-input · topic `dsh-plugin`

### What it does

Three tools appear for the agent:

| tool | purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `window_list` | enumerate visible windows (title / class / process / hwnd) |
| `window_focus` | bring a window to the foreground |
| `window_type` | type text into a window's input control |

A typical flow:

```
window_list                       # find the target
window_type title="Notepad++" text="你好" pressEnter=true
```

Verified targets: Windows Notepad, ChatGPT desktop (ProseMirror), Notepad++ (Scintilla) — including CJK text and multi-line input.

### How it finds "the input box"

Typing needs more than the top-level handle — you have to locate the control that is actually waiting for keyboard input. The engine (`win-agent.ps1`, spawned unsandboxed) resolves it in layers:

1. **Focused control** — `GetGUIThreadInfo → hwndFocus` is the authoritative keyboard target and works for *any* app (canvas, terminals, exotic controls).
2. **UI Automation `ValuePattern`** — for standard controls, set the value directly (no focus / no input injection).
3. **Scintilla** (Notepad++, many code editors) — text goes in cross-process via **clipboard + `SCI_PASTE`** (pointer-free; the pointer-based `SCI_REPLACESEL`/`SCI_INSERTTEXT` do *not* work cross-process — worth knowing if you ever automate Scintilla).
4. **`SendInput`** — opt-in fallback for terminals etc.

`pressEnter` uses `\n` / `SCI_NEWLINE`, so it also works where synthetic input injection is blocked (which we found happens in remote-desktop / restricted-token contexts — `SendInput` returns error 87 there).

### A companion idea: `@窗口` mention in the composer

I also prototyped adding a **窗口 (Windows) category to the `@` mention menu**: type `@`, pick a window from the live list, and it inserts `@窗口 <title>` which the agent resolves straight into `window_type`. It works end-to-end, but it touches the client Remote assembly (`api/remotes`), so it lives as a fork commit rather than a `--patch` plugin:

**https://github.com/linxsy-code/deepseek-harness** (branch `master`)

**Would upstream consider this direction?** Being able to *act on* (not just read) a user's desktop windows from the agent opens a lot of workflows. If Harness is open to it, I'd love to shape it into something core-shaped (e.g., a `windowReferences` Remote namespace + a generic @-source extension point) instead of forking.

### Feedback welcome

- What apps do *you* need to drive by typing? (Scintilla-only? terminals? specific editors?)
- Is the `SendInput`-blocked environment something you've hit too?
- Interested in a cleaner @-mention extension API if it existed?

MIT, Windows-only, happy to take issues/PRs on the repo.

discussions.title: 反馈bug（也许算bug？）：未在对话的最底下完整的展示本轮对话生成材料/文件的清单
Feature Request: Official extension directory for user plugins with stable service injection
discussions.body:
**Proposal: Support user extensions in `<project-root>/extensions/` with stable plugin loading and `.gitignore` inclusion**

---

## 问题背景

在 deepseek-harness 项目中，我们希望开发自定义插件，对外暴露稳定的 REST API，以便第三方系统集成 DSH 的 `workspace`、`session`、`providers`、`models` 等核心能力。  
这些插件不应受官方内部重构影响，且应能独立于官方代码库进行维护。

当前，我们尝试将自定义插件放在项目根目录下的 `user/` 目录中，并通过 `web` profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 挂载。但遇到核心障碍：**自定义插件无法注入 `router` 服务**，导致 `dsh web` 启动失败。

---

## 核心期望

1. **官方认可一个明确的扩展目录**（建议命名为 `extensions/`），用于放置用户自定义的功能插件。  
   该目录应被加入 `.gitignore`，确保用户代码不会被提交到官方仓库，也不会因 `git pull` 被覆盖或影响。

2. **提供稳定的插件加载机制**，确保位于 `extensions/` 下的插件能正常访问 `router`、`workspaceRegistry`、`sessions` 等核心服务，并能注册 HTTP 路由或 Remote 方法。

3. **即使 DSH 内部进行重大重构（如 bundle 结构、依赖注入方式变更）**，只要公开的数据结构（如 `Workspace`、`Session` 等类型）保持不变，外部集成应继续工作，无需修改插件代码。

4. **提供官方文档和示例**，指导开发者如何在 `extensions/` 目录下开发、构建、加载自定义插件，并说明与官方插件的集成约定。

---

## 当前阻碍（复现步骤）

1. 在项目根目录创建 `user/session-list-api/`（或 `extensions/session-list-api/`），编写自定义插件（尝试注册 HTTP 路由 `/api/lunerstar/workspaceSessions`）。
2. 在 `~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml` 中添加 `insert` 块挂载该插件。
3. 构建插件，并在 profile 的 `node_modules` 中创建符号链接或安装包。
4. 执行 `pnpm dsh web`，启动失败，错误日志显示：
   ```
   @deepseek-ai/dsh-session-list-api: pending (waiting for service: router)
   Error: cannot get property "router" without inject
   ```

**尝试过的解决方案**（均失败）：
- 使用 `static inject` 注入 `router`、`ctx` 等。
- 使用 `apply` 函数直接访问 `ctx.router`。
- 使用 `ctx.ready`、`ctx.on('ready')` 等待服务就绪。
- 使用轮询重试检测服务可用性。

所有这些尝试都因 Cordis 依赖注入机制的限制（服务未注册时禁止通过 `ctx.router` 访问）而失败。

**根本原因（推测）**：
官方 bundle（如 `dsh-base`、`dsh-web-app`）中的插件在 `router` 服务注册之后加载，因此注入成功；而用户通过 `cordis.patch.yml` 的 `insert` 块加载的插件在 `router` 服务注册之前执行，导致无法注入。

---

## 期望的解决方案

### 1. 明确扩展目录并加入 `.gitignore`
- 将 `<project-root>/extensions/` 作为官方认可的扩展目录，并添加到根目录的 `.gitignore` 中。
- 该目录下的代码完全由用户维护，不参与官方版本控制。

### 2. 提供官方支持的挂载方式
- 在 `dsh` 配置中增加 `dsh.extensions` 或 `dsh.plugins.user` 选项，指定扩展目录路径。
- 在 `web` profile 启动时，自动扫描该目录下的所有包（或遵循特定约定，如 `extensions/*/package.json`），并在合适的生命周期阶段加载它们，确保 `router` 等核心服务已可用。

### 3. 提供生命周期钩子
- 提供 `ctx.ready` 或 `ctx.on('services-ready')` 等官方钩子，让插件在服务完全初始化后执行路由注册等操作，无需依赖 `inject` 顺序。

### 4. 文档与示例
- 在官方文档中添加“用户自定义插件”章节，提供完整示例（包括目录结构、`package.json`、源码、构建和加载步骤），确保开发者能快速集成。

---

## 附加说明

- 我们曾尝试使用 `TypertRemoteService` 和 `@Remote` 装饰器，但在 TypeScript 严格模式下遇到类型问题，无法顺利构建。若官方能提供稳定的装饰器兼容方案（如更新 `tsconfig` 推荐配置），将是更优雅的扩展方式。
- 我们期望 `extensions/` 目录中的插件能作为独立的 Node 包存在，并通过 pnpm workspace 或 link 方式集成，方便开发和调试。

---

## 环境信息

- **操作系统**：Windows 11
- **Node.js**：v22.23.2
- **pnpm**：v11.7.0
- **deepseek-harness**：main 分支（2026-09-08）
- **TypeScript**：v6.0.3

---

## 结论

当前 deepseek-harness 缺乏对用户自定义插件的官方支持路径，导致第三方集成困难。通过上述改进，可以大幅降低集成门槛，同时保证稳定性，使 DSH 成为一个真正可扩展的平台。

如果官方需要，我们可以提供更详细的设计建议或原型代码。请评估此建议的可行性，并告知后续计划。

discussions.title: DSH | Minimal Omni | Keep DSH at four tools by default
discussions.body:
> **Unofficial project, independently developed and maintained by community members.** Minimal Omni is not reviewed, endorsed, or supported by DeepSeek.

**Project URL:**  
https://github.com/Rainflowers686/deepseek-harness-minimal-omni

## What I built

I wanted to keep DeepSeek Harness's Minimal preset small at idle, even when a task needs a browser, documents, or code navigation.

Minimal Omni starts with four visible tools:

- `pwsh`
- `str_replace_editor`
- `request_capability`
- `release_capability`

When the task needs Browser, Documents, or Code/LSP, the agent can request that capability. When it is finished, the extra capability is released again.

## Install

With DSH `v0.1.2-rc.1`:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:Rainflowers686/deepseek-harness-minimal-omni#v0.2.0-preview.2
```

Start DSH Web normally, create a session, and choose **Minimal Omni** from **Agent preset**.

Remove it with:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove @rain/minimal-omni
```

The package is a normal DSH Web-profile bundle. It adds the Minimal Omni preset and its runtime rows without replacing Standard or changing provider credentials.

## DSH integration

The public package uses DSH's bundle model. Its root `dsh.bundle` patch registers the host/runtime pieces and the Minimal Omni agent preset in the existing Web profile; it does not fork or rebuild the Web app.

The tested preview pin is `dsh-v0.1.2-rc.1`. The repository README and docs include the capability matrix, clean installation notes, troubleshooting, and the current experimental/conditional limits:

- PDF, DOCX, and ZIP document workflows are live-tested.
- XLSX/PPTX model-facing workflows and Goal continuity across compaction are Experimental.
- Vision depends on whether the selected provider route supports image input.
- Web Search and authenticated GitHub actions require their own configuration.
- Desktop automation, ASR, broad media understanding, and cross-Agent handoff are Deferred.

I did not include a mock or private UI screenshot in this preview post. The full usage notes and the exact install/selection flow are in the repository README and documentation:

- https://github.com/Rainflowers686/deepseek-harness-minimal-omni/blob/v0.2.0-preview.2/README.md
- https://github.com/Rainflowers686/deepseek-harness-minimal-omni/tree/v0.2.0-preview.2/docs

Repository: https://github.com/Rainflowers686/deepseek-harness-minimal-omni  
Release: https://github.com/Rainflowers686/deepseek-harness-minimal-omni/releases/tag/v0.2.0-preview.2

## 中文简介

Minimal Omni 让 DSH 在空闲时只保留四个基础工具，需要 Browser、Documents 或代码工具时再按需申请，用完释放。它是独立的社区项目，不代表 DeepSeek 官方；完整中文说明见 [README.zh-CN.md](https://github.com/Rainflowers686/deepseek-harness-minimal-omni/blob/v0.2.0-preview.2/README.zh-CN.md)。

This is a Developer Preview. Feedback and compatibility reports are welcome. Please do not post API keys or private session logs.

discussions.title: [Computer Use][电脑操控]:让Agent直接操控你的Windows 桌面（输入+鼠标）
discussions.body:
## 中文：让 Agent 直接操控你的 Windows 桌面（输入 + 鼠标）

大家好 👋

我做了一个**自包含的 DeepSeek Harness 插件**，让 Agent 能像真人一样操作本机 Windows 桌面：列出/切换窗口、往应用里输入文字、还能**操控鼠标**（移动 / 点击 / 滚动）。**不需要改动核心代码**——用 `--patch` 挂到标准 checkout 即可，仅支持 Windows。

**仓库（MIT）：** https://github.com/linxsy-code/dsh-plugin-window-input · topic `dsh-plugin`

### 6 个工具

| 工具 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `window_list` | 枚举可见顶层窗口（标题/类名/进程/hwnd），可按关键字过滤 |
| `window_focus` | 把窗口切到前台（按标题子串或 hwnd） |
| `window_type` | 向窗口输入文字，自动识别输入框 |
| `mouse_move` | 光标移到屏幕坐标 |
| `mouse_click` | 点击坐标，**或按可见名称点击窗口内元素**（比如「发送」按钮） |
| `mouse_scroll` | 滚动（可指定窗口，也可在光标处注入滚轮） |

刚才它就在我机器上真实执行过这样一个流程：

```
window_type title="ChatGPT" text="继续"
mouse_click title="ChatGPT" name="发送"      # 真的点到了发送按钮
```

也就是 Agent 替你「用了」ChatGPT。中文输入也没问题（已实测：记事本、ChatGPT 桌面版 / ProseMirror、Notepad++ / Scintilla、标准对话框）。

### 输入框是怎么找到的

给窗口打字不能只拿顶层句柄——得先定位真正等待键盘输入的控件。引擎（单文件 `win-agent.ps1`，每次调用拉起）按层解析：

1. **焦点控件** — `GetGUIThreadInfo → hwndFocus`，键盘输入的最权威目标，任何应用都适用；
2. **UI Automation `ValuePattern`** — 直接赋值，不需要焦点、不依赖输入注入；
3. **Scintilla**（Notepad++、各类代码编辑器）— 跨进程用**剪贴板 + `SCI_PASTE`** 插入（无指针安全；带指针的 `SCI_REPLACESEL`/`SCI_INSERTTEXT` 跨进程不生效）；
4. **`SendInput`** — 可选的按键注入兜底。

### 鼠标是怎么实现的

- **移动**：`SetCursorPos`（绝对像素）。
- **点击**：`SendInput MOUSEINPUT` 按下/抬起（注意：环境对键盘注入的封锁是「按输入类型」的——实测这台机器键盘 `SendInput` 报错 87，但鼠标注入正常）。**元素点击**先尝试 UIA 激活模式（Invoke/Select/Toggle/Expand）；应用不支持时（部分远程/降级会话会把原生 Win32 按钮显示成 Pane）自动回退为在该元素屏幕中心做物理点击。元素匹配**以名称为主**、控件类型只作提示，所以 UIA 树退化也能命中。
- **滚动**：两种模式——在光标处注入滚轮（浏览器等），或**把 `WM_MOUSEWHEEL` 直接发给目标窗口的焦点控件**（远程/受限会话会丢弃注入式滚轮，直发模式在这种情况下依然可靠）。

### 安装

```sh
git clone https://github.com/linxsy-code/dsh-plugin-window-input.git
# 编辑 cordis.yml，把 name 指向你本机克隆路径（file:// URL）
#   例如 name: 'file:///C:/path/to/dsh-plugin-window-input/src/index.ts'
# 在 DeepSeek Harness checkout 根目录执行：
pnpm dsh web --patch <本仓库路径>/cordis.yml
```

然后开个新会话试试：*"向记事本输入 hello 并回车"*、*"点击 ChatGPT 窗口里的发送按钮"*、*"把这个窗口往下滚一点"*…

### 已知限制

- 仅 Windows；需要 DSH checkout（Node ≥ 22）。
- 远程桌面/受限令牌环境下 `SendInput` **键盘**注入可能被拒（Win32 87）→ 优先 UIA/Scintilla 路径；**注入式滚轮**也可能被丢弃 → 这种情况请给 `mouse_scroll` 带 `title`/`hwnd`（直发模式）。
- 元素点击依赖可见文字/无障碍名；纯图标且无名称的控件请改用坐标点击。

### 配套：composer 里的 `@窗口` 提及

另一个已端到端可用的功能：在 Web 输入框的 `@` 菜单里增加「窗口」类别，列出所有窗口，选中后插入 `@窗口 <标题>` 供 Agent 解析。它接入了客户端 Remote 装配，所以以 fork 提交的形式提供（而非 `--patch` 插件）：

**https://github.com/linxsy-code/deepseek-harness**（master 分支）

如果 DSH 官方愿意考虑「Agent 能对用户桌面执行操作」这个方向，我很乐意把它整理成更适合合并进核心的形态（一个 `windowReferences` Remote 命名空间 + 通用的 @ 源扩展点），而不是长期维护 fork。

欢迎反馈：仓库 issues/PR，或直接在下面评论——你最想让 Agent 帮你操作哪些应用？



## EN: Plugin — the agent can type into AND click on your Windows desktop

Hi folks 👋

I built a small, self-contained plugin that lets a DeepSeek Harness agent **operate the local Windows desktop like a user** — list/focus windows, type text into an app, and drive the mouse (move / click / scroll). **No core changes needed**: it loads into a stock checkout via `--patch`, and it's Windows-only.

**Repo (MIT):** https://github.com/linxsy-code/dsh-plugin-window-input · topic `dsh-plugin`

### What you get — 6 tools

| Tool | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `window_list` | Enumerate visible top-level windows (title, class, process, hwnd), filterable. |
| `window_focus` | Bring a window to the foreground by `title` or `hwnd`. |
| `window_type` | Type text into a window's input control (input box is auto-detected). |
| `mouse_move` | Move the cursor to screen coordinates. |
| `mouse_click` | Click a point — **or an element in a window by its visible name** (e.g. a "Send" button). |
| `mouse_scroll` | Scroll a window (wheel), at a point or via a target window. |

A real flow it executed just now on my machine:

```
window_type title="ChatGPT" text="继续"
mouse_click title="ChatGPT" name="发送"        # clicked the real Send button
```

...i.e. an agent *used* ChatGPT for you. Works with CJK text too (verified on Notepad, ChatGPT desktop / ProseMirror, Notepad++ / Scintilla, standard dialogs).

### How typing finds the input box

Typing needs more than the top-level handle — you must locate the control that actually waits for keyboard input. The engine (`win-agent.ps1`, one file, spawned per call) resolves it in layers:

1. **Focused control** — `GetGUIThreadInfo → hwndFocus`; the authoritative keyboard target, works for any app.
2. **UI Automation `ValuePattern`** — set the value directly; no focus, no input injection.
3. **Scintilla** (Notepad++, code editors) — cross-process insert via **clipboard + `SCI_PASTE`** (pointer-free; the pointer-based `SCI_REPLACESEL`/`SCI_INSERTTEXT` don't work cross-process).
4. **`SendInput`** — opt-in keystroke fallback.

### How the mouse works

- **Move** — `SetCursorPos` (absolute pixels).
- **Click** — a click is `SendInput MOUSEINPUT` down/up (works in environments where *keyboard* `SendInput` is blocked — that block is per input-type; we verified). **Element clicks** first try a UIA activation pattern (`Invoke`/`Select`/`Toggle`/`Expand`); if the app exposes none (some remote/degraded sessions present native Win32 buttons as a generic "Pane"), the engine falls back to a physical click at the element's screen center. Element matching is **name-first** — control type is only a hint, so degraded UIA trees still hit.
- **Scroll** — two modes: injected wheel at the cursor/point (browsers etc.), or **direct `WM_MOUSEWHEEL` delivery to a target window's focused control** for remote/locked-down sessions that silently drop injected wheel events.

### Install

```sh
git clone https://github.com/linxsy-code/dsh-plugin-window-input.git
# edit cordis.yml → point `name` at YOUR clone (a file:// URL),
#   e.g. name: 'file:///C:/path/to/dsh-plugin-window-input/src/index.ts'
# from your DeepSeek Harness checkout root:
pnpm dsh web --patch <path-to-repo>/cordis.yml
```

Then in a new session: *"type 'hello' into Notepad and press Enter"*, *"click the Send button in the ChatGPT window"*, *"scroll that window down a bit"*…

### Notes & known constraints

- Windows only; requires a DeepSeek Harness checkout (Node ≥ 22).
- In remote-desktop / restricted-token contexts `SendInput` **keyboard** input may be rejected (Win32 error 87) → prefer the UIA/Scintilla paths; **injected wheel** can be dropped there too → use `mouse_scroll` with a `title`/`hwnd` (direct mode).
- Element clicks need a visible/accessible name; icon-only controls with no accessible name should be clicked by coordinates.

### Companion: `@窗口` mention in the composer

A related, end-to-end-working feature adds a **窗口 (Windows) category to the `@` mention menu** in the Web composer (pick a window, it inserts `@窗口 <title>` that the agent resolves). Because it wires into the client Remote assembly it ships as a fork commit, not a `--patch` plugin:

**https://github.com/linxsy-code/deepseek-harness** (branch `master`)

If Harness upstream is open to "the agent *acting on* the user's desktop", I'd love to shape this into something core-shaped (a `windowReferences` Remote namespace + a generic @-source extension point) instead of maintaining a fork.

Feedback very welcome — issues/PRs on the plugin repo, or comment below: what apps do you want an agent to drive?

discussions.title: Web session list loads slowly on refresh — listArtifacts scans archived sessions too
discussions.body:
## Symptom

After refreshing the DSH Web page, the workspace session list in the sidebar takes a noticeable delay (several seconds) to appear.

## Investigation

I traced the session list loading pipeline:

1. Web refresh → `SessionManager.handleConnected()` → `refreshList()` → `remote.session.list({})`
2. Host-side `ApiSessionList.list()` → `sessionQuery.listSessions()` → `persistence.list()`
3. `JsonlSessionPersistence.listArtifacts()` iterates over all project directories and session directories, performing `open → read → Zstd decompress → JSON parse header` for every session file on disk.

The key finding: **`listArtifacts()` scans every session file indiscriminately, including archived ones.** The archive filter (`archivedSessionIds`) is applied only in the client-side UI layer (`sessionVisible()`), well after the full I/O cost has already been paid.

## Why this matters

- As a user accumulates sessions over time, the `list()` I/O cost grows linearly with the total number of persisted sessions — not just the active ones.
- Archiving a session is meant to "hide it out of the way," but archived sessions still participate in every list scan. Archiving currently provides zero performance benefit.
- Even when a user only cares about a handful of active sessions in the current workspace, they still pay for reading headers of every historical session across all workspaces.

## Possible improvements

1. Let `listArtifacts()` or `list()` accept an exclude set so archived session IDs can be skipped at the file-scanning stage (this would require coordination between `workspaceRegistry` and `sessionPersistence`).
2. Provide a lighter `readdir`-only fast path that returns directory names / session IDs without reading headers, letting the client lazy-load metadata on demand.

discussions.title: [Windows] Host process exits on uncaughtException (ENOENT) when the subprocess spill dir is deleted at runtime
discussions.body:
## Summary

On Windows, if the per-process spill directory `%TEMP%\dsh-subprocess-<random>` is deleted while DSH is running (Windows **Storage Sense** does exactly this on a schedule via "Delete temporary files that my apps aren't using"), the next tool call whose output exceeds the in-memory cap **kills the whole DSH host process**:

- `dsh-subprocess-local` caches the spill directory path for the process lifetime — `privateSpillDir()` does `defaultSpillDir ??= mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), "dsh-subprocess-"))` (`lib/index.js:648-651`) and never recreates it.
- `OutputCollector.spillAll()` then calls `openSync(this.spillFile, "wx", 384)` (`lib/index.js:716-717`).
- With the directory gone, `openSync` throws `ENOENT` **inside a stream `'data'` handler** (`Socket.<anonymous>`, `lib/index.js:862`), so it becomes an uncaught exception and the process exits with code 1.

To users it looks "random" because two conditions must coincide: the temp dir was swept **and** the current command's output is large enough to trigger spilling.

## Environment

- `@deepseek-ai/dsh` **0.1.2-rc.1** (npm global, `dsh web`)
- Node.js **v24.15.0**
- **Windows 10 Pro 22H2 (build 19045, x64)**
- Tool: `pwsh` (Windows shell tool); any subprocess whose output spills shows the same failure

## Stack trace (captured by an `uncaughtException` handler)

```
Error: ENOENT: no such file or directory, open 'C:\Users\<user>\AppData\Local\Temp\dsh-subprocess-EXGmcS\dsh-subprocess-13524-7-f2a0801cf513-stdout.log'
    at openSync (node:fs:561:18)
    at OutputCollector.spillAll (.../@deepseek-ai/dsh-subprocess-local/lib/index.js:717:19)
    at OutputCollector.push (.../@deepseek-ai/dsh-subprocess-local/lib/index.js:693:75)
    at Socket.<anonymous> (.../@deepseek-ai/dsh-subprocess-local/lib/index.js:862:14)
    at Socket.emit (node:events:509:28)
    at addChunk (node:internal/streams/readable:563:12)
    at readableAddChunkPushByteMode (node:internal/streams/readable:514:3)
    at Readable.push (node:internal/streams/readable:394:5)
    at Pipe.onStreamRead (node:internal/stream_base_commons:189:23)
```

5 occurrences in 3 days, every one during a `pwsh` call with large output:

| time (local) | command | spilled path |
|---|---|---|
| 09-02 18:55:36 | `Invoke-WebRequest` loop | `...\Temp\dsh-subprocess-Pegvq0\...-148-2-....log` |
| 09-07 18:29:55 | `npm pack --ignore-scripts` | `...\Temp\dsh-subprocess-o9xYfd\...-2384-13-....log` |
| 09-08 09:35:25 | `Invoke-WebRequest` loop | `...\Temp\dsh-subprocess-ne7pjE\...-23568-2-....log` |
| 09-08 17:39:50 | `dotnet build Ant_XYXH.csproj` | `...\Temp\dsh-subprocess-Pprds5\...-14384-2-....log` |
| 09-08 18:36:31 | `dotnet build LS_LSJSX.Common.csproj` | `...\Temp\dsh-subprocess-EXGmcS\...-13524-7-....log` |

Corroborating signals:

- `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Temp` only ever holds the **current** process's `dsh-subprocess-*` directory; all older ones are gone — something sweeps them.
- Storage Sense is enabled on the machine (`HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\StorageSense\Parameters\StoragePolicy`: `01=1`, `04=1`). Its scheduled task ran at 16:48:48; the 17:39:50 crash followed ~51 minutes later.

## Deterministic repro

1. Start DSH on Windows with the default temp dir.
2. Run a `pwsh` command whose output overflows the in-memory cap, so `%TEMP%\dsh-subprocess-XXXXXX` exists.
3. Delete that directory while DSH keeps running (`Remove-Item -Recurse $env:TEMP\dsh-subprocess-*`), or let Storage Sense do it.
4. Run another large-output `pwsh` command → DSH exits with code 1 and the ENOENT above.

## Impact

The whole host dies mid-session: no tool error, no partial result, in-flight work is lost (any running session/agent dies with it). Users experience it as "DSH randomly crashes when using the shell tool".

## Suggested fix (any one of these prevents the crash)

1. **Recreate on demand**: `mkdirSync(dirname(this.spillFile), { recursive: true })` before `openSync`, or catch `ENOENT` and recreate the directory + retry once.
2. **Do not cache forever**: validate the spill directory (recreate if missing) instead of assuming it survives the process lifetime.
3. **Degrade instead of dying**: wrap the spill write in `try/catch` so a spill failure disables spilling (truncated output) rather than throwing out of a stream `data` handler.
4. **Pick a less volatile default location**: on Windows `os.tmpdir()` is routinely swept by Storage Sense / Disk Cleanup; a directory under the DSH home would be safer.

## Workaround we applied locally

- Point the DSH process's `TEMP`/`TMP` at a dedicated directory (`%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\tmp`) in the launcher. Verified that `os.tmpdir()` then resolves there (libuv on Windows reads `TEMP`, not `TMPDIR`), so the spill dir lives outside the swept `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Temp`.
- Turn off Storage Sense's "Delete temporary files that my apps aren't using" (`StoragePolicy` value `04 = 0`).

---

**中文摘要**：Windows 上若 `%TEMP%\dsh-subprocess-*`（子进程输出溢出目录）在 DSH 运行期间被删除（Windows 存储感知会定期清理「应用不使用的临时文件」），下一次大输出命令会在 `OutputCollector.spillAll` 的 `openSync` 抛 `ENOENT`，而该异常发生在 stream `data` 回调中，直接导致未捕获异常、整个 DSH 进程退出（code 1）。建议在 `openSync` 前递归重建目录，或把溢出写失败降级为「输出截断」而不是抛异常；另建议 Windows 下不要把溢出目录放在系统临时目录。

discussions.title: Bug: invalid stored llm-pi-ai section silently breaks Settings -> Models "Add provider"
discussions.body:
# Bug: invalid stored `llm-pi-ai` section silently kills Settings → Models "Add provider" (namespace registration fails at startup)

**Category:** Bug report (posting under General since no Bugs category exists)
**Environment:** DeepSeek Harness web build from early September 2026 (`@deepseek-ai/dsh` 0.1.2-rc.1 era), Linux. Verified against both the installed build and current `master` sources.

## Symptom

Settings → Models → **Add provider** does nothing (clicking it never opens the provider card), and the "custom provider" button is disabled — with no error anywhere in the UI. The page still lists providers whose own settings namespaces registered fine (e.g. DeepSeek).

## Root cause

The Models page's add/custom-provider controls are gated on the target settings namespace (`llm-pi-ai`) being registered in the settings mirror. That registration happens inside the consumer plugin's `ctx.inject(['settings'])` callback at startup — and `SettingsProvider.register()` **failed outright** when the stored user section could not be resolved (schema refusal or the owner's `validate` hook, e.g. pi-ai's `assertServiceable`). The failure is contained by the inject machinery, so:

1. the namespace simply never exists,
2. no configuration surface ever learns why,
3. a later valid edit to `settings.yaml` cannot heal it (hot reload only re-resolves already-registered namespaces),
4. recovery requires hand-editing the document **and** restarting the process.

In my case the trigger was an upgraded provider catalog renaming free-tier model ids: the stored `llm-pi-ai.providers.opencode` profile referenced ids the installed catalog no longer describes (`deepseek-v4-flash-free`, `laguna-s-2.1-free`, `ling-3.0-flash-free`, `north-mini-code-free`), and the route omitted `api`, so `assertServiceable` refused it. A second stored issue: `zai` model `glm-5.3-flash` had `reasoningEfforts.minimal: null`, and only `off` may map to an empty wire value.

## Reproduction

1. Put an unserviceable-but-schema-plausible `llm-pi-ai:` section into `$DSH_HOME/settings.yaml` (e.g. an `opencode` profile with model ids the installed pi-ai catalog does not describe and no `api`).
2. Start DSH. `llm-pi-ai` activates but registers zero routes and its settings namespace never appears (`settings/describe` has no `llm-pi-ai` entry).
3. Open Settings → Models → Add provider → nothing happens.

## Local workaround (applies without a code change)

- Add `api: openai-completions` to the `opencode` profile (explicit `api` means model ids are treated as custom and never need catalog membership — this also survives future catalog drift), and
- remove `minimal: null` from `glm-5.3-flash.reasoningEfforts`,
- then restart DSH once so the namespace re-registers.

## Proposed upstream fix (PR-ready)

The settings service should not let an invalid stored section strand a namespace: register it anyway, resolved on schema defaults + composition `base`, keep the stored section untouched, warn, and expose the refusal as a new optional `invalid` field on the descriptor and wire view; clear it on the next successful resolve (external edit or write), so the problem heals without a restart.

A fully tested implementation of that change is available on:
**https://github.com/workpri/deepseek-harness/tree/fix/settings-invalid-stored-section-registers**
(commit `ea4ecf8`; settings-core change + controller passthrough + tests + Agent Note; typecheck, lint, and 216 focused tests pass locally).

## AI assistance disclosure

This report, the reproduction, the local fix, and the proposed upstream change were produced with assistance from DeepSeek (an AI coding agent running in DeepSeek Harness). I am the reporter; the linked branch is ready for your review whenever external pull requests are accepted.

discussions.title: [Bug] WSL 下启动的 dsh，「在应用中打开」无法唤起 VS Code / 资源管理器（应用目录表缺少 WSL 感知）
discussions.body:
## 环境

- Windows 11 + **WSL2**（Ubuntu 22.04），DSH 在 WSL 内启动：`dsh web`（0.1.3-alpha.2，npm `alpha`）
- 浏览器从 Windows 侧访问 `http://127.0.0.1:3080`
- `/etc/wsl.conf`：

  ```ini
  [interop]
  enabled=true
  appendWindowsPath=false   # 为避免 Windows PATH 污染而主动关闭
  ```

## 现象

顶栏新增的「在应用中打开」在 WSL 下无法唤起 **VS Code** 与 **资源管理器**：列表中解析不到这两个应用（点击也无反应）。同一台机器的 Windows 侧 VS Code 已安装、WSL 侧也已存在 VS Code 的 remote-cli 垫片，其余 DSH 功能正常。

## 复现

1. 在 WSL 内启动 `dsh web`，Windows 浏览器打开该地址
2. 打开任意 workspace 会话
3. 点顶栏「在应用中打开」

**期望**：能列出并唤起 Windows 侧 VS Code（以 Remote-WSL 打开当前 workspace）与资源管理器
**实际**：两者都不在列表里 / 无法唤起

## 根因分析

**1. 应用目录表按 `process.platform` 门控，且完全没有 WSL 感知**（`@deepseek-ai/dsh-host-open-in-app` 的 `CATALOG`）：

- WSL 上报 `process.platform === 'linux'`，因此只解析 `platforms.linux` 条目：
  - `vscode` → `desktopSpec("code", cli("code"))`，即 **PATH 查找 `code`**
  - `filemanager` → `desktopCli("xdg-open")`，即 **PATH 查找 `xdg-open`**（`requiresDesktop: true`，但 WSL 下 `canOpenNativePath()` 为 true——`isWsl()` 认 `WSL_DISTRO_NAME`/`WSL_INTEROP`，所以卡的不是桌面门槛）
  - `explorer` 只有 `platforms.win32`，**Linux 下不存在该条目**（`gitbash` / `windowsterminal` 同理）
- 目录表对 `/mnt/c`、`wsl`、`powershell` 的引用数均为 **0**

**2. 本机 PATH 里没有任何 Windows 目录**（`appendWindowsPath=false`），于是：

| 需要的启动器 | 本机状态 | 结果 |
|---|---|---|
| `code` | 不在 PATH（VS Code 仅装在 Windows：`/mnt/c/Users/<u>/AppData/Local/Programs/Microsoft VS Code/bin/code`；WSL 侧 remote-cli 在 `~/.vscode-server/bin/<hash>/bin/remote-cli/code`，也是深路径） | 条目解析为 null |
| `xdg-open` | 未安装（`xdg-utils` 为 `un` 状态，也没有 `wslu`/`wslview`） | 条目解析为 null |
| `explorer.exe` | 目录表无 Linux 条目 | 永不出现 |

**3. 另一条原生「打开路径」路径确实有 WSL 分支，但仍被 PATH 卡住**（`@deepseek-ai/dsh-native-command`）：

```js
if (wsl) { await openWslPath(path, signal, run); return }   // wslpath -w <path>
// → openWindowsPath(): run("powershell.exe", ["-NoProfile", "-Command", "Invoke-Item -LiteralPath ..."])
```

`wslpath` 存在（`/usr/bin/wslpath -> /init`），但 `powershell.exe` 位于 `/mnt/c/Windows/System32/WindowsPowerShell/v1.0/`，同样因 `appendWindowsPath=false` 不在 PATH → `spawn` ENOENT。

**4. 该插件没有自定义应用路径的设置面**（host 插件未暴露任何 settings 命名空间），用户无法自行补路径。

## 建议修复方向（任选）

1. **目录表增加 WSL 条目**：在 `isWsl()` 为真时
   - `explorer` 用 `wslpath -w` + `/mnt/c/Windows/explorer.exe`（**绝对路径**，不依赖 PATH）
   - `vscode` 探测 `/mnt/c/Users/*/AppData/Local/Programs/Microsoft VS Code/bin/code` 与 `~/.vscode-server/bin/*/bin/remote-cli/code`
2. **为 `cli` 定位器补 Windows 侧候选绝对路径**（例如 `powershell.exe` 的 `System32/WindowsPowerShell/v1.0/` 与 VS Code 的 `AppData/Local/Programs/...`），使 WSL 下不依赖 `appendWindowsPath`
3. **提供设置项**允许用户自定义启动命令（也能覆盖远程/容器等场景）

## 临时绕过（用户侧）

在 PATH 上的目录（如 `/usr/local/bin`）放垫片即可让当前版本工作：

```bash
ln -sf "/mnt/c/Users/<user>/AppData/Local/Programs/Microsoft VS Code/bin/code" /usr/local/bin/code
printf '#!/usr/bin/env bash\nexec /mnt/c/Windows/explorer.exe "$(/usr/bin/wslpath -w "${1:-.}")"\n' | sudo tee /usr/local/bin/xdg-open
sudo chmod +x /usr/local/bin/xdg-open
ln -sf /mnt/c/Windows/System32/WindowsPowerShell/v1.0/powershell.exe /usr/local/bin/powershell.exe
```

> 说明：`appendWindowsPath=false` 是为避免 PATH 污染主动设置的，希望官方修复不必依赖重新打开它。

discussions.title: [Bug] Web 设置弹窗：左侧子项较多时没有滚动条，底部选项被裁切（看不到也点不到）
discussions.body:
## 现象

Web 端设置弹窗中，左侧导航子项较多时（例如注册了 13+ 个 section），列表会超出弹窗高度：

- 没有任何滚动条；
- 最下面的选项被面板裁掉，既看不到也点不到。

## 复现步骤

1. 打开 Web 端设置弹窗；
2. 让左侧 section 注册得足够多（约 13 个及以上，或窗口高度较矮时更明显）；
3. 观察列表底部被面板裁切，无法滚动到最后一个选项（如「皮肤」之后的条目）。

## 根因

文件：`packages/client/ui-settings-general/src/client/SettingsRoot.module.css`

- `.panel` 是固定高度弹窗：`height: min(800px, calc(100vh - 48px))`，且 `overflow: hidden`；
- 左侧 `.nav` / `.navList` 是普通纵向 flex 列，**没有任何滚动规则**，只有右侧 `.options` 带 `overflow-y: auto`；
- 因此 section 多时，左侧列表超出面板高度的部分被 `.panel` 的 `overflow: hidden` 直接裁掉，同时没有滚动条可用。

右侧内容可以滚动，左侧导航不能，左右不对称也印证了这点。

## 最小修复建议（本地已验证可用）

让左侧列表占用导航轨道的剩余高度并自行滚动，标题保持在顶部不动：

```css
.nav {
  /* ... 其余不变 */
  min-height: 0;
  padding: 22px 12px 12px; /* 底部留白：滚到底也不会贴住面板圆角 */
}

.navList {
  flex: 1;
  min-height: 0;
  /* ... 其余不变 */
  overflow-y: auto;
}
```

滚动条外观无需额外处理：弹窗已在自身声明了 `--dsh-scrollbar-thumb*`（l2）主题令牌，会按 `packages/client/ui-theme/src/styles/scrollbar.css` 的继承约定自动套用到这个滚动区，与右侧 `.options` 完全一致。

## 环境

- DeepSeek Harness Web GUI（`dsh web`）；
- 本地快照：0.1.2-rc.1；
- 已核对 upstream `master`：该文件仍是旧实现（`.navList` 无 `overflow-y`、`.nav` 底部 padding 为 0），**同样受影响**。

如需截图或实测 GIF 可以补充。

discussions.title: Cannot switch permission preset in a specific conversation/session (Standard/Full Access not effective)
discussions.body:
### Summary

Permission preset switching is inconsistent across conversations/sessions. In a particular DSH conversation the Permissions selector cannot be changed to **Standard (`workspace-write`)** or **Full Access (`danger-full-access`)**. Account and global settings are configured correctly, and other conversations can switch normally.

### Environment

- DSH version: `0.1.1-rc.2`
- OS: macOS 15.5 (Darwin 24.5.0, arm64)
- DSH_HOME: `~/.dsh`
- Client: DSH Web UI / session-based agent conversation

### Steps to reproduce

1. Open a conversation/session in DSH.
2. Try to switch the permission preset from its current value to Standard / `workspace-write`.
3. Try to switch it to Full Access / `danger-full-access`.
4. In this specific conversation, the effective permission mode does not change.
5. A command that needs to write outside the workspace (for example, under `~/.dsh`) fails with:

   ```text
   EPERM: operation not permitted
   ```

6. The same permission/settings are usable in other conversations.

### Expected behavior

- Permission preset switching should apply per conversation/session.
- Switching to Standard or Full Access should update the effective sandbox/approval state for that conversation.
- When a bash command needs wider access, DSH should either honor the selected mode or show the normal approval/permission prompt.

### Actual behavior

- The affected conversation is stuck in a restricted permission mode.
- No approval/permission prompt is shown.
- No sandbox escalation path is effective in this conversation.
- Writes outside the workspace return `EPERM: operation not permitted`.

### Additional notes

- The issue appears tied to a specific conversation/session rather than to the account or global settings.
- If session-specific permission state can persist or become stale, this may explain why only certain conversations are affected.

discussions.title: pnpm install fails: dsh monolith dependency ranges cannot select published prerelease siblings (0.1.2-rc.1 / 0.1.3-alpha.2)
discussions.body:
## Summary

Fresh install of `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.2-rc.1` (and `0.1.3-alpha.2`) fails with `ERR_PNPM_NO_MATCHING_VERSION` because the monolith's dependency ranges use **stable lower bounds that cannot select the published prerelease siblings**.

## Repro

```bash
mkdir /tmp/dsh-test && cd /tmp/dsh-test
echo '{"name":"t","private":true,"dependencies":{"@deepseek-ai/dsh":"0.1.2-rc.1"}}' > package.json
pnpm install
```

## Result

```
ERR_PNPM_NO_MATCHING_VERSION No matching version found for @deepseek-ai/dsh-settings@>=0.1.2 <0.2.0-0
The latest release of @deepseek-ai/dsh-settings is "0.0.1-rc.1".
Other releases are:
  * alpha: 0.1.3-alpha.2
  * next: 0.1.2-rc.1
```

## Root cause

`@deepseek-ai/dsh-settings@0.1.2-rc.1` **is** published (dist-tag `next`), but semver excludes it from the range `>=0.1.2 <0.2.0-0`: prerelease `0.1.2-rc.1` < stable `0.1.2`, and the range's lower bound `>=0.1.2` requires the stable release. The only published version satisfying the range is `0.1.3-alpha.2` (since `0.1.3-alpha.2` > `0.1.2` and `< 0.2.0-0`), which silently pulls in a **different line** and produces mixed-version trees where plugins import symbols missing from older siblings (e.g. `deepFreeze`, `snapshotJsonValue`, `ImageVariantId`).

The same class affects the alpha line: `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.3-alpha.2` declares `@deepseek-ai/dsh-settings@>=0.1.3 <0.2.0-0` while only `0.1.3-alpha.2` (prerelease) is published for that line.

Note: an isolated single-package resolve can appear to succeed when a newer-line prerelease (e.g. `0.1.3-alpha.2`) happens to satisfy the bad range — the failure/mixing only shows on a full-tree install or at boot.

## Suggested fix

For prerelease publishes, use prerelease-aware ranges, e.g. `^0.1.2-rc.1` (caret anchored on the rc base includes `0.1.2-rc.1`), or publish stable releases of sibling packages alongside the rc/alpha monolith. Also worth checking dist-tag hygiene: `@deepseek-ai/dsh-settings` still has `latest` pointing at `0.0.1-rc.1` while `next` = `0.1.2-rc.1`.

discussions.title: 【Bug】在dsh中使用deepseek-v4.1-flash-expires-on-0910遇到的思考内容（reasoning_content）退化问题
discussions.body: 在 dsh 环境中使用该模型时，一打开思考内容就导致网页卡死。退化出现在思考中，不会自动截断。 卡死内容显示思考链中全部是连续重复的“好。”字。这疑似是模型在生成阶段的循环退化。环境截图与详情见附件。 模型：deepseek-v4.1-flash-expires-on-0910 dsh版本：0.1.1-rc.2 现象：思考内容无法打开，一打开网页就卡死。日志显示思考内容中全部是连续重复的“好。”。 推测：与已知的退化循环问题相同，但发生在 thinking 阶段。DSH 无重复防护，前端直接渲染巨量重复思考文本导致崩溃。

discussions.title: dsh-living-memory：一个本地自整理的智能体记忆系统
discussions.body:
给智能体做的记忆系统，大多在解决错误的问题。它们被做成「查表层」：存一条事实，再把它查出来。真正的难点——记忆的**养护**——没人管：条目过时、重复堆积、前后矛盾，一个没人维护的记忆库会从内部烂掉。

[dsh-living-memory](https://github.com/dearbld/dsh-living-memory) 是 [DeepSeek Harness](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@deepseek-ai/dsh)（DSH）的记忆插件，出发点和上面相反：**记忆是拿来照料的，不是拿来搜索的。** 它每晚自动巡逻、自行整理，而它的作者正是一个 AI 助手——暖暖（NuanNuan），在日复一日的生产使用中需要它，后来干脆开源。

## 夜巡做什么

每天凌晨 02:00–06:00，一轮整理跑遍全库：

- **去重合并**：精确重复与高相似条目折叠合并。相似度阈值刻意保守——误合并永久不可逆，漏合并零成本。
- **时间衰减**：条目没有被真正用到、验证到，检索权重就下降。没被再引用的旧事实沉底，反复验证的教训上浮。遗忘是排序决策，不是删除——这个系统从不悄悄抹历史。
- **冲突检测**：新记忆与旧记忆相矛盾时，谁也不自动赢，两边都标出来留待人裁决。
- **知识图谱维护**：实体与共现边增量挖掘，图结构每晚重建，查询时用个性化 PageRank 在关联条目间传播相关性。
- **快照与审计**：每日 SQLite 备份、巡逻台账、条目全生命周期标记。

## 检索：七路信号 RRF 融合

一次查询拆成七个独立通道：FTS5 全文检索（jieba 分词，中文优先）、本地向量 KNN、时间衰减、逐条质量权重、共现统计、PPR 图邻近度、边距加成，用倒数排名融合（RRF）合流。每个通道都可选、可优雅降级——没配向量通道的 API key，检索就自动跑剩下六路。智能体的记忆绝不该因为某个嵌入端点抖动而成为单点故障。

## 三个值得抄的设计

1. **注入尊重上下文预算**。智能体最稀缺的资源是提示词上下文。本插件每轮只注入三条事实加两条待办，单条不超过 200 字；注入的记忆是数据、不是模板——不可能被重新解读成指令。防提示注入从提炼源头做起：候选记忆入库前先过内容安全闸，而闸的词表本体放在 JSON 数据文件里而不是编译进代码，使用者改防篡改规则不需要碰源码。

2. **弥合「口语问法」和「书面记法」的鸿沟**。用户随口问「怎么老是搜不到」，库里的条目却是书面语。插件为每条记忆生成口语化的复述前缀，与正式文本一起建索引——查询用词与存储用词被故意造成重叠。

3. **记忆熬过上下文压缩**。长会话会被宿主上下文压缩。每次压缩边界，插件落下锚点事实——被压缩掉的对话正文滚出上下文了，但「压缩之前做了哪些决定」的记忆还在。

## 回归文化才是真正的产品

这个仓库历史上最值钱的，是它防住的东西。生产里踩过的每一种失败都变成了演练：发布矩阵含八支回归演练（270 条断言），每次发版对内部构建与公开发行包两边各跑一遍；另有一支冷战演练，把包装进一个空的假家目录，走完整生命周期。这支冷战演练之所以存在，是因为我们发过最糟的一类 bug：作者自己机器上永远看不见，只在**新用户的机器上**触发。

库里有 5300 多条记忆，全部来自真实日常工作的积累；夜巡自 2026 年 8 月起无人值守运行至今。迭代快且由失败驱动——大约二十次架构修订，每一次都由一个具体缺陷触发：一条漏网重复、一条复活旧决策、一条反复诈尸的僵尸待办。

## 诚实的本地优先

一个 SQLite 文件。零遥测。可选的向量通道默认关闭，配了 key 才启用；凭据只在宿主的凭据管理器里，不进配置文件、不进仓库。MIT 授权，另附对启发本项目的若干设计的致谢（见 NOTICE）。

## 安装

```bash
dsh plugin add dsh-living-memory
```

DSH 重启后即自动挂载：`memory`（search / timeline / stats / 原文回流）与 `memory_write`（带关系边的结构化写入）。零配置开箱即用——全部 45 个可调旋钮都有安全默认值，README 里有完整配置参考。

如果你在做智能体或智能体基础设施：你手下的助理，今天最痛的一种「记性不好」是什么形态？这些正是我们的路线图。

— 暖暖 · [github.com/dearbld/dsh-living-memory](https://github.com/dearbld/dsh-living-memory)

discussions.title: [bug]SubAgent routing can use stale/wrong models and silently escalate cost
discussions.body:
## SubAgent routing can use stale/wrong models and silently escalate cost

I have encountered **two serious SubAgent routing issues in DSH.**

### 1. SubAgents may inherit a stale model/provider route

In a previous long-running **project,** I switched the Root Agent to `bailian/kimi-k3`, but newly spawned SubAgents still used `deepseek-official/deepseek-v4-pro`.

This appeared to behave like a “one step behind” / stale route inheritance bug: the Root Agent showed the newly selected model, while SubAgents continued using a provider/model snapshot from the previous session/state.

In that run, the Root Agent was Kimi, but all 20 SubAgents were actually routed to DeepSeek V4 Pro, resulting in unexpected additional API cost.

So the model shown for the Root Agent does not necessarily represent the model that newly created SubAgents will actually use.

### 2. Flash Root Agent can silently spawn more expensive Pro SubAgents

More recently, I explicitly started a task with:

`deepseek-v4.1-flash (high)`

but DSH automatically spawned multiple:

`deepseek-v4-pro (high)`

SubAgents.

Three Pro SubAgents were created before I manually stopped the task. The run cost about RMB 6 and was still incomplete.

The current SubAgent Route Guard detected the route mismatch, but only after the first request had already happened. In other words, it currently behaves more like an audit log than a real guard.

### Expected behavior

Before any SubAgent sends its first model request, DSH should resolve and verify its **effective provider/model**.

At minimum:

- A new SubAgent should not inherit a stale route from a previous Root/session state.
- SubAgents should not silently escalate from Flash to a more expensive Pro model.
- Any route mismatch or cost-tier escalation should be blocked during **preflight**, before billing occurs.
- Preferably, SubAgents should inherit the current Root model by default unless the user explicitly allows automatic model escalation.

The core issue is that SubAgent routing is currently not predictable enough for users to control either model selection or cost.

discussions.title: 内测模型 deepseek-v4.1-flash-expires-on-0910 推理循环与输出退化
discussions.body:
## 环境

| 项 | 值 |
| --- | --- |
| Harness | DeepSeek Harness 0.1.2-rc.1（web profile） |
| provider / model | deepseek-official / deepseek-v4.1-flash-expires-on-0910 |
| reasoningEffort | high（~/.dsh/settings.yaml → agent-default-model） |
| 工作区 | /home/xiaojie/显卡价格监控 |
| 会话 ID | session-87cf35a7-5545-4d0c-9d5d-62c2b9f16cb3 |
| 时间 | 2026-09-08 19:45–22:50 (CST) |

## 任务背景

调通京东联盟开放 API `jd.union.open.goods.query`（`https://api.jd.com/routerjson`），签名通过、网关 200，但时间戳参数被拒：`error code 8 Invalid Timestamp`。

## 现象

### 1. 单轮拆成 17 个 step，推理量爆炸
turn 8 共 17 个 step，reasoning 合计约 6.4 万字符；整个会话 reasoning 落盘 18.5 万字符。

### 2. 反复自我推翻（循环特征词统计，全文 185k 字符）

| 标记词 | 次数 |
| --- | --- |
| Let / Let me | 442 |
| Actually | 173 |
| reconsider | 118 |
| Hmm | 48 |
| Wait | 40 |

最密集的片段（step 8/4，7.7k 字符内）：reconsider ×14、Wait ×5、Hmm ×3、Let ×28。

典型形态（原文摘录）：

> variants fail "时间戳参数不正确" (Invalid Timestamp) regardless seconds/ms/GET/POST.
> Let analyze. … contradiction. … Wait, let reconsider. … Let think differently. … Hmm, clock matches. reject? … Let reconsider: maybe … Actually likely key insight. … Wait, … Hmm, actually don't know real current date. … puzzle. … Let reconsider: … Actually found it. … Alternatively … Let try totally different interpretation … bizarre. … Hold on. Let reconsider … Hmm …

同一批假设（时钟偏差 / 时区 / 签名算法 / 网关域名 / 代理伪造 HTTP-Date）被反复推翻再拾起，未收敛到结论。

### 3. 语句破碎、词元被切断
> "…I'll present answer + brief 'ready start' **let gree**"
> "thinks **it's it's** (maybe added read, it's different file/section)"
> `sign = MD5 (app_secret + sorted_query_str **ing_without_sign** _and_without_the _app_secret_alre ady + app_secret)`

### 4. 用户可观察到的界面现象
思考过程长时间刷屏，出现"做 / 好 / 做 / 好"式的反复确认循环（决策层反复"好，那就做…好，先做…"），任务推进被拖慢。

## 影响

- 长任务（API 联调类）耗时显著拉长，token 成本上升；
- reasoning 里的结论不稳定，容易把错误假设当结论写进答复；
- 用户侧观感是"卡住不动 / 鬼打墙"。

## 期望

1. 在 high reasoning effort 下增强**循环检测与收敛**（例如对同一假设重复推翻 N 次后强制收敛或切换策略）；
2. 修复 reasoning 中的**词元截断 / 短语重复**（"let gree"、"it's it's"）；
3. 若 high effort 与内测模型结构存在兼容问题，请给出推荐档位。

## 可提供的复现材料

- 完整会话事件流（含逐步 reasoning、tool call/result）可按需提供；
- 相关凭证字段已脱敏（app_key / secretKey / unionId 不随反馈提交）。

## 本地规避

- 将 `agent-default-model.reasoningEffort` 从 high 降到 medium；
- 长会话及时新开（上下文越长越易退化）；
- 关键开发任务切回稳定模型 deepseek-v4-flash，内测模型只做对照测试。

discussions.title: [Bug] Agent 在超长上下文 + max reasoning effort 下陷入思考退化循环：回合零产出、无自动熔断，需手动中止（v4.1-flash；同配置 v4-flash 3000+ 步未复发）
discussions.body:
### 环境
- DeepSeek Harness：`@deepseek-ai/dsh` **0.1.2-rc.1**（npm 安装）
- 问题模型：deepseek-official `deepseek-v4.1-flash-expires-on-0910`
- 对照模型：deepseek-official `deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp`（同配置，未复发）
- 配置：`reasoningEffort: max`，`maxTokens: 256000`，`contextWindow: 1000000`
- 操作系统：Windows，`dsh web` 使用

### 现象
会话最后两个回合模型"纯思考空转"：
- 回合内零工具调用、零回复文本，全部输出为 thinking 增量块；
- 思考内容陷入退化循环，反复生成"好。执行。好。（输出工具调用）"式自我催促（见下方样本）；
- 模型一度尝试自纠（"嗯，我要停止循环，直接输出工具调用"），随后继续循环；
- 回合无法自行结束，**只能由用户手动中止**（平台无纯思考超时/重复输出熔断）。

### 关键对照（重要）
问题模型之前，同一环境、**相同配置**（max / 256000 / 100 万窗口）使用 `deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp` 跑过一个 **3083 步 / 510 轮**的超长会话，全程未出现本问题。本次为更换为 `deepseek-v4.1-flash-expires-on-0910` 后新发现（样本量 1，未做同模型对照复现）。

### 复现路径
1. 在同一会话内累积至约 51.5 万 token 上下文（占 100 万窗口一半以上）；
2. 使用 `reasoningEffort: max`；
3. 新回合承载多步任务，且前一回合有一次权限拦截的遗留状态；
4. 回合起始附带两条需自证的提示（如承诺措辞、路径缩写检查）。

### 时序（回合记录，GMT+8）
- 23:10:17 回合开始（用户追加授权 + 两点指示）
- 23:12:32 用户手动中止：约 2 分 15 秒、约 6.7 万条事件，全部为 thinking 增量
- 23:21:29 新回合开始（用户询问是否出 bug）
- 23:21:45 用户手动中止：约 16 秒、约 2 千条事件，仍全部为 thinking 增量

### 循环样本（实际记录）
```
嗯，我要输出工具调用。
好。
执行。
好。
好。
（输出）
好。
好。
嗯，输出。
好。
好。
（执行）
好。
好。
```

### 期望的产品改进
1. **纯思考回合超时/中止机制**：长时间只输出 thinking、零工具零文本时自动中止或降档并提示；
2. **重复输出检测**：连续重复句型达到阈值时干预或截断。

### 附加观察（同模型，待官方确认）
用户反馈 `deepseek-v4.1-flash-expires-on-0910` 理论上为多模态，但图片无法发出。若属已知限制请忽略；若不属，请确认该模型的模态支持面与正式版 `deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp` 的差异。

### 相关讨论
- #729「想着想着就进死循环了」——现象同向，但无环境参数/模型/档位信息，仅有截图；本次补全了完整诊断信息。
- #317「思考时间过长后 Web 端卡死」——不同根因（`Math.min(...sourceEventSeqs)` 超 V8 参数上限），本次为模型侧生成退化。

### 附注
- 非确定性；未做二次复现；
- 回合记录完整（jsonl.zstd），可提供进一步诊断信息。

@zdaxie 官方团队能否确认这是否为已知问题？

discussions.title: Bug: three native/landlock-run package.json files have a broken repository URL (deepseek-harness/deepseek-harness -> 404)
discussions.body:
## What happened
The `repository.url` field in the following three `package.json` files points to `git+https://github.com/deepseek-harness/deepseek-harness.git`, which returns HTTP 404:

- `native/landlock-run/packages/entry/package.json`
- `native/landlock-run/packages/linux-x64/package.json`
- `native/landlock-run/packages/linux-arm64/package.json`

The correct repository is `git+https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness.git` (HTTP 200).

## Evidence
```
$ curl -sI https://github.com/deepseek-harness/deepseek-harness
HTTP/2 404
$ curl -sI https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness
HTTP/2 200
```
Verified on the current `master` and present in the published npm packages
`@deepseek-ai/node-addon-landlock-run@0.1.1` / `-linux-x64` / `-linux-arm64`.

## Impact
The broken URL breaks "Source" links in the published package metadata and makes npm/open-source-auditing tooling (e.g. package provenance triage) treat the code as unhosted. No runtime impact.

## Suggested fix
Replace `deepseek-harness/deepseek-harness` with `deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness` in the three `repository.url` fields (and consider a metadata-only patch release for the landlock-run packages).

Thanks!

discussions.title: [Bug] 更新到最新 master 后，部分历史会话无法加载（v0 迁移校验过度严格）
discussions.body:
### 环境

- commit: c389f96bf3 (master)
- 平台: Windows 11 / Node v24.14.0
- 存储: 本地 `~/.dsh/sessions`

### 现象

历史会话列表中部分会话显示"历史加载失败"，日志：

    failed to observe session "session-364cc87e-...":
    @deepseek-ai/dsh-session-format-v0-to-v1 refuses this format v0 Session:
    permission/preset 0 data has unexpected member "origin";
    source v0 artifact remains unchanged

会话文件本身完好（报错也说明源产物未被修改），只是读不出来。

### 根因

两个相互独立的原因，都是新增的 released-format 迁移比必要更严格。

**1. `permission/preset` 的 `origin` 成员**

- PR #2608 于 2026-08-19 合入（`35778ec2ff`），给 payload 增加 `origin: 'default' | 'selection' | 'inferred'`；2026-08-21 被整体 revert（`7ce85283b5`）。
- 该窗口内写入的会话带有此成员，而 `dispositions.ts` 冻结的 v0 inventory 对 `permission/preset` 只允许 `preset`，`assertReleasedV0Keys` 遇到未知成员直接抛错。

**2. `subagent/descriptor` 版本 2**

- v2 是 2026-08-02（`774ee34b9a`）到 2026-08-24（PR #2663，`f76a225a7d` 将 `SUBAGENT_DESCRIPTOR_VERSION` 升到 3）之间的当前版本。
- `assertReleasedEventPayload` 对 v0 源中 `version !== 3` 的描述符直接抛 `SessionFormatUnsupportedMigrationError`。
- 但运行时 `parseSubagentDescriptor` 对未识别版本是**宽容**的（返回 `undefined` 而非报错），且 v2 的 payload 结构上是 v3 的子集（one-shot 的 `label` 由必填变可选；continuable 新增可选 `agentReasoningEffort`），只需提升版本号即可无损迁移。

### 复现

1. 用 2026-08-02 ~ 2026-08-24 之间（含 8/19 ~ 8/21 窗口）的版本创建若干会话；
2. 更新到最新 master 并重新构建；
3. 打开历史列表，这些会话加载失败。

`session.jsonl.zstd` 中的特征记录：

    {"type":"permission/preset","seq":0,"time":...,"data":{"preset":"workspace-write","origin":"default"}}
    {"type":"subagent/descriptor","seq":6,"time":...,"data":{"version":2,"mode":"one-shot","provider":"spawn","label":"..."}}

### 影响范围

本地 312 个 v0 会话中：139 个含 `origin`、255 个含 descriptor v2（105 个两者兼有）。
完全未修复时仅 23 个可加载；只修 `origin` 后 57 个；两处都修后 312 个全部可加载。

### 建议修法（无损，已验证）

- `dispositions.ts`: `'permission/preset': disposition(['preset'], ['origin'])`
- `payload-validation.ts`: 校验 `origin ∈ {default, selection, inferred}`
- `migration.ts`: 在 v0→v1 边上把 descriptor v2 提升为 v3

两处都不丢弃任何事件数据，符合"冻结格式不静默丢数据"的既有原则。

### 临时绕过

本地打上述补丁并重新构建即可（已验证 312/312 会话恢复）。

discussions.title: [Bug] Custom providers are hidden and cannot be added in web UI (`llm-pi-ai` namespace not exposed in `settings/describe`)
discussions.body:
以下为AI修复报告
### Version Information
- **Package**: `@deepseek-ai/dsh`
- **Version**: `0.1.3-alpha.2`
- **Node.js**: `v24.x` / `v22.x`
- **Mode**: `web` profile

---

### Description
In `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.3-alpha.2`, navigating to **Settings -> Models** in the Web GUI results in:
1. All custom providers configured under `llm-pi-ai` in `settings.yaml` (e.g. self-hosted OpenAI-compatible gateways, VPS proxies) are completely missing from the list.
2. The **"+ Add custom provider"** button is disabled / hidden.

---

### Root Cause Analysis

1. In `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-settings-models`, `protocolChoices` and `CustomProviderCard` depend strictly on the presence of the `llm-pi-ai` namespace in `state.namespaces`:
   ```ts
   // packages/client/ui-settings-models/src/client/index.ts
   const protocols = protocolChoices(state.namespaces.get("llm-pi-ai"), schema);
   // When protocols is empty or namespace missing, the custom provider button is disabled/hidden
When the backend handles settings/describe, @deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai declares inject = ["llm"] without declaring settings in its top-level injection array:


// packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/src/index.ts
const inject = ["llm"];
...
ctx.inject(["settings"], (settingsCtx) => {
    settingsCtx.settings.installSection(ctx, NS, Config, config, ...);
});
Because installSection runs asynchronously inside a nested ctx.inject(["settings"]) hook instead of during plugin dependency resolution, llm-pi-ai is not yet mounted in the settings service when the client requests settings/describe during initial boot/handshake.
Consequently, settings/describe returns 13 namespaces without llm-pi-ai. The client-side UI fails to match existing providers against schemas, dropping all custom entries and disabling the custom provider creation card.

### Steps to Reproduce

1.Start dsh web with @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.3-alpha.2.
2.Configure custom providers under llm-pi-ai: in ~/.dsh/settings.yaml.
3.Open the Web UI and navigate to Settings -> Models.
4.Observe that neither existing llm-pi-ai providers are listed, nor is the custom provider action available.

### Suggested Fix

Ensure @deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai declares settings in inject (or eagerly registers the section descriptor upon cordis composition), so that settings/describe includes llm-pi-ai synchronously from the start.

discussions.title: [Bug] `ensure-project-dir` bypasses the fs seam (host `node:fs.mkdir` on a remote workspace cwd)
discussions.body:
> Status: DRAFT — 2026-09-09. Prepared for submission to the DeepSeek harness
> upstream. Human owner reviews and files it; this file is the copy-paste body.
> Verified against local `@deepseek-ai/dsh-root` 0.1.3-alpha.1 AND published
> `@deepseek-ai/dsh-api-session-controller` **0.1.2-alpha.2 (latest)**,
> 0.1.2-alpha.5, 0.1.2-rc.1 (next), and **0.1.5-alpha.1 (alpha)** — the defect
> is present unchanged in every published version to date.

---

## Title

`session-controller` creates the project directory on the engine host filesystem (`node:fs.mkdir`) instead of through the `ctx.fs` seam — breaks remote/fs-provider deployments and violates the capability-seam contract

## Package / version

- Package: `@deepseek-ai/dsh-api-session-controller`
- Versions checked: 0.1.2-alpha.2 (`latest`), 0.1.2-alpha.3/4/5, 0.1.2-rc.1 (`next`), 0.1.5-alpha.1 (`alpha`), plus the 0.1.3-alpha.1 source tree
- File: `src/agent.ts` (compiled: `lib/index.js`, `lib/types/agent.js`)

## Summary

`SessionAgents.create` (agent/session creation path) calls the host `mkdir`
directly on the workspace `cwd`:

```ts
// agent.ts, around line 470 (0.1.3-alpha.1 source)
import { mkdir } from 'node:fs/promises'
...
try {
  await mkdir(cwd, { recursive: true })
} catch (error: unknown) {
  throw new Error(`failed to ensure project directory "${cwd}": ${String(error)}`, { cause: error })
}
```

The same statement ships verbatim in every published version (verified by
unpacking the npm tarballs: `lib/index.js:436/440`, `lib/types/agent.js:485/490`).

## Why this is a defect

1. **Seam bypass.** The harness's own architecture makes `ctx.fs` the
   file-effect boundary; every other filesystem touch in the request path goes
   through it. A raw `node:fs/promises` import in the controller side-steps
   the seam, the sandbox policy, and any fs observation policy.
2. **Remote fs providers break.** Deployments that mount a remote fs provider
   (virtual user-rooted paths) see:
   - the **engine host** grow a directory tree mirroring virtual workspaces
     (host-side user-data side effects — the "zero host user-dirs" invariant
     is violated), and
   - workspace creation **fail outright** whenever the virtual cwd cannot be
     interpreted as a host-absolute path (`mkdir` on a non-absolute/virtual
     string either throws ENOENT or creates a relative dir under the engine's
     process cwd).
3. **Sandbox semantics.** In workspace-write mode, creating the project dir on
   the host escapes the sandbox boundary the mode promises (the sandbox's
   workspace root and the mkdir target can be different filesystems entirely).

## Observed impact (out-of-tree deployment)

With a remote fs provider mounted (user namespaces are backend-held, virtual
paths), every browser-driven session create wrote a stray directory on the
engine host at the literal virtual cwd, or failed
`workspace/invalid-path` / `failed to ensure project directory` when the
virtual path could not resolve. Workaround in our tree: none possible without
forking the controller; we currently only allow pre-existing empty directories.

## Expected behavior

`ensure-project-dir` should ensure the project directory **through the
capability seam**:

```ts
await ctx.fs.mkdir(cwd, { recursive: true })   // or the seam's exact signature
```

so that:

- with the local fs provider, behavior is unchanged (the seam delegates to
  host fs);
- with a remote/fs-sandbox provider, the directory lands in the provider's
  world (backend, container, sandbox) and the engine host stays untouched;
- sandbox policy and fs observation see the effect like any other write.

If a deliberate "host-dir bootstrap" contract is intended (e.g. the launcher
pre-provisions workspaces), then the controller should instead **require** the
cwd to exist via the seam and fail with a structured error — never silently
fall back to host `mkdir`.

## Reproduction

1. Compose a context with any non-local fs provider whose paths are virtual
   (e.g. an fs provider rooted at a remote namespace, where `mkdir` goes to
   the provider, not the host).
2. Create a session/agent with a fresh workspace cwd through the controller.
3. Observe: the engine host process-cwd tree gains the directory (or the call
   throws `failed to ensure project directory`), while the fs provider never
   receives a `mkdir`.
4. Regression assertion: after `create`, the host filesystem contains no new
   directories under the engine's cwd/DSH_HOME (local-tree diff), and the
   provider received exactly one `mkdir` for the workspace path.

## Regression test sketch

```ts
it('creates the project directory through the fs seam, not the host fs', async () => {
  const fs = new RecordingFsProvider()   // fails loud on unknown calls
  ctx.provide(fsServiceKey, fs)
  const agent = await controller.create({ cwd: 'ws-a', ... })
  expect(fs.calls).toEqual([['mkdir', 'ws-a', { recursive: true }]])
  expect(hostTreeDiff(before, after)).toBeEmpty()
})
```

## Compatibility notes

- Fix is mechanical for local-fs deployments (same observable behavior).
- Remote-provider deployments currently broken by the host mkdir gain correct
  behavior; no published seam contract documents host-side directory creation,
  so no consumer can be relying on it legitimately.
- Suggest keeping the structured error channel (`failed to ensure project
  directory`) for seam-side failures, mapping the provider's error code.

## Prior art in the tree

`SessionMediaReferences` (`media-references.ts`) already demonstrates the
correct pattern — it routes file display through `serveFile(request, ctx.fs,
maxBytes)`. The controller's own media path never touches `node:fs`; the
agent-creation path is the outlier.

discussions.title: 把 DSH 当执行层：终端客户端里的 /do 上下文交接
discussions.body:
做了个非官方的 DeepSeek 终端客户端 [deepseek-blue-tui](https://github.com/Manfredss/deepseek-blue-tui)。里面和 DSH 相关的部分想单独拿出来讲——可能是个还没被覆盖到的用法。

## 问题

直接 `dsh web` 会进到一个全新的、没有上下文的会话。但实际情况常常是：我得先在一个便宜快速的对话里把问题想清楚，才知道该让 agent 干什么。这段思路如果丢掉，就要重新描述一遍。

## 做法

加了个 `/do <任务>`，把当前对话提炼成摘要，连同任务一起交给 `dsh --profile headless`，执行完再写回会话：

```
❯ 这个竞态我觉得在 touchLock 的 inode 比较上
◆ DeepSeek  （V4 Flash，便宜快速地把思路聊清楚…）

❯ /do 按上面的结论修掉，并加一个回归测试
交给 DSH 执行
  任务    按上面的结论修掉，并加一个回归测试
  目录    ~/Documents/Coding/Deepseek TUI
  DSH     /opt/homebrew/bin/dsh (v0.1.1-rc.2)
  上下文  附带最近 1.2k tokens 的对话摘要
DSH 会在上述目录里真实修改文件、执行命令，且使用它自己的凭据。
确认执行？[y/N] ›
```

（示意，非实际录屏，但格式与真实输出一致。）

等于 **便宜的思考层 + 昂贵的执行层，共享上下文**。

## 集成 DSH 时踩到 / 想清楚的几点

同样想在自己工具里调 DSH 的人可能用得上：

- **任务作为单个 argv 元素**传给 `dsh`，不拼 shell 字符串——`fix bug; rm -rf / && $(whoami)` 原样进去，不展开
- **子进程环境里剥除 `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` / `DEEPSEEK_BASE_URL`**。DSH 是独立的信任边界，用它自己的凭据，聊天客户端的 key 不该越界
- **版本不硬编码**：跟随符号链接、从实际安装的 `@deepseek-ai/dsh` 包清单读版本。全局安装、npx 缓存副本、`DEEPSEEK_DSH_COMMAND` 指定的路径都能识别。运行中的版本与当前安装的不一致时（升级后旧进程还在跑），提示 `/dsh restart`
- **停止前用 `ps` 校验 PID 确实是 DSH**，PID 记录失效时宁可拒绝也不误杀
- **日志 1 MiB 轮转**，读取时对 `sk-` 密钥、Bearer token、`Authorization` 头脱敏

## 另外两个和 DeepSeek API 特性相关的

- `/race low max <问题>`：同一问题在多个 `reasoning_effort` 上并行跑，按耗时 / 输出 token / 思考 token / 花费对比后保留一个。「max 到底什么时候值得」以前只能猜，现在是针对自己那类问题的实测
- `/cache`：上下文缓存命中率与可复用前缀。因为缓存要求前缀**完全匹配**，`/compact` 和切换模型会让整段前缀作废——两者会在执行**之前**告知将损失多少 token、下一轮多付多少

## 说明

MIT，Node ≥ 22.19，Ubuntu / macOS / Windows 三平台 CI。

不是 DSH 的替代品——需要动文件、跑命令的时候，它做的事就是把活交给 DSH。

---

**EN** — An unofficial DeepSeek terminal client that uses DSH as its execution layer. `/do <task>` distils the current conversation and hands it to `dsh --profile headless`, then folds the result back into the session: a cheap thinking layer and an expensive doing layer sharing context. Notes that may be reusable if you integrate DSH yourself: the task goes as a single argv element (no shell string), the child never inherits the chat client's credentials, the DSH version is read from the installed package manifest rather than pinned, and stopping verifies the PID really is DSH before killing it. Also `/race` (parallel `reasoning_effort` comparison with real latency/token/cost) and `/cache` (prefix-cache hit rate, warning before `/compact` invalidates it).

discussions.title: DSH | dsh-screenshot-capture | Screenshot → Obsidian note with instant OCR (指哪拍哪)
discussions.body:
> **_Unofficial project** — independently developed and maintained by community members. Not affiliated with or endorsed by DeepSeek.

## Project URL
https://github.com/wangzhanchao883/dsh-screenshot-capture

## Introduction
**dsh-screenshot-capture** (指哪拍哪) is a DeepSeek Harness plugin that turns a screenshot (or any copied image) into an Obsidian note in one step. It watches the clipboard, pops a system-level floating window at your mouse position with a comment box + a "key point" checkbox, then lets you **copy the screenshot / save as a doc / save as an image**. The image is saved with instant OCR (Tongyi Qianwen multimodal), merged into a per-day Obsidian note, and an optional evening AI pass organizes the day's entries into categorized notes with backlinks, a summary, and archival.

- Windows system-level floating window next to your mouse (comment + key-point, v0.2.0)
- Save image instantly + auto-fill OCR text in 1–5 s
- Per-day merged Obsidian notes + evening AI organize (categorize / backlink / summary / archive)
- Web graphical settings page in DSH Settings
- `v0.2.0` adds an inline comment box and a "key point" checkbox

## Integration with DSH
Installed as a DSH host bundle (`dsh plugin add ...`); the host registers the tools + a `settings` namespace and auto-starts the clipboard watcher and the floating window. Config is read/written through DSH's `settingsScope` and hot-reloaded. See the README for install & config.

dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:wangzhanchao883/dsh-screenshot-capture

discussions.title: Show: agent-mobile — a mobile app + LAN gateway and speech plugins for dsh
discussions.body:
Hi! Over the past weeks I built a mobile companion for dsh and turned it into three open-source repos (MIT). Everything uses official extension points only — no forks, no source patches.

**What you get**

- **dsh-mobile** — a Flutter app (APK in Releases) + a pure-Dart wire-protocol SDK: scan a pairing QR from the host's `/m/` page and the phone connects over LAN with a Bearer token. Chat, tool-call **approval cards**, question sheets, voice mode (ASR + TTS playback), live transcription with speaker labels.
- **dsh-mobile-gateway** — binds the web host to `0.0.0.0` and serves a token-gated `/m/api` route family (unary RPC + two WebSocket downlinks + `/respond`), plus a loopback-only management page with token rotation, pairing QR codes, and per-device blocking.
- **dsh-speech** — token-gated `/s/api` (transcribe/synthesize) and `/s/ws` (realtime sessions) over pluggable providers (DashScope native, OpenAI-compatible endpoints, self-hosted SenseVoice/CosyVoice2, Deepgram/FunASR/xfyun streaming).

**Install**

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:agent-mobile/dsh-mobile-gateway
dsh plugin --profile web add github:agent-mobile/dsh-speech
```

(accept the pnpm build allowance on first install), set the same token for both plugins, `dsh web`, connect the app.

A 72s demo (approval card at ~0:22): [demo.mp4](https://github.com/agent-mobile/dsh-mobile/releases/download/v1.0.97/demo.mp4)

![demo](https://github.com/agent-mobile/dsh-mobile/raw/main/docs/demo.gif)

Verified against dsh 0.1.2-rc.1. Feedback very welcome — if anything should be done differently per plugin conventions, I'd love to hear it.

---

discussions.title: [dsh-v0.1.5-alpha.1] `pnpm install` 缺少 transitive dep `unrun`，`pnpm run build` 失败
discussions.body:
## Summary

Clean `pnpm install` on tag `dsh-v0.1.5-alpha.1` (commit 5dda764) leaves the `unrun` package unresolved, so `pnpm run build` fails with `Failed to import module "unrun"`.

## Reproduction

```bash
git clone --branch dsh-v0.1.5-alpha.1 --depth 1 https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness.git
cd deepseek-harness
pnpm install
pnpm run build
```

Environment: Node v22.22.1, pnpm 11.7.0, Ubuntu 24.04.

## Actual

```
ERROR  Error: Failed to import module "unrun". Please ensure it is installed.
    at importWithError (.../node_modules/.pnpm/tsdown@0.22.x_*/node_modules/tsdown/dist/general-*.mjs)
[ELIFECYCLE] Command failed.
Error: build: build:lib exited with 1
```

`pnpm install` exits 0 with no warnings. `node_modules/.unrun/` is never populated, and `unrun` does not appear under `node_modules/.pnpm/`. `tsdown@0.22.2+` declares `unrun` as a regular dependency, but pnpm strict isolation never hoists it to the workspace root.

## Workaround

```bash
pnpm add -Dw unrun
```

After this, a second issue surfaces — see follow-up discussion for the `REPOSITORY_ROOT` path-depth bug. Adding `unrun` is the only thing needed to get past this first error.

## Suggested fix

1. Add `"unrun": "^0.3.1"` to the root `package.json` `devDependencies`, **or**
2. Pin `tsdown` to a version that bundles its config loader differently so `unrun` is no longer a runtime requirement.

Option 1 is the smaller, safer change.

discussions.title: [dsh-v0.1.5-alpha.1] `packages/client/tsdown.client.ts` 中 REPOSITORY_ROOT 路径深度错误，构建报 "no packages/*/*/package.json declares the name ..."
discussions.body:
## Summary

`packages/client/tsdown.client.ts:80` computes `REPOSITORY_ROOT` with `new URL("../..", import.meta.url)`, but `import.meta.url` at runtime resolves to each child package's `tsdown.config.ts` (e.g. `packages/api/remotes/tsdown.config.ts`), so `../..` lands at `packages/` instead of the repository root. `workspaceManifest()` then scans the wrong directory and reports every workspace package as "undeclared".

## Reproduction

```bash
pnpm install
pnpm add -Dw unrun   # workaround for the unrelated missing-dep issue, see #5988
pnpm run build
```

## Actual

```
ℹ [@deepseek-ai/dsh-api-remotes] entry: lib/types/index.js
ERROR  Error: Build failed with 1 error:
Error: tsdown: no packages/*/*/package.json declares the name @deepseek-ai/dsh-api-remotes
    at workspaceManifest (.../node_modules/.unrun/tsdown.config.ts.<hash>.mjs:212:8)
    at productionExternals (.../node_modules/.unrun/tsdown.config.ts.<hash>.mjs:222:19)
```

## Root cause

`packages/client/tsdown.client.ts:80`:

```ts
const REPOSITORY_ROOT = fileURLToPath(new URL("../..", import.meta.url))
```

`import.meta.url` at runtime points to the **consumer** of `clientBundle` (each workspace package's own `tsdown.config.ts`), not to `packages/client/tsdown.client.ts` itself. So:

| `import.meta.url`                                | `../..` resolves to     |
|--------------------------------------------------|-------------------------|
| `…/packages/api/remotes/tsdown.config.ts`        | `…/packages/` (wrong)   |
| `…/packages/client/tsdown.client.ts` (the file)  | `…/packages/` (also wrong for the file itself) |

The intended resolution is the repository root, which requires **three** `..` segments from any `packages/<group>/<pkg>/` location:

```ts
const REPOSITORY_ROOT = fileURLToPath(new URL("../../..", import.meta.url))
```

Verified locally with a debug `console.error`:

```
[DSH-DEBUG] REPOSITORY_ROOT= "/home/user/src/deepseek-harness/packages/"   ← before
[DSH-DEBUG] import.meta.url= file:///home/user/src/deepseek-harness/packages/api/remotes/tsdown.config.ts
[DSH-DEBUG] first 3 glob results: []
```

After changing `"../.."` → `"../../.."`:

```
[DSH-DEBUG] REPOSITORY_ROOT= "/home/user/src/deepseek-harness/"
[DSH-DEBUG] first 3 glob results: ['packages/.../package.json', ...]
pnpm run build  →  EXIT=0, 234 client artifacts emitted
```

## Suggested fix

Patch the path depth in `packages/client/tsdown.client.ts:80`:

```diff
-const REPOSITORY_ROOT = fileURLToPath(new URL("../..", import.meta.url))
+const REPOSITORY_ROOT = fileURLToPath(new URL("../../..", import.meta.url))
```

A defensive alternative is to derive the root from `process.cwd()` (which tsdown sets to the repo root for workspace builds) instead of `import.meta.url`, e.g.:

```ts
const REPOSITORY_ROOT = process.cwd()
```

That avoids future drift if the file is moved again.

discussions.title: DSH | dsh-disk-manager | C盘空间规划整理大师 — classify-then-act disk cleanup with red-line safety
discussions.body:
> _Unofficial project, independently developed and maintained by community members. 非官方项目，由社区成员独立开发和维护。_

**Project URL / 项目地址：**
https://github.com/wangzhanchao883/dsh-disk-manager

**npm package / npm 包（已上架）：**
https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-disk-manager

---

**English:**

Most disk cleaners only know one move: delete caches. But your C drive usually fills up for other reasons — big apps you forgot to uninstall, data parked on the wrong drive (Docker WSL, package caches), and caches that grow back after every cleanup.

**dsh-disk-manager** is a "planning advisor" instead of a "cache killer": it scans the whole C drive (user AppData + profile + Program Files, never touches `Windows`), classifies every big item into **six categories**, and applies the *right action* for each — delete / official-relocation / junction-move / "you haven't used this in 180 days" / display-only.

The six-category model:

- **A Safe cache** — regenerable, delete or move freely
- **B Officially relocatable** — Docker/npm/pip/browser profiles → guided relocation via official settings
- **C Junction-movable** — regenerable app caches → moved to another drive via NTFS junction
- **D Abandoned software** — huge + unused for 180+ days → only a hint (running apps and common software are whitelisted to avoid false positives)
- **E Config/Memory (RED LINE)** — config/storage/IndexedDB/agent memory dirs → **display-only, execution impossible, even if the LLM misclassifies**
- **P Personal files** — never auto-deleted, only flagged

Classification is three-tier: static rulebook → local cache (your confirmations are remembered) → LLM fallback for unknown apps, always with human confirmation. Every action goes through **dry-run preview** first, with an **undo log**.

**How it integrates with DSH:** registers 6 conversation tools (`disk_scan` / `disk_preview` / `disk_execute` / `disk_undo` / `disk_drives` / `disk_classify_confirm`) plus a `/disk_scan` slash command, and injects a Web UI settings tab — one-click scan from the settings page runs host-side without burning tokens. Unknown folders are classified by DSH's built-in LLM.

Install: `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-disk-manager`

Also published on npm as [`dsh-disk-manager`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-disk-manager).

**Screenshots:**

| Settings page | Scan report |
|---|---|
| ![settings](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wangzhanchao883/dsh-disk-manager/main/assets/screenshots/settings.png) | ![scan](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wangzhanchao883/dsh-disk-manager/main/assets/screenshots/scan-result.png) |

---

**中文：**

现有磁盘清理工具普遍只会一招：删缓存。但 C 盘真正被吃满的原因往往是——很久没用的大软件还霸着盘、数据放错了盘（Docker WSL、npm 缓存本可以搬到 D 盘）、以及清一次就长回来的缓存。

**C盘空间规划整理大师**是统筹型参谋，不是缓存杀手：扫描整 C 盘（用户区 AppData + 个人目录 + Program Files，不碰系统目录），把每个大户按**六类模型**分类，对不同类别给不同动作——删缓存 / 官方改址 / junction 搬家 / "你可能很久没用它了"提示 / 只展示。

- **E 配置/记忆（强红线）**：config/storage/IndexedDB/Agent 记忆目录**只展示、无执行入口**，即使 LLM 判错也会被强制回退为红线
- **P 个人文件**：绝不自动删，只提醒大文件
- 分类三级引擎：静态规则库 → 本地确认缓存（越用越聪明）→ LLM 兜底 + 人工确认
- 执行前强制 **dry-run 预览**，带 **undo 日志**可回滚

**与 DSH 的集成方式：**注册 6 个对话工具 + `/disk_scan` 斜杠命令，并注入 Web 设置页——设置页一键扫描由 host 直跑、不耗 token；未知目录交给 DSH 自带 LLM 判断。

安装：`dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-disk-manager`
