discussions.title: DSH｜dsh-minimal-transcript｜用执行流程图标隐藏 Web UI 中的思考与工具过程
discussions.body:
> 非官方项目，由社区成员独立开发和维护。

## 项目介绍

[dsh-minimal-transcript](https://github.com/Wzh0718/dsh-minimal-transcript) 是一个兼容 DSH `0.1.1-rc.2` 的 Web UI 插件。

它把页头原本的“显示执行过程”纯文字按钮替换成紧凑的执行流程图标。启用 Minimal 模式后，思考内容、工具调用和 Turn process 只在浏览器显示层隐藏，不修改 Session 事件、工具执行、持久化数据或模型请求。

## 安装

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:Wzh0718/dsh-minimal-transcript
```

安装后重启 Web profile。

## DSH 集成

插件通过 `conversation.session.header.actions` 注册执行流程图标，并使用浏览器端 CSS 控制思考步骤、工具调用和 Turn process 的显示。

目标版本：`DSH 0.1.1-rc.2`。

欢迎反馈兼容性问题、UI 建议和其他 DSH 版本适配需求。

discussions.title: [Feature Proposal] Optional exit confirmation for interactive long-running profiles
discussions.body:
# Optional exit confirmation for interactive long-running profiles

## Use case

When running a long-lived DSH Web process from an interactive terminal, one accidental Ctrl+C can end the host and interrupt multiple active conversations. I would like to offer users an explicit exit-confirmation option for this workflow.

## Proposed behavior

An enabled interactive confirmation policy would print a prompt on the first Ctrl+C, accept a second Ctrl+C within a short confirmation window, and return to normal operation when that window expires. Once shutdown starts, further interrupts would retain the existing force-exit behavior. Supervisor SIGTERM and non-interactive invocations would retain their direct shutdown semantics. Application-requested shutdown would dispose any pending confirmation timer.

The earlier [prototype](https://github.com/foo-hao/deepseek-harness/commit/14f8c3c99d23fa7b8115b9dd678825de2630cc5a) uses a three-second window and a terminal check. It is an August implementation reference; the current launcher and shutdown lifecycle are the target for a refreshed implementation and validation.

## Integration questions

Would the team prefer an opt-in launcher setting for interactive long-running profiles, or an application-owned policy exposed through a launcher extension contract? I lean toward explicit opt-in so that enabling confirmation expresses a deliberate user choice.

The launcher currently owns process signal handlers, while app-provided exit requests share the shutdown controller. A supported policy contract would let the app describe the desired behavior while preserving one owner for signal handling and shutdown ordering. Guidance on the intended configuration scope and terminal detection would help keep the implementation small.

## Validation

The refreshed implementation would be verified with a real terminal process as well as redirected input/output: first and second interrupt, expiration, SIGTERM during a pending prompt, application completion while armed, interrupt during shutdown, and startup cancellation. Windows console-broadcast isolation, discussed in [#3195](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/3195) and [#4713](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/4713), calls for its own platform-specific process-isolation validation; the proposed preference addresses deliberate user interaction with a terminal.

## 中文摘要

希望为从交互终端启动的长驻 DSH 进程提供可选退出确认：首次 Ctrl+C 提示，确认窗口内再次按下开始退出，超时后继续运行。进入退出流程后的中断、SIGTERM、非交互运行和应用主动退出沿用各自的关闭语义，并正确释放确认计时器。已有历史原型可供参考，本帖先确认团队更倾向于启动器配置还是应用声明的退出策略扩展点，再按当前生命周期完成适配和真实终端验证。

discussions.title: harness 进程内存随会话事件数持续增长，长批次约 8 小时后堆触顶 OOM 退出（附测量与采样归因）
discussions.body:
**一句话结论**：dsh web 的 harness 进程内存消耗与累计会话事件数成正比、与数据量基本无关，单个长会话批任务连续运行约 8 小时后 V8 堆触及默认上限（约 4 GB）崩溃退出；抽样与源码线索指向逐事件的投影/校验/冻结记账只增不减。

**预期**：长会话连续运行数天，harness 内存稳定在会话数据量的合理倍数以内。
**实际**：内存以约 4–5 MB/分钟的速率净增长（活跃回合期间），单批 7.9 小时触顶，`FATAL ERROR: Reached heap limit Allocation failed - JavaScript heap out of memory`，进程以 exit code 134 退出。

## 环境

DSH Desktop 0.7.2（内嵌 @deepseek-ai/dsh 0.1.2-alpha.1，Node v24.9.0）· Windows 11 · 32 GB 内存 · web profile

## 关键事实

| 观察 | 数据 |
|---|---|
| 崩溃前最后一次 Mark-Compact | 4125.7 → 4060.0 MB，仅回收 65 MB（活集真占用） |
| 同期会话 jsonl 新增 | 约 13 MB（无单条大记录，工具结果平均 7 KB） |
| 复测 10 分钟窗口 | 新增事件数据约 0.2 MB，heapUsed +46 MB（约 200 倍放大） |
| 增速外推 | 4.6 MB/min × 7.9 h ≈ 2.2 GB + 基线，与实际触顶时间吻合 |

## 机制线索（源码阅读 + 10 分钟 HeapProfiler 采样归因，属分析判断而非定论）

1. `dsh-session` 的 `Session.log` 为 append-only 深冻结数组，含全部流式块（该批任务一夜产生 6500+ 条 `assistant/chunk`），进程存活期间从不裁剪；
2. 每条事件经 `dsh-session-projection` 的 `drive()` 被**十余个投影单元**（todos / goal / sessionStats / tokenUsage / contextBreakdown / subagent…）逐一折叠，whole-value 语义下每步重建整份状态并过 zod 校验；采样中 drive、zod parse、`walkJsonValue` 深冻结遍历均在分配榜前列；
3. projection cache 在每个 `turn/end` 与节流点对全部单元状态做整体 `structuredClone`；
4. 采样中约六成分配归为 native 字符串/缓冲（流式文本累积）。

## 影响

长批次任务必然触顶（默认堆上限下约 8 小时）；harness 死后桌面端停留在失败恢复界面直至手动重启，批次工作全部中断。

## 可选方向

投影状态历史裁剪或增量 checkpoint；空闲会话释放/冷存；流式块合并后再入账。

## 不在范围

桌面端 GPU/渲染问题；归档会话无恢复入口（见讨论 #40）；会话数据量本身（已排除）。

## 复现 / 观察方法

给 harness 进程加 `--inspect=127.0.0.1:<port>`，用 CDP `Runtime.evaluate` 读 `process.memoryUsage()` 每分钟采样，活跃回合期间可见约 4–5 MB/min 净增长；`HeapProfiler.startSampling` / `stopSampling` 可复现上述归因。

## 证据索引

harness.log 的 GC 段与崩溃行（可按要求提供完整片段）；采样 profile JSON（10 分钟窗口，16 KB 采样间隔，可附）。

discussions.title: Feature request: 子代理模型可配置（agent-child-model 设置分节）
discussions.body:
## 背景与动机

子代理（subagent）spawn 时目前没有独立的模型配置入口：`resolveChildAgentOptions()`（`dsh-subagent/lib/index.js`）把父会话的 `{provider, model, maxTokens}` 直接继承给子代理，spawn 请求侧只有 workflow 的 `agent(prompt, {provider, model})` 能显式覆盖，而 `subagent` 工具的 schema 只暴露 description/prompt/run_in_background。

典型场景：长会话用快模型（如 deepseek-v4-flash）做主线，但大批量派工/复核子代理希望走另一个模型（如 kimi-coding/k3）——目前只能整条会话换模型，代价太大。

## 提案：新增 `agent-child-model` 设置分节

### 配置面（照抄 `agent-default-model` 的分层模式，最小增量）

```yaml
# ~/.dsh/settings.yaml
agent-child-model:
  provider: kimi-coding      # 缺省/不设置 = 保持现状（继承父会话）
  model: k3
  reasoningEffort: high      # 可选，同 agent-default-model 分节语义
```

### 解析优先级（first hit wins，全部向后兼容）

1. spawn 请求显式 `agentOptions`（workflow `agent()` 的 provider/model；`subagent` 工具建议新增同名可选参数直通）
2. 会话级显式覆盖（GUI 会话设置里的"子代理模型"选择器，可选）
3. settings 的 `agent-child-model`（本配置项）
4. 兜底 = 现状：继承父会话 `{provider, model}`

### 实现落点（按现有架构惯例）

- 新插件 `dsh-agent-child-model`：结构上复制 `dsh-agent-default-model`（组合配置基座 + 设置提供方叠加 + `currentSelection()`/`saveSelection()`）。
- `resolveChildAgentOptions()` 在 `...requested` 与父继承之间插入一层 childDefault（由新插件经 ctx 提供）。
- `subagent` 工具 schema 增加可选 `provider`/`model`（直通 requested，与 workflow `agent()` 对齐）。
- GUI 设置页复用"默认模型"选择器组件，新增"子代理模型"一行；会话卡的子代理列表可直接展示 descriptor 已有的 `agentModel` 字段（数据已在，只差展示）。

### 明确边界（一期不做）

- 不做角色路由（按用途/深度分模型）——一期只做单一默认。
- depth>1 的子代理同规则递归适用。
- continuable resume：descriptor 已固化的 `agentModel` 沿用（会话一致性优先），除非 resume 时显式覆盖。
- 建议在 descriptor/会话日志记录"模型来源=继承/配置/显式"，便于审计排查。

### 设计理由

DSH 的风格是「组合配置基座 + 设置提供方叠加 + 显式请求直通」三层，`agent-default-model` 已证明这个模式。子代理模型是同一问题的孪生（"无会话级选择时的默认值" vs "有父会话时的覆盖值"），用同一模式新增一个分节，认知成本与实现成本都最低，且不动任何存量行为（不配置 = 现状继承）。

——本建议由 DSH 实际使用中整理（长会话 flash 主线 + 批量建卡子代理派工场景实测）。

discussions.title: [Bug] Minimal preset: persistent pwsh input corrupted at console-width wrap boundaries (`Write-Output` → `rite-Output`)
discussions.body: # [Bug] 极简模式持久化 pwsh 包装命令在控制台宽度折行处被损坏 ## Environment - dsh: `0.1.2-rc.1` (`@latest`); also verified present in `0.1.5-alpha.1` (`@alpha`) — `dsh-tool-pwsh-persistent/lib/index.js` is byte-identical between the two (SHA-256 `7fcae687…d436`) - OS: Windows 11, pwsh 7.x, ConPTY via node-pty - Preset: **minimal** (persistent PowerShell enabled by default since 0.1.0-rc.8) ## Symptom In a minimal-preset session on Windows, running any command through the persistent `pwsh` tool intermittently fails with a corrupted cmdlet name, e.g.: ``` OUT '; $LASTEXITCODE = $null; $__s = 1; try { Invoke-Expression "Get-Date"; $__o ok = $? } catch { $__ok = $false }; if ($null -ne $LASTEXITCODE) { $__s = [int]$LASTEXITCODE } else { $__s = if ($__ok) { 0 } else { 1 } }; Write-Output ('__DSH_ _PERSISTENT_PWSH_END_06bc8933-662f-49a1-b5a6-c3077af17e8c:' + $__s) rite-Output: The term 'rite-Output' is not recognized as a name of a cmdlet, function, script file, or executable program. ``` `Write-Output` loses its leading `W` exactly at a wrap boundary and the command fails. ## Root cause `wrapCommand` in `packages/shell/tool-pwsh-persistent/src/index.ts` sends every command as **one physical input line**: ```ts return `Write-Output '${marker.start}'; $LASTEXITCODE = $null; $__s = 1; try { Invoke-Expression "${body}"; $__ok = $? } catch { $__ok = $false }; if ($null -ne $LASTEXITCODE) { $__s = [int]$LASTEXITCODE } else { $__s = if ($__ok) { 0 } else { 1 } }; Write-Output ('${marker.end}' + $__s)`; ``` The two UUID markers alone are ~80 chars each; with the `Invoke-Expression` boilerplate the line is **382 characters even for `Get-Date`** — far beyond any console width (the backend defaults to `cols: 160`; many terminals are 80/120). PSReadLine/ConPTY drops characters at wrap boundaries of long input lines, so the wrapper itself is corrupted before execution. This also means **no user-side workaround can help**: shortening the command does not shrink the wrapper, and backtick continuations inside the command are escaped to `` `n `` inside the double-quoted string by `quoteForPwsh`, so the input stays one physical line regardless. ## Reproduction 1. Windows, `npm i -g @deepseek-ai/dsh@latest`, `dsh web`. 2. New session, **Minimal mode**, run any command (e.g. `Get-Date`) through the `pwsh` tool. 3. Intermittently: `rite-Output: The term 'rite-Output' is not recognized …` (depends on where the wrap boundary lands for the random UUID). Not Windows-specific in mechanism: on Linux (pwsh 7.4.6 under node-pty at `cols: 80`), the same 382-char wrapper **fails to produce the end marker at all** — the same class of input corruption, so a regression test can run in CI on Linux. ## Proposed fix Write the wrapper to a temp `.ps1` file and send only a short dot-source invocation to the PTY: ```powershell . 'C:\Users\...\AppData\Local\Temp\dsh-pwsh-.ps1' # ~60 chars, never wraps ``` The script file keeps the exact marker/exit-code contract (`Write-Output` of start/end markers, `$LASTEXITCODE` / `$?` mapping). Dot-sourcing (`.`, not `&`) keeps variables, functions and cwd changes in the persistent session, matching today's `Invoke-Expression` semantics. Side benefit: commands containing raw ESC characters stop being "unsupported", since the command body no longer travels through PSReadLine's input line at all. Reference patch (3 changes against `lib/index.js` of `dsh-tool-pwsh-persistent`): ```diff +import { writeFile, unlink } from "node:fs/promises"; +import { tmpdir } from "node:os"; +import { join } from "node:path"; -function wrapCommand(command, marker) { - const body = quoteForPwsh(command); - return `Write-Output '${marker.start}'; $LASTEXITCODE = $null; ...`; -} +function wrapperScript(command, marker) { + const body = quoteForPwsh(command); + return [ + `Write-Output '${marker.start}'`, + "$LASTEXITCODE = $null", + "$__s = 1", + `try { Invoke-Expression "${body}"; $__ok = $? } catch { $__ok = $false }`, + "if ($null -ne $LASTEXITCODE) { $__s = [int]$LASTEXITCODE } else { $__s = if ($__ok) { 0 } else { 1 } }", + `Write-Output ('${marker.end}' + $__s)`, + "" + ].join("\r\n"); +} +async function writeWrapperScript(command, marker) { + const path = join(tmpdir(), `dsh-pwsh-${randomUUID()}.ps1`); + await writeFile(path, wrapperScript(command, marker), "utf8"); + return { path, invocation: `. '${path.replaceAll("'", "''")}'` }; +} - const wrapped = wrapCommand(command, marker); + const script = await writeWrapperScript(command, marker); + __addDisposableResource(env_1, { [Symbol.dispose]: () => { void unlink(script.path).catch(() => {}); } }, false); + const wrapped = script.invocation; ``` ## Verification Mechanism test against a real PTY (node-pty + pwsh 7.4.6, `cols: 80`), 11/11 pass: ``` PASS stock wrapper exceeds 80 cols even for Get-Date — 382 chars PASS stock wrapper corrupted even on Linux PTY — no end marker PASS patched invocation is short — 58 chars PASS patched Get-Date exit 0 PASS variable persists across patched calls PASS multi-line command works PASS throwing command reports exit 1 PASS native exit code propagates — exit 3 PASS CJK command works ``` Known boundary: dot-sourcing a local `.ps1` is subject to execution policy — fine under the default `RemoteSigned` (locally written files carry no Mark-of-the-Web); `AllSigned` deployments would refuse. --- ## 中文摘要 **现象**：Windows 上极简模式（minimal）的持久化 pwsh 工具，任何命令都可能报 `rite-Output: The term 'rite-Output' is not recognized` —— `Write-Output` 在折行处被吃掉首字母。 **根因**：`wrapCommand` 把每条命令包装成一条 ~380 字符的单行发给 PTY（两个 UUID 标记 + Invoke-Expression 样板，空命令也有 ~350 字符），远超控制台宽度；PSReadLine/ConPTY 在长输入行的折行边界丢字符。因此用户侧无法规避：命令再短包装层也照样超长，反引号换行会被转义进字符串。 **复现**：Windows + minimal 预设 + 任意命令，间歇性出现；Linux 下 80 列 PTY 也能复现（结束标记丢失），可用于 CI 回归测试。 **建议修复**：把包装层写进临时 `.ps1`，PTY 只发送 ~60 字符的点源调用 `. ''`。保持 marker/退出码协议不变；点源保证变量/函数/cwd 持久；顺带解决原始 ESC 字符不支持的问题。上文附参考补丁（3 处改动）与 11 项机制测试结果。

discussions.title: [0.1.5-alpha.1] 升级既有 profile 后 client combo 缺失新增 bundle 模块（ui-sidebar-* 404 / loaded without registering），全部 client 插件失效
discussions.body:
> **TL;DR (EN)**: after upgrading an existing npm-global profile from 0.1.3-alpha.2 to 0.1.5-alpha.1 on Windows, the client combo served by `/plugins/??…` omits the four NEW `ui-sidebar-*` bundle modules although the boot roster lists them — every client plugin fails with "loaded without registering", and chat file links throw `sidebarRight: no registered tab type claims`. Rollback to 0.1.3-alpha.2 restores everything. Full forensics below (Chinese).

---

## 环境 / Environment

| 项 | 值 |
|---|---|
| OS | Windows 11（x64，非 WSL 内） |
| 安装方式 | `npm i -g @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.5-alpha.1`（npm 全局，非源码构建） |
| dsh 版本 | 0.1.5-alpha.1（`dsh --version` 确认） |
| 升级前版本 | 0.1.3-alpha.2（npm 全局） |
| profile | 既有 web profile（0.1.2/0.1.3 时代创建），含 6 个外部 client 插件（junction 直链仓库工作树）+ 1 个本地插件 |
| Node | v24.14.1 |

## 现象 / Symptoms

升级到 0.1.5-alpha.1 并重启 `dsh web` 后：

1. 浏览器报 `Failed to load plugins — failed to import loader entry 5d0bcba2 (@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-hmr): client-modules: bundle /plugins/??… loaded without registering "@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-hmr"`，**全部 60 个 client 插件不加载**（含此前一直正常的外部插件）；
2. 点击聊天中的文件链接另弹 `无法打开文件：sidebarRight: no registered tab type claims "dsh-resource://file/…"`。

## 取证 / Evidence

在 0.1.5-alpha.1 运行中的宿主上按顺序做了如下只读取证：

1. **boot roster 包含 sidebar 条目**：`__DSH_BOOT__` 清单（60 条）中有
   `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-sidebar-right` / `-textpreview` / `-files` / `dsh-client-ui-sidebar`；
2. **npm 树内产物存在**：
   `…\npm\node_modules\@deepseek-ai\dsh\node_modules\@deepseek-ai\dsh-client-ui-sidebar-right\lib\client.js`（129 KB）、
   `…dsh-client-ui-sidebar-textpreview\lib\client.js`（29 KB）均在；
3. **dsh-web-app bundle 声明完整**：已安装的 `dsh-web-app\cordis.patch.yml`（L220–235）包含 4 个 `ui-sidebar-*` insert 行，`package.json` dependencies 亦声明这 4 个包；
4. **但 combo 路由对 sidebar 模块 404**：

   ```
   GET /plugins/??@deepseek-ai/dsh-api-gateway/client.js&rev=<boot rev>          → 200（73 616 字节）
   GET /plugins/??@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-sidebar-right/client.js&rev=<同 rev> → 404
   GET /plugins/??@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-sidebar-textpreview/client.js&rev=<同 rev> → 404
   ```

5. 浏览器按完整清单请求 combo（60 个模块逗号拼接），响应字节中不含 sidebar 模块的注册代码 →
   `__ModuleLoader__.load` 从未为清单中靠后的条目调用 → 首个未注册条目（此处为 `dsh-client-hmr`，无辜）
   报 "loaded without registering"，整个 combo 的插件全部失效；
6. 附带效应：文件链接点击统一路由进 `sidebarRight.openResource`（0.1.5 移除了 Detail 面板），而
   `ui-sidebar-textpreview` 的 `text` 类型从未注册，于是所有文件链接点击都抛
   `no registered tab type claims`——符合源码注释 "an address no type will open is a wiring mistake" 的定位。

## 结论（怀疑方向）

boot roster 与 artifact/rev 注册表**不一致**：组合（compose）阶段把 0.1.5 新增的 web-app bundle insert 行
（4 个 `ui-sidebar-*`，均为本版新增模块）纳入了 roster，但 npm 发行树的 client artifact/rev 集里没有对应字节：

- 可能 A：构建期记录的 client artifact 集（234 artifacts）早于/漏于这 4 行；
- 可能 B：升级既有 profile 时，bundle 新增 insert 行未被并入组合或产物对账（npm 全局安装路径）。

无论哪种，roster 与可服务字节的差异目前是**静默**的——表现为无辜条目（hmr）背锅 + 全插件失效，而不是启动时 fail loud。

## 复现 / Reproduce

1. 在 0.1.2/0.1.3 时代的既有 web profile（npm 全局安装）上，`npm i -g @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.5-alpha.1`；
2. `dsh web` 重启，浏览器打开；
3. 观察 combo 加载失败；再点任意聊天文件链接观察第二个弹窗。

（同一 profile 上回退 `npm i -g @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.3-alpha.2` 后一切恢复正常。）

## 期望 / Expected

- boot roster 与可服务的 combo 字节一致：roster 声称存在的模块必须可服务；
- 不一致时启动阶段 fail loud（指名缺失的包），而不是浏览器端首个无辜条目背锅；
- 升级既有 profile 时，bundle 新增 insert 行的依赖应可被解析（或给出明确的迁移指引）。

## 临时缓解 / Workaround

回退 `npm i -g @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.3-alpha.2` 后恢复正常（六插件与宿主均正常）。

## 备注

- 另发现 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-open-in-app`（同样是 0.1.5 新增行）在 combo 中是否可服务未单独验证；若同样缺失，说明是「新增行」级别的系统性遗漏而非 sidebar 特有；
- `ui-sidebar-textpreview` 的 `text` 类型定义（`patterns: ['dsh-resource://file/**']`、`canOpen` 基于 `parseFileAddress`）对 Windows 盘符 `absolute/E:/…` 地址解析正确，已单独验证，排除该因素。

discussions.title: CachyOS DMS ，运行本地部署的dsh每次重启会有概率丢失会话历史
[Bug] Cross-process cold attach: observeSession/promote commits crash-repair closers against a session live in another process (5,876 colliding seqs, history unobservable)
discussions.body:
# [Bug] A cold `observeSession`/`promote` in a second process commits crash-repair closers against a session that is live in another process — 5,876 colliding seqs, history permanently unobservable

This is the cross-process concurrent-writer family already reported in #2571 / #3401 (and analysed in #5640). I am adding it because the **trigger** in this instance is different from both of #5640's triggers: here the second process sealed colliding rows into the log **before any user input in that process at all** — the read/attach path itself (`observeSession` → `promote` → `commitRepair`) is what corrupted the log. It also produced by far the largest collision I have seen reported: **5,876 duplicated seqs**, not 1–4.

## Environment

| | |
|---|---|
| Client | DSH Desktop **2.0.5** (Electron 43.3.0, bundled Node v24.18.1), Windows 11 Pro 10.0.26200, x64 |
| Persistence | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-persistence-jsonl` **0.1.2-rc.1**, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-session` **0.1.2-rc.1** (defaults: zstd frames, `packChunks: true`) |
| Store | one `DSH_HOME` (`%USERPROFILE%\.dsh`) shared by a DSH runtime that had owned the session since creation and by the newly launched desktop app |
| Symptom | `failed to observe session "session-…": corrupt session log: seq gap in committed region at line 1007 (expected 21443, got 21439) (gateway/internal)` |

## Timeline (local time, ms)

The session was created at 10:50:57 and owned continuously by process **A** (a DSH runtime already running before the desktop app was launched; the app's user-data directory and its `logs/dsh-2026-09-09.log` first run header both date from 11:15:37, so the desktop app was not the earlier owner).

| Time | Writer | Event |
|---|---|---|
| 11:15:35.099 | A | `turn/start` (turn 3) |
| 11:15:37.747 | — | DSH Desktop 2.0.5 launched (`run 1788923737666`) |
| 11:16:47.434 | A | seq **21438** `web/deepseek-search-llm-request`; A's next expected seq is **21439** |
| 11:16:47.4 – 11:16:50.878 | **B** (desktop host) | cold-loads the same session → `commitRepair` seals seqs **21439–21441** (`tool/result` synthetic + `step/end` + `turn/end{reason:{kind:"interrupted"}}`), then its resumed `Session` appends `session/end-seed` seq **21442** |
| 11:16:54.280 | A | the real tool result arrives → appends seq **21439** `tool/result` (+ 21440 `step/end`, 21441 `step/start`) → **first collision** |
| 11:16:56.7 | B | 21443 `agent/inbox/spliced`, 21444 `turn/start`, 21445 `agent/inbox/spliced`, 21446 `step/start`, 21447 `user/message`, 21448 `request/header` (a follow-up turn on B's side) |
| 11:17:48.957 | B | turn ends, `turn/end` at seq **27314** |
| 11:17:58.149 | A | turn ends, `turn/end` at seq **27757** |
| 11:18:40 | — | desktop run killed uncleanly (`0xc000013a`), restarted 11:18:43.9 and 11:19:47.9; the next open of the session fails with the error above |

Neither writer ever saw the other: A's cursor stayed at 21439, B's started at 21439 and ran to 27314.

## Forensics

- **Container is healthy**: 935 complete zstd frames, `tornStart: none`, 0 unparsable lines, every frame decodes and passes its checksum. This is *not* a torn-tail case.
- **Two internally contiguous streams interleaved in file order** (a faithful mirror of `scanZstdFrames` + `SessionLogScanner`). One zstd frame = one append batch, so frames partition by writer:
  - prefix written by A before the divergence (frames 1..614, seq `0..21438`) **plus B's whole branch** (frames 615, 616, 628, 631, …): 772 frames, 27,315 events, seq `0..27314`, zero internal gaps
  - A's branch after the divergence (frames 617, 618, 619..627, 629, 630, …): 162 frames, 6,319 events, seq `21439..27757`, zero internal gaps
- **Duplicate census**: 5,876 seqs written **twice** (contiguous range `21439..27314`); 0 missing seqs; 33,634 event instances against 27,758 distinct seqs.
- **The repair fingerprint is unambiguous.** The first colliding row is byte-shape identical to `interruptedTurnClosers()` output:

  ```json
  {"type":"tool/result","seq":21439,"time":1788923807434,"data":{"turn":3,"step":4,
   "message":{"id":"interrupted-tool-result-call_01_…-21439","role":"user",
   "source":{"kind":"tool","callId":"call_01_…"},"content":[{"type":"tool-result",
   "toolCallId":"call_01_…","isError":true,"content":[{"type":"text","text":"The tool call was
   interrupted after it was recorded, but no result was durably recorded. …"}]}]},
   "error":{"name":"ToolOutcomeUnknownError","code":"TOOL_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN"}},
   "surfaceOp":"append","sourceEventSeqs":[21437]}
  ```

  `interrupted-tool-result-<callId>-<seq>` id, `TOOL_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN`, `sourceEventSeqs: [21437]`, and `time` reused from the previous real event — i.e. B ran the **crash-recovery** path against a turn that was merely in flight in another process.
- The colliding seqs are not only closers: from 21441 onward the two branches differ in content (`turn/end` vs `step/start`, `session/end-seed` vs `assistant/chunk`, `agent/inbox/spliced` vs `assistant/chunk`, …), so the two histories genuinely fork and never re-converge.

## Why the *attach* path triggers it

`SessionHistoryController.follow` (`dsh-api-session-controller/lib/types/history.js`) resolves its source through `sourceFor` → `ctx.sessionQuery.observeSession(id)`, and when the observation is `prepared` (cold) with `address.kind === 'session'` it calls `this.promote(promotion)` after the snapshot. B's in-process registry has no live session for that id — the owner is in a different process — so B saw a **cold** stored prefix whose tail turn was open, and:

1. `commitRepair` sealed the synthetic closers at the next-seq B had computed from disk (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-session/repair.js`, `interruptedTurnClosers`);
2. the promoted `Session` was constructed from the stored log as a seed and appended `session/end-seed` (`dsh-session` constructor: `if (seed !== undefined && this.log.at(-1)?.type !== 'session/end-seed') this.append('session/end-seed', {})`).

A, still live, knew nothing about either write. So in the cross-process case the corruption needs **no user action in the second process** — merely opening the session in a second instance is enough, because a live turn is indistinguishable from a crashed turn to a cold reader. (Once B started its own turn, the two branches diverged further; the closers only needed to exist once.)

Difference from #5640: Trigger A there is a stale projection-cache hydrate baseline across restarts; Trigger B is a same-process interrupt/streamer race. This is a third trigger: **cross-process cold attach of a live session**, and the first one I have seen where the observation path alone seals colliding rows.

## Suggested fixes (roughly in order)

1. **Cross-process writer ownership** — the standing ask in #2571/#3401. A lease/lock in the session directory (owner pid + heartbeat) with the loser failing **before** its first write. In the shipped 0.1.2-rc.1 bundles the only exclusive open is `open(tmp, "wx")` for the materialization temp file (`dsh-session-persistence-jsonl/lib/index.js:1227`); nothing takes `flock`/`O_EXCL`/`lockf` on the log, and the `reservation`/`lease` machinery in `dsh-session-persistence` is in-process only.
2. **Never commit repair against a possibly-live session.** Require positive crash evidence before `commitRepair` seals closers — e.g. no foreign lease *and* the log's size/mtime unchanged for N seconds — or make `observeSession`/`promote` strictly read-only while a foreign writer lease exists. This is the fix that would have prevented this report.
3. **Append-time seq guard.** Refuse to seal a frame whose rows do not continue the log's committed length; re-observe and rebase instead of writing a colliding row.
4. **A supported recovery path.** When the committed region contains duplicated seqs, load the longest contiguous branch and warn loudly, instead of making the entire session unreadable. The current behaviour turns a 5,876-row overlap into total loss of a 27,757-event conversation.

## Recovery we performed (for reference)

- Identified the two branches by frame (one zstd frame = one append batch) and kept the branch that matches the persisted projection (`~/.dsh/storages/session_projcache/sessions/<id>.json`: `turns: 4`, `lastTurn: 4`, turn 4 complete) — i.e. the branch the user actually saw in the UI.
- Rebuilt the artifact **byte-exactly**: header frame + the 772 frames of that branch, original frame bytes untouched, **no seq renumbering** (so `sourceEventSeqs` provenance stays valid).
- Verified with the real loader (`JsonlSessionPersistence.loadStored()`): 27,315 events, seq `0..27314` contiguous, `tornMarker: none`; `list()` still returns the session normally. The original file is retained as `session.jsonl.zstd.corrupt-<date>`.

Happy to attach the corrupted log and the rebuild script if useful.

*Related: #2571, #3401, #5640, #5567, #5243, #3198, #1497, #2167.*

discussions.title: 工具参数解析时大整数精度丢失（业务 ID 被舍入）——修复补丁

Source checkout: every run fails with `Cannot find module …/node-addon-system-<platform>/bin/system.node` after pulling the fs-ext → node-addon-system migration（源码检出拉取 flock 迁移后运行即失败，缺 bin/system.node）
discussions.body:
**Environment**

- Clone of `deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness`, HEAD `5dda764ed3` (dsh 0.1.5-alpha.1) — checked out before Sep 7, then `git pull` + `pnpm install`
- macOS 15, arm64; Node v24.18.0; pnpm 11.7.0
- Running from the source workspace (not the npm package)

**Symptom**

Every harness run fails at startup:

```
Cannot find module '<repo>/native/system/packages/darwin-arm64/bin/system.node'
Require stack:
- <repo>/native/system/packages/entry/src/flock.ts
```

The checkout passed the documented First-time setup (`pnpm install` + `pnpm run typecheck`), so nothing signaled that a build step was missing until the first run.

**Root cause**

1. `d927cbff99` (Sep 7) replaced `fs-ext` with the in-repo `@deepseek-ai/node-addon-system` family — motivated by the fs-ext NAN compile failures (#5784, #5929, #5945). Reasonable move: npm consumers are unaffected, since the published platform tarballs ship `bin/`.
2. Inside the workspace, the entry package's platform `optionalDependencies` are `workspace:*` links to `native/system/packages/<platform>/`, and `packages/*/bin/` is gitignored by design — so on a source checkout `bin/` stays empty until you build it.
3. `pnpm install` succeeds silently, and the setup-completion gate in `docs/development.md` (typecheck) never touches native artifacts. A machine set up before Sep 7 and pulled since therefore looks healthy until the first run.
4. The required step — `pnpm run build:native-system` — is documented only in `native/system/README.md` (Development) and the Sep 7 agent note ("Source builds explicitly compile the host addon before repository tests and builds that need it"). It is absent from the root setup docs, and the runtime `MODULE_NOT_FOUND` carries no pointer to it.

**Workaround (verified)**

```sh
pnpm run build:native-system   # from repo root; builds <platform>/bin/system.node
```

After this, `native/system`'s flock suite passes 23/23 and runs start normally again. (Running that suite also needs `pnpm -C native/system run build:test-oracle` first, or the 4 C-oracle tests fail.)

Any pull that touches `native/` requires re-running the build.

**Suggestions** — any one of these closes this class of report:

1. Add the host-addon build to First-time setup in `docs/development.md`, plus a "re-run after pulls touching `native/`" note.
2. An install-time or `doctor`-style check verifying that the host platform package's `prebuilds.json`-declared files exist, failing with the exact fix command.
3. An actionable runtime error: when the flock binding is missing on a source checkout, name `pnpm run build:native-system` in the message.

Happy to send a docs PR for (1) if that's useful.

---

**环境**：macOS arm64 源码检出（Sep 7 之前克隆，pull 至 0.1.5-alpha.1 / `5dda764ed3`）；Node 24.18.0 / pnpm 11.7.0。

**现象**：每轮运行启动即失败，报 `Cannot find module '…/native/system/packages/darwin-arm64/bin/system.node'`（require 栈指向 `entry/src/flock.ts`）。文档规定的初始化（`pnpm install` + `pnpm run typecheck`）全部通过，没有任何信号提示缺构建步骤。

**原因**：`d927cbff99`（9 月 7 日）用仓库内 `node-addon-system` 替换 fs-ext（动机即 #5784 / #5929 / #5945 的 fs-ext 编译问题；npm 用户不受影响，发布 tarball 自带 `bin/`）。但 workspace 内平台包是 `workspace:*` 链接、`packages/*/bin/` 按 design 不进 git，源码检出装完依赖后 `bin/` 为空；必需的 `pnpm run build:native-system` 只写在 `native/system` 子目录 README 和 agent note 里，根目录 setup 文档没有，运行时报错也不指路。

**解法（已验证）**：仓库根目录 `pnpm run build:native-system`；跑 flock 测试套件前先 `pnpm -C native/system run build:test-oracle`。凡 pull 涉及 `native/` 都要重跑构建。

**建议**（三选一即可）：setup 文档补上该步骤；或 install / doctor 时校验宿主平台 `prebuilds.json` 声明的文件并给出修复命令；或运行时报错直接带上 `pnpm run build:native-system`。第 1 项我可以直接提 PR。

discussions.title: [Security]Path traversal / arbitrary file write in `@deepseek-ai/dsh-storage-json` 0.1.5-alpha.1 legacy bootstrap (unvalidated record key)
discussions.body:
## 1. Product Introduction
DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`) is an open-source AI coding-agent harness developed by DeepSeek AI. Its persistence layer is backed by the `@deepseek-ai/dsh-storage-json` package, a JSON key-value storage backend with two layouts: `single` (one file per unit) and `per-record` (one file per record). On first open of a `per-record` unit, a legacy whole-unit file from the old `single` layout is migrated into per-record documents. The vulnerability resides in that migration (legacy bootstrap).

---

## 2. Vulnerability Title
Path traversal / arbitrary file write in `@deepseek-ai/dsh-storage-json` 0.1.5-alpha.1 legacy bootstrap (unvalidated record key)

---

## 3. Summary / Description
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-storage-json` 0.1.5-alpha.1 is affected by a path-traversal weakness in `bootstrapLegacyUnit`. When migrating a legacy whole-unit file into per-record documents, record keys are interpolated directly into `join(dir, table, `$ {key}.json`)` without the package's own `SAFE_KEY_RE` (`^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+ $`) validation. An attacker who can influence a legacy file can supply a key containing `../` (e.g. `../../../../tmp/evil`), causing `mkdir(dirname(path), { recursive: true })` + `writeAtomic` to write `serializeRecord(...)` outside the storage root, resulting in an integrity impact (arbitrary file write).

---

## 4. Technical Analysis / Root Cause
**Weakness**: CWE-22 Path Traversal (leading to arbitrary file write; secondary CWE-73)

**Data flow / trigger path**:

```plain
record key inside legacy whole-unit file <root>/<unit>.json
  → bootstrapLegacyUnit (per-record-unit.ts)
  → join(dir, table, `${key}.json`)    // key is NOT validated against SAFE_KEY_RE
  → mkdir(dirname(path), {recursive:true}) + writeAtomic(path, serializeRecord(...))
  → writes outside the storage root
```

**Code location**:

```latex
File: packages/storage/storage-json/src/per-record-unit.ts
Line: 147-156
Relevant code:
  for (const [table, records] of Object.entries(recordsByTable)) {
    const target = state.tables.get(table)
    if (target === undefined) continue
    for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(records)) {
      const path = join(dir, table, `${key}.json`)          // key unvalidated
      await mkdir(dirname(path), { recursive: true, mode: 0o700 })
      await writeAtomic(path, serializeRecord(descriptor.version, value))
      target.set(key, value)
    }
  }
```

**Contrast (the same validation exists everywhere else)**:

```latex
File: packages/storage/storage-json/src/per-record-unit.ts
Line: 218-221 putRecord        → assertSafeKey(...)
Line: 225-228 deleteRecord     → assertSafeKey(...)
Line: 170     loadTableRecords → SAFE_KEY_RE.test(key)
```

**Root cause**: The package documents the invariant — "record keys become path segments, so they must be path-safe (`[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+`); an unsafe key rejects at write" — and enforces it in `putRecord`, `deleteRecord`, and the read side `loadTableRecords`, but `bootstrapLegacyUnit` omits it. In the pre-per-record layout, record keys were JSON object keys that never needed path safety, so a `..`-containing key is a direct traversal carrier during migration.

---

## 5. Affected Versions
+ **Affected**: 0.1.5-alpha.1 and possibly earlier
+ **Not affected**: none confirmed
+ **Fixed version**: no fix available as of report date
+ **Tested environment**: dsh 0.1.5-alpha.1 / Node.js ≥ 22.19 / a `per-record` unit with a legacy whole-unit file (e.g. `session_projcache`)

---

## 6. Severity
| Item | Value |
| --- | --- |
| CVSS v3.1 score | 5.5 |
| CVSS v3.1 vector | `CVSS:3.1/AV:L/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:H/A:N` |
| CVSS v4.0 score (self-assessed, verify with calculator) | 5.1 |
| CVSS v4.0 vector | `CVSS:4.0/AV:L/AC:L/AT:N/PR:L/UI:N/VC:N/VI:H/VA:N/SC:N/SI:N/SA:N` |
| Rating | Medium |


> Scoring rationale: Triggering requires local access (the ability to write/influence the owner-only storage medium), hence AV:L, PR:L. Impact is integrity only (writing to an arbitrary path with controlled content), no confidentiality/availability impact, hence I:H. This is a defense-in-depth gap and an upgrade landmine rather than a directly remote-exploitable primitive.
>

---

## 7. CVSS Vector
```plain
CVSS:3.1/AV:L/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:H/A:N
CVSS:4.0/AV:L/AC:L/AT:N/PR:L/UI:N/VC:N/VI:H/VA:N/SC:N/SI:N/SA:N
```

---

## 8. Reproduction Steps
### 8.1 Environment
+ Product/version: dsh 0.1.5-alpha.1
+ OS/runtime: any OS + Node.js ≥ 22.19
+ Network position: local
+ Test account: requires write access to the storage root (owner access)

### 8.2 Steps
**Step 1 — Set up the environment**  
Mount the `storage-json` backend with a `per-record` unit that declares `compatibleVersions` (e.g. `session_projcache`), and ensure no new-tree document or `global.json` exists yet (so bootstrap runs).

> Evidence: `packages/session/session-projection-cache/src/spec.ts` uses the per-record layout with a version upgrade path.
>

**Step 2 — Craft the malicious legacy file**  
Write a legacy document at `<root>/<unit>.json` containing a path-traversal record key:

```json
{
  "unit": { "name": "{{UNIT_NAME}}", "version": {{LEGACY_VERSION}} },
  "tables": { "{{TABLE}}": { "../../../../tmp/evil": { "x": 1 } } }
}
```

> Evidence: `bootstrapLegacyUnit` checks only `unit.name` / `unit.version` / `tables` shape, never the key.
>

**Step 3 — Trigger and observe**  
On first `loadAll()`, `bootstrapLegacyUnit` runs; `join(dir, table, "../../../../tmp/evil.json")` escapes the storage root, and `mkdir(dirname, {recursive:true})` + `writeAtomic` writes `serializeRecord(...)` to `/tmp/evil.json` (or any sibling path).

> Evidence: the write path is determined by the `join` result; `writeAtomic` does not reject `..`.
>

**Step 4 — Verify impact (optional)**  
Confirm `/tmp/evil.json` (or the target path) was created with the controlled serialized record, proving the out-of-root write.

---

## 9. Proof of Concept
### 9.1 Usage
+ Runtime: Node.js
+ Dependencies: none
+ Disclaimer: For authorized testing and vulnerability verification only.

### 9.2 POC Code (conceptual, non-weaponized; follows the source path)
```typescript
// Precondition: storage-json backend mounted, per-record unit {{UNIT_NAME}} with compatibleVersions
// 1) Write a legacy file at <root>/{{UNIT_NAME}}.json containing a "../" key (see step 2 JSON)
// 2) Trigger the bootstrap migration via loadAll()
// 3) Observe /tmp/evil.json (or target path) created, containing serializeRecord output
```

### 9.3 Expected output / success criteria
`evil.json` is created outside the storage root, containing `serializeRecord(descriptor.version, value)` — proving the traversal write succeeded.

---

## 10. Mitigation / Fix Recommendations
### 10.1 Temporary mitigations
+ Before upgrading, audit/clean legacy whole-unit record keys to ensure none contain `..`, `/`, or `\`.
+ Apply tighter write permissions to the storage root to reduce the blast radius of an out-of-root write.

### 10.2 Root-cause fixes
+ Mirror `assertSafeKey` in `bootstrapLegacyUnit` (skip or reject legacy keys that fail `SAFE_KEY_RE`), matching the read-side behavior already in `loadTableRecords`:

```typescript
if (!SAFE_KEY_RE.test(key)) continue   // or throw
```

### 10.3 Verification
Replay the malicious legacy file; the out-of-root key is skipped/rejected and `/tmp/evil.json` is no longer created.

---

discussions.title: DSH | DSH SuperAdvisor | A second opinion for your main model, approved by you
discussions.body:
> Unofficial project, independently developed and maintained by community members.

Project: [kvmem/dsh-super-advisor](https://github.com/kvmem/dsh-super-advisor)

**Renamed in 0.1.7:** formerly DSH Advisor (`dsh-tool-advisor`), now DSH SuperAdvisor (`dsh-super-advisor`). Existing users: follow the [upgrade steps](https://github.com/kvmem/dsh-super-advisor#upgrading-from-dsh-advisor-016-or-earlier) to replace the old package while keeping settings and audit records.

DSH SuperAdvisor lets the main model request a focused second opinion through `ask_advisor`. You review and approve the complete request before it reaches the advisor. The advisor returns text advice, and the main model continues to verify and carry out the task.

- **Review before sending:** inspect the question and selected evidence, edit the request, remove evidence, or reject it.
- **Reuse your DSH configuration:** select an existing service and model in Settings → Plugins → DSH SuperAdvisor. Endpoints and credentials stay in Models settings.
- **Control the shared context:** only the reviewed text and explicitly selected evidence are sent; the plugin does not automatically attach the full conversation or workspace. The advisor has no execution tools.
- **Read the result:** expand the advice, inspect the original text, and follow the request ID. Send markers and cached results prevent automatic duplicate sends after interruption.

The plugin uses DSH's native tool, model-adapter, approval, user-question, and Web UI extension services. It also adds guidance about when to seek advice; the main model still decides whether to call the tool.

By default, output follows the model service's token budget and the plugin adds no received-text size cap. Model/service limits and the default 120-second timeout still apply. Approved calls may incur your model service's normal charges.

## Typical setups

- **Local main model + cloud advisor:** keep routine analysis and execution with a local model connected to DSH and capable of calling tools. Approve focused requests to a stronger cloud model when help is needed; the local model verifies the advice and continues.
- **Flash main model + Pro advisor:** use `deepseek-v4-flash` for the main task and `deepseek-v4-pro` for difficult questions or focused reviews, with user approval for each consultation.

The aim is to approach the quality of using a stronger model throughout while reducing stronger-model usage and cost. Actual quality and savings depend on the task, models, context size, and consultation frequency. No comparative quality or cost benchmark has been performed.

## Screenshot

Actual DSH settings UI with a local test configuration. The settings card currently uses Chinese labels; documentation is available in English and Chinese.

![Advisor model settings](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kvmem/dsh-super-advisor/main/docs/screenshots/advisor-settings.png)

## Install

Tested with **DSH 0.1.3-alpha.2, Node 24, Linux, and a local POSIX filesystem**. DSH's installer also requires pnpm. Other versions and operating systems have not been verified.

Download and install the [latest GitHub release](https://github.com/kvmem/dsh-super-advisor/releases/latest) without entering a version number:

```sh
curl -fL https://github.com/kvmem/dsh-super-advisor/releases/latest/download/dsh-super-advisor.tgz -o dsh-super-advisor.tgz
dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-super-advisor.tgz
dsh web
```

This downloads the latest release when you run the command; it does not enable automatic background updates.

Configure the service in **Settings → Models**, including its saved Base URL, credentials, and model. Then select the advisor under **Settings → Plugins → DSH SuperAdvisor** and save. Main-model and advisor-model selections are independent; saving settings does not run inference.

The current release passes **51 automated tests**, build checks, real DSH Loader checks, and Chromium settings checks. This release uses controlled model fixtures for testing. Earlier acceptance included a real DeepSeek Flash → Pro → Flash flow. GLM/Qwen tests used local mock endpoints, not their cloud services. See [ACCEPTANCE.md](https://github.com/kvmem/dsh-super-advisor/blob/main/ACCEPTANCE.md) for the full scope.

## 中文简介

这是一个非官方 DSH 顾问插件：主模型遇到难题时，通过 `ask_advisor` 整理问题和证据；你先查看、编辑或拒绝，逐次批准后才发送给顾问模型。顾问返回文字建议，主模型继续验证和执行。

`0.1.7` 起名称改为 **DSH SuperAdvisor**，包名为 `dsh-super-advisor`。旧版用户请参考[中文升级说明](https://github.com/kvmem/dsh-super-advisor/blob/main/README.zh-CN.md)，替换安装包并保留原设置和审计记录。

模型服务、地址和密钥复用 DSH 的 Models 设置，顾问在 Plugins → DSH SuperAdvisor 中选择。默认沿用模型服务的输出预算，插件接收文本不设上限。模型自身限制及请求超时仍有效。

两个典型场景：

- **本地主模型 + 云端大模型顾问**：具备工具调用能力、已接入 DSH 的本地模型处理日常任务；遇到难题，经用户批准后向云端大模型求助。
- **Flash 主模型 + Pro 顾问**：Flash 负责主要执行，按需请 Pro 分析难题或复核，收到建议后由 Flash 继续验证和执行。

目标是在接近全程使用更强模型效果的同时降低成本。实际效果与节省幅度取决于任务、模型、上下文长度和求助频率，目前尚未进行质量与费用的对照评测。

[English README](https://github.com/kvmem/dsh-super-advisor/blob/main/README.md) · [中文说明](https://github.com/kvmem/dsh-super-advisor/blob/main/README.zh-CN.md) · [反馈问题](https://github.com/kvmem/dsh-super-advisor/issues)

discussions.title: CLI退出问题：正常退出时取消超时兜底，可能导致 WebSocket 残留句柄让 CLI 持续等待
斜杠命令/技能描述硬编码英文且 web 与桌面壳两端不一致——建议提供官方本地化或描述覆盖机制
discussions.body:
## 现象

斜杠命令面板（`/` 菜单）与技能列表的**描述文字**为硬编码英文，且 **web 端与桌面壳显示不一致**：

- `/compact`、`/export`、`/feedback`、`/goal`、`/plan`、`/permission` 等内置命令描述为英文（如 "Compact older conversation history"）
- 插件注册的技能/命令描述同理（如 univer 系列 8 个技能，英文长描述）
- 同一命令：web 端显示中文（本地补丁改过 description），桌面壳显示英文——两端加载的核心包不是同一物理副本

## 根因（本机实证）

- **web 实例**：由 launchd 从 npx 缓存启动，加载 npx 缓存内的 `@deepseek-ai/*` 核心包
- **桌面壳实例**：内嵌 server 是 Electron 主进程的一部分，模块解析从 app bundle 自带 node_modules（`app.asar.unpacked/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/`）起步，**绕过共享层/任何外部覆盖点**

因此命令描述这类硬编码展示文本，本地只能以「直接改 node_modules 文件」的方式覆盖（幂等补丁脚本），**任何升级（DSH 升级或桌面壳更新）都会还原英文**，且两端永远各打各的补丁。

## 建议

1. 为命令/技能 description 提供**官方本地化或覆盖机制**，例如：
   - 命令注册支持从 profile 配置覆盖 description（`cordis.patch.yml` 或 locale 文件），或
   - 提供 `i18n` 字典目录（如 `dsh-*` 包的 `locales/zh.json`），UI 按 `Accept-Language` 渲染
2. 文档化桌面壳内嵌 server 的核心包来源（app bundle 内 node_modules），方便维护者预知补丁失效边界

环境：DSH 0.1.1-rc.2（npx 安装）+ DSH Desktop 2.0.3（macOS）

discussions.title: [开源自荐] DSH TUI：在终端里使用 DeepSeek Harness，支持会话管理、多模型与中英文界面
discussions.body:
大家好，给社区分享一下我们做的 DSH TUI：一个可以安装到官方 DeepSeek Harness 上的原生全屏终端界面。

如果你平时主要在终端里写代码，希望在同一个窗口里和 Agent 对话、查看工具结果、处理审批、切换模型，再接着上次的任务继续工作，这个插件可能适合你。

DSH TUI 通过独立的 tui profile 安装，沿用官方 Harness 的 Agent 执行循环、持久会话和插件机制。我们的工作主要放在终端交互上：让运行过程更容易看清，让会话和模型等常用操作能直接在终端完成。

项目采用 MIT 协议，已经开源并发布到 npm，是独立维护的社区插件。

  • GitHub： Lingxi-AI-cn/dsh-tui-plugin

  • 中文说明： README.zh.md

  • npm： @lingxi-ai-cn/dsh-tui

先看一下界面

仓库中的中文启动界面预览；截图中的模型仅作展示，实际可选模型取决于配置和账户。

目前可以做什么

🖥️ 在终端里看清 Agent 正在做什么

对话界面可以显示 Markdown、推理过程、工具调用与结果、代码 Diff，以及搜索和 Web 活动。连续的工具调用会收成紧凑的活动摘要，需要时再展开查看详情。

较长的回复可以打开阅读器，按行滚动查看；支持复制或导出当前回复片段、同一轮完整回复。任务列表、子 Agent 活动和后台工作也有对应的查看入口。

🗂️ 把会话接着做下去

  • /resume：查找并恢复历史会话。

  • /sessions：跨工作区浏览、筛选、重命名、归档和分叉会话。

  • /new、/clear：开始一个新会话。

  • /rewind：从更早的安全对话节点创建会话分支。

  • /export：导出会话，方便回顾或备份。

也可以搜索完整对话记录，在根 Agent 和仍存活的子 Agent 之间切换。对于需要反复接续的任务，不必每次都从头说明背景。

🧠 切换模型和 Agent 模式

通过 /models 选择已配置的提供方、模型，以及模型支持的推理强度。随包提供 ChatGPT Codex adapter，可以从界面发起 ChatGPT 登录，并动态发现账户可用的模型。

当前增强 Provider 在界面中显示为 ChatGPT Codex（Lingxi 增强）。安装不会自动登录或迁移现有凭据；在 TUI 中新选择的默认模型单独保存，不会改写共享的 Agent 默认模型。

/mode 可以选择官方的 Standard、PTC、Minimal、Creator 四种 Agent Preset，也可以选择已经安装且可用的自定义 Preset。已有工作内容时，切换模式会在确认后创建新会话。

⌨️ 键盘操作，也能用鼠标辅助

支持多行编辑、命令与路径补全、已提交输入的历史记录、撤销/重做、外部编辑器，以及工作区文件的 @ 引用补全。

终端支持相应能力时，可以用鼠标滚动和选择常用界面目标；也能在 /config 中调整鼠标行为、主题和按键绑定。当前有效快捷键可以直接在 /help 查看。

🌏 中英文界面与主题

通过 /lang zh 或 /lang en 切换界面语言，菜单、提示、对话框和底部状态栏会一起更新。

主题支持自动、深色、浅色和无颜色模式，并处理中文等 Unicode 字符的显示宽度。底部状态栏可以直接打开模型、模式、权限、上下文和工作区等常用面板。

🧩 在终端里发现插件和排查配置

/plugins 可以浏览已安装插件、Registry 条目和社区 GitHub 仓库，并区分哪些版本可安装、哪些条目仅供浏览。安装和移除仍通过官方 dsh plugin 命令完成。

另外还有 /skills、/mcp、/provider 等查看入口；遇到配置问题时，可以用 /doctor 检查能力与运行状态，用 /context 查看当前加载的模型、工具和上下文信息。

怎么安装

截至本文准备时，已发布的版本组合是：

下面适用于新安装环境。如果已经在使用其他 DSH 版本，请先查看仓库的兼容性说明，避免直接覆盖现有安装。

npm install --global @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.2-rc.1
dsh plugin --profile tui add --save-exact @lingxi-ai-cn/dsh-tui@0.1.9-rc.1
dsh --profile tui

如果已经安装了上述官方 DSH 版本，只需执行后两行。使用项目本地安装的 DSH 时，通过该安装提供的 dsh 执行同样的 profile 命令。

首次进入后，可以依次试试：

/lang zh     切换到中文
/models      选择模型或完成认证
/mode        选择 Agent 模式
/config      调整主题和交互设置
/help        查看命令与快捷键

只需要安装入口包 @lingxi-ai-cn/dsh-tui，内部依赖会一并安装。如果曾使用包含 @deepseek-ai/dsh-tui-app 的旧 tui profile，请先按中文说明中的旧 profile 迁移步骤备份并重建。

当前版本的边界

目前仍是预发布版本，有几件事需要提前说明：

  • 兼容版本需要对齐。 当前版本验证的是官方 DSH 0.1.2-rc.1，尚未声明支持 0.1.5-alpha.1 等更新的 alpha 版本，请按上面的精确版本安装。

  • 终端环境仍需要更多实测。 本次发布已通过 macOS 14、Ubuntu 24.04 CI，以及使用官方 DSH 包的干净环境安装和终端启动/退出检查。Windows、原生中文输入法预编辑、真实账户 OAuth，以及不同 SSH/tmux 终端组合还需要进一步验证。

  • 部分操作取决于 Host 能力。 例如待发送消息的编辑/删除、会话取消归档等，只有当前 Host 提供相应能力时才会开放。

  • 退出仍可能遇到官方 CLI 的连接等待。 插件会释放自有连接并恢复终端状态，但远端 WebSocket 关闭握手仍可能拖延官方 CLI 的自然退出；当前 npm 插件版本尚未解决这一 CLI 层问题。

详细功能、升级说明和版本变化可以查看中文 README与更新记录。

欢迎试用和反馈

如果你也喜欢在终端里使用编码 Agent，欢迎试试 DSH TUI。我们尤其想了解：

  • 第一次安装、选择模型和开始对话是否顺利？

  • 长回复、工具活动和历史会话是否容易阅读？

  • 你使用的终端里，中文输入、鼠标滚动和快捷键是否符合预期？

  • 哪些日常操作还需要频繁离开终端完成？

可以在这里回复，也可以到项目 Issues反馈，附上 DSH/TUI 版本、系统和终端名称会更方便定位。喜欢的话，也欢迎给项目一个 Star。

感谢 DeepSeek Harness 团队提供的插件系统和 Agent 能力，也感谢社区里分享插件、工具和使用经验的朋友。

`/resume`：查找并恢复历史会话。 - `/sessions`：跨工作区浏览、筛选、重命名、归档和分叉会话。 - `/new`、`/clear`：开始一个新会话。 - `/rewind`：从更早的安全对话节点创建会话分支。 - `/export`：导出会话，方便回顾或备份。 也可以搜索完整对话记录，在根 Agent 和仍存活的子 Agent 之间切换。对于需要反复接续的任务，不必每次都从头说明背景。 ### 🧠 切换模型和 Agent 模式 通过 `/models` 选择已配置的提供方、模型，以及模型支持的推理强度。随包提供 ChatGPT Codex adapter，可以从界面发起 ChatGPT 登录，并动态发现账户可用的模型。 当前增强 Provider 在界面中显示为 **ChatGPT Codex（Lingxi 增强）**。安装不会自动登录或迁移现有凭据；在 TUI 中新选择的默认模型单独保存，不会改写共享的 Agent 默认模型。 `/mode` 可以选择官方的 **Standard、PTC、Minimal、Creator** 四种 Agent Preset，也可以选择已经安装且可用的自定义 Preset。已有工作内容时，切换模式会在确认后创建新会话。 ### ⌨️ 键盘操作，也能用鼠标辅助 支持多行编辑、命令与路径补全、已提交输入的历史记录、撤销/重做、外部编辑器，以及工作区文件的 `@` 引用补全。 终端支持相应能力时，可以用鼠标滚动和选择常用界面目标；也能在 `/config` 中调整鼠标行为、主题和按键绑定。当前有效快捷键可以直接在 `/help` 查看。 ### 🌏 中英文界面与主题 通过 `/lang zh` 或 `/lang en` 切换界面语言，菜单、提示、对话框和底部状态栏会一起更新。 主题支持自动、深色、浅色和无颜色模式，并处理中文等 Unicode 字符的显示宽度。底部状态栏可以直接打开模型、模式、权限、上下文和工作区等常用面板。 ### 🧩 在终端里发现插件和排查配置 `/plugins` 可以浏览已安装插件、Registry 条目和社区 GitHub 仓库，并区分哪些版本可安装、哪些条目仅供浏览。安装和移除仍通过官方 `dsh plugin` 命令完成。 另外还有 `/skills`、`/mcp`、`/provider` 等查看入口；遇到配置问题时，可以用 `/doctor` 检查能力与运行状态，用 `/context` 查看当前加载的模型、工具和上下文信息。 ## 怎么安装 截至本文准备时，已发布的版本组合是： | 项目 | 版本要求 | | --------------------- | -------------------------- | | DSH TUI | `0.1.9-rc.1` | | 官方 DeepSeek Harness | **`0.1.2-rc.1`，精确匹配** | | Node.js | `^22.19.0` 或 `>=24` | 下面适用于新安装环境。如果已经在使用其他 DSH 版本，请先查看仓库的兼容性说明，避免直接覆盖现有安装。 ```sh npm install --global @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.2-rc.1 dsh plugin --profile tui add --save-exact @lingxi-ai-cn/dsh-tui@0.1.9-rc.1 dsh --profile tui ``` 如果已经安装了上述官方 DSH 版本，只需执行后两行。使用项目本地安装的 DSH 时，通过该安装提供的 `dsh` 执行同样的 profile 命令。 首次进入后，可以依次试试： ```text /lang zh 切换到中文 /models 选择模型或完成认证 /mode 选择 Agent 模式 /config 调整主题和交互设置 /help 查看命令与快捷键 ``` 只需要安装入口包 `@lingxi-ai-cn/dsh-tui`，内部依赖会一并安装。如果曾使用包含 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tui-app` 的旧 `tui` profile，请先按[[中文说明中的旧 profile 迁移步骤](https://github.com/Lingxi-AI-cn/dsh-tui-plugin/blob/v0.1.9-rc.1/README.zh.md)](https://github.com/Lingxi-AI-cn/dsh-tui-plugin/blob/v0.1.9-rc.1/README.zh.md)备份并重建。 ## 当前版本的边界 目前仍是预发布版本，有几件事需要提前说明： - **兼容版本需要对齐。** 当前版本验证的是官方 DSH `0.1.2-rc.1`，尚未声明支持 `0.1.5-alpha.1` 等更新的 alpha 版本，请按上面的精确版本安装。 - **终端环境仍需要更多实测。** 本次发布已通过 macOS 14、Ubuntu 24.04 CI，以及使用官方 DSH 包的干净环境安装和终端启动/退出检查。Windows、原生中文输入法预编辑、真实账户 OAuth，以及不同 SSH/tmux 终端组合还需要进一步验证。 - **部分操作取决于 Host 能力。** 例如待发送消息的编辑/删除、会话取消归档等，只有当前 Host 提供相应能力时才会开放。 - **退出仍可能遇到官方 CLI 的连接等待。** 插件会释放自有连接并恢复终端状态，但远端 WebSocket 关闭握手仍可能拖延官方 CLI 的自然退出；当前 npm 插件版本尚未解决这一 CLI 层问题。 详细功能、升级说明和版本变化可以查看[[中文 README](https://github.com/Lingxi-AI-cn/dsh-tui-plugin/blob/main/README.zh.md)](https://github.com/Lingxi-AI-cn/dsh-tui-plugin/blob/main/README.zh.md)与[[更新记录](https://github.com/Lingxi-AI-cn/dsh-tui-plugin/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)](https://github.com/Lingxi-AI-cn/dsh-tui-plugin/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)。 ## 欢迎试用和反馈 如果你也喜欢在终端里使用编码 Agent，欢迎试试 DSH TUI。我们尤其想了解： - 第一次安装、选择模型和开始对话是否顺利？ - 长回复、工具活动和历史会话是否容易阅读？ - 你使用的终端里，中文输入、鼠标滚动和快捷键是否符合预期？ - 哪些日常操作还需要频繁离开终端完成？ 可以在这里回复，也可以到[[项目 Issues](https://github.com/Lingxi-AI-cn/dsh-tui-plugin/issues)](https://github.com/Lingxi-AI-cn/dsh-tui-plugin/issues)反馈，附上 DSH/TUI 版本、系统和终端名称会更方便定位。喜欢的话，也欢迎给项目一个 Star。 感谢 DeepSeek Harness 团队提供的插件系统和 Agent 能力，也感谢社区里分享插件、工具和使用经验的朋友。

discussions.title: Downstream requirements: the proposed "Pre-tool input rewrite" design
discussions.body:
# Downstream requirements: the proposed "Pre-tool input rewrite" design

This post collects requirements from a plugin that hits the current
pre-execute ceiling every day. It references the proposed agent note
`.agents/notes/proposed/feature/2026-06-30-pre-tool-input-rewrite.md`
(status: proposed; TODO(pre-tool-input-rewrite) anchors the missing phase).

## The dsh-mask scenario (real, measured in our plugin workspace)

dsh-mask replaces PII with placeholders. Two of its hard rules matter here:
the agent/pre-step masking listener never blocks a step (it always calls
next()), and model-visible text equals the logged text. Its own source
records the ceiling: tool arguments cannot be rewritten at pre-execute
under the current contract, so the tools scope lands on results, "the
rewritable model-visible face" (dsh-mask index.mjs).

Consequence today: when the model emits a tool call whose arguments contain
PII (a bash command with an ID number, a key in an env assignment), those
arguments execute unmasked; masking happens only on the result content
post-execution. The only pre-execution lever tools/pre-execute offers is
allow/deny/ask over frozen arguments - for dsh-mask that means fail-closed
deny (blocks the work) or letting the plaintext run. What dsh-mask needs is
a pre-execution rewrite: replace secrets with placeholders and strip or
downgrade fields before execution, with the original arguments preserved
for audit.

## Downstream view on the four open questions

Each item is a suggestion from one downstream, not a conclusion.

Q1. assistant/message rewrite vs a separate correction record.
Suggestion: default to a separate correction record carried into the next
request; keep the in-place rewrite as an explicit opt-in. Grounding:
permission-rules replays session history and keeps its decision rows
log-only, never injected into model context, precisely so the replay stays
faithful (dsh-permission-rules README). dsh-mask follows the same
invariant: the log must reconstruct exactly what the model saw. Editing the
assistant tool-call block changes what the model "sees it said"; the ADR's
own risk section notes a provider may reject that on replay.

Q2. Preserve the original arguments on tool/call (sidecar field)?
Suggestion: yes, under a reserved, schema-pinned field (for example
originalArguments). Audit needs both facts: what the model emitted and what
executed. Without the original, a post-hoc review cannot tell whether a
rewrite was the intended mask or a malicious edit, and the decision cannot
be reconstructed. Keep the sidecar out of presentation.

Q3. Where does the rewrite decision live?
Suggestion: a dedicated earlier extension point (a pre-rewrite decision)
over moving the existing pre-execute hook earlier. Moving the existing hook
forces every allow/deny/ask plugin to reason about a new ordering and can
make them run twice; a separate decision lets rewrite-only plugins such as
dsh-mask opt in while the existing gate keeps its firing point. The rewrite
must resolve before the log commit, and for deterministic maskers it should
complete synchronously without surfacing an ask.

Q4. Interaction with the permission ask flow.
Suggestion: ask binds to the effective (rewritten) arguments; the ask
payload shows the original-vs-effective difference so the human approves
exactly what will run. A decline must leave the original assistant/message
authoritative and execute nothing. A rewrite that changes the risk profile
must be visible as such, never silently folded into an approve.

## What we will do with a merged mechanism

- dsh-mask: pre-execution argument masking/downgrade with originals
  preserved; retire the post-execution-only tools scope where the rewrite
  covers it.
- permission-rules: rewrite-aware audit rows; decision events record both
  argument forms.
- Report measured behavior (replay fidelity, audit completeness, ask flow)
  back to this discussion.

discussions.title: [Bug] V2→V3 迁移拒绝含"中断轮次重启"的 v2 会话：turn/start N+1 does not open expected turn N（附根因与修复）
discussions.body:
## 现象

升级到含 V2→V3 迁移的构建（0.1.5-alpha.1 / master 5dda764ed3）后，一份历史会话无法打开，日志加载失败：

```
SessionFormatUnsupportedMigrationError: Session migration from v2 to v3 refuses
the transformed artifact: turn/start 24 does not open expected turn 23
（v2 原文件保持不变）
```

## 最小复现（与具体会话内容无关）

一段 v2 事件序列即可复现：

```
turn/start(1) → step/start(1,1) → step/end(1,1)
→ agent/inbox/spliced{target:'next-turn',start:0,inserted:[userMessage]}
→ turn/start(2)          # 没有 turn/end(1)
```

用 catalog 以 `validation: 'transformed'` 恢复，抛
`turn/start 2 does not open expected turn 1`。

## 根因

- 已发布的 v2 writer 在"上一轮被中断/中止、用户又发消息"时，会留下一个未关闭的轮次：紧跟一条非空 `next-turn` 的 `agent/inbox/spliced`，然后下一个 `turn/start`；恢复只在内存里关闭旧轮次，日志保留未关闭形态。
- V1→V2 边会为 **v1 来源**补一条 `interrupted` 的 `turn/end`（`session-format-v1-to-v2/src/migration.ts:393-410`），但**由 v2 writer 直接写出的 v2 文件不经过这条边**。
- 读取 v2 文件时若无需迁移，`transformed` 策略只做 codec 校验，所以 released v2 运行时能读；一旦要迁移到 v3，就走
  `restoreReleasedV3Artifact` → `restoreReleasedV2Artifact` → `assertReleasedArtifactRelationships`，
  而 `RELEASED_V2_RELATIONSHIP_EXTENSIONS`（`session-format-v1-to-v2/src/validation.ts:23`）没有打开 `legacyInterruptedTurnRestart`，于是拒绝。
- 该开关本来就是为这个形态设计的（`session-format-v0-to-v1/src/relationships.ts:38,82`），v0/v1 的测试也已启用（`src/testing/validation.ts:29,42`），唯独 v2 漏了——v2 校验器与 v2 writer 自相矛盾。

## 建议修复（1 行）

`packages/session/session-format-v1-to-v2/src/validation.ts`：

```diff
 const RELEASED_V2_RELATIONSHIP_EXTENSIONS = {
   stepEvents: new Set(['assistant/attempt']),
   preservedSourceTitleRequestText: true,
+  // Released v2 appends the next turn after an interrupted one without writing
+  // its turn/end, so its own logs carry the legacy restart pattern.
+  legacyInterruptedTurnRestart: true,
 } as const
```

接受范围仍严格限定为"无打开 step 的打开轮次 + 紧邻的非空 next-turn splice + 下一个编号的 turn/start"；空 splice、跳号仍拒绝。V2→V3 不插入合成 `turn/end`。

## 回归测试
`packages/session/session-format-v2-to-v3/tests/migration.spec.ts` 新增用例：接受该重启、断言不产生合成 closer、并断言空 `inserted` 的同样形态仍抛错。
[migration.spec.ts](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/31992566/migration.spec.ts)


## 验证

- 出问题的真实日志：修复前精确复现同一条错误；修复后 `transformed` 与 `current` 两条加载路径都通过，26 个 turn 全部保留。
- `session-format-v1-to-v2` + `session-format-v2-to-v3` + `v0-to-v1 relationships` 共 695 tests 通过；`session-format-catalog` 26 通过；改动文件覆盖率 100%。

## 影响

任何含该形态的 **v2** 会话，在带 V2→V3 迁移的构建上都会打不开（v2 文件不会被改写，所以没有数据丢失）。v3 会话、以及 v0/v1 会话（会在 V1→V2 边被修复）不受影响。

discussions.title: dsh-outlook — zero-credential Outlook automation for locked-down corporate Windows (13 tools + sidebar badge)
discussions.body:
**在 IT 不给你 Graph API 权限的公司电脑上，让 AI 直接操作你正在用的 Outlook。**

仓库：https://github.com/UnknowCao/dsh-outlook · 安装：`dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/UnknowCao/dsh-outlook`

## 为什么做这个

所有 Outlook MCP/集成方案的第一步都是注册 Azure 应用 / 配 SMTP 密码——在企业锁死的 Windows 环境里这一步就死了。dsh-outlook 走另一条路：**COM 直驱你已经登录的桌面 Outlook 客户端**，零凭据、零管理员权限，装完即用。

## 它能做什么（13 个工具）

- 邮件：搜信（文件夹/日期/发件人/主题）、读全文、草稿、发送、回复/全部回复/转发（自动引用原文）、附件保存
- 日程：日历查询、创建条目/会议邀请、同事忙闲、会议室搜索+时段空闲检查
- 通讯录：GAL 搜人名/邮箱/别名
- 侧边栏角标：新邮件到达红色计数（展开态外置角标 / 收起态圆钮内红点），点击弹层预览

## 安全设计

任何离开机器的动作（发邮件/发邀请）过**三层互相独立的门**：两轮确认弹窗 → 内容哈希绑定（给你看 A 发送 B 的偷换会被强制退回）→ PowerShell 桥的一次性令牌。发不出去就是发不出去。

## 工程质量

- 33 个测试用例（TESTCASES.md），自动化项全部实测：watcher 崩溃 30s 自愈、确认偷换攻击拦截、路由上限等
- COM 本地化怪癖（Jet/DASL 双阶段过滤、Restrict 日期格式、PS 5.1 stdin 编码）全部编码注释在 lib/olk.ps1
- CHANGELOG 按"为什么改"写版本叙事

Windows + 经典桌面版 Outlook 适用。欢迎试用反馈！

discussions.title: Preset roster health scan is uncached — one un-mountable preset plus a retrying client pegs a core at 100%
discussions.body:
# Preset roster health scan is uncached — one un-mountable preset plus a retrying client pegs a core at 100%

**Version:** 0.1.5-alpha.1, source build (`pnpm run build`), Windows 11, Node 24.18.0
**Symptom:** the Web UI feels laggy (settings included) and the `dsh web` node process holds ~100% of one CPU core indefinitely — measured 9.5 s of CPU per 10 s of wall time, sustained for the whole session.

## What happens

A third-party preset (`router-standard`, from a plugin repo) fails to mount because its `persona` row still carries the pre-rename config field:

```
agent-presets: preset "router-standard" failed to mount:
failed to apply loader entry persona (@deepseek-ai/dsh-persona): invalid config:
- $.prefix missing required value (at prefix)
```

The client that has that session open then retries the resume continuously (~25 retries/s). Every retry walks the full path:

`ApiSessionAgentController.resumeObserved` (`packages/api/session-controller/src/agent.ts:414`)
→ `composeAgent` (`:374`) → `preset.resolve` (`packages/preset/agent-presets/src/index.ts:343`)
→ `list()` (`:248`) → `discoverPresets` (`packages/preset/agent-presets/src/discovery.ts:331`)
→ `scanRoot` (`:292`) → `compositionProblem` (`:225`) → `unresolvableRows` (`:194`) → one `existsSync` per composition row.

`discoverPresets` caches nothing: each call re-reads and re-health-checks every preset directory and every row of every preset. A CPU profile of the burning process attributes ~37% of samples to `existsSync` and ~35% to `unresolvableRows`.

## Why it matters

- One un-mountable preset becomes a permanent CPU burn whenever a client keeps that session open; the whole UI degrades — this is what a user experiences as "dsh is laggy", not as a preset error.
- Nothing in the loop is bounded: no backoff on a repeatedly failing mount, no caching of the roster scan, and the scan cost scales with the number of preset rows.
- With the client closed (`--no-open`, no page connected) the same server sits at ~0.3% CPU, so the burn is client-cadence-driven.

## Possible directions (not prescriptive)

1. Cache/version the roster health scan (invalidate on root mtime change) so a resolve does not re-walk every row.
2. Back off or cap repeated failed mounts per session instead of retrying at client cadence.
3. Surface the mount failure in the UI — a session whose preset cannot mount currently just looks unresponsive.

Happy to attach the raw `.cpuprofile` and the instrumentation logs if that helps.

discussions.title: [Proposal] Make sandbox escalation session-aware and ignore redundant same-mode requests
discussions.body: ## Problem In a `danger-full-access` session, `bash`, `pwsh`, `write`, and `edit` may still expose `sandbox_permissions` and `justification`. Some models include those fields and repeatedly hit: ```text invalid justification: expected a non-empty sentence ``` or: ```text sandbox escalation to "danger-full-access" is not strictly wider than this call's current "danger-full-access" mode ``` The runtime check is correct: `danger-full-access` has no wider mode. The mismatch is that tool schemas are registry-global, while sandbox and approval policies are resolved per session. ## Proposal Project escalation options from the effective session policy: | Current policy | Exposed targets | |---|---| | `read-only` + `ask` | `workspace-write`, `danger-full-access` | | `workspace-write` + `ask` | `danger-full-access` | | `danger-full-access` | none | | any mode + `never` | none | When no escalation is possible: - omit `sandbox_permissions` and `justification`; - remove descriptions or result hints saying escalation is available. As a compatibility fallback, when: ```text requestedMode === effectiveMode ``` ignore the redundant escalation fields and execute under the existing policy without creating an approval request. Genuine escalation should still require a non-empty justification and approval. Downgrade requests should remain invalid. `ToolRuntime.schemas(scope)` and the PTC SDK projection already resolve tools by scope, so a shared scope-aware schema projection point may keep Native and PTC tool calling consistent. ## Acceptance criteria - Sessions with different policies receive different schemas. - Permission changes affect the next model request. - Native and PTC expose the same options. - Same-mode requests do not create approval events. - Genuine escalation retains the existing strictly-wider and approval checks. - `approval=never` does not advertise escalation. Would a scope-aware schema projection hook in `ToolRuntime` be the preferred implementation direction?

discussions.title: tripo-dsh — 在 DSH 里用一句话或一张图生成可直接导入引擎的 3D 模型（skills-only，国内站/海外站双区域）
discussions.body:
让 DeepSeek Harness 的 agent 直接生成 3D 资产：文生 3D、图生 3D、绑骨动画、减面 LOD、格式转换（GLB/FBX/OBJ/STL/USDZ/3MF），文件直接落到你的本地项目目录。

仓库：https://github.com/VAST-AI-Research/Tripo3D-Plugin-dsh · npm：https://www.npmjs.com/package/tripo-dsh
安装：`dsh plugin --profile web add tripo-dsh`，然后 `dsh web`，输入 `/` 能看到 `tripo-3d` 和 `tripo-game-asset` 两个 skill。

## 它是什么

[Tripo](https://www.tripo3d.ai) 官方的 DSH 插件。装完后对 agent 说"生成一个低多边形的宝箱，导出 FBX 给 Unity 用"或者丢一张概念图让它转 3D，agent 会自己跑完整条流程：检查登录 → 生成 → 看 `preview.png` 确认效果 → 把模型路径告诉你。

## 设计上的几个选择

- **skills-only，不注册 tool、不引入 MCP。** API 契约（鉴权、区域探测、轮询、下载、exit code、`--json` 输出）全在 `tripo-cli` 里，skill 只是操作手册。不给每轮请求增加 tool schema token；CLI 契约变了改 skill 文本即可。
- **零依赖、纯 ESM、无构建步骤。** `package.json` 没有 dependencies / scripts，npm、tarball、目录、git 四种安装方式都不触发 pnpm 的构建许可拦截。
- **双区域是硬要求。** 国内站（developers.tripo3d.com，短信登录/支付宝）和海外站（developers.tripo3d.ai）是两套独立账号。skill 会在区域未知时先问一句再启动设备码登录，选错了 CLI 也会在 Key 验证时自纠。
- **积分规则写进 skill。** 批量生成前先确认、多资产先查余额、3D 打印自动跳过贴图积分、预设链尾的付费转换步骤会提前告知、不默默重摇。
- **无头设备码登录。** 不需要用户把 API Key 粘进聊天：agent 跑 `login --yes`，把验证 URL 和一次性码原样展示，用户在浏览器授权即可。

## 两个 skill

| skill | 用途 |
|---|---|
| `tripo-3d` | 基础：登录、`tripo make`、exit code 分支、积分规则、结果呈现 |
| `tripo-game-asset` | 游戏管线配方：面数预算、道具集、一次生成多级 LOD、T-pose 角色绑骨 + 走跑跳动画、Unity/Unreal/Godot/Three.js 导入 |

## 试试这些

- 生成一个低多边形的宝箱 3D 模型，导出 FBX 给 Unity 用
- 把这张概念图转成带贴图的 3D 模型，导出 GLB
- 生成一个可 3D 打印的骑士小雕像，导出 STL
- 做一个 T-pose 的机器人士兵，绑骨并加上 idle/walk/run 三个动画

需要 Tripo 账号（新账号有免费积分），生成会消耗积分。MIT 协议，README 里有完整的 DSH 加载机制和运行时生命周期说明。问题和建议欢迎直接提 issue。
