discussions.title: SSRF via degraded public-address validation in `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-fetch-http` 0.1.5-alpha.1 when an HTTP(S) proxy is configured
discussions.body:
---

## 1. Product Introduction
DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`) is an open-source AI coding-agent harness developed by DeepSeek AI, built on an "everything-is-a-plugin" Cordis architecture. It lets a large language model execute commands, read/write files, browse the web, and invoke tools to assist with software development, launched via `dsh web` (GUI) or headless. Its web capability (`web_fetch` / `web_search` tools) is provided by the `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-fetch-http` package. The vulnerability resides in that package's SSRF guard on the HTTP(S)-proxy path.

---

## 2. Vulnerability Title
SSRF via degraded public-address validation in `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-fetch-http` 0.1.5-alpha.1 when an HTTP(S) proxy is configured

---

## 3. Summary / Description
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-fetch-http` 0.1.5-alpha.1 is affected by a server-side request forgery (SSRF) weakness in its `requestOnce` path. When a proxy route is active, the request is dispatched through `requestVia` and **skips** `resolvePublicAddresses`, leaving only `isNonPublicIpLiteral` (literal-IP rejection) as protection. An attacker — via indirect prompt injection or by steering the model to call `web_fetch` — can supply a **hostname** that resolves to an internal or cloud-metadata address (e.g. `metadata.google.internal`, `admin.internal.corp`, `169.254.169.254.nip.io`), which the proxy resolves and connects to, bypassing the public-address enforcement that the direct path would have applied. This results in a confidentiality impact (reading internal services / cloud metadata).

---

## 4. Technical Analysis / Root Cause
**Weakness**: CWE-918 Server-Side Request Forgery

**Data flow / trigger path**:

```plain
web_fetch tool URL → HttpFetchProvider.requestOnce (provider.ts)
  → proxyRouteFor(url) matches a proxy → proxied=true and hostname is not a non-public literal
  → requestVia(dispatcher, url, ...)   // resolvePublicAddresses is skipped
  → proxy resolves hostname and connects → reaches internal/metadata service
```

**Code location**:

```latex
File: packages/web/web-fetch-http/src/provider.ts
Line: 134-139
Relevant code:
  const route = proxyRouteFor(url)
  if (route.proxied && !isNonPublicIpLiteral(url.hostname)) {
    return await publicHttpNetwork.requestVia(route.dispatcher, url, headers, signal)
  }
  const addresses = await this.resolveAddresses(url.hostname, signal)
  return await publicHttpNetwork.request(url, addresses, headers, signal)

File: packages/web/web-fetch-http/src/network.ts
Line: 171-174
Relevant code (the only remaining protection, literal IPs only):
  export function isNonPublicIpLiteral(hostname: string): boolean {
    const unbracketed = stripIpv6Brackets(hostname)
    return isIP(unbracketed) !== 0 && !isPublicIpAddress(unbracketed)
  }
```

**Root cause**: The direct-path defense is address-based: `resolvePublicAddresses` resolves the hostname once and rejects the whole answer set if any address is not global unicast, then the connection is pinned to those validated addresses (DNS-rebinding resistant). On the proxied path, the proxy performs DNS so there is no local address to validate, and the code skips validation entirely — the guarantee silently degrades from "public-address enforcement" to "literal-IP-only". The weakening is silent (no warning, no allow-list); the code comments acknowledge the trade-off but do not surface the residual risk to operators.

---

## 5. Affected Versions
+ **Affected**: 0.1.5-alpha.1 and possibly earlier
+ **Not affected**: none confirmed
+ **Fixed version**: no fix available as of report date
+ **Tested environment**: dsh 0.1.5-alpha.1 / Node.js ≥ 22.19 / any environment with HTTP_PROXY configured (common in enterprise/CI)

---

## 6. Severity
| Item | Value |
| --- | --- |
| CVSS v3.1 score | 5.9 |
| CVSS v3.1 vector | `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:H/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:N/A:N` |
| CVSS v4.0 score (self-assessed, verify with calculator) | 5.9 |
| CVSS v4.0 vector | `CVSS:4.0/AV:N/AC:L/AT:P/PR:N/UI:N/VC:H/VI:N/VA:N/SC:N/SI:N/SA:N` |
| Rating | Medium |


> Scoring rationale: Network-reachable trigger (model/prompt injection), no authentication, but requires the additional precondition that the target environment has configured a proxy that can reach internal services — hence AC:H (v3.1) / AT:P (v4.0). Impact is confidentiality only (internal/metadata read). If the proxy can reach cloud metadata (169.254.169.254) or internal CIDRs, real-world impact can rise to High; re-verify against the deployment surface.
>

---

## 7. CVSS Vector
```plain
CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:H/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:N/A:N
CVSS:4.0/AV:N/AC:L/AT:P/PR:N/UI:N/VC:H/VI:N/VA:N/SC:N/SI:N/SA:N
```

---

## 8. Reproduction Steps
### 8.1 Environment
+ Product/version: dsh 0.1.5-alpha.1
+ OS/runtime: any OS + Node.js ≥ 22.19
+ Network position: internal (target environment must have a forward proxy)
+ Test account: none

### 8.2 Steps
**Step 1 — Set up the environment**  
Launch with a forward proxy (enterprise/CI, or Clash/mitmproxy/Burp):

```plain
export HTTP_PROXY=http://<proxy-host>:<port>
dsh web   # or headless
```

> Evidence: proxy policy resolved once at [packages/util/http-proxy/src/policy.ts:306-326](packages/util/http-proxy/src/policy.ts#L306-L326).
>

**Step 2 — Craft the malicious request**  
In a session, make the model (or exploit indirect prompt injection from a fetched page) issue a `web_fetch` request to a **hostname** (not an IP literal) that resolves to an internal/metadata address:

```plain
http://metadata.google.internal/
http://admin.internal.corp/
http://169.254.169.254.nip.io:8080/
```

> Evidence: the direct path would run `resolvePublicAddresses` and throw `WEB_BLOCKED_URL`; the proxied path skips it.
>

**Step 3 — Trigger and observe**  
`isNonPublicIpLiteral(hostname)` returns `false` for a hostname, so the request is dispatched to the proxy, which resolves and connects to the internal address and returns the internal response.

> Evidence: the project's own test [proxy.spec.ts:75-86](packages/web/web-fetch-http/tests/proxy.spec.ts#L75-L86) asserts "the resolver that rejects non-public destinations is not consulted at all."
>

**Step 4 — Verify impact (optional)**  
If the proxy reaches cloud metadata (169.254.169.254), temporary cloud credentials are readable; if it reaches the internal CIDR, internal admin panels/APIs are readable.

---

## 9. Proof of Concept
### 9.1 Usage
+ Runtime: Node.js + an HTTP proxy that can reach internal/metadata
+ Dependencies: none
+ Disclaimer: For authorized testing and vulnerability verification only.

### 9.2 POC Code (conceptual, non-weaponized; follows the source path)
```typescript
// Precondition: process env has HTTP_PROXY=<proxy-url>, and installProxyFromEnvironment() ran
import { HttpFetchProvider } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-fetch-http'

// Expected: the direct path rejects; the proxied path does not
const provider = new HttpFetchProvider({
  maxResponseBytes: 5_000_000, maxBodyChars: 100_000,
  timeoutMs: 5000, maxRedirects: 5, userAgent: 'poc',
})
// Target: a hostname (not an IP literal) resolving to an internal/metadata address
await provider.fetch({ url: 'http://{{INTERNAL_HOSTNAME}}/' })
// Observe: once proxyRouteFor marks it proxied, requestVia is used and resolvePublicAddresses is bypassed
```

### 9.3 Expected output / success criteria
The request returns the internal service's response instead of `WEB_BLOCKED_URL`; `publicHttpNetwork.resolve` is never called (consistent with the official test).

---

## 10. Mitigation / Fix Recommendations
### 10.1 Temporary mitigations
+ Do not configure a proxy, or ensure the proxy only egresses to the public internet and cannot reach internal/metadata CIDRs.
+ Keep `web_fetch` on the default no-proxy deployment; if a proxy is required, add egress allow-listing at the proxy.

### 10.2 Root-cause fixes
+ Run `resolvePublicAddresses` on the proxied path as well (resolve-validate every origin not explicitly exempted by `NO_PROXY`; only route explicitly-exempt origins through the proxy).
+ Or, at `installProxyFromEnvironment`, warn that enabling a proxy degrades `web_fetch` public-address enforcement to literal-IP-only, and support a configurable allow-list of proxy-resolvable origins.

### 10.3 Verification
After the fix, `http://metadata.google.internal/` (etc.) must still be rejected by `resolvePublicAddresses` (`WEB_BLOCKED_URL`) even with a proxy configured, and `resolve` must be observed to run.

discussions.title: [Docs] capability-seams.md Direct-consumers column is hand-maintained and has drifted from source (v0.1.2-alpha.5)
discussions.body:
## Summary

The Direct-consumers column in `docs/capability-seams.md` is rendered from a hand-written `consumers: [...]` array inside `scripts/gen-doc-graphs.ts`, not derived from the `inject` declarations in `packages/`. The page's footer describes the classification as having a completeness guard, but the guard that exists only checks which service keys are present -- it never validates the contents of `consumers`. As a result several rows have drifted: some are substantially incomplete, and three list packages that do not consume the seam at all.

Line numbers in the evidence below are pinned to commit `49a606bc` (`v0.1.2-alpha.5`), the tree this audit was performed against; all commands are run from the repository root. I re-checked every item against `master` head `5dda764ed` (2026-09-08) and all three findings still hold there unchanged -- only line numbers shift (the guard moves to `731-742`, the `goals` role entry to `452`, and the hand-written array count from 52 to 53).

## Evidence

### A. The consumer lists are hand-maintained, and the guard does not cover them

`docs/capability-seams.md:1` marks the file as generated, and `docs/capability-seams.md:538` states:

> Maintenance mode: hybrid: services are discovered from Cordis declarations; interface/implementation/consumer roles are classified in `scripts/gen-doc-graphs.ts` with a completeness guard.

Service *discovery* is indeed derived from Cordis declarations, but the consumer role is a literal array. `SERVICE_ROLES` begins at `scripts/gen-doc-graphs.ts:100`, and each entry carries an optional hand-written `consumers` field (`scripts/gen-doc-graphs.ts:36`). The renderer at `scripts/gen-doc-graphs.ts:757` and `:769` emits the graph edges and the table cell straight from that array, with no source lookup in between.

The guard referenced by the footer is `assertServiceRolesComplete` (`scripts/gen-doc-graphs.ts:716-727`, invoked at `:730`). It compares the set of discovered service keys against the set of classified keys and throws on `missing` or `stale` keys. It does not read `implementations`, `consumers` or `companions`. So the guard establishes that every service has a row, not that any row's consumer list is accurate.

```bash
# 52 hand-written consumer arrays
grep -c "consumers:" scripts/gen-doc-graphs.ts

# the guard's full body -- key sets only
sed -n '716,727p' scripts/gen-doc-graphs.ts
```

### B. Drift: `ctx.goals` renders empty, `ctx.tools` lists 10 of 31

**`ctx.goals`** -- the role entry at `scripts/gen-doc-graphs.ts:437-442` has no `consumers` field at all, so the table row at `docs/capability-seams.md:510` renders `-`. Source declares three:

- `packages/goal/tool-goal/src/index.ts:22`
- `packages/goal/command-goal/src/index.ts:13`
- `packages/goal/goal-round-driver/src/index.ts:19`

```bash
grep -rn --include='*.ts' -E "inject\s*=.*'goals'" packages/ | grep -v /tests/
```

(`packages/client/ui-goal/src/client/index.ts:50` additionally injects `remote.goals`, i.e. the client-side Remote face rather than the host service.)

**`ctx.tools`** -- the row at `docs/capability-seams.md:499` lists 10 consumers: `agent-loop`, `tool-ask-user`, `tool-bash`, `tool-cordis`, `tool-fs`, `tool-terminal`, `tool-skill`, `tool-subagent`, `tool-todo`, `tool-web`. All 10 are genuine, but 31 packages declare `inject` on `'tools'` (32 once the runtime `ctx.inject` form is included, via `packages/context/file-reference-local/src/index.ts:68`).

```bash
grep -rlE --include='*.ts' "inject\s*=.*'tools'" packages/ \
  | grep -v /tests/ | sed -E 's|^packages/([^/]+/[^/]+)/.*|\1|' | sort -u
```

The 21 undocumented ones include several that shape the tool pipeline rather than merely register a tool: `guard/timeout-policy` (`src/index.ts:31`), `spill/spill-policy` (`src/index.ts:73`), `mcp/mcp-client` (`src/index.ts:32`), `plan/plan-mode` (`src/index.ts:171`), `core/agent-tool-presentation` (`src/index.ts:35`) and `session/session-checkpoint-policy` (`src/index.ts:18`).

### C. Inverted entries: three packages listed under `ctx.sessionPersistence` do not inject it

`scripts/gen-doc-graphs.ts:230` lists `tool-bash`, `hooks-claude-code` and `hooks-codex` as consumers of `ctx.sessionPersistence`, and `docs/capability-seams.md:484` renders all three with links to their package directories. None of the three declares the seam:

| package | actual `inject` | source |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `tool-bash` | `['tools', 'shell', 'systemPrompt', 'shellEnv']` | `packages/shell/tool-bash/src/index.ts:30` |
| `hooks-claude-code` | `['shell', 'sessionProjections']` | `packages/hooks/hooks-claude-code/src/index.ts:42` |
| `hooks-codex` | `['shell', 'sessionProjections']` | `packages/hooks/hooks-codex/src/index.ts:41` |

```bash
grep -rn --include='*.ts' -E "^export const inject" \
  packages/shell/tool-bash/src/index.ts \
  packages/hooks/hooks-claude-code/src/index.ts \
  packages/hooks/hooks-codex/src/index.ts
```

All three share the same likely origin: each has a **test-only** import of the JSONL *implementation* (not the seam), backed by a devDependency.

- `packages/shell/tool-bash/tests/integration.spec.ts:8`, devDependency at `packages/shell/tool-bash/package.json:57`
- `packages/hooks/hooks-claude-code/tests/coverage-cases.ts:8`, devDependency at `packages/hooks/hooks-claude-code/package.json:52`
- `packages/hooks/hooks-codex/tests/coverage-cases.ts:8`, devDependency at `packages/hooks/hooks-codex/package.json:51`

```bash
grep -rn "session-persistence-jsonl" \
  packages/shell/tool-bash packages/hooks/hooks-claude-code packages/hooks/hooks-codex
```

Mounting a backend in a test fixture is not consumption of the seam, and in the hooks case the packages' own READMEs are explicit that they read nothing from it -- `transcript_path` is hardcoded empty precisely because "the persistence seam exposes no artifact paths" (`packages/hooks/hooks-claude-code/README.md:91`, `packages/hooks/hooks-codex/README.md:87`).

Meanwhile five real consumers are absent from the row: `packages/acp/acp/src/index.ts:62`, `packages/experimental/agent-team/src/index.ts:60`, `packages/schedule/schedule/src/index.ts:38`, `packages/session/session-checkpoint-policy/src/index.ts:18` and `packages/workspace/workspace/src/index.ts:93`. Of the seven packages listed on the row, four are correct and three are not.

## Impact

`capability-seams.md` reads as the authoritative map for anyone wiring a new plugin or swapping a seam implementation, and the generated-file header plus the completeness-guard sentence both signal that the whole table is source-derived. A downstream reader planning an integration against `ctx.tools` would see 10 consumers and miss the policy and guard packages that also sit on the pipeline, and so would under-estimate what a change to the seam affects; a reader tracing `ctx.sessionPersistence` would go to `packages/shell/tool-bash` looking for a usage example and find nothing to read. Because the incorrect and incomplete rows sit beside genuinely generated columns and are visually indistinguishable from them, the failure is quiet -- there is no signal telling the reader which cells to double-check against source.

## Suggestion

The `inject` declarations already encode this relation, so the consumer column could be derived rather than curated: collect `export const inject = [...]`, `static inject = [...]` and `ctx.inject([...], ...)` across `packages/*/*/src`, map each service key to its declaring packages, and emit that in place of the literal arrays -- keeping the hand-written field only as an optional additive override for consumption paths the source cannot express. Even without deriving the column, extending `assertServiceRolesComplete` to reject a `consumers` entry naming a package that has no `inject` on that key would be a small change with provable coverage here: it catches all three of the mis-listings in case C, since none of `tool-bash`, `hooks-claude-code` or `hooks-codex` declares the seam. If neither is worth the effort right now, the cheapest fix would be to drop the "with a completeness guard" phrase from the footer at `docs/capability-seams.md:538` and state plainly that implementation and consumer roles are curated and may lag source -- so readers know which columns to verify themselves.

Happy to send a PR for whichever direction you prefer.

## Related

- #5211 and #3396 -- earlier docs-vs-source reports in this format; this post follows their structure.
- #3458 -- a prior instance of the same class of problem, where a generated catalog structurally could not see rows the source writes.
- #288 -- proposes rendering seam-stability annotations in `docs/capability-seams.md`, describing the page as "already doc-synced". That assumption is what motivated checking this column.

---

*Audit performed against commit `49a606bc` (`v0.1.2-alpha.5`); all quoted line numbers refer to that tree. Re-verified against `master` head `5dda764ed` (2026-09-08).*

discussions.title: [Bug] Forking a session inherits the parent's queued prompts — the child executes them on first submit
discussions.body:
## 环境

- 版本：dsh **v0.1.5-alpha.1**（源码构建，`origin/master` `5dda764ed3`）
- 平台：Linux

## 现象

从某轮对话的结果上「分支」出新会话后，子会话并不是全新的：如果分支时收件箱里还有排队提示词（即上一轮运行期间用户提交了下一条消息），子会话首次提交输入时，**父会话排队中的提示词会被当作待办直接执行**，用户刚输入的内容反而进入排队队列。

## 复现步骤

1. 会话已有完成的轮次 A、B；轮 B 运行期间用户提交了下一条提示词——它被持久化为 `agent/inbox/spliced` 事件（收件箱待办输入），尚未被认领。
2. 从轮 B 的结果上点击分支（fork）。
3. 在子会话输入新内容并提交。
4. 实际被执行的是父会话那条排队提示词；用户的新输入排在后面等待。

## 根因

1. 排队提示词持久化为 `agent/inbox/spliced { target: "next-turn", inserted: [...] }`，其在日志中的物理位置是**上一轮 `turn/end` 之后、下一轮 `turn/start` 之前**——恰好是 fork 切割时要扫过的区域。
2. `packages/api/session-controller/src/commands.ts` 的 `fork()` 在定位边界 `turn/end` 后，用 `while (events[cut].type !== 'turn/start') cut++` 向后补齐边界轮的尾事件——这条循环把 dangling 的收件箱 splice 记录一并装进了子会话种子。
3. `packages/core/agent-loop/src/inbox.ts` 的收件箱投影（`inboxProjectionDefinition.apply`）折叠种子里的全部 splice 事件，父会话的排队提示词因此被恢复为子会话 agent 的 pending 输入。
4. 子会话首次提交时，`claim()` 取走 `next-turn` 队首——即被复活的父会话排队提示词；用户的新输入进入队列排在后面。

## 证据（本地真实会话日志）

fork 时刻的父会话：

```
seq 129 turn/end
seq 130 agent/inbox/spliced { target: "next-turn", inserted: [message id=4e88b854…] }
← fork 发生在此处
```

fork 后的子会话：

```
seq 130 agent/inbox/spliced { … id=4e88b854… }    ← 继承自种子
seq 133 agent/inbox/spliced { … id=a3b414ba… }    ← 用户在子会话里真正输入的新内容
seq 135 agent/inbox/spliced { removedCount: 1 }   ← claim() 取走队首
seq 137 user/message   id=4e88b854…               ← 实际执行的是父会话的排队提示词（同一 UUID）
```

相同的消息 UUID `4e88b854…` 在父、子两个会话里各执行了一次，证明这是种子导致的收件箱复活，而不是用户重新输入。（从该子会话再次 fork 又复现了一次，连续第三代。）

## 修复建议

任选其一：

1. `fork()` 计算出 `cut` 后，剔除种子中边界 `turn/end` 之后的 `agent/inbox/spliced` 记录——它们是父会话的活队列状态，不属于对话历史；
2. 或者在子会话种子写完后，追加一条补偿性的持久 splice（如 `agent/inbox/spliced { target: "next-turn", start: 0, removedCount: N, inserted: [] }`），把继承的待办输入清空。

discussions.title: Notify users when switching chat provider that web search has its own config
discussions.body:
## Problem

When a user switches their chat model provider (Settings → Models), the `web-search-deepseek` plugin does not follow — it keeps using its own endpoint (`https://api.deepseek.com/anthropic/v1`) and its own credential resolution (`DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` / the credentials seam).

This causes a confusing 401 error on the first `web_search` call after switching to a custom provider, with no indication that search config lives in a separate settings page.

## Suggested improvement

Add a notification or banner in the UI when the model provider changes, telling the user that web search configuration is independent and pointing them to **Settings → Plugins → Web search** to review the endpoint and API key.

At minimum, the `web_search` tool result could surface a clearer error that names the search endpoint and explicitly explains the separation from chat model config.

## Relevant source

- `packages/web/web-search-deepseek/src/index.ts` — plugin config, credential resolution (falls back from literal `apiKey` → credentials seam → env var `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`)
- `packages/web/web-search-deepseek/src/provider.ts` — endpoint fallback chain (`config.baseURL` → `DEEPSEEK_SEARCH_BASE_URL` → hardcoded default), and the `searchEndpointError()` message that currently fires on failure

discussions.title: dsh-claude-memory — read-only Claude Code memory bridge, plus two pitfalls that fail quietly
discussions.body:
Sharing a plugin and two findings that cost real debugging time.

**dsh-claude-memory** — https://github.com/GodCC6/dsh-claude-memory
`dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-claude-memory`

It surfaces Claude Code's existing project memory inside DSH so a task can continue after a Claude Code quota runs out: the resolved project's `MEMORY.md` index plus the user-global `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md` go into the prompt, and one `claude_memory` tool opens any note on demand. Read-only, `realpath`-confined to the Claude home, credential redaction before injection, zero dependencies (`node:*` only). 76 test assertions, no network or model calls.

Two things that may deserve a line in the docs, because both fail quietly:

**1. Prompt providers are synchronous.**
`dsh-system-prompt` resolves section/context `text` without awaiting it (`lib/index.js:330,337`), and the interpolator then calls `text.indexOf` (`lib/index.js:152`). A provider declared `async () => string` therefore yields a `Promise`, not a string. The plugin still *mounts* fine — it only breaks at assembly, which makes it easy to ship. The most prominent Claude Code bridge in the ecosystem does this today. Worth either awaiting the provider result or throwing a clear error when `text` is not a string.

**2. Claude Code files memory under the git repository root, not the raw cwd.**
Memory lives at `~/.claude/projects/<encoded-path>/memory/`, and the encoded path is the enclosing **git repo root**. Measured on my machine, on a docs hub that sits inside a larger repo and has no `.git` of its own: the session's recorded `cwd` was the hub, yet all 12 of its memory writes landed under the enclosing repo's key — it referenced that key's `MEMORY.md` 235 times and its own directory's memory path 0 times. A bridge that resolves by `process.cwd()`, or that stops at the exact cwd, silently reads the wrong project's notes for any hub directory. (Memory directories are also created on demand: of 50 project directories here, only 20 had a non-empty index and 21 were empty.)

Full write-up with code references is in the repo README.

discussions.title: 关于WebSocket承载大体积数据的问题：慢链路下心跳误杀 + 整窗重发风暴
discussions.body:
## 环境

- `dsh web`（0.1.2-rc.1）。
- 自建反向网关（含身份认证）部署在一台公网云服务器上，**总出网带宽仅 1 Mbps**；
  通过该网关远程访问 dsh web，在家庭宽带、办公网络、移动网络下均能复现。

## 现象

- 远程使用中连接频繁断开重连，控制台反复出现 `[connection] connection lost, retry #1`；
- 提问/审批弹窗出现瞬间消失（断连导致在途 waterfall 事件被 abort）；
- 刷新页面后近期内容能成功渲染出来，但随后 WS 仍反复拉取同一份大快照，直至长时间"静默死等"，只能再次手动刷新；
- 公网带宽越紧张、会话历史越大，现象越严重。

## 复现与证据（headless Chromium + CDP 逐帧抓取）

| 场景 | 结果 |
|---|---|
| 空闲 WS（不跟随会话），公网路径 | 10+ 分钟零断连 |
| 跟随大会话，本地直连服务端 | 零断连 |
| 跟随大会话，公网路径 | 每次重连后收到**单条 ~1.6MB 快照帧**，约 13s（≈1.6MB @ 1Mbps）后连接被异常终止 → `retry #1` → 整窗重发 → 循环 |
| 跟随小会话，公网路径 | 零断连 |

- 快照帧实为**会话尾窗（最近 ≤50 条 user/assistant 消息）**的序列化，非整场历史；体积只取决于尾窗真实载荷，可到 MB 级。
- 将心跳间隔从默认 2000ms 调到 30000ms 后断连消失，公网带宽占用随之下降（重连风暴停止）。

## 根因分析

1. **心跳与数据同队列、无优先级**：WS Ping/Pong 控制帧与数据帧在同一个 TCP 发送队列里排队。链路满载超过约 4–6s（心跳 2000ms × 连丢 2 次即 `socket.terminate()`）时，Ping 被大帧压后，服务端按"发出时间"判定超时 → 误杀"慢但健康"的连接。
2. **会话跟随快照无分帧、无体积上限、无 WS 压缩**：每条流 item 整体序列化、单条 WS 消息写出；日志 append-only，compaction/pruner 只做表层遮蔽、不删已落字节 → 帧大小无官方旋钮可限。
3. **断连后重连整窗重发**：无逐段 ack/resume，慢链路下形成"重连 → 大帧 → 再断"的正反馈风暴。

## 观点（欢迎讨论）

坚持"**WS 传信号、HTTP 传数据**"的分层原则：体积不可预知/可能很大的批量内容（会话尾窗快照、历史分页）应走 HTTP（dsh 已有 `session/page` 分页接口与 SSE 先例），WS 只承载有界、实时、交互性的信号与增量；快照与增量之间用 cursor 握手衔接，保证有序、无缝隙、可续传。

退而求其次的近期可选改动：

- 心跳超时应**感知数据是否仍在推进**（有字节流动时不计 miss）；
- 为单条 WS 帧设体积上限，或对超大窗口做分片下发；
- 客户端重连携带已收 seq，做增量续传而不是整窗重发。

## 临时止血（已在生产验证）

在 profile 补丁层（`$DSH_HOME/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml`）覆盖 `typert-gateway`：

```yaml
- id: typert-gateway
  config:
    websocketHeartbeatIntervalMs: 30000
```

注：心跳仍保留兜底（约 60s 内可感知死连接），只把误杀窗口放宽到慢链路的安全区。

discussions.title: Non-widening sandbox escalation fails closed when the session is already danger-full-access
discussions.body:
[dsh-non-widening-escalation-fix.patch](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/32002259/dsh-non-widening-escalation-fix.patch)
## Summary

In any session whose effective policy is `danger-full-access` (the most common harness deployment), a model that mechanically attaches `sandbox_permissions: "workspace-write"` — or any non-widening mode — receives a `sandbox escalation to "<mode>" is not strictly wider than this call's current "<effective>" mode` throw instead of running the command. The model then retries without the field, the retry succeeds, and every such session pays a wasted round trip + a red tool card for a behavior that harmed no one.

The tool schema's `sandbox_permissions` enum is registry-global, while the effective mode is per-call truth. Under a `danger-full-access` default the enum still offers `workspace-write` and `danger-full-access`, and the description still coaches escalation as the recovery path. A model that learned the recovery habit in a confined session will reproduce it in a `danger-full-access` one and trigger this fail-closed path constantly.

## Reproduction

1. Run dsh web with default sandbox policy `danger-full-access` (the project default).
2. Trigger any ordinary `bash` call.
3. Have the model attach `sandbox_permissions: "workspace-write"` plus a `justification`. (This is what current models naturally do when following the tool's own coaching: "retry the exact call with the narrowest wider mode that suffices.")

Without any model cooperation, simulate it against `packages/sandbox/sandbox/src/escalation.ts`:

```ts
const result = await approveEscalation(
  { requestedMode: 'workspace-write', effectiveMode: 'danger-full-access', justification: '...', subject: {} },
  { approver: async () => ({ outcome: 'granted-once' }) },
)
```

## Current behavior

`approveEscalation` throws `sandbox escalation to "workspace-write" is not strictly wider than this call's current "danger-full-access" mode`. The tool registry turns the throw into `isError`, no command runs, and the model pays a retry round trip on every subsequent call. Across a long-running agent loop this becomes "the harness is broken in a way that's invisible to most users but constant for anyone who uses the default policy".

## Expected behavior

A target that is equal to or narrower than the call's effective mode resolves to that effective mode itself — a no-op grant that runs without prompting a human and without recording an approval event. Strict-widening remains the safety boundary for asks that genuinely widen; a forged or bogus `sandbox/mode` override cannot leverage the change because the ladder still gates what can widen.

## Proposed fix

A 4-line change in `packages/sandbox/sandbox/src/escalation.ts` plus paired test + docs updates across `packages/sandbox/sandbox/`, `packages/shell/tool-bash/`, and `packages/shell/tool-pwsh/`. Test coverage moves from the stale fail-closed error text to a pinned "no-op grant + never asks" invariant for all three packages. 157 unit tests pass.

The exhaustive alternatives considered and rejected are documented in the accompanying Agent Note `.agents/notes/implemented/bug-fix/2026-09-07-non-widening-escalation-noop.md`:

- **Harder prompt steering only** is rejected because schemas are registry-global — the enum cannot shrink per session.
- **Silently stripping the fields** before the escalation path is rejected — decisions belong in `approveEscalation`, not in argument validation (hidden `?? default` inside `run()`).
- **Warn-but-run** (grant the no-op but append a model-facing correction marker) is rejected as added model-visible surface for a condition that is already harmless.

## Patch

📎 See the attached `dsh-non-widening-escalation-fix.patch` file (47.5 KB, `git format-patch -1 HEAD`). Apply with `git am < dsh-non-widening-escalation-fix.patch`.

Patch includes:
- `packages/sandbox/sandbox/src/escalation.ts`: replace the throw with `return effectiveMode`
- `packages/sandbox/sandbox/tests/escalation.spec.ts`: pin the no-op grant + never-ask invariant
- `packages/shell/tool-bash/tests/tools.spec.ts` and `packages/shell/tool-pwsh/tests/tools.spec.ts`: same-pin for the bash/pwsh tool surfaces
- README, i18n, and feature-note files updated in both English and Chinese (per repo's bilingual README convention)

## Environment

- dsh `0.1.5-alpha.1` (`5dda764ed3`)
- Any OS, Node ≥ 22
- Default sandbox executor with default policy `danger-full-access`

## Impact

Costs every `danger-full-access` deployment one wasted model round trip per escalation-shaped call. Multiplied across every such session — the exact composition where the error is guaranteed to keep firing — this reads as "the harness is broken on every new session" and trains users to distrust sandbox messaging entirely.

I'm carrying the patch locally (commit `da07fe834c`) and posting here since I noticed external PRs aren't being accepted right now. Happy to refine the approach or test any alternate fix the team prefers.

discussions.title: dsh web：Launch Token 兑换 Cookie 后仍可复用，是否支持一次性兑换或短时过期？
discussions.body:
使用 `dsh web` 时，我们注意到启动链接中的 `?token=...` 在兑换浏览器 Cookie 后，原链接仍可再次使用。想确认这是预期设计，还是有现成配置或扩展方式可以使 Token 在成功兑换后立即失效。

## 源码依据

查看 [browser-auth.ts（commit 5dda764）](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/5dda764ed3aa172535a7967b06ff95d9cbfe536a/packages/client/connection/src/browser-auth.ts)：

- `processLaunchToken()` 为同一进程上下文复用 Token。
- `authorizeIndex()` 校验 Token 后返回 `303`、`Set-Cookie` 和跳转到 `/`，但未看到将 Token 标记为已使用、轮换或检查独立过期时间的逻辑。
- Cookie 有独立的签名和有效期，因此让兑换 Token 失效，理论上无需使已签发的 Cookie 失效。

这里关注的是同一 DSH 进程运行期间的重复兑换，不是声称 Token 跨进程重启永久有效。

## 复现核对步骤

1. 启动 `dsh web`，保存带 Token 的启动链接。
2. 在浏览器 A 打开链接，确认响应签发 Cookie 并跳转到不带 Token 的地址。
3. 保持 DSH 进程运行，在完全独立、没有该站点 Cookie 的浏览器 B 中打开原链接。
4. 检查是否仍能再次获得 Cookie 并访问页面。

我们观察到了原链接重复打开仍可访问；上述独立浏览器步骤用于排除已有 Cookie 导致的放行。根据当前源码，预计同一有效 Token 可以再次兑换，欢迎维护者确认。

## 风险与期望

即使不是云端部署，只要其他人能够访问同一个 DSH 地址，带 Token 的链接一旦被误转发、截图或记录在日志中，对方仍可能在原用户已经登录后，用旧链接建立自己的浏览器会话。跳转去掉 URL 参数可以减少暴露，但不会撤销已经泄露的 Token。

希望可以选择：Token 仅用于一次登录兑换，成功时原子地消费，之后拒绝重复兑换；已签发且有效的 Cookie 继续工作。未使用的 Token 也可配置较短有效期。

## 想请教的问题

1. 当前是否已有一次性兑换、短时有效期或主动撤销 Launch Token 的配置/推荐方案？
2. 能否通过官方支持的 Host 插件扩展点，在签发 Cookie 时消费 Token？目前看到 `ctx.connection.authorizeIndex()`，但未发现明确的兑换钩子。
3. 若需要修改核心模块，是否考虑支持上述能力，并提供不重启 DSH 的安全补发方式，用于更换浏览器、清理 Cookie 或首次兑换响应丢失？

我们理解一次性 Token 无法阻止泄露后被他人抢先兑换；本问题主要希望缩短凭据暴露窗口并阻止成功兑换后的重放，而不是关闭认证。

相关讨论：[远程/反向代理场景的浏览器认证 #5828](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/5828)、[Token 认证配置诉求 #5631](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/5631)。这里重点询问一次性消费和安全扩展方式。

discussions.title: [bug][agent-loop] steer 在阻塞式 job_output(wait) 期间无法抢占:next-step 只在 step 边界消费,会话最长 10 分钟对用户输入无响应(0.1.5-alpha.1 实测)
discussions.body:
在 0.1.5-alpha.1 上确认:一次阻塞式 `job_output(wait: true)` 期间,用户的 steer 消息要等这次 wait 返回才会被消费,最长 10 分钟。会话在这段时间里对输入完全没有反应,UI 上只显示「深度求索中...」,看起来像卡死,实际进程健康、后台任务也在正常推进。

这不是「跑等待命令就该失联」。`steer()` 的语义是插队到 next-step,本应尽快被消费;问题在于 next-step 的消费点只有 step 边界一处,而一次 wait 可以让 step 边界十分钟不出现。同一状态下 `agent.cancel({kind:'user'})` 能在同一 tick 内解除阻塞,说明等待逻辑本身是尊重 `AbortSignal` 的,只是 steer 从来不会去触发它。

## 实测

`dsh-v0.1.5-alpha.1`(commit `5dda764ed3`,源码构建),隔离的 `DSH_HOME`,macOS / Node v22.22.3:

| 时刻 | 事件 |
|---|---|
| 7.0s | agent 阻塞在 `job_output(wait: true)`,后台 job 是 `sleep 120` |
| 10.1s | 经 `session/prompt` 以 `mode: 'steer'` 发一条带唯一标记的消息 |
| 125.8s | 该消息才作为 `user/message` 进入会话日志 |

steer 延迟 **115.7 秒**,正好等于剩余的 wait 时间。

## 代码路径(行号为 0.1.5-alpha.1)

`steer` 只入队,不 abort — `packages/core/agent-loop/src/agent.ts:141-143`

```ts
steer(input: UserMessage): void {
  this.send(input, 'next-step', true)
}
```

对照 `cancel`,它会 abort 当前 phase — `agent.ts:154`

```ts
if (this.phase.kind !== 'idle') this.phase.abort.abort(cause)
```

而 next-step 的唯一消费点在 `preStep()` 里 — `agent.ts:244`

```ts
const claimed = this.inbox.claim(target, position.turn)
```

step 卡在 await 里就永远走不到这一行。阻塞侧本身没有问题:`packages/jobs/tool-jobs/src/index.ts:332-333` 正确 clamp 了超时并把 `exec.signal` 转发下去,`packages/jobs/jobs-local/src/index.ts:230` 的 `wait` 也确实只有三个出口(job 终态、timeout、signal abort)。缺的是第四个出口。

配置上有个容易混淆的地方(`tool-jobs/src/index.ts:205-206`):默认阻塞是 30 秒,不是 10 分钟;10 分钟是 `maxWaitTimeoutMs` 上限。但模型可以显式把 `timeout_ms` 顶到上限,没有任何机制阻止或抢占。

`tool-jobs` 的 system prompt 里已经写了「do not busy-poll or sleep on one」,现场会话仍然在做 `sleep` + `job_output(wait:true)` 的组合轮询。靠提示词约束模型行为在这里不成立,需要机制层面的兜底。

顺带一提,job 完成通知走的是同一条路(`tool-jobs/src/index.ts:292-299`,owner busy 时 `inject`,即 next-step),所以完成通知的延迟特征和用户输入完全一致。

## 版本核对

这个问题最初是在 0.1.3-alpha.2 上遇到的。升到 0.1.5-alpha.1 后逐条复核,上述判据字节级未变;`git diff dsh-v0.1.3-alpha.2..dsh-v0.1.5-alpha.1` 里 `tool-jobs` 和 `jobs-local` 两个包零改动。`agent.ts` 改了 111 行,但都是本版 Inbox 重构的搬家,没有触及 steer / claim / abort 的语义。全仓搜 `preempt` / `interrupt` / `pendingInput` 也没有新增的抢占路径。

## 想讨论的修法

首选是**协作式抢占**:让 `ctx.jobs.wait` 除了 job 完成和 timeout 之外,也在「调用方有 pending next-step 输入」时 resolve,返回 `[status: running]` 并保持 job 存活。语义不变、不丢工作、job 继续跑,只是把控制权还给 loop。实现上需要给 wait 传一个 `until` / input-pending 信号。

次选是收紧上限加界面提示:把 `maxWaitTimeoutMs` 默认从 10 分钟降到 60–120 秒,同时在界面上显示「会话正阻塞于 job X,你的消息已排队」,至少别让用户误判成卡死。

还有一个更激进的选项:仅针对阻塞式 wait,把用户 steer 当作软中断,复用现有 abort 路径但不清空 inbox。这个改动面最大,语义上也最需要斟酌。

有意思的是,0.1.5 把 `Inbox` 改成类型接口之后,`hasPending` / `claim` 退出了公开面,但公开的 `Inbox` 保留了 `nextStep` 只读数组(`packages/core/agent/src/runtime-types.ts:48-52`),`Agent.inbox` 也是公开的,工具执行上下文能拿到 `exec.agent`。所以第三方插件现在已经可以包一层 `job_output`、轮询 `exec.agent.inbox.nextStep.length` 来先行验证首选方案的语义,不必等本体改动。

想问维护者两件事:一是首选方案的语义(wait 因为有排队输入而提前返回 running)是否可接受;二是如果可接受,这个「input-pending」信号更适合由 loop 通过 exec 传给工具,还是由 jobs 服务自己去问 agent。

## 临时缓解

杀掉底层子进程(比如 `sleep` 的 PID),job 立即结束,wait 返回,会话回到 step 边界后就能消费排队的消息。

discussions.title: Error when creating new sessions

discussions.title: Bug: Tool call with empty name/id → Error: unknown tool "" (UNKNOWN_TOOL)
discussions.body:
[FIX-ANALYSIS.md](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/32003565/FIX-ANALYSIS.md)
[ISSUE-REPORT.md](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/32003571/ISSUE-REPORT.md)
## Environment

- dsh version: 0.1.2-rc.1 (not fixed in 0.1.5-alpha.1, per release notes)
- Node.js: v24.15.0
- Platform: Windows (win32)
- LLM gateway: self-hosted DeepSeek gateway at http://10.10.10.10:8000/v1
- Model: deepseek-v4-pro
- Provider: deepseek-official (chat-completions)
- Agent preset: standard (also reproduced with cordis)

## Summary

When the model is an instruction that triggers a tool call (e.g. "check"/"检查"), the harness
records the tool call with an empty `name` and empty `id`, while `arguments` is fully populated.
The tool dispatcher then rejects it:

Error: unknown tool ""
ToolNotFoundError / UNKNOWN_TOOL

This repeats in a loop (8 times in one observed turn).

## Evidence (decoded from session.jsonl.zstd)

{
  "type": "assistant/message",
  "data": { "message": { "content": [
    { "type": "text", "text": "user asked..." },
    { "type": "tool-call",
      "id": "",                    // <- empty
      "name": "",                  // <- empty
      "arguments": "{\"command\": \"echo ...\"}" }
  ] } }
}

## Already ruled out (direct gateway tests)

| Test | Result |
|---|---|
| /v1/chat/completions (non-stream) | function.name == "pwsh" ✓ |
| /v1/chat/completions (stream) | first delta carries name = "pwsh" ✓ |
| /v1/chat/completions (stream + reasoning) | name = "pwsh" ✓ |
| /v1/responses (stream) | name = "pwsh" ✓ |

The empty name is produced inside the adapter, not upstream.

## Suspected code path

packages/llm/deepseek (bundled as @deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-deepseek/lib/index.js)

closeBlock():
  case "tool-call": return {
    type: "tool-call",
    id: brandString(block.callId ?? ""),
    name: block.name ?? "",   // <- empty if name never assigned
    arguments: block.text
  };

translate() tool-call loop only assigns name/id when a delta carries them:
  if (call.id !== void 0) block.callId = call.id;
  if (call.function?.name !== void 0) block.name = call.function.name;

discussions.title: [DSH Desktop] web_search 联网搜索工具静默使用官方 DeepSeek API 并计费，且界面无任何提示
discussions.body:
### 环境
- DSH Desktop 2.0.3（bundle: `ai.deepseek.dsh.desktop`），macOS
- 对话模型：内网私有部署（OpenAI/Anthropic 兼容协议，`llm-pi-ai`，`agent-default-model = changhangju / deepseek-v4-flash`）
- 联网工具：`web_search`（DSH 提供）
- 凭证：仅一把 `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`

### 现象
1. 界面中明确选用的是**内网私有模型**（从未选择官方模型）。
2. DeepSeek 开放平台账单却按这把 `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` 产生扣费。
3. 排查后确认：扣费来自 Agent 会话里的 **`web_search` 工具调用**，而非对话模型。

### 根因（本机已核实）
- 会话日志显示每次主对话请求 `provider = changhangju / model = deepseek-v4-flash`，主对话从未走官方。
- 但 `web_search` 的后端使用 `.credentials.yaml` 里的 `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` 访问 DeepSeek 官方 API 鉴权。
- 证据：吊销该 key（占位符 `123`）后，`web_search` 报：
  `Authentication Fails, Your api key: 123 is invalid`
  与请求 DeepSeek 官方 API 的 `authentication_error` 完全一致。
- 结论：**"工具"并非本地免费函数，被静默路由到 DeepSeek 官方云服务（检索 + 可能的 LLM 处理），按用户官方 key 计费。**

### 复现
1. 配置有效 `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`，选择内网私有模型。
2. Agent 会话中触发 `web_search`（要求"联网搜索"）。
3. 官网账单出现按该 key 的扣费；全程界面无任何"将调用官方 API 并计费"的提示。

### 期望
- **透明**：明确提示哪些工具/功能会调用官方云 API 并按用户 key 计费（尤其联网这类"工具"）。
- **可控**：提供开关，允许把联网/工具调用的后端指向自定义（内网 / OpenAI 兼容）服务，与对话模型同通道。
- **防呆**：主模型与工具通道不一致或即将产生官方计费时，给出警告/二次确认。
- **可观测**：用量页区分"对话"与"工具/搜索"消费，便于对账。

### 补充
- 实测扣费时间窗与 `web_search` 调用窗口完全吻合（示例时段 15:00–16:00、20:20–20:50）。
- 删除该 key 后 `web_search` 即失效（`123 invalid`），未再扣费。

discussions.title: 功能需求：目标工具支持可选唤醒延迟，用于心跳式长期监控
discussions.body:
## 使用场景

希望把需要长时间关注的事件交给 DSH 持续跟进。例如，一个批处理任务可能运行十几个小时甚至数天，我们希望 agent 定期醒来查看进度、状态和错误信息；正常推进时继续等待，出现严重错误、长时间停滞或其他需要人工介入的情况时，及时通知用户查看，任务完成时汇报结果。

这类目标的大部分时间都在等待外部事件推进。用户需要的是低频、持续的关注，而不是连续执行很多轮检查，也不想每次手动发消息让 agent 再看一眼。

## 诉求

希望给目标工具增加一个**可选的唤醒延迟参数**，让目标可以在等待一段时间后自动唤醒并继续检查，达到心跳式唤醒的效果。

例如，用户可以交代：“帮我盯着这个超长批处理，每隔 10 分钟检查一次；正常就继续等，出现严重问题就通知我来查看，直到任务结束。”希望一次交代后，DSH 就能按这样的节奏长期跟进。

核心期待是：等待期间保持安静，在约定的检查时间主动跟进，在真正需要用户关注时提醒用户。

cc @tianyicui，看到你近期参与了不少核心功能的提交和合并，想请你看看这个使用场景是否适合纳入目标能力的规划。谢谢！

discussions.title: DSH | dsh-resume-screening | Free resume screening plugin for HR on DeepSeek Harness
discussions.body:
> ⚠️ **Unofficial community project / 非官方社区项目** — independent, community-maintained, not affiliated with or endorsed by DeepSeek. 独立社区维护的插件，与 DeepSeek 官方无关。

## Intro / 简介

**EN** — `dsh-resume-screening` is a resume screening plugin for HR in DeepSeek Harness. Ingest up to 100k Word/PDF/Excel resumes into one searchable library, then screen by plain-language criteria: deterministic rule pre-filter in the database (gender / education / years / skills…) plus LLM fine-judge on the shortlisted few. Auto-ingests & de-dupes new resumes, records ingest time, exports CSV.

**ZH** — 面向 HR 的简历筛选插件。把 10 万份以内的 Word/PDF/Excel 简历统一收进可检索的简历库，用大白话下指令即可筛选（库内规则过滤硬条件 + 对少数入围者 LLM 精判适配度）。新简历自动入库去重、记录入库时间、可导出 CSV。

## Features / 功能

- Batch ingest docx / pdf / xlsx / xls / md / txt → unified Markdown archive, content-hash de-dupe
- Structured profile: hard fields (rules) + granular skills & coarse categories (LLM), ingest & source-mtime tracked
- Two-stage screen: DB rule pre-filter → LLM fine-judge (0-100 score / verdict / matched skills / gaps / hard-field recheck)
- Auto-ingest via `resume_screen(folderPath=...)`; reusable job requirements; CSV export

## Screenshot

![settings](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wangzhanchao883/dsh-resume-screening/main/assets/screenshots/settings.png)

## Integrate with DSH

```
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-resume-screening
```

Then use in chat, e.g. `resume_screen(reqId=1, folderPath="...", llm=true)`.

## Links

- Repo: https://github.com/wangzhanchao883/dsh-resume-screening
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-resume-screening

The release scripts still cannot run on Windows: `tar -tzf C:\...` is read as an rsh host, and the remaining bare `npm` spawns are ENOENT
discussions.body:
`pnpm install` and the build both succeed on Windows. Every release step after
them fails, in two unrelated ways. `pnpmInvocation` already solved the same
class of problem for pnpm; these are the two places it does not reach.

Measured on `dsh-v0.1.5-alpha.1` (5dda764ed3), Windows 11, Node 22.23.2,
pnpm 11.7.0, Git for Windows on PATH, invoked as `pnpm run`.

## 1. `tar -tzf C:\…` is read as a remote host

`release:pack` dies on its first tarball:

```
Error: tar -tzf C:\…\dist\npm\deepseek-ai-dsh-brand-0.1.5-alpha.1.tgz exited with 2:
tar (child): Cannot connect to C: resolve failed
gzip: stdin: unexpected end of file
tar: Child returned status 128
tar: Error is not recoverable: exiting now
    at tarballFiles (scripts/release/tarball.ts:30:10)
```

MSYS GNU tar reads the leading `C:` as an rsh HOST. Windows also ships bsdtar
in system32, which does not, so whether a release works depends on PATH order.

The documented remedy, `--force-local`, is not usable here: bsdtar rejects the
flag outright, so adding it just moves the failure to the other tar. Running
each invocation from the tarball's own directory and naming it by basename
passes no drive letter at all, and both tars accept it.

## 2. The remaining bare `npm` spawns are ENOENT

With tar fixed, `release:pack` completes (258 tarballs) and the next step
fails immediately:

```
Error: spawnSync npm ENOENT
  syscall: 'spawnSync npm',
```

`npm` is a `.cmd` shim on Windows, not an executable. A bare `npm` is ENOENT
because no `npm.exe` exists, and `npm.cmd` is EINVAL because Node refuses to
spawn `.cmd` without a shell (the CVE-2024-27980 fix). `shell: true` is not
the alternative: under a shell Node concatenates arguments without escaping
(DEP0190), and these arguments are mostly paths.

Three call sites remain: `npm view` and `npm publish` in
`scripts/release/publish.ts`, and `npm install` in
`scripts/release/verify-packed-install.ts`.

`npm_execpath` cannot answer this the way `pnpmInvocation` uses it, because a
script launched through `pnpm run` sees pnpm there. Taking npm from the
installation beside the running Node binary and running it under that binary
needs no shell and cannot be re-split.

## Patch

A branch carrying both, based on `5dda764ed3`, so it applies with `git am -3`:

https://github.com/nokkies/dsh-upstream-patches/tree/fix/release-windows-npm-and-tar

It adds `scripts/npm-invocation.ts` next to `scripts/pnpm-invocation.ts` and
mirrors that file's shape, including its spec style. Non-Windows platforms
keep spawning `npm` by name and take an unchanged tar path.

Verified on this tree: before, `release:pack --family dsh` fails on the first
tarball; after, it packs all 258. Before, `release:verify-packed-install`
fails at once with `spawnSync npm ENOENT`; after, npm runs and installs the
packed consumer.

## One thing the patch does not address

With both fixed, `release:verify-packed-install` gets as far as a real install
and then fails inside npm itself:

```
npm error Cannot read properties of null (reading 'edgesOut')
```

That is npm 10.9.8's Arborist crashing rather than reporting ERESOLVE, and it
is reachable because the packed test-support packages carry `vitest` as a
runtime dependency, so a consumer install inherits vitest's optional-peer
surface — `@vitest/browser-playwright@5.0.0` demands `vitest@5.0.0` exactly,
against the 4.x placed by the tree. Moving vitest to `peerDependencies` with
`peerDependenciesMeta.optional` removes it from consumer installs entirely.
Happy to open that separately if it is useful.

discussions.title: The v0 migration refuses `subagent/descriptor` version 2 on the number alone, so sessions written before 2026-08-24 will not open
discussions.body:
`session-format-v0-to-v1` refuses any v0 `subagent/descriptor` whose `version`
is not 3. `SUBAGENT_DESCRIPTOR_VERSION` was 2 until #2663 (merged 2026-08-24),
so every release before that date wrote version 2 — `0.1.0-rc.7`,
`0.1.0-rc.8`, `0.1.1-rc.1`, `0.1.1-rc.2`. Anyone who used subagents on those
releases has sessions that cannot be opened on `0.1.5-alpha.1`.

```
SessionFormatUnsupportedError: subagent/descriptor 0 uses unsupported
descriptor version 2; source v0 artifact remains unchanged
```

## The shape of it is worse than the error suggests

It fails closed and leaves the artifact untouched, so nothing is lost. But a
listing reads only the header line, so the affected sessions still appear in
the session list with their titles, and refuse to open when clicked. Sessions
look present and are not.

Measured on one real store of 321 session logs:

| measure | count |
|---|---|
| logs carrying a `subagent/descriptor` | 291 |
| logs whose descriptor is version 2 | 282 |
| logs whose descriptor is version 3 | 9 |
| **logs the migration would refuse** | **282 of 321** |

## The refusal is the number, not the payload

#2663 bumped 2 to 3 and added exactly one field, `agentReasoningEffort`. The
released-v0 disposition for this event requires `mode`, `version`, `provider`
and permits `label`, `agentProvider`, `agentModel`, `agentReasoningEffort`,
`persona`, `toolFilter` — so `agentReasoningEffort` is optional there, and a
version-2 payload is a valid version-3 payload by that same rule.

The code never gets that far. In `assertReleasedEventPayload` the version
comparison throws before `assertReleasedV0Keys` runs, so the payload is never
checked against the disposition that would accept it.

Every descriptor in that store, in five distinct key shapes:

| shape | count |
|---|---|
| v2 `agentModel,agentProvider,label,mode,provider,version` | 190 |
| v2 `label,mode,provider,version` | 40 |
| v2 `mode,provider,version` | 52 |
| v3 `agentModel,agentProvider,label,mode,provider,version` | 8 |
| v3 `label,mode,provider,version` | 1 |
| **violating the v3 disposition** | **0 of 291** |

## Suggestion

Accept version 2 alongside 3 for a v0 source and let `assertReleasedV0Keys` do
the work it already does. On this evidence that costs no strictness: every
real payload passes the same key check a version-3 descriptor gets, and the
one field the bump introduced is optional in the disposition either way.

If the intent is that version 2 carries some semantic the migration cannot
reconstruct, then the error should say which one, because from the payloads
the two generations are indistinguishable apart from an optional field.

A branch carrying that, based on `5dda764ed3`, so it applies with `git am -3`:

https://github.com/nokkies/dsh-upstream-patches/tree/fix/subagent-descriptor-generation-2

Generation 2 falls through to the key and value checks instead of being
refused, in both the disposition gate and `subagentDescriptorValue`. Every
other generation is still unknown and still refused, and the payload rules are
unchanged for both: an unlisted member, or an unpaired `agentProvider`, is
still rejected at generation 2. Measured over those 291 descriptors: 9
accepted before, 291 after. The package suite passes at 112.

discussions.title: The published test-support packages carry `vitest` as a runtime dependency, so a lockfile-less consumer install crashes npm
discussions.body:
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-test-support-client-runtime` and
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-test-support-session-snapshot` both declare `vitest` in
`dependencies`. Every consumer of the published packages therefore installs
vitest and inherits its whole optional-peer surface.

That surface is not stable. `@vitest/browser-playwright@5.0.0`, published
2026-09-03, requires `vitest@5.0.0` exactly. Resolving it against the 4.x the
tree places makes npm 10.9.8's Arborist dereference a null edge and crash
rather than report ERESOLVE:

```
npm error Cannot read properties of null (reading 'edgesOut')
```

`release:verify-packed-install` installs the packed tarballs without a
lockfile and with strict peers, deliberately, to prove the published ranges
resolve for a fresh consumer. It fails there with no useful diagnosis, and so
would anyone installing the published packages the same way.

## Why the dependency is in the wrong section

vitest is a test-suite peer, not a runtime dependency: neither package imports
it outside its own test surface, and a consumer that never runs vitest should
never receive it.

Declaring it as a plain peer is not sufficient, because npm 7 and later
auto-install a required peer, so the consumer still gets it and still inherits
the same surface. `peerDependenciesMeta.optional` is what removes it from a
consumer install. `devDependencies` keeps it for this repo's own tests, so
nothing changes for development.

## Patch

A branch based on `5dda764ed3`, so it applies with `git am -3`:

https://github.com/nokkies/dsh-upstream-patches/tree/fix/test-support-vitest-optional-peer

It touches only the two manifests. `pnpm-lock.yaml` is not included;
regenerating it with `pnpm install` is a 6-line change.

Measured on Windows with npm 10.9.8: before, the packed install fails on the
Arborist crash above; after, npm resolves the tree and installs.

## One thing you will hit next

With this fixed, the packed install proceeds and then fails on something else:
`--omit=optional`, which `verify-packed-install` passes, strips koffi's
prebuilt binaries, because koffi ships them AS optional dependencies and sets
`hasInstallScript`. The install script then compiles from source and fails
with `CMake does not seem to be available`.

On a Linux runner with CMake present that does not fail; it silently verifies
a source build rather than the prebuilt path every real consumer gets. Since
npm already treats `optionalDependencies` as best-effort, the flag buys
nothing the intent did not already have. Removing it is one line, and with
both changes `release:pack --family dsh` packs 258 tarballs and
`release:verify-packed-install --family dsh` exits 0 on Windows. Happy to send
that as a separate patch if it is wanted.

discussions.title: taskfold — fold finished work out of context: −63.5% prompt tokens over a 411-step session
discussions.body:
**taskfold** — https://github.com/yindf/taskfold
`dsh plugin --profile web add github:yindf/taskfold`

Long sessions drown in their own history: every request re-sends hours of finished work — old tool outputs, debug logs, abandoned attempts. taskfold makes the agent wrap each piece of work in `task_begin("…")` and close it with `task_end("…")`. Closing folds the whole span into one short titled summary, and `fold_recall({ fold: N })` brings the original back on demand.

**Measured on one real session** — 411 model steps, 26 folds, read from the harness's own usage records:

| | Without folding | With taskfold |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Total prompt tokens | 142,654,308 | 52,127,098 (**−63.5%**) |
| Largest single request | 594,909 | 206,896 (−65%) |
| Context window at peak | 59.5% | 20.7% |

441,100 tokens of finished work were moved off the surface. Because that history would otherwise be re-sent on every later request, it added up to 90,527,210 tokens never sent. Producing the 26 summaries cost 3,550,270 tokens — 3.9% of the saving, and most of it cache reads.

**Design notes that may be useful even if you don't install it:**

- The summary is written once, while the original span is still in context — so it is accurate, not a summary of a summary. It is instructed to keep user decisions (verbatim where wording matters), pitfalls and *why* things failed, what changed, and the outcome.
- Folding rewrites only a middle chunk of history, so the stable prefix (system prompt, tools, earlier context) stays cache-friendly. I re-verify this after every dsh upgrade against a live session log (`scripts/verify-cache.mjs` exits non-zero when a fold's summarizer call re-pays its span — the signature of the prefix envelope no longer matching the host's summarization input).
- Hints are events, not state: one is published only when a condition appears or its wording changes, nothing is published once the condition clears, and there is no wrapper or expiry notice.
- Open tasks survive restarts; closing is well-ordered (innermost first), and a failed close never corrupts anything — just retry.

**Honest caveats.** That is one session with one task shape — your numbers will differ. Most of the saved tokens would have been cache *reads* rather than fresh input: cheaper, but still billed and still occupying the window. Supported dsh: alpha through `0.1.5-alpha.1`, rc through `0.1.2-rc.1` (both verified; the verification notes are in the README). dsh does not yet expose host-version negotiation to plugins, so on an incompatible host folds degrade — tasks still close, unfolded — rather than corrupt. MIT, offline test suite in `test/` (`npm test`).

Feedback welcome, especially if your session shape produces very different numbers.

---

**中文：** taskfold 把「已经做完的工作」折叠成一条带标题的短摘要，原文随时用 `fold_recall` 取回。一个真实会话实测（411 个模型步骤、26 次折叠，数据取自 harness 自己的 usage 记录）：prompt token 从 1.427 亿降到 5213 万（**−63.5%**），单次最大请求从 594,909 降到 206,896，峰值上下文占用从 59.5% 降到 20.7%。26 次摘要自身花了 355 万 token，只占节省量的 3.9%。

要点：摘要是在原始 span 还在上下文里时一次性写好的，不是「摘要的摘要」；折叠只改写历史中间一段，稳定前缀（system prompt、工具、更早上下文）仍然命中缓存；提示是事件而非状态，条件消失就不再输出。安装：`dsh plugin --profile web add github:yindf/taskfold`。支持 alpha 至 `0.1.5-alpha.1`、rc 至 `0.1.2-rc.1`（均已验证）。MIT 许可。

discussions.title: read_image refuses on vision-capable models whose image input is not declared — refusal should point at the fix
discussions.body:
## Version

`@deepseek-ai/dsh` 0.1.2-rc.1 (global npm install)

## What happened

A real agent session needed to read a page of a scanned PDF (a French PLU zoning regulation, raster-only, no text layer). It rasterized the page to PNG and called `read_image`:

```
Error: cannot read ".../page_02.png" as an image: model "zai-org/GLM-5.3-Flash" does not declare image input; switch to an image-capable model to read images
```

GLM 5.3 Flash **is** image-input-capable on its OpenAI-compatible endpoint — the refusal was about the *declaration*, not the model. The agent then pip-installed `rapidocr-onnxruntime` + `pymupdf` into a scratch venv and OCR'd the page locally to get text into context — work a supported `read_image` call would have made unnecessary.

## Root cause

`read_image`'s capability gate (`assertImageCapableRoute`, `dsh-tool-fs`) requires the resolved route to explicitly declare image input. Modality resolution for a custom-provider model falls through:

1. per-model `input:` on the provider's `models` entry,
2. pi-ai's catalog entry for the model id,
3. the provider's `defaultInput`,
4. `DEFAULT_INPUT = ["text"]`.

Two gaps:

- **pi-ai's catalog** has `glm-5.3-flash` only under provider `zai`, declared `"input": ["text"]` — no `friendli` entry, and no image modality anywhere in the GLM family. (The `openai-completions` transport itself carries image parts fine — see verification below.)
- **The user-facing fix exists but is undiscoverable.** Adding `input: [text, image]` to the model entry in settings resolves it, but nothing points there: the refusal message says "switch to an image-capable model", the settings templates don't mention the `input` field, and the tool description ("Requires the current model to accept image input") reads as a model property, not a configuration one.

## Verified workaround

```yaml
llm-pi-ai:
  providers:
    friendli:
      models:
        - id: zai-org/GLM-5.3-Flash
          name: GLM 5.3 Flash
          contextWindow: 1048576
          maxTokens: 65536
          input: [text, image]   # <- this line
```

Headless run after the change: `read_image` on a 1×1 PNG returned the image block, and the model correctly reported the rendered pixel color (r=0, g=255, b=0, a=127). Same harness, same model, one line of config.

## Requests

1. **Refusal message should hint at the declaration path** — e.g. `...does not declare image input; if this model accepts images, declare "input: [text, image]" on its models entry`. The current message sends users model-shopping when the model is fine.
2. **Catalog refresh**: GLM 5.3 / 5.3-flash (and plausibly 5.2) accept image input; pi-ai's `zai.json` (and any friendli coverage) should carry `"input": ["text", "image"]`.
3. **Docs**: the custom-provider `models` schema accepts `input: [text, image]` — worth one line wherever custom providers are documented, plus a mention in `read_image`'s tool description.

Happy to file the pi-ai catalog piece wherever that data lives upstream if this isn't the right home for item 2.

discussions.title: [Idea] 希望 DeepSeek 支持视频阅读：上传视频并理解内容 (Video understanding support)
discussions.body:
## 背景 / Current Situation

目前 DeepSeek 网页版（chat.deepseek.com）和 APP 支持上传图片和文档，但**不支持直接上传视频文件**。想让 DeepSeek "看"一个视频，只能手动截图逐帧上传，或者先用第三方工具转录音轨，非常麻烦。

## 期望 / Proposed Enhancement

希望 DeepSeek 后续能支持**视频阅读（视频理解）**：

- 在网页版 / APP 的上传入口支持常见视频格式（如 mp4、mov）；Agent / Harness 形态下也期待能直接读取和消化视频文件
- 模型能够理解视频内容，包括：画面与场景、情节时序、语音内容（转写）
- 支持针对视频的提问：内容总结、要点提取、指定时间点问答、多视频对比等
- 长期看，也期待开放平台（API）能提供视频输入能力

## 使用场景 / Why this matters

- **讲座/课程学习**：上传录播视频，让 AI 总结知识点、生成时间轴笔记
- **会议录像**：快速提取结论和待办事项
- **视频内容核对**：检查素材是否完整表达意思（比如确认拍摄的视频"大概意思到了没有"）
- **无障碍**：为听障/视障用户提供视频内容描述

类似的视频理解能力在其他主流助手产品中已逐渐普及，希望 DeepSeek 也能考虑支持，谢谢！

English summary: We hope DeepSeek (web/app and agent forms) will support **video reading** — allowing users to upload video files (mp4/mov) so the model can understand visuals, timeline, and speech, and answer questions about the content (summaries, key points, Q&A at specific timestamps). Currently only images and documents are supported, which forces manual frame-capturing or third-party transcription.

北极星记忆 (dsh-polaris-memory) — 让 DeepSeek Harness 记住你的项目 (v0.1.0, on npm)
discussions.body:
# 北极星记忆 (dsh-polaris-memory) — 让 DeepSeek Harness 记住你的项目 (v0.1.0, on npm)

## TL;DR
一个本地优先、按项目隔离的项目记忆插件：每项目一份 `.dsh-memory.json`，AI 每轮自动带着你的习惯（用户画像常驻）、改文件时自动提醒规矩（场景触发）、聊到相关内容自动翻出来（语义召回）、重要记忆还能上锁防删（硬守卫）。

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-polaris-memory
```

## 解决的问题
- **AI 记性差**：聊着聊着就忘之前说过的项目事实/经验/偏好。
- **注入太吵/太乱**：要么每轮全量刷屏，要么命中一堆不相关。
- **重要底线守不住**：光靠提示词，AI 还是能删/改核心记忆。

## 功能
- **6 类记忆**：project / reference / feedback / user / skill / knowledge（每项目一份 `.dsh-memory.json`，按 cwd 隔离）。
- **分级注入（三层漏斗）**：
  - L1 常驻元层：用户画像 + 当前状态 + 催办 + 心跳（**首步真身**——`readDocSync` 同步读，冷启动不空段）；
  - L2 场景触发：`detectScene` 四源归一（文件域 / 记忆操作 / 命令 / 话语倒排）→ 重要等级 **P1 红线 / P2 常设 / P3 情境** → 片段（title+命中行+`[来源:slug]` 溯源）→ cap3 去重 → **P1 置顶**；
  - L3 规则守卫：规则精简句+记忆场景全量+**硬守卫**（文件直改 `.dsh-memory.json` 拒绝）。
- **语义召回**：IDF + unigram + 同义词层（跨说法召回，如"怎么合并记忆"→ 命中"冗余治理"）。
- **底线记忆 → 硬守卫机制**：识别**禁止语义**（禁止/绝不/严禁/不得/勿；义务词"必须/记得"只走 P1 提醒不装守卫）→ 三选项授权弹窗（允许仅记忆 / 允许并装硬守卫[规格全文] / 拒绝）→ `guard` 字段进记忆（零 schema）→ 内存守卫表 → **pre-execute 拦截**（AI 工具删：deny + 回显；用户 `/memory delete`：弹窗确认可绕——**守卫约束 agent 不约束用户**）→ `/memory guard list|remove`（可逆）→ **归档记忆锁自动失效**（冗余记忆不挂锁）。
- **写操作二次确认**（memory_* 工具弹窗，用户批准才落盘）+ 自动打标（域 tags / 别称 / 义务）+ 正文自动整理。
- **设置页 UI**：记忆列表 / 编辑 / 删除 / 拖动排序 / 状态过滤 / 搜索 / 多项目切换。
- **数据安全**：损坏备份（`.corrupt-<ts>`）+ lossless round-trip + 写盘三道防线。
- **装卸干净**：装一次全生效；Cordis dispose 自动清理（含 webServer 路由 ctx.effect）；`.dsh-memory.json` 数据保留。

## 验证 / 局限
- 测试：`node --test`（roundtrip / m4-recall / guard 等）+ `rule.js` / `scene.js` selfTest 全绿。
- 已知限制：路径子串误伤（弹窗规格展示用户肉眼兜底，v2 路径分段）；shell 间接写不在守卫内；义务语义无法机制化（"忘记做 X" 只能 P1 提醒）。
- 适配核心：DSH **v0.1.2-rc 系**（web/desktop profile 通用）；配置 `injectMode: scenario | legacy-full`（金丝雀回退开关）。

## Status
- **npm**：`dsh-polaris-memory@0.1.0`（beta）
- **仓库**：https://github.com/LAYZR114/dsh-project-memory （公开 / `dsh-plugin` topic / BSD-3-Clause / 双语 README）
- **目录 PR**：awesome-dsh-plugin #4739（审核中）

## Try it
```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-polaris-memory
/memory status
/memory guard list
```

*北极星记忆：让 AI 记清你的项目 —— 三层即时性（此刻上下文 / 该想起想起 / 想起真执行），每轮 O(1) token。*

discussions.title: 左侧会话列表:建议增加"运行中会话优先"排序(含子代理运行中),可作 orderBy 新档或默认策略
discussions.body:
## 背景

多任务并行时,左侧会话树里往往混着几十个会话。当前 `orderBy` 只有两档:

- `manual`(手动排序):会话位置由用户拖动决定,运行中的会话可能沉在列表深处;
- `updated`(最近更新):运行中的 agent 会频繁产生轮询/进度更新,导致列表顶部"跳动",反而不稳定、难定位。

而"正在跑的任务"恰恰是最需要一眼看到的:切回来继续跟进、观察子代理进度、处理等待交互的完成会话。

## 期望行为

在既有排序之上叠加一个**运行中优先**策略(稳定排序,rank 相同则保持原有相对顺序,不产生跳动):

```
rank 0  会话本身 running(主会话正在跑)
rank 1  有 running 的子代理后代(基于子代理血缘链 runningCount > 0)
rank 2  completed === true 且未查看(绿色"完成"提示点,便于继续下一步)
rank 3  其他(空闲/归档外会话)
```

## 想确认的方向

官方是否考虑把它作为**内置能力**(如 `orderBy` 第三档 `running`,或作为默认显示策略并可切换)?

discussions.title: 建议：让子 Agent 按情况决定是否唤醒主 Agent，而不是每次都唤醒
discussions.body:
## 希望解决什么问题

我会直接打开子 Agent 的会话，继续提问、讨论方案或处理它提出的决策。子 Agent 已经向我解释清楚后，主 Agent 又因为收到通知而运行，把同一份信息重新讲一遍。

希望把两件事分开：**把信息同步给主 Agent**，和**让主 Agent 现在开始思考、行动或回答**。由子 Agent 根据当前情况决定采用哪一种，而不是每次结束一轮就自动唤醒主 Agent。

核心是让子 Agent 可以选择通知方式。“在主会话直接展示子 Agent 原话”只是可选的展示办法，不是这条需求要求所有通知采用的形式。

## 我的意见和建议原文

以下完整保留我的原始表述：

> 我认为，让 Sub Agent 自己决定什么时候应该通知主 Agent 并将其唤醒以生成答复，什么时候应该只把上下文塞进 Context 里面会比较好。如果 Sub Agent 还能控制主 Agent 生成答复时需要投入多大的 Effort，以及生成什么内容，那就更加好了。
>
> 比如说，我想到的这种情况下的理想方案应该是：
>
> 1. Sub Agent 把生成完毕的决策信息同步给 Main Agent。
> 2. Main Agent 不做复述，而是提示：“Sub Agent 有一些需要你决策的信息如下，你可以直接看”，然后附带一个消息块。
> 3. 前端将这个消息块渲染为 Sub Agent 发送的原消息的逐字原文本。
>
> 这样一来，用户无论是在 Main Agent 还是在 Sub Agent 里面看，都可以处理这条信息，同时不会产生Main agents二次复述这些决策信息所带来的 Token 输出成本。

## 实际遇到的情况

环境：macOS，DSH Desktop 0.7.2。以下是对 2026-09-09 本地父、子会话持久化记录的核对，不是另行构造的测试；已省略项目、文档、会话标识和内部方案内容。

一个很明确的例子（纽约时间）：

1. 09:35:48，我直接在子 Agent 会话里追问它提出的决策及其背景。
2. 09:36:10，子 Agent 回答完毕。这一轮没有调用 `report`。
3. 同一秒，主 Agent 收到来自该子 Agent 的 `subagent-settled`，开始新一轮。
4. 09:36:20，主 Agent 再次解释这些决策、再次让我选择。这一轮还检查了其他任务进度，共有 2 次模型请求，记录的输出合计 1,484 tokens（含推理）。

这不是界面把同一条消息画了两遍，而是主 Agent 确实又运行、又生成了回答。上述 token 数是整轮的用量，不能全部归为逐字复述成本。

另两次直接向子 Agent 提交的请求中，子 Agent 先调用 `report`，随后又有 `subagent-settled`。其系统提示仍要求结束前调用 `report`。因此，只改其中一条通知路径可能不够。

也不希望一刀切地禁止主 Agent 接收结果或继续工作：同一组记录里，主 Agent 有时确实做了有用的文档同步、证据核对。要避免的是**每次子 Agent 回答完，都默认值得主 Agent 再运行一轮**。

## 核心建议：由子 Agent 按情况选择通知方式

子 Agent 应能根据自己正在处理的事情、当前结果和协作需要，选择：

1. **叫醒主 Agent，并说明希望它做什么。** 例如请主 Agent 理解最新情况，再派发其他任务；可附上工作建议，以及希望投入多大 effort。
2. **叫醒主 Agent，把下一步交给它判断。** 子 Agent 提供情况和依据，主 Agent 结合自己的完整上下文，决定接下来做什么，不要求子 Agent 预先指定行动。
3. **不叫醒，只把消息放进主 Agent 的上下文。** 主 Agent 下次正常运行时可以看到，不为这次信息同步额外启动一轮模型请求。

这些方式由子 Agent 按情况决定，不应固定为每次都唤醒。子 Agent 对具体行动和 effort 的说明，也不应成为所有通知的必填项；它可以只报告情况，让主 Agent 自己决定。

正在等待子任务结果才能推进工作时，可以选择唤醒；用户直接在子会话里追问、补充信息时，可以选择只同步。它们是使用场景，不是要用固定关键词或“紧急/不紧急”规则替代子 Agent 的判断。

## 可选办法：在主会话直接展示子 Agent 原话

当消息主要是给用户看的，例如一组待决策事项，可以在主会话显示简短提示和子 Agent 的原消息块，标明来源并能跳回原消息。正文逐字展示，用户从任一会话进入都能处理同一条信息，避免主 Agent 为转述再生成一遍。

这只是其中一种展示方式。需要主 Agent 理解现状、分析或派发任务时，仍然应允许它正常思考、回答和行动。

如果提示只是固定文案，可以直接由前端展示，不必为生成这句提示再启动主 Agent。这里希望消除的是不必要的二次改写开销；不声称后续模型读取这些上下文也没有 token 成本。

## 对这条建议的进一步澄清（原文）

> 直接展示原话，别再复述一遍，只是一种可选的方法，我感觉它不应该被放在这个idea的标题里面
>
> 子 Agent 也可以采取以下策略：
>
> 1. 叫醒主 Agent，并让他理解一下现状，再派发一些别的任务。
> 2. 叫醒主 Agent，由主 Agent 自己决定接下来该干什么。
> 3. 完全不叫醒主 Agent，只是把消息注入到 contexts 内部。
>
> 这些都应该由 sub agent 自己来按情况决定，而不是总是唤醒主会话。

## 与已有讨论的区别

- [#684](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/684) 已反馈最终答复后出现追加确认回合，并提出非交互通知方向。
- [#2192](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/2192) 讨论 `report` 与结束通知的重复投递和顺序。
- [#471](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/471) 讨论较旧的汇报晚于新结果到达，触发额外回合。

这条需求的核心是**让子 Agent 按情况决定是否唤醒主 Agent，以及唤醒时是否附上行动建议**。用户直接与子 Agent 继续对话是一个具体例子，直接展示原消息只是可选方案。上面的实际案例没有主动 `report`，单独一条结束通知也会触发主 Agent，所以仅做重复消息去重或修复顺序，不能完整解决。

这是产品体验建议，不预设底层必须采用哪种实现。如果已有设置、插件接口或计划能支持这种用法，也请指出。
