discussions.title: [Bug] 工具执行中途崩溃的轮会留下悬空 tool_calls：切到 deepseek-official 重放历史必 400（repair 只补尾部 turn，deepseek 适配器无 sanitizer）
discussions.body:
## 症状

会话中途从其他 provider（cerebras/qwen 等）切换到 `deepseek-official`，该会话的第一个请求即 400：

```
An assistant message with 'tool_calls' must be followed by tool messages responding to each 'tool_call_id'. (insufficient tool messages following tool_calls message)
```

切回原模型立即恢复正常；不带伤的会话切换 DeepSeek 也正常。触发条件是**该会话历史里曾有某一轮在工具执行中途崩溃**（见根因），伤会永久留在 transcript 里，只有严格校验的 provider 会引爆。

## 环境

- dsh 0.1.2-rc.1（Windows 11，`dsh web`）
- 已核对 npm 最新 0.1.5-rc.1 与 master（2026-09-10）：`serialize.ts` 无 sanitizer、`repair.ts` 逻辑一致，均未修复；GitHub 上无同类报告

## 根因链

1. 某轮在工具执行中途崩溃（我这例是内部错误 `Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'prepare')`）。session log 落了 `assistant/message`（含 tool-call 块）和 `tool/call`，但 `tool/result` 永远没落，turn 以 `step/end` + `turn/end(reason=error)` 收尾 → 历史里留下悬空 tool_call。
2. `packages/core/session/src/repair.ts::interruptedTurnClosers` 只补"尾部未闭合 turn"；本例 turn/end 已写、日志"平衡"，repair 返回空 closers（`step/end` 分支的 `pendingCalls.clear()` 把悬空记录直接清掉了）。
3. `packages/llm/llm-deepseek/src/serialize.ts::serializeMessages` 对历史做无损直转，无任何补齐。
4. DeepSeek API 严格校验 assistant.tool_calls 与后续 tool 消息的配对与相邻 → 重放该历史必 400。Cerebras 等 provider 容忍悬空调用，所以问题一直潜伏，直到切到 DeepSeek 才暴露。

## 证据（session.jsonl 事件节选）

```text
17553 assistant/message  calls=[run_code]
17554 tool/call          run_code
17555 step/end
17556 turn/end           reason={"kind":"error","error":{"message":"Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'prepare')"}}
        ← 无 tool/result，悬空永久入史
...（会话在宽松 provider 下继续正常使用数小时）...
31840 model/selection    {"provider":"deepseek-official","model":"deepseek-flash"}
31852 turn/end           reason={"kind":"error","error":{"message":"An assistant message with 'tool_calls' must be followed by tool messages responding to each 'tool_call_id'. (insufficient tool messages following tool_calls message)","code":"INVALID_REQUEST","status":400}}
```

## 建议修复（二选一或都做）

- **修根**：turn 以 error 收尾时，为该步内未落结果的 tool-call 写合成 `tool/result`（复用 repair.ts 已有的 `TOOL_NOT_STARTED` / `TOOL_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN` 语义）；或让 repair 扫描全史补齐悬空调用，而不仅是尾部 turn。
- **防御**：deepseek 适配器在 `requestWithMessages` 收口处（text 与 image 两条序列化路径共用）为未应答的 tool_call_id 插合成 tool 消息，约 15 行。此法同时救活所有已带伤的存量会话。

## 现状 workaround

只能新开会话，或手改 session 日志补 `tool/result`。存量长会话一旦留伤就永远切不了 DeepSeek，故提此报告。

discussions.title: Upgrade requires a hard refresh: stale client bundle revisions silently break the plugin tree
discussions.body:
## Summary

After upgrading DSH or any plugin and restarting, the Web UI can show a broken plugin tree:

```
HARNESS — Failed to load plugins
web boot: 22 entries did not activate
@deepseek-ai/dsh-api-session-controller: pending (waiting for service: fileUpload)
@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-session: pending (waiting for service: sessions)
@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-sidebar: pending (waiting for service: uiWorkspace)
... (22 official client plugins cascade to pending)
```

Everything **looks** like a hard crash, but the host side is completely healthy: sessions still open, V3 migration succeeded, the dependency tree in `profiles/<name>/node_modules` is complete and all official packages match the new version. The chain always starts at a missing **client-side service**:

```
fileUpload (dsh-client-file-upload) missing
  → sessions (dsh-api-session-controller) pending
    → uiSession / uiConversation / sidebar / chat / ... 22 plugins pending
```

## Root cause (from source)

`dsh-client-modules` intentionally treats versioned client code as immutable:

> "Versioned code is immutable; mismatched revisions are rejected instead of serving newer bytes."

Upgrading a plugin changes its content-hash (rev) for the client bundle. The browser keeps requesting the **cached old rev**, the host **rejects** it instead of serving the new bytes, so the old `client.js` never registers its service. The result is a silent dependency-chain break in the browser, with no indication that the fix is a cache refresh.

## Why this is a UX trap

- The error surfaced to the user is `Failed to load plugins` / `N entries did not activate`, which reads like a broken installation, not a stale browser cache.
- A normal refresh (F5) can still hit the cache and keep failing. Only a **hard refresh (Ctrl+Shift+R)** recovers.
- Everything server-side is fine, so users may reinstall, roll back, or file bugs about the wrong component.

In our case the resolution was simply `Ctrl+Shift+R`. Two DSH upgrades in a row hit this (after upgrading `dshmarket` and `dsh-context`).

## Suggestions

1. **Detect and surface the mismatch.** When a requested rev does not match, respond with a distinguishable signal (e.g. `409`/`428` + `X-DSH-Rev-Mismatch`), and have the shell show an actionable message such as "A new version of the client was deployed — press Ctrl+Shift+R to reload", ideally with a one-click reload button.
2. **Auto-recover.** Stamp the deployed rev into the boot payload / `index.html`; if the running client detects a different rev, trigger `location.reload(true)` (or a cache-busting reload) automatically.
3. **Consider cache headers.** If boot config or entry HTML were served with `no-cache`/`must-revalidate` (while keeping hashed assets immutable), a stale client would be far less likely to run against a new host.
4. **Docs.** A short "after upgrading, hard-refresh the browser" note in the upgrade docs would prevent most of these reports.

## Environment

- DSH `0.1.5-rc.1` (also observed after plugin upgrades on `0.1.2-rc.1`)
- Linux, Node v22.23.2
- Plugins involved in the trigger: `dshmarket` `1.45.1`, `dsh-context` `0.48.0` (both changed client bundles)
- Browser: Chromium-based

Happy to provide any further traces or test a patch if useful.

discussions.title: 轨迹（Trajectory）面板：历史回放时首 token 延迟/生成时间/吞吐量恒显示"首 token 时间不可用"
discussions.body:
## 摘要

Trajectory（轨迹）面板的 Assistant timing 面板在**打开已结束的会话（历史回放）**时，
`首 token 延迟`、`生成`、`吞吐量` 三项恒显示 **"首 token 时间不可用"**。

同一份会话数据，聊天统计条（turn footer）与 `sessionStats` 投影的 TTFT 均正常。
根因是轨迹面板自有的流折叠只识别**裸 delta chunk**，而持久化的 `assistant/message.stream`
一律以**压缩批（packed run）**格式存储，从未包含裸 delta。

## 影响

- 所有已结束会话的轨迹面板 timing 三项不可用（100% 复现）
- 仅**正在流式输出**的步正常（此时走另一条合成事件路径）
- 与 provider、模型、部署方式（loopback / 反代）均无关；本机 loopback 访问同样复现

## 复现

1. 用任意 provider 完成一次至少含一个 assistant 步的对话
2. 刷新页面（或重新打开该会话）——确保该步**不再是**流式进行中
3. 打开 Trajectory 面板 → 展开任一 assistant 步 → 查看 timing 面板

**实际**：`首 token 延迟` / `生成` / `吞吐量` 均显示 `首 token 时间不可用`

**期望**：三者显示具体数值（如 `5.4s`、`12.1s`、`42.3 tok/s`）

## 环境

| 项 | 值 |
|---|---|
| dsh CLI | `0.1.5-alpha.1` |
| `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-trajectory` | `0.1.5-alpha.1` |
| `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm` | `0.1.5-alpha.1` |
| `@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-stats` | `0.1.5-alpha.1` |
| `@deepseek-ai/dsh-api-session-controller` | `0.1.5-alpha.1` |
| provider | 任一（见下文"provider 无关性"论证） |
| 部署 | `dsh --profile web`，浏览器访问（loopback 与反代均复现） |

## 根因分析

### 数据链路

轨迹面板的首 token 时间来自 `state.firstTokenTime`，其**唯一赋值点**在
`dsh-client-ui-trajectory/lib/client.js`：

```js
// 第 722 行 —— 唯一的赋值点
...isTokenDelta(chunk) && state.firstTokenTime === void 0 ? { firstTokenTime: time } : {}

// 第 592 行 —— 判定只看裸 delta
function isTokenDelta(chunk) {
    switch (chunk.type) {
        case "text-delta":
        case "reasoning-delta": return chunk.text !== "";
        case "tool-call-delta": return chunk.argumentsDelta !== "" || chunk.name !== void 0;
        default: return false;
    }
}
```

`updateChunk` 的**唯一调用来源**是客户端合成的 `assistant/live-chunk` 事件：

```js
// 第 843 行
if (match.event.type === "assistant/live-chunk") return updateChunk(context.state, match.event.data.chunk, match.event.seq, match.event.time);
```

而该合成事件在 `dsh-api-session-controller/lib/client.js` 中**仅在 `baseline.activeAttempt`
存在时**才由压缩批展开产生：

```js
// dsh-api-session-controller/lib/client.js 第 1368 行起
const opening = baseline?.activeAttempt;
if (opening !== void 0) for (const [index, member] of expandAssistantStream(opening.stream).entries()) {
    // ...合成 assistant/live-chunk
}
```

服务端只在**流式进行中**提供 `activeAttempt`
（`dsh-api-session-controller/lib/index.js` 第 1253 行，`snapshot()` 里
`...this.activeAttempt === void 0 ? {} : { activeAttempt: {...} }`）。

**因此历史回放时 `state.firstTokenTime` 恒为 `undefined`。**

### 持久化格式：只有压缩批，没有裸 delta

`assistant/message` 事件的 `data.stream` 一律为压缩批记录。实测一条真实记录：

```
record types: ['chunk', 'reasoning-chunks', 'chunk', 'tool-call-chunks', 'chunk', 'tool-call-chunks', 'chunk', 'chunk']
has text-chunks: False
has raw text-delta chunk: False
```

其中 `chunk` 记录仅承载 `block-start` / `block-end` / `usage` / `finish`，
**没有任何 `text-delta` / `reasoning-delta`**。

遍历本机全部历史会话确认：`assistant/message.stream` **从未**包含过裸 delta。
（更早的 v0 格式里出现过 `text-delta`，但它属于 `assistant/chunk` 事件，不是 `assistant/message.stream`，
故不属于"格式回归"，该缺陷在当前架构下一直存在。）

### provider 无关性

打包发生在 harness 内部的统一组件 `dsh-llm` 的 `BlockAssembler.push()`
（`dsh-llm/lib/index.js` 第 1119 行起）：

```js
case "text-delta":
case "reasoning-delta": {
    const type = chunk.type === "text-delta" ? "text-chunks" : "reasoning-chunks";
    const gap = previous !== void 0 && previous.type === type ? safeGap(previous.lastTime, time) : void 0;
    if (previous !== void 0 && previous.type === type && previous.index === chunk.index && gap !== void 0) {
        previous.dt.push(gap);
        previous.texts.push(chunk.text);
        ...
```

即：**任何** provider 的裸 delta 经 assembler 后一律成为压缩批。
打包是 harness 的存储层行为，与适配器实现无关，故该缺陷对所有 provider 生效。

（报告者本机有 stream 的会话恰好全部来自自建适配器，
但上述代码路径表明官方 provider 走同一 assembler，结论不依赖观测样本。）

### 为什么三项一起失效

三个渲染函数共用 `firstTokenTime` 作为前置门槛
（`dsh-client-ui-trajectory/lib/client.js`）：

```js
// 第 4035 行 —— ttft()
if (metrics.firstTokenTime === null) return t("timing.firstTokenUnavailable");

// 第 4039 行 —— generationTime()
if (!metrics.timingRecorded || metrics.firstTokenTime === null) return t("timing.firstTokenUnavailable");

// 第 4046 行 —— throughput()
if (!metrics.timingRecorded || metrics.firstTokenTime === null) return t("timing.firstTokenUnavailable");
```

`timing` 对象在 `settleMessage` 中构造（第 776 行起），直接透传该状态：

```js
timing: {
    stepStartTime: state.started ? state.startTime : null,
    firstTokenTime: state.firstTokenTime ?? null,   // ← 恒为 null
    completedTime: event.time
}
```

### 对照组：同一数据在别处工作正常

| 消费者 | 是否解码压缩批 | TTFT 结果 |
|---|---|---|
| `dsh-session-stats` | ✅ 调用 `assistantStreamFirstTokenTime`（来自 `dsh-llm`） | 正常 |
| `dsh-client-connection`（聊天统计条折叠） | ✅ 本地 `expandAssistantStream` | 正常 |
| **`dsh-client-ui-trajectory`** | ❌ 裸 `isTokenDelta` | **不可用** |

`dsh-client-connection/lib/client.js` 第 3057/3063 行即为正确范例：

```js
case "assistant/attempt": {
    const first = expandAssistantStream(event.data.stream).find((member) => isFixtureTokenDelta(member.chunk))?.time;
    if (openStep.firstTokenTime === null && first !== void 0) openStep.firstTokenTime = first;
    break;
}
```

同文件第 1549 行有一份**客户端本地**的 `expandAssistantStream` 实现
（含 `validateRecord` / `validateRun`，含 `time0 + dt` 差分时间重建），
证明该解码逻辑在浏览器侧完全可实现，不违反客户端 bundle 的跨插件值导入约束。

## 实测数据

在真实会话日志（**440** 条带 stream 的 `assistant/message`；会话仍在增长，数字随会话内容增加）上对比两种算法：

```
带 stream 的 assistant/message 总数: 413
轨迹面板算法（当前实现，裸 isTokenDelta）能算出首 token 的: 0
dsh-llm 算法（含压缩批展开）能算出的:              440
```

按修复算法计算出的实际数值（同一会话前 5 步）：

```
step (1, 1): 首 token 延迟 = 7391 ms  (轨迹面板当前显示: 不可用)
step (1, 2): 首 token 延迟 = 4050 ms  (轨迹面板当前显示: 不可用)
step (1, 3): 首 token 延迟 = 5516 ms  (轨迹面板当前显示: 不可用)
step (1, 4): 首 token 延迟 = 5219 ms  (轨迹面板当前显示: 不可用)
step (1, 5): 首 token 延迟 = 5409 ms  (轨迹面板当前显示: 不可用)
```

即：数据完好，仅未被解码。

## 建议修复

在 `dsh-client-ui-trajectory` 的 `settleMessage` 中，为 `firstTokenTime` 增加
"从 `event.data.stream` 回退解码"的路径，与 `dsh-session-stats` / `dsh-client-connection` 对齐：

```js
timing: {
    stepStartTime: state.started ? state.startTime : null,
    // 实时路径优先；历史回放时从持久化的压缩批回退解码
    firstTokenTime: state.firstTokenTime
        ?? assistantStreamFirstTokenTime(event.data.stream)
        ?? null,
    completedTime: event.time
}
```

实现要点：

1. **不要**直接 `import` `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm` —— 客户端 bundle 有跨插件值导入约束。
   按 `dsh-client-connection` 的做法在包内本地实现等价解码
   （压缩批 → 成员时间 = `time0` 逐项累加 `dt[i-1]`；首个非空 text/reasoning 成员，
   或带 `name` 的 tool-call 批的 `time0`）。
2. 保留 `state.firstTokenTime` 的优先级，使实时路径行为不变。
3. 建议同时覆盖 `assistant/attempt` 事件（同格式），以防重试步的 timing 缺失。

## 附：最小验证脚本

```bash
# 取任一会话日志，对比两种算法
zstd -dc ~/.dsh/sessions/<workspace>/<session-id>/session.v3.jsonl.zstd | python3 - <<'PY'
import sys, json

def is_token_delta(c):
    t = c.get("type")
    if t in ("text-delta", "reasoning-delta"): return c.get("text", "") != ""
    if t == "tool-call-delta": return c.get("argumentsDelta", "") != "" or c.get("name") is not None
    return False

def run_first_token_time(run):
    if run.get("type") == "tool-call-chunks" and run.get("name") is not None:
        return run.get("time0")
    members = run.get("texts") or run.get("args") or []
    if not members: return None
    dt, t = run.get("dt") or [], run.get("time0")
    for i, frag in enumerate(members):
        if i: t += dt[i - 1] if i - 1 < len(dt) else 0
        if frag != "": return t
    return None

def trajectory_algo(stream):          # 当前实现
    for r in stream:
        if r.get("type") == "chunk" and is_token_delta(r.get("chunk", {})):
            return r.get("time")
    return None

def correct_algo(stream):             # dsh-llm / client-connection 实现
    for r in stream:
        if r.get("type") == "chunk":
            if is_token_delta(r.get("chunk", {})): return r.get("time")
        else:
            t = run_first_token_time(r)
            if t is not None: return t
    return None

traj = correct = total = 0
for line in sys.stdin:
    try: o = json.loads(line)
    except Exception: continue
    if o.get("type") != "assistant/message": continue
    st = o.get("data", {}).get("stream")
    if not st: continue
    total += 1
    traj += trajectory_algo(st) is not None
    correct += correct_algo(st) is not None

print(f"total={total}  trajectory_algo_ok={traj}  correct_algo_ok={correct}")
# 预期输出：trajectory_algo_ok=0  correct_algo_ok=total（total 随会话内容增长）
PY
```

discussions.title: dsh-plugin-preset-default-guard：修掉「升级后无法新建对话」的静默失败
discussions.body:
## 它解决什么

升级 DeepSeek Harness 后点「新会话」没有任何反应——界面零反馈。

根因是 preset 的 id 改名了（`0.1.5-rc.1` 里 `code` 改成了 `ptc`），但你设置文件里还写着旧 id：

```yaml
agent-presets:
  default: code      # 已不存在
```

新建会话解析这个默认值时找不到，于是 `session.create` 失败；而这个失败被客户端折叠成一句 `console.warn`，所以界面上什么都看不到。**已有会话不受影响**——它们在创建时就把 preset 记进了自己的日志，只有新建会话才会重新解析设置。

## 它做什么

进程启动时，把解析出来的 `agent-presets.default` 和本部署实际提供的 preset 名单比对：

1. 正常 → 什么都不做
2. 失效 → 清掉，让部署自带的默认值重新生效
3. 仍无可用默认值 → 写入一个有效 id（配置的 `fallback` → `standard` → 名单第一个）

## 安装

```sh
cd ~/.dsh/profiles/web
npm install dsh-plugin-preset-default-guard
```

```yaml
# ~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml
- insert:
    - id: preset-default-guard
      name: 'dsh-plugin-preset-default-guard'
      config:
        fix: true
```

## 怎么确认它生效

写一个假 id 再重启，对比前后：

```yaml
# 重启前            # 重启后
agent-presets:      agent-presets: {}
  default: nope
```

## 边界

- 修的是**设置**，不是客户端：它消除了失败根因，但没有给「新会话」按钮补 UI 反馈
- 每个进程只在启动时跑一次——也就是升级引入的改名第一次暴露的时刻
- 只写 `agent-presets.default` 一个键，绝不碰会话日志

仓库：https://github.com/Robin1987China/dsh-plugin-preset-default-guard　|　上游问题记录：#6119

discussions.title: Desktop plugin manager: plugins.remove() always fails with "has no manifest" (staging project has no node_modules)
discussions.body:
## Summary

`plugins.remove()` in the desktop plugin manager always fails with
`desktop project: installed package "<name>" has no manifest`. A plugin installed through
**Application → Desktop Plugins…** (or `Ctrl+,`) can therefore never be removed again, and the
plugin manager window has no other way to undo an install.

## Reproduction

1. Open **Application → Desktop Plugins…** and install any plugin.
   Verified with `@liustack/modlens@3.26.1` (it declares `dsh.bundle.patch` and ships no
   lifecycle scripts, so it is a valid desktop plugin).
2. Remove that same plugin.

## Current behavior

The install succeeds; the removal fails immediately and the plugin stays installed:

```
Error invoking remote method 'dsh-desktop:plugins-remove':
Error: desktop project: installed package "@liustack/modlens" has no manifest
```

## Root cause

`DesktopProjectManager.mutate()` prepares its staging project with `copyMetadata()`, and
`DESKTOP_PROJECT_FILES` covers `package.json`, `pnpm-lock.yaml`, `pnpm-workspace.yaml`,
`desktop-release.json` plus the core package set — and `desktop-packages`, but **not**
`node_modules`.

The `plugin-remove` branch of `applyMutation()` then runs

```ts
const remaining = pluginRecords(projectDir).filter(plugin => plugin.name !== mutation.name)
```

against that staging project. `pluginRecords()` → `inspectPlugin()` requires
`node_modules/<name>/package.json`, which does not exist yet, so it throws before
`pnpm remove` is ever invoked.

`plugin-add` and `plugin-update` are unaffected because both run pnpm first, which materializes
`node_modules` before the inspection happens. That asymmetry is what makes removal the only
broken path.

## Expected behavior

Removal should succeed: it drops the package from `package.json` dependencies and from
`dsh.profile.bundles`, and removes it from `node_modules`.

## Suggested fix

`writeProfilePlugins()` only reads `plugin.name` — it just writes the `dsh.profile.bundles`
list — so the surviving set can be derived from the profile manifest rather than from
`node_modules`:

- relax `writeProfilePlugins()`'s parameter to `readonly { readonly name: string }[]`
- in the `plugin-remove` branch, take the installed names from `profilePluginNames()` and
  apply the existing "not installed" check against that list

Patch (fix + regression test) on a fork branch:
https://github.com/yf-yf630/deepseek-harness/tree/fix/desktop-plugin-remove-staging

I opened this as a Discussion rather than a pull request because `CONTRIBUTING.md` states
external pull requests are not accepted at the moment, and Issues are disabled on this
repository. Happy to move it anywhere more useful.

## Testing

`plugin-remove` currently has no test coverage: `apps/desktop/tests/project-manager.spec.ts`
never exercises a removal, which is how this reached a release. The branch above adds one that
drives a full `applyRelease → plugin-add → plugin-remove` cycle.

- `pnpm exec vitest run apps/desktop/tests/project-manager.spec.ts`
  - with the fix: `9 passed`
  - with the fix reverted: `1 failed` — `Error: desktop project: installed package "@scope/plugin" has no manifest`

- Integration run against the real bundled runtime (the node and pnpm shipped inside the
  packaged app, with the real release seed, on an isolated `DSH_HOME`):

  ```
  plugin-add        : OK in 23s -> [{"name":"@liustack/modlens","version":"3.26.1"}]
  plugin-remove     : OK in 10s -> []
  bundles after     : ["@deepseek-ai/dsh-base","@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app"]
  dependency gone   : true
  node_modules gone : true
  ```

## Environment

- DeepSeek Harness desktop `0.1.5-rc.1` (Electron 44.0.0), bundled Node.js 24.17.0 / pnpm 11.7.0
- Windows 10 (19045) x64
- Repository revision `aa8262ec091698bae9a6b04773a6b5b06ad4aef2`

discussions.title: [Bug] Locale `fr-be` (Belgian French) incorrectly served as Belarusian (`be`) UI
discussions.body: ## Description The DeepSeek web interface (chat.deepseek.com) is served in **Belarusian** to users whose browser sends `fr-be` (Belgian French) in the `Accept-Language` header, even when `fr` and `fr-fr` are also present and ranked higher. This appears to be a confusion between the **ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code** `BE` (Belgium) and the **ISO 639-1 language code** `be` (Belarusian). ## Steps to reproduce 1. Use Firefox (tested on version 155) with the following `Accept-Language` preference list for websites: - `fr-be` (Français Belgique) - `fr` (Français) - `fr-fr` (Français France) - `en-us` (English US) 2. Connect from a Belgian IP address (country: BE). 3. Navigate to `https://chat.deepseek.com`. ## Expected behavior The interface should be displayed in **French**, since `fr-be`, `fr`, and `fr-fr` are all present in `Accept-Language` and all resolve to the French language. ## Actual behavior The interface is displayed in **Belarusian**, despite no Belarusian locale being requested and despite the user being located in Belgium (a country where French, Dutch, and German are official languages — but not Belarusian). ## Workaround Removing `fr-be` from the preferred languages list in Firefox (keeping only `fr` and `fr-fr`) resolves the issue immediately. This strongly suggests the backend is matching on the substring `be` inside `fr-be` and treating it as the Belarusian language code. ## Impact - Affects all French-speaking Belgian users. - Cannot be resolved client-side without removing the legitimate `fr-be` locale, which impacts date/number formatting on other sites. - This is a standards-compliance issue: `Accept-Language` should be parsed per RFC 4647 / BCP 47, and regional subtags (`BE`) must not be confused with primary language subtags (`be`). ## Suggested fix Parse `Accept-Language` using a proper BCP 47 parser, and match on the **primary language subtag** (`fr` in `fr-be`) rather than performing substring matching on the full tag. Region subtags (`BE`, `FR`, `CA`, etc.) should never be interpreted as language codes. ## Environment - Browser: Firefox 155 - OS: (Linux Debian or Fedora) - IP geolocation: Belgium (BE) - Date: 2026-09-10 Thank you for looking into this.

discussions.title: Loader should tolerate plugin failures: skip the failing entry instead of failing the whole profile
discussions.body:
## Problem

When any loader entry fails to apply, `@deepseek-ai/cordis-plugin-loader` throws immediately and rolls back, so the **entire profile fails to boot** — core included, together with every healthy plugin.

Evidence (`cordis-plugin-loader/lib/index.js`):

```js
if (failures.length === 1) throw failures[0];
if (failures.length > 1) throw new AggregateError(failures, "loader entries failed to apply");
// ...followed by rollback of already-applied entries
```

## Why this hurts (real scenario)

A core upgrade takes down the whole harness as soon as **one** third-party plugin has not caught up.

Third-party plugins pin exact core version lines through `peerDependencies`, e.g.

```
@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent => 0.1.2-rc.1 || 0.1.2-alpha.5
```

Because of prerelease semver rules, `0.1.5-rc.1` does **not** satisfy `^0.1.2-rc.1`. So upgrading the core `0.1.2-rc.1 -> 0.1.5-rc.1` makes such plugins fail to load, and since the loader is fail-fast, **the server does not start at all** — not just the outdated plugin, everything is down.

The user is then forced to either stay on an old core (missing new models/features such as `deepseek-flash` / V4.1 Flash), or hand-disable every incompatible plugin before every upgrade.

## Proposed behavior

The core is the subject; a single plugin failure should not take down the harness. An opt-in tolerance mode would fix it, e.g.

```yaml
- id: loader
  config:
    tolerateEntryFailures: true      # or: onEntryFailure: "disable"
```

Behavior: an entry that throws is **disabled with a warning** (logged and surfaced in the plugin inventory / settings UI), the remaining entries apply normally, and the app boots. Strict fail-fast stays the default, so this is backward compatible.

There is precedent inside the repo: `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` already exposes `failOnStartupError` (default `false`) so an unreachable MCP server does not block activation.

## Additional value

- Enables **incremental core upgrades**: upgrade the core, keep healthy plugins working, and let outdated ones return automatically once they ship compatible versions.
- Lets the plugin inventory show "loaded / disabled (failed)" instead of an all-or-nothing boot.

discussions.title: @ahiosuz/dsh-workspace-tools — per-workspace default Agent & permission presets for new sessions
discussions.body:
# @ahiosuz/dsh-workspace-tools — per-workspace default Agent & permission presets

Hi! I built a plugin that adds **per-Workspace default Agent preset and permission preset** for new sessions: each Workspace row's "…" menu gets a *Workspace defaults…* action, a dialog with per-workspace values and live global-default inheritance hints, and a Full-Access selection requiring an explicit risk acknowledgement. Saved values apply only to **root sessions created later** in that Workspace — existing, forked, resumed, and subagent sessions stay unchanged.

- Plugin repo: https://github.com/AHIOSUZ/dsh-workspace-tools (v0.3.0, MIT, prebuilt, no lifecycle scripts)
- Works against DSH `0.1.5-rc.1`.

## One companion core patch

The official build does not yet expose the extension points this UI needs (a workspace row-action registry, an overlay slot for workspace dialogs, a `workspace.setSessionDefaults` Remote verb, and workspace-scoped create-time resolution). The plugin therefore ships with a small companion core patch — 2 commits on my fork, based on current master (`aa8262ec09`):

https://github.com/AHIOSUZ/deepseek-harness/tree/feat/workspace-session-defaults

It follows the existing architecture conventions:

- Workspace entity/registry: stored `defaultAgentPreset` / `defaultPermissionPreset` with atomic set/clear, plus a `registerSessionDefaults` resolver seam and `sessionDefaultsFor` read.
- New Remote verb `workspace.setSessionDefaults`: preset validation against the composed services, stable `workspace/defaults-rejected` failures, baseline/follow projections.
- `session.create` resolution order: request fields → registered resolver contributions → Workspace stored fields; the effective permission preset is pinned during Agent composition, before session publication.
- Client: `workspaceActions` row-action registry, the `sidebar.workspaces.overlay` slot, and the defaults dialog with risk confirmation.

Validation: `npm run typecheck` clean, oxlint clean, 1184 tests passing across the six touched packages (3 failures are pre-existing Windows symlink-EPERM issues that also fail on clean master).

On the official build the plugin alone degrades silently (a logged notice, no menu entry), so it is not usable end-to-end without the core side. I would love to hear whether the team would consider adopting the workspace-defaults capability (or a variant of it) upstream — happy to rework the patch to match your direction. Meanwhile the plugin itself is published for anyone running a build that carries the extension points.

Thanks for a great harness!

discussions.title: 切换v4.1后大模型返回结构报错
分享一个 dsh 升级流程技能：升级前评估 → 审核放行 → 升级 → 验证（附 7 个实测坑）
discussions.body:
升级 dsh 时踩了几个坑，整理成了一个升级流程技能，分享给同样要升级的人。 ### 这个技能做什么 把「升级 dsh」变成一个**可审核、可回滚、有证据**的流程，而不是一次靠运气的操作： ``` 升级前评估 → ★用户审核放行★ → 升级 → 升级后验证 ``` - **审核门**：先只读评估，产出《升级影响评估报告》交你审核；**你没放行，agent 不会动手** - **无条件备份 + 回滚手册**：备份会话数据并校验数目一致，回滚手册作为报告附件交付 - **第三方插件 与 第三方技能 分别评估**：两者来源不同、互不覆盖 - **官方项仅做知情披露**，不逐个排查 - **证据驱动验证**：PID 变化 + 启动时间 + `lsof` 实际加载的原生模块路径，三判据证明新进程真的在跑新代码 ### 7 个实测坑 基于 `0.1.2-rc.1` → `0.1.5-rc.1` 的一次真实升级，按踩到的顺序： 1. **dsh 不强制校验 peer 依赖** —— 插件 peer 不满足时升级过程毫无报错，**运行时才崩**。 2. **只查插件会漏掉全部第三方技能** —— 实测 4 个第三方插件携带 **0 个**技能，而用户本地有 5 个技能，两者是完全独立的两批东西。顺带一提，本技能的前一版自己就因版本升级而失效（写死了 401 期望、漏了 `--no-open`、依赖数量写死）。 3. **npm 11+ 会静默跳过原生模块的 `install`/`postinstall` 脚本** —— 只打印一条 warning。`node-pty` 这类包会缺编译产物。本次实测靠加载器回退到 `prebuilds/darwin-arm64/pty.node` 才没出事，并用 `pty.spawn` 实测确认；`koffi` 则是自带平台包二进制。 4. **`dsh web` 必然要求 token** —— 无 token 请求返回 **401 而不是 200**，token 是内存态（`launchToken`，`randomBytes` 生成、进程内 Map 缓存、**从不落盘**），只在启动时随 URL 打印一次。按旧写法用 `curl` 判断 200 会把成功判成失败。 5. **`dsh --profile web --dump-config` 不是只读命令** —— 它要写 `~/.dsh/profiles/

/cordis.yml`（`prepareProfile` 里的 `writeFileSync`），在受限沙箱下直接 EPERM 崩掉。而且这个 EPERM 长得很像文件属主问题，实际是沙箱拒绝。 6. **会话格式 V2→V3 不可降级读取** —— 迁移会生成新文件并保留原文件，且是**懒加载**（只迁移被打开的会话）。没有备份就无法回滚。 7. **预发布版本的 semver 陷阱** —— `^0.1.2-rc.1` 在数学上**不匹配** `0.1.5-rc.1`：只有当范围里存在与目标版本**同一 `[major,minor,patch]` 元组**的预发布比较器时才可能满足。所以几乎所有把 `@deepseek-ai/*` 钉在 `^0.1.x-rc.y` 的第三方插件都会报 peer 不满足 —— 这是**常态而非例外**。反过来说，**peer 不满足 ≠ 不可用**（dsh 不强制校验，`dump-config` 依然通过）。 ### 仓库 https://github.com/ybl2020/dsh-upgrade （MIT） `SKILL.md` 保持精简（流程骨架 + 审核门 + 两份交付物模板），深度细节放在 `references/` 按需加载：版本对比 / 第三方插件与技能排查 / 原生模块 allow-scripts / 升级后验证。 ### 说明 - 技能面向 **agent 执行**，里面的命令是给 agent 跑的 - 按 macOS + `npm install -g` 安装的 dsh 编写，部分步骤需要工作区外的文件写权限 - 文中的版本号与依赖数量都是**本机实测值**，会随版本变化，技能正文里也反复强调「不要写死数量」 欢迎指出与 DSH 实际行为不符的地方，我按实测更新。

discussions.title: [Bug] 输入法拼音未上屏时，输入框自动填充乱码汉字
discussions.body: 在输入框使用中文输入法打字时，拼音还未选字上屏，输入框就会自动填充该拼音对应的错误音译汉字（例如输入拼音 wo xian zi...，输入框直接显示“沃仙兹沃克沃克斯沃”），随后选字会将正确词汇追加到前方。

discussions.title: 联网搜索工具【web_search】在没有配置DSkey时无法工作！
discussions.body: 在一次与其他提供商模型对话时，DSkey后台显示了一次模型使用，但我没有在会话的任何地方发现调用提示。起初我以为是key被盗取了，后来我新建了一个会话把整个会话记录让模型帮我查，才发现原来web_search工具默认使用flash模型，且在没有配置DSkey时直接不运行，我认为这是不对的，应该设置成默认由会话所选的模型来负责，包括其他可能有类似问题的工具。

discussions.title: [Bug] Web UI 长任务运行几十分钟后停止更新，重启后显示已完成（0.1.2-rc.1，附持久化日志时间线）
discussions.body:
## Summary

**长任务运行几十分钟后，Web 页面停止更新；重启后才发现任务已完成。**

在 `dsh web` 中执行较长任务，使用过程中页面看起来卡住，无法看到后续进展。重启后重新查看，发现任务已经完成。用户需要靠重启确认任务结果，容易将页面状态停滞误判为 Agent 执行卡死。

以下区分用户观察、本地持久化日志证据和待验证的原因。

## Reproduction

根据实际使用过程描述，尚未得到稳定的最小复现：

1. 通过 `dsh web` 打开 Web UI，启动运行数十分钟、包含较多工具调用的任务。
2. 保持会话运行。使用中观察到页面停止更新，任务状态/输出停留在先前位置。
3. 重启后重新查看会话，发现任务已完成，后续结果已存在。

用户已进一步确认：本次报告指的是最近一次重启前最后并行运行的三个会话。下文按 A/B/C 对照这三个会话；尚未记录冻结开始的准确时间、当时前台选中的会话、浏览器是否处于后台，以及仅刷新页面是否足以恢复。

## Current behavior and log evidence

对报告时间附近的本地 `session.jsonl.zstd` 做了只读检查。以下时间均为 **2026-09-10，UTC+8**。会话以 A/B 匿名代称；仅提供事件元数据，省略提示词、工具参数、工具输出和工作区信息。

| 证据 | 会话 A | 会话 B |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 所检查轮次开始 | 15:37:10，turn 1，seq 4 | 15:46:55，turn 2，seq 17308 |
| 最后一条 assistant/message | 16:10:08，seq 82627 | 16:01:46，seq 56086 |
| turn/end | 16:10:08，seq 82629 | 16:01:46，seq 56088 |
| turn/end reason.kind | completed | completed |
| 重启前会话累计 tool/call / tool/result | 85 / 85 | 139 / 139 |
| 重启前 JSONL 物理记录数 | 3,143 | 3,113 |
| 重启前 JSONL 解压大小 | 2,150,884 bytes | 2,506,908 bytes |

注：B 的累计数包含重启前两个已完成轮次。物理记录数与 seq 数量不同，因为日志中包含打包的 chunk 记录。

检查时当前 `dsh web` 进程的启动时间是 **16:36:51**。因此，上述两个轮次的最终消息和 `completed` 事件都已在这次启动之前落盘。它们不是启动之后才执行完成的任务。

脱敏后的结束事件（`time` 展开为可读本地时间）：

```text
A  16:10:08  seq=82627  assistant/message  turn=1  step=59
A  16:10:08  seq=82628  step/end
A  16:10:08  seq=82629  turn/end  {"turn":1,"reason":{"kind":"completed"}}

B  16:01:46  seq=56086  assistant/message  turn=2  step=56
B  16:01:46  seq=56087  step/end
B  16:01:46  seq=56088  turn/end  {"turn":2,"reason":{"kind":"completed"}}
```

- 所扫描的当天 23 份会话文件可正常解压和解析，未发现 zstd/JSON 解析错误。重点检查的 A/B 会话 seq 单调递增，无重复 tool call ID。
- A/B 重启前分别有 5 次 / 2 次 `llm/retry`，failure code 为 `TRANSPORT`，错误为 `DeepSeek API request to https://api.deepseek.com failed`；后续仍有工具执行、最终消息和正常 `completed`，不能把这些已恢复的模型请求错误直接认定为页面冻结原因。
- 第三个会话 C 从 **15:31:36** 开始运行，**16:35:17** 的 `turn/end`（seq 90760）原因为 `interrupted`，没有把它当成“正常完成”的证据。它到 **16:35:16** 仍有新的 `bash` 调用和返回，随后在 **16:35:17** 出现 `job_output` 的调用/返回以及中断结束事件。因此，重启前的三个会话实际状态是“两项已完成，一项持续推进后被中断”，不是三个后台任务一起停止执行。
- C 的部分工具调用确有数分钟等待，例如 16:27:39 → 16:32:10、16:32:12 → 16:35:13；这些等待都有后续返回，不能据此认定整个 dsh 后端卡死。日志中的 `interrupted` 本身不说明是谁或什么触发了中断。
- 用户确认了这三个会话就是本次排查范围；仍缺少冻结当时的浏览器侧记录，无法判定具体视图停在了哪个 seq。

## Investigation / remaining uncertainty

目前更应检查 **Web UI 的流式事件消费、会话状态同步与 conversation 投影/渲染**。尚未确认具体根因，也没有冻结现场的浏览器 Console、WebSocket 帧或性能记录。

对本机安装的 `0.1.2-rc.1` 做了有限代码核对：

- `dsh-api-gateway` 服务端已有 WebSocket ping/pong 心跳及漏心跳终止逻辑，因此不将旧版“完全没有心跳”作为本报告的结论。
- `dsh-client-ui-conversation` 的 `BoundConversation.flush()` / `ConversationNodeAssembler.flush()` 路径中，投影异常可能中断后续发布；这是值得检查的失败路径，但本次没有浏览器异常堆栈，不能确认它实际发生。
- 所检查的 `dsh-client-ui-conversation`、`dsh-client-ui-chat`、`dsh-api-gateway` 和 `dsh-client-connection` 的 `lib/client.js` / `lib/index.js` 均与对应版本发布包字节一致。

相近报告：[#4830](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/4830)（长会话渲染停滞）、[#5907](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/5907)（加载更早历史后的投影异常）。本次未确认相同触发条件或根因。

建议排查时对照后端最新 seq、客户端已接收 seq、投影已发布 seq 和完成状态，区分事件未送达与事件已到达但视图未更新。

## Expected behavior

长任务运行期间持续更新进度，任务结束后及时显示完成状态和最终结果。连接或页面投影出错时应显示可诊断的错误/恢复状态，并能重新同步会话，避免页面静默停留在旧状态。

## Environment

- OS: Fedora Linux 44 (Workstation Edition), Linux x86_64
- Node.js: v22.23.1；运行中的 dsh 使用系统 Node 22
- CLI: `@deepseek-ai/dsh` **0.1.2-rc.1**，npm 全局安装
- 启动方式：`dsh web`
- 所检查的 Web/connection/conversation/session 相关包：0.1.2-rc.1
- 会话记录中的 provider/model：`deepseek-official` / `deepseek-flash`
- 浏览器型号与版本：未记录
- 本报告针对上述已安装版本；未在当前最新版本复现

discussions.title: [Bug]分叉正在运行的或者发送消息但是终止运行的会话的行为和以前不一致了
discussions.body:
* 背景: 在当前会话中, 用户已经输入过消息, 并且dsh已经给出了最终回复.
* 场景1: 我输入一条消息, 但是发现有错误, 选择直接终止对话, 点击最后一条助手消息下面的分叉按钮, 分叉出一个新的会话. 在新的会话中输入消息, 点击发送, 实际发送的消息是分叉之前错误的并且被终止的消息. 我输入的新的消息在排队队列中.
* 场景2: 我输入一条消息, dsh开始工作. 我想在同样的上下文下进行其他的分析任务. 点击最后一条助手消息下面的分叉按钮, 分叉出一个新的会话. 在新的会话中输入消息, 点击发送, 实际发送的消息是分叉之前发送的消息. 我输入的新的消息在排队队列中.
* 当前版本是0.1.5-rc.1, 在之前的版本中, 点击最后一条助手消息下面的分叉按钮, 分叉出一个新的会话, 在新的会话中输出消息, 然后发送. 发送的消息直接是第一条消息, 不会出现分叉之前的被终止的或者正在被处理的消息.

* 由于dsh没有提供删除消息或者修改消息的功能, 如果消息发错了, 为了不污染上下文, 我一般选择分叉会话, 重新发送消息. 在0.1.5-rc.1中, 由于以上我提到的两个场景和以前的行为不一样了, 我现在消息发错了, 分叉会话, 继续发送消息, 依然把之前错误的消息发送出去了, 真正想发的消息在排队队列中.

* 我想知道这是预期行为, 还是一个bug. 如果是预期的行为, 我觉得这样很奇怪.我还是觉得以前的行为好一些, 就是点击最后一条助手消息下面的分叉按钮, 分叉出一个新的会话, 在新的会话中输出消息, 然后发送. 发送的消息直接是第一条消息, 不会出现分叉之前的被终止的或者正在被处理的消息.

discussions.title: [Bug] v0→v1 迁移对单条不合规历史记录整体拒载，导致旧会话永久打不开 / Whole-log refusal on one non-conforming legacy record
discussions.body:
### 摘要 / Summary

dsh 0.1.5-rc.1 读取旧 v0 会话日志时，只要**一条**历史记录违反 released v0 schema，就会拒绝**整份**日志（`source v0 artifact remains unchanged`），用户的感受是"所有历史会话都打不开"。触发字段往往只是第三方插件当年写入的一个无实际用途的可选字段。

When dsh 0.1.5-rc.1 migrates a legacy v0 session log, a single historical record that violates the released v0 schema makes the whole log unloadable. In practice the offending field can be a purely cosmetic optional field written by a third-party plugin years ago.

### 实例 / Real case

- 触发者：第三方记忆插件在 `form: "instructions"` / `"recall"` 的 plugin source 上带了 `summary`（released v0 schema 只允许 `form: "notice"` 配 `summary`）。
- 规则：`@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-format-v0-to-v1/lib/index.js:948-949`
- 报错：

```
@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-format-v0-to-v1 refuses this format v0 Session:
user/message 13 source summary requires notice form
```

- 本机统计：82 个 v0 会话中 60 个因此拒载（全部含该插件的注入），另外 22 个正常。该字段在 v1+ 格式里不参与任何逻辑。

### 诉求 / Request

1. **降级而不是整体拒载**：对历史日志中"未被 released schema 允许、且不影响语义"的可选字段，迁移时丢弃并告警（例如在会话里插入一条 `session/migration-warning` 或仅打印日志），而不是让整个会话永久打不开。至少要提供官方的"忽略该字段并继续"开关。
2. **错误信息可操作**：现在的信息缺少字段来源与修复建议。若能指出"该字段来自 plugin X，可用 <命令/工具> 丢弃并继续加载"，用户就不必自己解压 zstd 改 JSON。
3. （可选）**迁移前的只读体检**：像 `dsh sessions doctor` 之类，先报告"哪些会话会被拒载、因为哪条记录哪个字段"，再决定是否迁移。

### 为什么值得 / Why it matters

- v0 时代的插件写入不受今天 schema 约束，历史日志里这类"不合规但无害"的字段几乎必然存在；一条记录代价 = 一个会话永久不可用。
- 社区已经有专门的会话修复插件（dsh-session-surgeon）来救这类"打不开"，说明代价很高（要手工解压/改 zstd/备份）。
- 目前的应对只能在日志层面删字段：本机用"保持 zstd 帧结构 + 写 .bak"的方式修完全部 60 个会话，并逐一用 `sessionFormatCatalog.createRestore(header, { recovery: "strict", validation: "transformed" })` 复验通过——但这不该是用户承担的工作量。

### 环境 / Environment

- dsh 0.1.5-rc.1 (npm `@next`)，`@deepseek-ai/cordis` 4.0.2，Windows 11
- 受影响会话：format v0 的 `session.jsonl.zstd`（0.1.5-rc.1 起新会话写 v3，不受影响）

### 备注 / Notes

- 这与 Discussion #5926（第三方插件注册 RPC 通道时 `cannot get property "webServer" without inject`）是两件事，本文只谈迁移健壮性。
- 如果官方认为"严格拒载"是有意设计，希望能给出官方的绕过/修复路径（例如把"丢弃该字段"做成受支持的操作）。

discussions.title: [Bug] settings overlay / omitted inputModalities marks vision models as text-only (UI: 当前模型不支持图片)
discussions.body:
## Summary

DSH UI shows **����ǰģ�Ͳ�֧��ͼƬ�����л�֧��ͼƬ��ģ�͡�** (`MODEL_DOES_NOT_SUPPORT_IMAGES`) even when the **actual model is vision-capable**. The toast is decided from the **local catalog's `inputModalities` / `input`**, not from the provider.

Official `deepseek-flash` (V4.1 Flash) already advertises `['text', 'image']` in `DEFAULT_MODELS`. Two config paths still mark it (and other vision models) as text-only.

## Repro 1 �� `llm-deepseek` settings overlay strips vision

1. Official default (no `models:` in settings): `deepseek-flash` has `inputModalities: ['text', 'image']`. Images work.
2. Add a settings overlay that **re-lists** the same id, which is common when pinning `contextWindow` / `description`:

```yaml
llm-deepseek:
  models:
    - id: deepseek-flash
      name: deepseek-flash
      contextWindow: 1000000
      inputModalities:
        - text
```

or even omit `inputModalities` entirely. `catalogModel` schema defaults the field to `['text']` (`packages/llm/llm-deepseek/src/index.ts`).

3. Attach an image with `deepseek-flash` selected �� UI rejects **before** any API call.

README already says an explicit `models` list **replaces** the default catalog. Combined with `.default(['text'])`, a partial overlay of `deepseek-flash` silently disables vision that the built-in catalog just granted for V4.1 Flash.

## Repro 2 �� hand-declared `llm-pi-ai` gateway models

A custom OpenAI-Responses / Anthropic gateway route with only `id` + `name`:

```yaml
llm-pi-ai:
  providers:
    my-gateway:
      api: openai-responses
      baseURL: https://example.com/v1
      models:
        - id: claude-opus-5
          name: claude-opus-5
```

`DEFAULT_INPUT` is `['text']` (`packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/src/config.ts`). Claude / GPT-5.x / GLM-V all look **text-only** in the picker. Same toast. The model on the wire can take images; DSH never sends them.

## Expected

- Re-listing a **built-in** catalog id without an explicit `inputModalities` should **inherit** the shipped modalities (Flash vision stays on).
- Omitting `input` on a hand-declared model should not be worded as ��the model does not support images�� if that is only a missing catalog declaration.
- Ideally: inherit catalog `input` when the model id matches an installed pi-ai catalog entry (e.g. OpenAI GPT vision models).

## Suggested code change (cannot send a PR; see CONTRIBUTING)

1. `resolveModels` / schema: if `inputModalities` is omitted and `model.id` exists in `DEFAULT_MODELS`, copy that entry��s modalities (and image pixel/byte defaults) instead of `['text']`.
2. Keep explicit `inputModalities: [text]` as an opt-out for deployments that truly want text-only.
3. UI copy: distinguish `CATALOG_DID_NOT_DECLARE_IMAGES` vs a hard model capability miss.
4. `llm-pi-ai`: same inherit-from-catalog when `id` matches an installed catalog model; document `input: [text, image]` next to the toast.

## Environment

- DSH `0.1.5-rc.1` (source, `aa8262e`)
- Web UI, attach image in composer
- `deepseek-official` / `deepseek-flash` with a settings `models:` overlay
- Also reproduced on a hand-declared gateway listing `claude-opus-5` without `input`

Official CONTRIBUTING says external PRs are not accepted, so this is a Discussion report only.

discussions.title: [Bug] Forked session inherits the parent's queued next message and runs it as a phantom turn
discussions.body:
### Summary

Forking a session from an earlier turn silently copies the parent's **pending next-turn inbox item** into the child. The child is born holding a queued user message it never received. It stays invisible while the child is idle, then runs as an extra turn the moment the user sends their first real message — which is queued behind it. From the UI it looks like the app hallucinated a message out of thin air.

### Environment

- `@deepseek-ai/dsh` **0.1.5-rc.1** (npm dist-tags `latest` and `next` both resolve to this version)
- Windows 11, `dsh web`, session format v3
- Logic still present on `master` today:
  - `packages/api/session-controller/src/commands.ts` — `SessionCommandController.fork()`
  - `packages/core/agent-loop/src/inbox.ts` — `inboxProjectionDefinition`

### Steps to reproduce

1. In one session, send two messages back to back: `testing:1`, then `testing:2` (either while the first answer is still streaming, or after it finished — both turns complete).
2. Fork the conversation from the answer to **`testing:1`** (an older answer, not the newest one). The child transcript is correct: history up to turn 1 only, and `testing:2` is not shown.
3. In the child, send `testing:3`.
4. Observed: a `testing:2` user message appears in the child out of nowhere and runs as the child's first new turn; `testing:3` is queued behind it and only runs afterwards.

Expected: the child's first new turn is `testing:3`, and `testing:2` never appears in the child.

### Root cause

`fork()` picks the seed cut by walking **forward** from the boundary `turn/end` to the *next* `turn/start`:

```ts
// packages/api/session-controller/src/commands.ts — SessionCommandController.fork()
let cut = SessionLogOffset(boundary.seq + 1)
while (cut < source.events.length && source.events[cut]?.type !== 'turn/start') {
  cut = SessionLogOffset(cut + 1)
}
// ...
seed: source.events.slice(0, cut),
```

`slice(0, cut)` therefore also carries every event between the boundary and the next `turn/start`. Every user prompt is preceded by an `agent/inbox/spliced` insert placed immediately before its `turn/start`:

```
 17  turn/end             turn 1 completed      <- fork anchor resolves here
 18  agent/inbox/spliced  insert "testing:2"    <- swept into the seed
 19  turn/start           turn 2
 20  agent/inbox/spliced  remove 1              <- NOT swept (lands after turn/start)
```

The insert is kept while the paired removal is dropped, so the seed describes a message that is still pending.

On the child side, `inboxProjectionDefinition` (`packages/core/agent-loop/src/inbox.ts`) folds **every** `agent/inbox/spliced` event in the session log — inherited seed events included — into the child's live pending input. The child therefore boots with one phantom queued message. Nothing drains it while idle; when the user prompts, `followup()` → `send()` appends the real message (`inbox.splice('next-turn', Infinity, 0, [message])`) and wakes the driver, which claims FIFO — phantom first.

### Evidence (real session log, format v3)

Source session `session-2c860bfb…` (`isSeeded:false`) — events 17/18/19 as shown above.

Child session `session-9b6ab230…` (`isSeeded:true`, `parentSession: session-2c860bfb…`):

```
  0..18  inherited seed (= source events 0..18, INCLUDING seq 18's insert of "testing:2")
 19  session/end-seed     {inherited:true}
 21  agent/inbox/spliced  insert "testing:3"   start=1   <- non-zero start: one item already queued
 22  turn/start           turn 2 -> consumes the inherited "testing:2"
 25  user/message         "testing:2"  (source.rpcId is still the parent's 399ad8ad-…)
 30  turn/start           turn 3 -> consumes "testing:3"
```

The `start=1` on the user's own prompt is decisive: the agent admitted the new message *behind* an already-pending item, and the inherited message's `rpcId` is still the parent's original one — no client ever sent it into this session.

### Scope

Forking at any turn that is not the newest completed turn hits this, because every user message adds an `inbox/spliced` insert between its predecessor's `turn/end` and its own `turn/start`. Forking from the newest answer while the session is idle is the only clean case.

Across 42 local sessions (30 of them forked), **23 forked sessions were born with inherited pending input**; the worst had 9 items queued.

### Impact

- The child silently runs a turn nobody sent: an extra LLM call, extra tokens, transcript pollution, and the parent's message duplicated into the wrong branch.
- It is durable: the phantom lives in the child's own log, so it returns after every reopen/restart.
- It is invisible until the user sends something, which makes it read as a UI hallucination rather than a state bug.

### Suggested fix

Never let the seed carry pending input:

```ts
let cut = SessionLogOffset(boundary.seq + 1)
while (cut < source.events.length
  && source.events[cut]?.type !== 'turn/start'
  && source.events[cut]?.type !== 'agent/inbox/spliced') {
  cut = SessionLogOffset(cut + 1)
}
```

Or simply stop at `boundary.seq + 1`: the sweep only exists to carry non-turn metadata (e.g. a trailing `session/title`), which is not worth importing pending prompts for.

Why not fix it in the inbox projection instead: treating `session/end-seed` as an inbox barrier sounds cleaner, but child logs already produced by this bug contain splices whose `start` indices were computed against the polluted length (the `start=1` above). Clearing the projection at the seed boundary makes those replays fail validation (`start > inbox.length` → `invalid persisted inbox splice at session seq N`), breaking every session this bug has already created. The fix belongs on the seed side.

Note: sessions already forked under this bug keep their phantom (it is in their own log); the seed-side fix stops new ones from being created.

---

## 中文摘要

从较早的一次回答处 fork 会话时，父会话**排在队列里的下一条用户消息**会被一并复制进子会话的 inbox。子会话一出生就带着一条自己没收到过的待处理消息：空闲时不显示，用户发出第一条消息的瞬间它就作为额外的一轮先跑，用户的消息被排到它后面——看起来像是界面凭空冒出一条消息。

原因在 `fork()` 的种子截断：`cut` 从 `turn/end` 之后**向后**扫到下一个 `turn/start`，于是把区间内的 `agent/inbox/spliced` 插入事件也复制进了种子，而与之配对的移除事件在 `turn/start` 之后未被复制。子会话的 inbox 投影会把日志里所有 spliced 事件（含继承来的）折叠成待处理输入，因此幽灵消息成了真实的队列项。

只要 fork 锚点不是"最后一个已完成回合"就必然触发。本机 42 个会话中 30 个是 fork 出来的，其中 23 个出生时即带有继承的待处理输入，最多的一个继承了 9 条。影响不只是显示：子会话会真的多跑一轮 LLM、消耗 token、写进自己的转写，且因为落在自己的日志里而持久存在，重开仍在。

建议修法：种子绝不越过 `agent/inbox/spliced`（或在 `boundary.seq + 1` 直接停止）。不建议改在 inbox 投影侧加屏障——已产生的会话日志里 spliced 的 `start` 索引是按被污染的长度算的，屏障会让这些日志在重放时报 `invalid persisted inbox splice`。

discussions.title: [Android/Termux] DSH 0.1.5-rc.1 无法运行：flock is not supported on android-arm64（附 sharp 问题与临时修复）
discussions.body:
---

## 中文摘要

DSH **0.1.5-rc.1** 在 Android/Termux（aarch64）上**每一轮 agent 运行都会失败**，界面报：

```
本轮运行失败  flock is not supported on android-arm64  UNKNOWN
```

原因：`@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-persistence-jsonl` 从 0.1.5 起在每个会话写入前要对 `session.lock` 取 POSIX `flock`，而 `@deepseek-ai/node-addon-system/lib/flock.js` 只支持 `linux`/`darwin`，其它平台直接抛 `ERR_FLOCK_UNSUPPORTED_PLATFORM`；**没有 android-arm64 的原生绑定包**。0.1.2 不使用 flock，因此这是 0.1.5 引入的回归。

同一升级还暴露第二个 Android 兼容问题：`sharp` 没有 android-arm64 预编译（需回退到 `@img/sharp-wasm32`）。

---

## English report

### Environment

- Device: Samsung SM-N986U (Galaxy Note 20 Ultra), Android 13
- Runtime: Termux 0.119.0-beta.3, **Node.js v24.18.0**（`process.platform === 'android'`, `process.arch === 'arm64'`）
- DSH: **0.1.5-rc.1**, installed globally via `npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh`
- Install path: `$PREFIX/lib/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh`

### Summary

Every agent turn fails on Android/Termux:

```
本轮运行失败 flock is not supported on android-arm64 UNKNOWN
```

The session JSONL is never materialized, so no session can run.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Android (aarch64) + Termux, Node 24.
2. `npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.5-rc.1`
3. `dsh web --no-open`, open the printed token URL, send any message.
4. The turn fails immediately with the error above.

### Root cause

- `@deepseek-ai/node-addon-system/lib/flock.js` → `loadBinding()`:

  ```js
  const { platform, arch } = process;
  if (platform !== 'linux' && platform !== 'darwin') {
      throw Object.assign(new Error(`flock is not supported on ${platform}-${arch}`), {
          code: 'ERR_FLOCK_UNSUPPORTED_PLATFORM',
          syscall: 'flock',
      });
  }
  ```

  Android reports `platform === 'android'`, so it always throws.

- There is **no `@deepseek-ai/node-addon-system-android-arm64`** package; only `node-addon-system-darwin-arm64` (and the linux variants) ship prebuilds.

- Consumer: `@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-persistence-jsonl` → `SessionWriteLease.acquire()` calls `tryLockExclusive(handle.fd)` on `session.lock` for every write-open. It maps `EAGAIN` to `SessionAlreadyOwnedError` and **rethrows everything else** — so `ERR_FLOCK_UNSUPPORTED_PLATFORM` becomes a fatal turn error.

- Regression: 0.1.2's `dsh-session-persistence-jsonl` does **not** import flock at all, so Android worked before this upgrade.

### Suggested fix (upstream)

Any of these is fine; the lock exists to serialize cross-process writers, and on a single-process harness an in-process claim already excludes all writers (the module's own docs note the browser worker stubs flock to immediate success for exactly this reason):

1. Degrade gracefully: on an unsupported platform, treat the lease as acquired (optionally warn once), instead of throwing.
2. Ship/allow an android-arm64 binding (Termux can build `src/flock.c` with node-gyp), and gate the platform check on actual binding availability rather than a hard platform allow-list.
3. Make `SessionWriteLease` capability-based (e.g. skip the kernel lock when no binding is available).

### Workaround (what we applied locally)

Patch the platform branch in `.../@deepseek-ai/node-addon-system/lib/flock.js`:

```js
if (platform !== 'linux' && platform !== 'darwin') {
    binding = { tryLock: (_fd, cb) => cb(0) };   // single-process harness: emulate acquired lock
    return binding;
}
```

Verified: `tryLockExclusive(0)` resolves, and sessions run again.

### Second Android issue on the same upgrade: `sharp`

`sharp` has no android-arm64 prebuilt, so image/attachment handling needs the WASM fallback. Workaround used: copy `@img/sharp-wasm32@0.35.4` (+ `@emnapi/runtime`, `tslib`) into `sharp/node_modules`, then `sharp` reports `versions.sharp 0.35.4 / vips 8.18.6`.

### Minor

Starting a second `dsh web` while one is already listening produces `EADDRINUSE 127.0.0.1:3080` and a full stack trace. A clearer message ("already running on port 3080") would help.

### Note

Both workarounds are **wiped by `npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh`** (they live inside `node_modules`) and must be re-applied after every upgrade. If DSH can carry these Android accommodations itself, Termux users would stop hitting a hard failure on upgrade.

discussions.title: DSH | dsh-fork-relink | fork 后子 agent 记录自动跟随新会话
discussions.body:
> _ 非官方项目,由社区成员独立开发和维护(与 AI 结对开发)。
>
> _ Unofficial project, independently developed and maintained by community members (co-developed with AI).

**项目地址 / Project URL:**
https://github.com/Enosensu/dsh-fork-relink

**项目介绍 / Introduction:**

官方 fork(会话列表的分支按钮)用新会话 id 承接被继承的历史,而子 agent 会话按头部的 `parentSession` 挂在父会话下——fork 之后子 agent 记录留在旧会话上,新对话的子 agent 面板为空。

本插件监听官方 `session/created` 事件,自动把旧会话的直接子 agent(`origin === 'subagent'` 的冷会话)的头帧 `parentSession` 重链到 fork 子会话:整棵子 agent 树统一跟随(含子 agent 的子 agent),并按 fork 子会话 seed 的引用过滤(被裁掉尾部的子 agent 不跟随)。只重写头帧,其余帧字节原样;每次重链前备份到 $DSH_HOME/trash。

**与 DSH 的集成方式 / How it integrates with DSH:**

- 纯官方扩展点:cordis `ctx.on('session/created')` 事件监听,零 UI、零路由、零依赖;
- 按 DSH 会话日志格式(zstd 拼接帧,头帧独立)只重写子 agent 头帧;
- 遵循官方 trash 备份惯例;`dsh plugin add` 即装,官方原生实现 children relink 后可直接卸载、无残留。

**截图 / Screenshots:**

本插件为纯后台伴随进程,无任何界面;以下为 fork 发生时的运行日志(dsh-fork-relink.log),替代截图展示实际工作:

```json
{"t":"(首次 fork 后这里会出现 relink 记录)"}
```

**收录状态:** awesome-dsh-plugin 收录 PR 见 [#4789](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin/pull/4789);fork 子 agent 跟随的官方原生实现提案见 [Discussions #6149](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/6149)。

discussions.title: 升级到 0.1.5 后，以前的一些老会话打不开了
discussions.body:
一直在用dsh，很喜欢。遇到一个问题想反馈一下。

## 问题

从 0.1.1 升级到 0.1.5 之后，一些以前的会话打不开了。网页上提示 `failed to observe session ... refuses this format v0 Session`，意思是不认这个旧格式。我这边 35 个会话里有 15 个打不开。

## 原因

看起来是新版把老会话升级成新格式的时候检查得太严了——只要是老版本当时写进去、现在不再用的字段，整份会话就直接不给加载。

而且它一次只报一个错，改掉一个又冒出下一个，我一共碰上四种：

1. 老版本的权限设置里多了个 `origin` 字段，新版不认，报错。（新版其实已经不用这个字段了，直接忽略掉就行）
2. 子代理的记录是老格式 `version: 2`，新版只认 3，报错。（这两种格式的字段其实是一样的，当成 3 应该就行）
3. 插件自己加的消息来源类型（比如 `instruction-hint`、`at-file-mention`），新版不认，报错。
4. 以前用 dsh-chat-import 导入的会话，开头有个 `session/imported` 标记，新版不认。

## 建议

老版本自己写进去的数据，希望新版能兼容一下：能忽略的就忽略，能直接升级的就升级，不要因为一个字段就让整个会话打不开。

或者至少给个修复的命令，不然这些老会话就永远看不了了。

**环境**：dsh 0.1.5-rc.1，Windows 11，Node v24.4.1。

再次感谢！

discussions.title: Empty tool calls (name/callId empty) are persisted without validation, then fail the whole session load as corrupt
discussions.body:
## Summary

`@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.2-rc.1` accepts a **degenerate tool call** (empty `name`/`id`/`arguments`) from a model response and persists the result chain as-is. On the next load, the strict message-shape validation (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-session`, same version) rejects the stored `tool/result` and **marks the entire session corrupt** — the conversation history cannot be opened and the provider can no longer observe/resume the session. There is no recovery path short of manually editing the zstd frame container.

This happened on multiple sessions across two machines (Windows + Linux), with 15–16 such chains in a single long session.

## Environment

- `@deepseek-ai/dsh` `0.1.2-rc.1` (also `@deepseek-ai/dsh-session` `0.1.2-rc.1`)
- Node 25 (Windows / Linux)
- OpenAI-completions–style adapters (`dsh-llm-pi-ai`), model `deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp` served via local/custom providers

## What gets persisted

A model turn ended with a tool call block carrying empty fields:

```json
{"type": "tool-call", "id": "", "name": "", "arguments": "{}"}
```

The harness then recorded (no validation at the append boundary):

```json
{"type": "tool/call", "seq": 709, "data": {"turn": 2, "step": 3, "callId": "", "name": "", "arguments": "{}"}}
```

```json
{
  "type": "tool/result",
  "seq": 710,
  "data": {
    "turn": 2, "step": 3,
    "message": {
      "source": {"kind": "tool", "callId": ""},
      "content": [{"type": "tool-result", "toolCallId": "", "isError": true, "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "Error: unknown tool \"\""}]}],
      "role": "user",
      "id": "1121ab3f-4834-4b6e-be7f-a890cc8c0ddd"
    },
    "error": {"name": "ToolNotFoundError", "code": "UNKNOWN_TOOL"}
  },
  "sourceEventSeqs": [709],
  "surfaceOp": "append"
}
```

## What breaks on load

History load (session query) fails with:

```
stored session "<id>" is corrupt: stored session "<id>" failed validation: Error: session event at seq 710 message must have tool source
```

because `assertMessageEventShape` (dsh-session `lib/index.js`) requires `tool/result` messages to have `source.kind === "tool"` **and a non-empty `source.callId`** (plus `block.toolCallId === source.callId`). The event was allowed to be written with `callId: ""` but can no longer be read back — a write/read validation asymmetry within the same build.

Provider resume/observe then fails from the daemon side:

```
dsh rpc error (code=gateway/internal): failed to observe session "<id>": ...
```

## Impact

- The affected conversation's full history is unreadable in the UI.
- The agent cannot start or resume — its session is unobservable, so every start attempt fails.
- No CLI/flag lets you drop the offending event; recovery requires manual decompression/patch/re-compression of the `.jsonl.zstd` frame container.

## Suggested fixes

1. **Write boundary**: when the model output yields a tool call with empty `name` (or empty `id`), reject it (raise/fail the step or retry once with a steering message) instead of persisting a degenerate `tool/call`+`tool/result` chain. At minimum, never persist a `tool/result` with an empty `callId`.
2. **Read boundary**: quarantine a single malformed message event during load (log a warning, skip just that event/tool-result) rather than failing the whole session — one lost tool result is far less harmful than an unloadable conversation. Keep strict validation for fresh/seed logs if a hardened mode is preferred.
3. **Recovery**: a documented CLI repair/export path for already-affected sessions (e.g., validate-and-drop or `--repair`) would save users manual binary surgery.

## Repro sketch

1. Use any OpenAI-completions-style provider; cause the model to emit a tool call with empty `name` (observed with `deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp`).
2. Let the step fail with `ToolNotFoundError` (`unknown tool ""`); the chain above is persisted.
3. Reload the session (open history / resume) → "corrupt: … message must have tool source".

discussions.title: dsh-model-map: map third-party models onto official DeepSeek models — vision + thinking efforts + the official wire dialect
discussions.body:
# dsh-model-map

[![DeepSeek Harness](https://img.shields.io/badge/DeepSeek%20Harness-plugin-4d6bfe)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) · Repo: **https://github.com/netease877-lab/dsh-model-map** · MIT

**English** · 简体中文如下

---

## What it does

**Solve one concrete problem: DeepSeek models served by third-party providers ship without thinking levels or vision.** Map such a model onto an official DeepSeek model — pick a provider model, pick an official model, save — and it instantly gains the official entry's image input (vision), thinking-effort levels, and the part other plugins don't cover: the **official DeepSeek wire dialect**.

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:netease877-lab/dsh-model-map
```

Restart `dsh web` once, then **Settings → 模型映射** (a top-level settings page, sibling of Models/Plugins). Three dropdowns (provider → third-party model → official model), a `deepseek|openai` style switch, one save, live effect.

> **Scope: DeepSeek models only.** For providers serving *DeepSeek* models (official-API relays, aggregators, self-hosted gateways). It is **not** a general adapter that makes other vendors' models (GPT, Gemini, Qwen, GLM, …) vision-capable or thinking-capable — their wire dialects differ and are out of scope.

## How it differs from the existing effort plugins

The ecosystem already has excellent plugins for the reasoning **picker** — `dsh-provider-auto` / `dsh-thinking-effort` / better-reasoning-effort auto-fill `reasoningEfforts`, thinking-level-override rewrites levels mid-request. This plugin attacks the gap they leave open: a DeepSeek-protocol relay needs the request to **look like an official-API request**, and vision needs `input: [text, image]`. So instead of patching one field, it stamps the mapped model with the official entry's **full capability declaration**:

| | Effort-picker plugins | **dsh-model-map** |
|---|---|---|
| Thinking levels offered | ✔ | ✔ (from the official entry) |
| Wire dialect (`thinking:{type}` + `reasoning_effort`) | ✘ | ✔ official dialect, or plain-OpenAI via the style switch |
| `off` → explicit `thinking:{type:"disabled"}` | ✘ | ✔ byte-identical to official requests |
| Vision admission (`input: [text, image]`) | usually ✘ | ✔ |
| Capability facts from | knowledge base / heuristics / your YAML | **the running dsh's own official catalog** |
| Hardcoded model tables | sometimes | **none** |

## Zero hardcoded model lists

The official-model dropdown is filled from the same session `modelCatalog` RPC the composer's model selector uses; each save resolves the target's facts (name / modalities / efforts) live via `listModels` + `resolveModelInfo`. **When a dsh update adds or renames official models, the picker and new stamps follow automatically — the plugin never needs an update for that.** Wire alignment falls out of the design: mapped requests are built by the same code path dsh's own test suite pins for the official dialect.

## Scope & notes

- Only the capability declaration moves; requests still go to your third-party endpoint.
- Capacities (context window, max tokens, pricing, image budgets) are deliberately **not** copied — they are your endpoint's own facts.
- Deleting a mapping withdraws only the stamped fields; hand-edited entries are never touched.
- If the official catalog is momentarily unreadable, mappings stay pending rather than writing invented values.

---

## 简体中文

**解决一个具体问题：第三方供应商提供的 DeepSeek 模型没有思考强度档位和识图**。把它们映射成官方 DeepSeek 模型——保存即生效，立刻获得官方条目的识图与思考强度档位，以及现有同类插件没有的那块：**官方 DeepSeek 线缆方言**（`thinking:{type}` + `reasoning_effort`，关档显式发 `thinking:{type:"disabled"}`），DeepSeek 协议中转站像对待官方 API 一样接受请求。

安装（`lib/` 预编译入库，无构建脚本、无 allowBuilds 提示）：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:netease877-lab/dsh-model-map
```

重启 `dsh web`，打开 **设置 → 模型映射**（与「模型 / 插件」同级的一级页面）：三个下拉（供应商 → 第三方模型 → 官方模型）+ `deepseek|openai` 参数风格 + 一次保存，即时生效。

> **范围：只针对 DeepSeek 模型。** 适用于官方 API 中转站、聚合站、自建网关等提供 DeepSeek 模型的第三方供应商。它**不是**让其他厂商模型（GPT、Gemini、Qwen、GLM 等）获得思考和识图的通用适配器——那些模型的请求方言不同，不在本插件范围内。

**与现有档位类插件的分工**：`dsh-provider-auto` / `dsh-thinking-effort` / better-reasoning-effort 解决"档位选择器"，thinking-level-override 在请求层改写档位——它们不管线缆方言和识图。本插件把官方条目的**完整能力声明**（`name` / `input` / `reasoningEfforts` / `compat` 五件套）整体盖到映射模型上，这正是 pi-ai 物化模型吃的字段，所以模型页、选择器、识图准入、档位菜单全部原生联动。

**零写死模型表**：官方下拉吃输入框模型选择器同一个 `modelCatalog` RPC；保存时能力事实经 `listModels` + `resolveModelInfo` 现查。dsh 升级新增/改名官方模型，下拉与盖章自动跟进，插件永远不需要为此更新。线缆对齐是同一构造路径的自然结果（dsh 自家 adapter.spec 钉死的形态）。

**边界**：只动能力声明，请求仍发你的端点；上下文窗口/最大输出/价格/图片预算是端点自己的事实，刻意不复制；删除映射只撤回盖章字段，手改条目不碰；官方目录读不到时映射待命，不写编造值。

仓库：https://github.com/netease877-lab/dsh-model-map （中英 README）· Release：https://github.com/netease877-lab/dsh-model-map/releases/tag/v0.2.1

discussions.title: [Bug] Web 交付卡片的「在文件资源管理器中显示」只创建隐藏窗口（Windows）
discussions.body:
### 环境

- DeepSeek Harness 本地构建版 `0.1.5-rc.1`（master，HEAD `aa8262ec09`）
- Windows 10/11，浏览器 Chrome
- `GET /api/present.host` 返回 `{"name":"DESKTOP-***","available":true,"fileManager":"explorer"}`

### 复现步骤

1. 让模型通过 `present` 交付一个文件，或等待某轮产生交付卡片
2. 点击卡片右侧 `∨` → 「在文件资源管理器中显示」
3. 观察：没有任何资源管理器窗口出现

### 预期

资源管理器中弹出窗口并选中该文件。

### 实际

- Network 中 `POST /api/present.open?sessionId=…&seq=351&index=0&action=reveal` 返回 **204**，说明服务端链路全部正常
- 用同一坐标在浏览器 Console 手工 `fetch(...)` 同样返回 204
- 系统里**确实**新生成了 explorer 窗口，且 `Shell.Application.Windows()` 中该窗口的 `Document.SelectedItems()` 正确选中了目标文件
- 但 `IsWindowVisible(hwnd) == false`：窗口被创建为**不可见**状态。同一会话累计出现 10 个此类隐藏窗口，`showCmd` 为 `SW_NORMAL` 却始终不显示
- 因为窗口不可见，用户侧表现为"点击后毫无反应"（卡片状态文字一闪而过，容易忽略）

### 定位

`revealNativePath()`（`packages/util/native-command/src/path-opener.ts:228`）在 win32 走：

```
runNativeCommand('explorer.exe', ['/select,', fileUrl])
```

而 `runNativeCommand`（`packages/util/native-command/src/runner.ts:27`）使用：

```
execFile(command, args, { encoding: 'utf8', signal, windowsHide: true }, …)
```

`windowsHide: true` 会设置 `STARTF_USESHOWWINDOW` + `SW_HIDE`，explorer 创建的顶层窗口继承该显示状态，于是窗口存在但不显示。

### 对照实验（同一台机器、同一目标文件）

| 启动方式 | explorer 窗口是否可见 |
|---|---|
| Node `execFile` + `windowsHide: true`（当前实现） | ❌ 不可见（创建成功） |
| PowerShell `Start-Process explorer.exe /select,<uri>` | ✅ 可见 |
| PowerShell `Shell.Application.Explore(path)` | ✅ 可见 |
| PowerShell `Start-Process explorer.exe "<目录>"` | ✅ 可见 |

### 相关既有结论

仓库自己的笔记 `.agents/notes/implemented/feature/2026-08-25-promote-open-anywhere-plugin.zh.md` 已记录同一现象：

> 文件管理器条目直接经 `dsh-native-command` 的路径打开器启动（`shell-open`，OS shell 的 open verb，携带完整父环境，而非 detached 的清理环境 spawn），因为直接 spawn `explorer.exe <dir>` 不能可靠地弹出窗口。

「在应用中打开」的文件管理器条目已按该结论改走 `shell-open`，但交付卡片的 reveal 动作仍在直接 spawn，未同步。

### 建议修法

win32 分支不要复用带 `windowsHide: true` 的 `runNativeCommand`，改为显式正常窗口的启动方式（任一即可，均有实测支持）：

- 以 `SW_SHOWNORMAL` 启动 `explorer.exe /select,<fileUrl>`；或
- 使用 Shell 的 open verb / `Start-Process -WindowStyle Normal`；或
- 复用 `open-in-app` 已有的 `shell-open` 启动路径

### 附：复现脚本

一个最小对照脚本（枚举 explorer 窗口并比较各种启动方式的可见性）：

```powershell
Add-Type -Namespace P -Name W -MemberDefinition @'
[DllImport("user32.dll")] public static extern bool IsWindowVisible(IntPtr h);
'@
$file = 'D:\path\to\target.txt'
$uri = ([System.Uri]::new($file)).AbsoluteUri.Replace(',', '%2C')
$shell = New-Object -ComObject Shell.Application
function Count-Visible {
  $v = 0
  foreach ($w in @($shell.Windows())) {
    try { if ($w.Document.Folder.Self.Path -like '*your-workspace*') { if ([P.W]::IsWindowVisible([IntPtr]$w.HWND)) { $v++ } } } catch {}
  }
  $v
}
"before: $(Count-Visible)"
Start-Process -FilePath 'explorer.exe' -ArgumentList '/select,', $uri   # 可见
# Node 的 execFile + windowsHide:true 等价路径：不可见
Start-Sleep -Seconds 3
"after:  $(Count-Visible)"
```

---

discussions.title: [Bug] Continuing web session loses 25 native tools and matching prompt sections between turns
discussions.body:
# Bug report: standard web session loses 25 native tools and matching prompt sections between turns; background job cannot be stopped

## Summary

A captured two-turn web session started a managed background shell job successfully. On the next user request, `close the background task`, the recorded request catalog had lost 25 native tools, including `bash`, `job_list`, `job_output`, and `job_kill`. Corresponding system-prompt sections also disappeared. All 225 MCP tools remained, and every retained tool schema was identical.

The capability loss is confirmed in the session export. Its initiating lifecycle/configuration event is **not known**. This report does not claim a proven core race or a deterministic clean-install reproduction.

## Environment and qualification

- Incident: 2026-09-10, macOS, browser UI, top-level session with preset `standard`.
- Recorded provider/model: `zai` / `glm-5.3-flash`, reasoning effort `high`. Logged provider/model configuration did not change between the two headers.
- Source checkout inspected afterward: local commit `ee55cf07920a021a6a609b23fcfd0c9cafcf9297`, based on `0.1.5-alpha.1`; the relevant core files match upstream commit `5dda764ed3aa172535a7967b06ff95d9cbfe536a`.
- This is a **customized deployment**, including local skills-related changes, installed third-party/local plugins and MCP integrations. These have not been eliminated as contributing factors. The ZIP does not record an exact runtime commit or full resolved plugin composition.
- Capture: one `session.v3.jsonl`, 354 JSON records, including 353 contiguous events (`seq` 0 through 352), 2 turns, 54 tool calls with corresponding results. Private paths, account data, credentials and correlation identifiers are omitted below.

## Observed sequence

1. During turn 1, native shell/filesystem tools worked and the agent built a small web application.
2. At `seq 224` / JSONL line 226 it called `bash` with `run_in_background: true`; `seq 225` returned `started background job bash-1`. A later shell call verified HTTP 200 from the dev server.
3. Turn 1 ended at 12:59:41 Asia/Kolkata. At 14:41:02 the user requested `close the background task`.
4. Before generating the shutdown response, the second logged request header already lacked the shell and job tools. The corresponding system prompt lacked their instruction sections as well.
5. No `bash` or `job_kill` call was emitted during turn 2. The agent instead entered an unrelated MCP-call loop and eventually supplied manual shutdown instructions. The capture contains no successful agent-issued shutdown.

These are steps observed in this incident, not a claim that waiting this long deterministically reproduces the loss. No preset switch, unmount or reconstruction event explaining the change appears in this export; absence from this log does not prove none occurred at the host level.

## Request-catalog evidence

| Recorded header | Turn 1 | Turn 2 |
|---|---:|---:|
| Event sequence | 12 | 242 |
| JSONL line, metadata included | 14 | 244 |
| Local time, Asia/Kolkata | 12:43:55 | 14:41:02 |
| Total tools | 257 | 232 |
| MCP tools | 225 | 225 |
| Other tools | 32 | 7 |
| Shell and job-control tools | present | absent |

Exactly these names were removed; no new tool was added:

```text
ask_user_question, bash, create_goal, edit, exit_plan_mode, get_goal,
glob, grep, interrupt_agent, job_kill, job_list, job_output, list_agents,
ralph, read, read_image, send_message, skill, subagent_fork, todo_write,
update_goal, web_fetch, web_search, workflow, write
```

The remaining non-MCP tools were:

```text
learning_evidence, learning_propose, memory_mutate, memory_read,
memory_search, memory_stats, subagent
```

The later system-prompt event is `seq 240` / JSONL line 242. Its filesystem, shell, job-control, goal and workflow sections are absent. This is a change in Harness's recorded request context, not merely the model overlooking a tool which was still listed.

## Expected behavior

A continuing standard-preset session should retain its native capabilities unless configuration or policy deliberately changes them. If capabilities are intentionally removed, that transition should be observable, and loss of job-control access should be explained to the agent/user.

## Relevant source and limits of attribution

- [Standard preset composition](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/5dda764ed3aa172535a7967b06ff95d9cbfe536a/packages/preset/agent-presets/presets/standard/agent.cordis.yml) includes shell, filesystem and job-control contributions.
- [Preset scope binding and unjoined-agent diagnostics](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/5dda764ed3aa172535a7967b06ff95d9cbfe536a/packages/preset/agent-presets/src/index.ts#L208) explain how preset tools and prompt sections depend on the agent joining its standing scope.
- [ToolRuntime scope-derived view](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/5dda764ed3aa172535a7967b06ff95d9cbfe536a/packages/core/tools/src/index.ts#L1142) combines global and scope-chain contributions.
- [Request construction](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/5dda764ed3aa172535a7967b06ff95d9cbfe536a/packages/core/agent-loop/src/agent.ts#L553) records the request header.

The simultaneous disappearance of tools and prompt sections is consistent with composition, registration lifetime or scope visibility changing. This remains an inference. Host lifecycle logs and a reproduction are needed to distinguish those mechanisms. Ordinary preset-file generation changes preserve existing standing generations in the inspected implementation, so this report does not attribute the failure to normal file refresh.

Existing preset mount/invariant tests were run against the checkout: 57 passed across 2 files. They do **not** reproduce or fix this incident.

## Related reports

- [#4946](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/4946) reports missing `bash` after a QQbot disposal/reconstruction path. Similar symptom, but this case is a top-level web session, explicitly records catalog and prompt shrinkage, and has no corresponding lifecycle transition in its export. A common cause is not established.
- [#4921](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/4921) concerns child-agent inherited capabilities, a different path.
- The downstream wrong-tool repetition overlaps [#3819](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/3819); the repeated-call evidence is being added there separately.

## Useful next diagnostic

Capture agent scope ancestry, standing-generation identity, registration disposal and resolved tool/prompt contributions before and after a continuing web session becomes idle or its plugins reload. Compare the runtime registry with the exact assembled model request. The regression should assert preservation of the shell/job tool set, not just that a second response completes.

## Redacted evidence and verifier

The following allowlisted summary is derived from the export. It is not a full raw session or provider-wire trace.
