discussions.title: [0.1.5-rc.1] connection.rpc.handle() always throws (cannot get property 'webServer' without inject) - all plugin RPC channels return 405
discussions.body:
## Summary

In `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.5-rc.1`, the public `connection.rpc.handle(channel, handler)` API throws synchronously on every call, so **no plugin RPC channel is ever registered on the web server**. Browser requests for those channels fall through to the SPA/static handler, which answers **405** for any non-GET/HEAD request.

## Environment

- `@deepseek-ai/dsh` **0.1.5-rc.1** (npm `latest`)
- `@deepseek-ai/cordis` **4.0.2**
- `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-connection` **0.1.5-rc.1**
- Windows 11, Node v22.23.1, profile `web`
- Affected plugins observed: `dsh-mnemon` 0.5.5 / 0.5.6 / 0.5.7 (all ship the same code), `dsh-vision-router` 2.1.4

## Root cause

`packages/client/connection` → `HostConnectionService`:

```js
get rpc() {
  const owner = this.ctx;                                               // ← service's own context
  return { handle: (channel, handler) => this.register(owner, channel, handler), ... };
}

register(owner, channel, handler) {
  ...
  return owner.effect(() => owner.webServer.register(route), `client-connection: ${channel} rpc channel`);
  //                          ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ throws here
}
```

`this.ctx` inside the class resolves to the **service's own context** (the plugin's declared `inject` is `["credentials"]`), not the reader-scoped context — even though the doc comment on the surrounding API says *"scoped to the Context reading this service"*. With cordis 4.0.2, accessing a service that is not in that context's inject set **throws** instead of returning `undefined`:

```
cannot get property "webServer" without inject
```

Because the throw is synchronous inside `handle()`, the channel route never reaches `webServer`, and there is no log line anywhere — the failure is completely silent.

## Why this is not a caller-side problem

Measured live in the running host (0.1.5-rc.1):

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `ctx.webServer` on a context that injected `['webServer','connection']` | accessible (`true`) |
| `ctx.effect(() => ctx.webServer !== undefined)` on the same context | accessible (`true`) |
| `ctx.connection.ctx === ctx` (reader-scoped proxy) | `true` |
| `ctx.connection.rpc.handle('/probe', ...)` from that same context | **THROWS** `cannot get property "webServer" without inject` |
| `ctx.webServer.register({kind:'prefix', path:'/probe', handler})` directly | works, route appears |

Since `connection.ctx` *is* the reader context and `reader.webServer` is provably readable inside an effect, the `owner` used inside `register()` cannot be that same reader context — it is the raw service context. So no amount of correct injection on the plugin side can work around it.

No package in the DSH core actually calls `rpc.handle` (verified by scanning every `@deepseek-ai/*` `lib/**.js`), so this regression is not covered by the in-repo test suite.

## Observed impact

The web server prefix table contains **zero** plugin RPC channels:

```
post-upgrade prefixes: /api, /plugins, /dream-skin/api, /auto-compact/api,
                       /super-injector/api, /describe-image, /boot-guard,
                       /api/builtin-toggles, /open-in-app/icon, ...
  missing: /dsh-mnemon-read, /dsh-mnemon-write, /dsh-mnemon-settings,
           /dsh-mnemon-activation, /dsh-mnemon-pack, /dsh-mnemon-view,
           /dsh-mnemon-view-settings, /vision-router-settings
```

User-visible: the Mnemon memory panel shows `Mnemon 尚未就绪` plus
`transport failure for /dsh-mnemon-read/status-summary: HTTP 405`, while all host-side tools keep working (they are in-process and never touch HTTP) — which makes the failure look like a plugin bug.

## Suggested fix

Use the lenient accessor (or thread the reader-scoped context through explicitly):

```diff
-  return owner.effect(() => owner.webServer.register(route), `client-connection: ${channel} rpc channel`);
+  return owner.effect(() => owner.get('webServer').register(route), `client-connection: ${channel} rpc channel`);
```

Verified against the live 0.1.5-rc.1 process: with this change, `rpc.handle()` no longer throws, all 7 `/dsh-mnemon-*` prefix routes register, and the panel's requests stop returning 405.

## Minimal reproduction

```js
export const name = 'probe';
export const inject = ['connection', 'webServer'];
export function apply(ctx) {
  ctx.webServer.register({ kind: 'prefix', path: '/probe-direct',
    handler: (req, res) => { res.writeHead(200); res.end('ok'); } });
  console.log('direct register ->', !!ctx.webServer.match('/probe-direct/x')); // true
  try {
    ctx.connection.rpc.handle('/probe-raw', async () => ({ ok: true }));
    console.log('rpc.handle ok');
  } catch (e) {
    console.log('rpc.handle THREW:', e.message); // cannot get property "webServer" without inject
  }
}
```

## Related

- Downstream report with the same root cause: omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon#219

discussions.title: 【Bug】0.1.5-rc.1 Web 客户端必然加载失败：dsh-client-ui-sidebar-right 对未随版本发布的 @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-dockkit 有 43 处硬引用
discussions.body:
0.1.5-rc.1` 的发布物中**缺少 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-dockkit`**（该包在 `0.1.5-alpha.1` 时存在），而 `dsh-client-ui-sidebar-right` 的客户端产物对它存在**运行时硬引用**，导致 Web 客户端**必现**加载失败，并连带拖挂对话面板。

环境

| 项 | 值 |
|---|---|
| DSH CLI | `0.1.5-rc.1` |
| profile 依赖 | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-base@0.1.5-rc.1`、`@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app@0.1.5-rc.1` |
| 平台 | Windows 11 |
| Node | `v24.20.0` |
| Profile | `web`（全新 profile，未装任何第三方插件） |
| 安装渠道 | npm（registry.npmmirror.com 镜像） |

现象

**(1) 浏览器控制台**

```
Failed to load plugins
web boot: 1 entry did not activate
dsh-client-ui-chat: pending (waiting for service: sidebarRight)
```

**(2) 客户端模块解析失败**

```
client-modules: require("@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-dockkit") missed the module table
— not a platform seed word, not a materialized module,
  and no registered package factory
  (a build-time externals drift, or a dynamic dependency that did not arrive)
```

**(3) 服务端启动是正常的** —— `dsh web` 正常打印监听地址，**错误只发生在客户端**，所以容易被误判为"配置问题"。

根因（三层证据）

**证据 1：`sidebar-right` 对 dockkit 的引用不是偶然，而是深度依赖**

- `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-sidebar-right@0.1.5-rc.1` 的客户端产物 `lib/client.js` 中，**共 43 处**引用 `dockkit`：
  - `lib/client.js:34` → `require("@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-dockkit")`（**运行时 hard require**）
  - `lib/client.js:352` → `dockkit.createInitialState(...)`
  - `lib/client.js:353` → `dockkit.EMPTY_HISTORY`
  - `lib/client.js:359` → `dockkit.findPaneContentTab(...)`
  - （其余为同一模块的成员访问）

**证据 2：该包**没有**随 `0.1.5-rc.1` 发布**

- 安装后的 `node_modules/@deepseek-ai/` 下**查无** `dsh-client-ui-dockkit`
- 全量递归搜索 CLI 安装产物：**0 命中**
- 但它**在 npm registry 上存在**：`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-dockkit` 可见版本为 **`0.1.5-alpha.1`**
  → 说明 **alpha.1 发布过，rc.1 漏发**（或未同步发布）

**证据 3：它也无法作为"插件行"被供入模块表**

- 该包**没有 `dsh.client` 声明**、**没有 `./client` 导出**
- 因此它无法通过 client module graph 的 row 机制被供料
- 于是唯一出路是随发布物下发 —— 而这正是 rc.1 缺失的那一步

**结论**：三者叠加 → 客户端模块表必然 miss → `Failed to load plugins` → `dsh-client-ui-chat` 永久 `pending`。

影响

- **Web 客户端必现失败**（全新 profile、无第三方插件也复现，与用户配置无关）
- **插件面板全部不可用**（所有客户端插件一起挂）
- **对话面板被拖挂**（`chat: pending (waiting for service: sidebarRight)`）
- 用户侧**无法自行规避**（依赖既没发布，也不能作为插件行供料）
- 推测影响**所有 0.1.5-rc.1 用户**（纯客户端打包问题，与平台无关）

复现步骤

1. 准备全新 profile（不安装任何第三方插件）
2. 安装：`@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.5-rc.1` + `@deepseek-ai/dsh-base@0.1.5-rc.1` + `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app@0.1.5-rc.1`
3. 启动：`dsh --profile web --port 3081 --no-open`
4. 打开页面 → 控制台出现上述 (1)(2) 两组错误，插件面板不加载

辅证命令**

```bash
# 发布物里没有它
find node_modules/@deepseek-ai -maxdepth 1 -name '*dockkit*'        # → 空

# 但 registry 上有（alpha 版本）
npm view @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-dockkit version                  # → 0.1.5-alpha.1

# sidebar-right 里的引用数量
grep -rc 'dockkit' node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-sidebar-right/lib/client.js

期望修复（任一即可）

1. **把 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-dockkit` 纳入 `0.1.5` 系列的发布物**（与 `sidebar-right` 同版本）；或
2. **在打包 `sidebar-right` 时把 dockkit 内联/bundle 进去**（不再留作 external）；或
3. 将其改为可选依赖 + **运行时兜底**（缺包时该面板降级，而不是整棵客户端树失败）。

此外建议：**client bundle 中的 external 引用应在构建期做一次"发布物完整性校验"**，避免同类问题再次漏到 rc。

### 同类问题（供参考，说明这不是孤例）

- Discussion **#6168**：`dsh@0.1.5-rc.1 无法全局安装：依赖 @deepseek-ai/dsh-util-crypto@^0.1.5-rc.1 未发布，导致 ETARGET`
  → **同一性质：rc.1 有一批包未发全**

discussions.title: [Bug] Windows: revealNativePath never shows a window, and opens the Desktop instead of the target folder
discussions.body:
# [Bug] Windows: revealNativePath never shows a window, and opens the Desktop instead of the target folder

## Environment

- `@deepseek-ai/dsh` 0.1.5-rc.1, module `@deepseek-ai/dsh-native-command` 0.1.5-rc.1
- Windows 11 build 22621, Node v24.19.0, Windows PowerShell 5.1.22621.4387
- Launch: `dsh --profile web --port 3080`

## Summary

The Web GUI "Reveal in File Explorer" action (`POST /api/present.open?...&action=reveal`) is a
silent no-op on Windows. It returns HTTP 204, so the client reports success, but no window
appears. Once the first failure is worked around, the window does appear but points at the
Desktop instead of the file's folder. Three independent defects stack up; each alone breaks it.

## Defect 1 - runNativeCommand uses piped stdio, refused by a sandboxed host

`lib/index.js:17-21` calls `execFile(command, [...args], { encoding: "utf8", signal, windowsHide: true }, ...)`.
`execFile` attaches piped stdio. On a host that sandboxes child processes, any stdio other
than `"ignore"` fails:

    Error: spawn EPERM
      errno: -4048, code: 'EPERM', syscall: 'spawn'
      at ChildProcess.spawn (node:internal/child_process:458:11)
      at execFile (node:internal/child_process:349:17)

Measured on the affected host: default pipe -> EPERM, "inherit" -> EPERM, "ignore" -> succeeds.

The catch in `revealNativePath` only tolerates `code === 1`, so EPERM propagates and becomes a
RemoteError, which the HTTP layer surfaces to the UI as success. Nothing is logged. The reveal
command is never started.

## Defect 2 - a bare explorer.exe has no console, so /select cannot complete

With a runner that survives (`spawn` + `stdio: "ignore"`), explorer runs and exits 1 - which the
code treats as a valid delegated handoff - but no window is created. Measured, same host, same
target:

- `execFile("explorer.exe", [...])` -> no window
- `spawn("explorer.exe", [...], { stdio: "ignore" })` -> no window
- `spawn("explorer.exe", [...], { shell: true, stdio: "ignore" })` -> window appears

Going through cmd.exe (`shell: true`) is what lets explorer complete the handoff.

## Defect 3 - a file:// URI is not an equivalent argument; explorer falls back to the Desktop

`lib/index.js:228` builds `pathToFileURL(windowsPath, { windows: true }).href.replaceAll(",", "%2C")`.
With a working runner, a visible window opens but at the Desktop rather than the file's directory.

| Argument to `explorer.exe /select,` | Resulting window |
|---|---|
| `file:///E:/.../md%2B%2B_x64-setup.exe` (encoded, current code) | Desktop (wrong) |
| `file:///E:/.../md++_x64-setup.exe` (raw URI) | Desktop (wrong) |
| `E:\...\md++_x64-setup.exe` (plain path) | correct folder |
| `cmd /c start "" explorer.exe /select, <plain path>` | correct folder |

Masking note: with an ASCII-only file name the URI form appeared to work, because the parent
folder name happened to resolve. With a non-ASCII name (`md++使用与故障排查.md`) it demonstrably
falls back to the Desktop. Easy to miss when testing with ASCII fixtures only.

## Reproduction

1. On Windows, start `dsh --profile web` and open the GUI.
2. `present` a file with a non-ASCII name inside a workspace subfolder.
3. Click the card's action for "reveal in file manager".
4. Status becomes "requested", no window appears; the endpoint returns 204.

## Proposed fix

Four changes to `dsh-native-command/lib/index.js`:

1. import `spawn` alongside `execFile`
2. add a `runShellDetached` runner: `spawn` + `shell: true` + `stdio: "ignore"`, mapping a
   non-zero exit to a numeric `code` so the existing "exit 1 = handoff, else reject" rule holds
3. `revealNativePath` uses it (`const run = internals.run ?? runShellDetached;`)
4. pass the plain Windows path (`const target = windowsPath;`) instead of a file:// URI

Verified after the change, by enumerating visible `CabinetWClass` windows:

    before: 0 visible explorer windows
    after : 1 -> 'deepseekh-workspace - 文件资源管理器', target file selected
    revealNativePath resolved without throwing

Known residual risk: `shell: true` concatenates arguments into a command string for cmd.exe, so
paths containing `&`, `^`, `%`, `(`, `)` remain a theoretical hazard. A stricter form is
`spawn("explorer.exe", [...], { shell: false })` mediated through PowerShell `Start-Process`
(argument array, no concatenation) - not verified by the reporter.

## Suggestion: the failure must not be silent

A reveal that throws is currently indistinguishable from one that succeeded - no log, no UI
difference. Please log the error server-side (the catch in `openWorkspacePath` has it), and
surface a non-2xx status so the client's existing `revealError` branch
(`dsh-client-ui-deliverables/lib/client.js:151-166`) can report it instead of a false success.

## Method

The runner's `internals.run` seam was used to capture the real argv; the helper was driven
directly so the engine's call shape could be compared against alternatives. Window presence was
measured by enumerating `CabinetWClass` top-level windows with `EnumWindows` + `IsWindowVisible`,
and the resulting folder by window title.

discussions.title: Not every workspace is a project — 建议给 DSH 工作区加一个「用途」维度
discussions.body:
## 现状

DSH 的工作区模型很干净:工作区按**规范化目录路径**归组,一个目录下的会话聚在一起,
由 `ctx.workspaceRegistry` 统一管理,持久化在 `~/.dsh/storages/workspace.json`,侧边栏是它的投影。

但这个模型有一个隐含前提:**每个工作区都是一个项目**。

而真实使用里,并非所有工作区都是项目。很多时候我只想临时问一个问题、试一段一次性代码、
或者让 agent 干点跟任何仓库都无关的事——这类"临时对话"在当前的模型里没有位置。

## 痛点

1. **临时对话没有落脚点。** 想快速问点东西,只能开一个真实目录当工作区。于是它进入工作区
   列表,和真实项目混在一起,想去掉还得手工收拾。

2. **会被动继承项目作用域。** 项目指令是按会话 cwd 逐级向上加载的
   (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-instructions` 找 `AGENTS.md`/`CLAUDE.md`)。把一个真实目录当临时
   工作区,项目约定就会被注入;即使用一个空目录,较上层的 `AGENTS.md` 仍可能沿祖先链命中。

3. **无法按性质组织。** 区分"项目"和"随手开的临时空间"目前只能靠命名习惯,侧边栏没有
   按用途分区的能力。

4. **恢复时没有用途概念。** 重启后无法表达"这几个是项目、那几个是临时工作区",
   最近打开的工作区丢掉了它本来的性质。

这不是新概念——有些 coding agent 已经区分项目工作区与临时/scratch 会话。
DSH 的工作区模型离这个能力,其实只差一个维度。

## 建议

**给工作区加一个用途维度,而不是给会话加类型:**

```
workspacePurpose: "project" | "conversation"    // 缺省 "project"
```

配套行为:

- **临时对话有固定沙箱**:在应用数据目录下提供一个固定的临时工作区
  (如 `$DSH_HOME/workspace/default`),懒创建,所有临时对话共用,不落进任何项目目录。
- **不参与项目级作用域**:`conversation` 用途的工作区不注入项目指令、不参与项目级 bootstrap。
- **侧边栏按用途分区**:「项目」/「对话」两组,分区顺序与展开态独立持久化。
- **恢复时带上用途**:记录"上次打开的工作区及其用途",重启原样恢复。
- **会话级可覆盖**:仍允许在单个会话上临时切换用途,不牺牲灵活性。

## 为什么维度加在工作区上

- 用途是工作区**固有**的,不是会话偶然的属性;同一目录下所有会话天然同性质。
- 现有基础设施可以复用:工作区注册表、持久化、侧边栏投影都已存在,只多一维。
- 迁移成本低:缺省 `project`,旧数据无需改动。

## 一个可参考的实现:ZCode 的做法

ZCode(智谱的编码客户端)已经把这层做出来了,可以直接当参考:

- **用途挂在工作区上,不在会话上**:本地工作区描述符带 `workspacePurpose: "project" | "conversation"`(缺省 `project`);远程工作区没有这个概念。
- **临时对话有固定目录**:所有临时对话共用一个位于应用数据目录下的工作区(`~/.zcode/workspace/default`),按需懒创建,而不是每个会话一个沙箱。
- **按工作区限定作用域时按用途过滤**:内部在需要按工作区组装 bootstrap 范围时,把 `conversation` 用途直接跳过,所以项目级配置不会作用到临时对话上。
- **UI 按用途分区**:侧边栏分成「项目」「对话」两组,分组的顺序与展开态单独持久化。
- **恢复时记录用途**:持久化"上次打开的工作区及其用途",重启原样恢复。
- 会话表里没有用途字段——用途是工作区级属性,查询时按工作区关联出来。

值得注意的是,ZCode 把**固定单一目录**作为默认:所有临时对话共用一个沙箱,而不是一个对话一个目录。

## 想听官方的意见

1. 这个方向是否在路线图上?
2. 临时对话工作区应该**固定单目录**(所有临时对话共用),还是每个对话一个**独立临时目录**?
3. 工作区列表是否会开放行级/分区级扩展点,让第三方能参与按用途分组,而不必接管官方
   工作区组件?

感谢!如果这个方向可行,也很想知道官方倾向的语义边界(例如 `conversation` 工作区是否
还应该有独立的权限/工具默认值)。

---
---

# Not every workspace is a project — a case for a `workspacePurpose` dimension

## Where things stand

DSH's workspace model is clean: workspaces group sessions by **canonical directory path**, are
managed by `ctx.workspaceRegistry`, persist in `~/.dsh/storages/workspace.json`, and the sidebar is
a projection of them.

The model carries one implicit assumption: **every workspace is a project.**

But in practice, not every workspace is a project. Often I just want to ask a quick question, try a
throwaway snippet, or have the agent do something unrelated to any repo. That kind of *temporary
conversation* has no home in the current model.

## The friction

1. **Nowhere to put a temporary conversation.** To ask something quick, I have to open a real
   directory as a workspace — so it shows up in the workspace list, gets mixed in with real
   projects, and has to be cleaned up by hand.

2. **It inherits project scope by accident.** Project instructions are loaded by walking up from the
   session cwd (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-instructions` looks for `AGENTS.md`/`CLAUDE.md`). Point a
   temporary workspace at a real directory and project conventions get injected; even an empty
   directory can still pick up an ancestor `AGENTS.md`.

3. **No way to organize by nature.** Separating "projects" from "scratch spaces" is left to naming
   discipline; the sidebar cannot group by purpose.

4. **No notion of purpose on restore.** After a restart there is no way to express "these were
   projects, those were temporary workspaces" — a recently opened workspace loses what it was.

This isn't a novel idea — some coding agents already separate project workspaces from
temporary/scratch sessions. DSH's workspace model is only one dimension away from it.

## Proposal

**Give a workspace a purpose dimension, rather than giving a session a type:**

```
workspacePurpose: "project" | "conversation"    // defaults to "project"
```

Supporting behavior:

- **Temporary conversations get a fixed sandbox**: a fixed workspace under the app data directory
  (e.g. `$DSH_HOME/workspace/default`), created lazily, shared by all temporary conversations, and
  never inside a project directory.
- **Excluded from project scope**: workspaces with purpose `conversation` do not receive project
  instructions and do not participate in project-level bootstrap.
- **Sidebar grouped by purpose**: a "Projects" / "Conversations" split, with the group order and
  expansion state persisted independently.
- **Restore carries purpose**: persist the workspaces that were open and their purpose, and restore
  them as they were.
- **Per-session override**: still allow switching purpose on an individual session, so flexibility
  isn't lost.

## Why the dimension belongs on the workspace

- Purpose is **intrinsic** to a workspace, not incidental to a session; every session in a directory
  shares its nature.
- The existing infrastructure can be reused: the registry, persistence, and sidebar projection already
  exist — this only adds one dimension.
- Migration is cheap: `project` is the default, so existing data needs no change.

## Prior art: how ZCode does it

ZCode (Z.ai's coding client) has already shipped this layer, so it works as a concrete reference:

- **Purpose lives on the workspace, not the session**: a local workspace descriptor carries `workspacePurpose: "project" | "conversation"` (default `project`); remote workspaces don't have the concept.
- **Temporary conversations get a fixed directory**: all of them share a single workspace under the app data directory (`~/.zcode/workspace/default`), created lazily — not one sandbox per session.
- **Filtered by purpose when scoping work to workspaces**: when composing workspace-scoped bootstrap, it simply skips `conversation` workspaces, so project-level configuration never reaches temporary conversations.
- **Sidebar grouped by purpose**: split into "Projects" and "Conversations", with group order and expansion state persisted separately.
- **Restore records purpose**: it persists the workspaces that were open together with their purpose, and restores them as they were.
- No purpose column in the session table — purpose is a workspace-level attribute, joined in at query time.

Worth noting that ZCode makes the **single fixed directory** the default: all temporary conversations
share one sandbox rather than getting one directory each.

## Questions for the maintainers

1. Is this direction on the roadmap?
2. Should the temporary workspace be a **single fixed directory** (shared by all temporary
   conversations), or **one directory per conversation**?
3. Will the workspace list expose row- or section-level extension points, so third parties can
   participate in grouping by purpose without having to take over the official workspace component?

Thanks! If the direction is viable, I'd also love to know the intended semantic boundary — e.g.
whether a `conversation` workspace should have its own permission/tool defaults.

discussions.title: [Bug] /compact reports transport failures as "could not produce a useful summary"
discussions.body:
**Environment**
- dsh `0.1.5-rc.1` (installed), verified the same code path on `master`
  (`packages/compaction/compaction-basic/src/region.ts:277-299`)
- Provider route: `deepseek-official` (DeepSeek API)
- Evidence: session log of one session, plus a scan of all local session logs

## Summary

When the summarization request dies at the transport layer, `/compact` tells the user:

> Compaction could not produce a useful summary. The conversation is unchanged; the attempt is recorded in the session log.

The real failure is `DeepSeek API stream from https://api.deepseek.com failed` (`LlmError`, code `TRANSPORT`).
It is only written to the log-only `compaction/end.error` field; the user never sees it, and is pointed at
"summary quality" instead of the network.

This contradicts the documented contract in `packages/compaction/command-compact/README.md`:

| Situation | Message you see |
|---|---|
| No useful summary could be produced | `Compaction could not produce a useful summary. ...` |

> Failures other than these expected cases surface as errors rather than being silently converted.

## Evidence

Same args (`/compact`, `args=""`), same session, two failures then one success:

| Event | Line | Detail |
|---|---|---|
| `command/run` | L1117 | `cmd-31e9807e-1` |
| `compaction/start` | L1118 | 1789041799161 |
| `compaction/end` | L1119 | `error="DeepSeek API stream from https://api.deepseek.com failed"` (8556 ms) |
| `command/done` | L1120 | `kind=error`, "Compaction could not produce a useful summary. ..." (+6 ms) |
| second attempt | L1121-1124 | same args, same error string (12327 ms) |
| third attempt | L1364-1369 | succeeds (14869 ms), `command/done` = `Compacted 529 history items (~247453 tokens).` |

Scan of all local session logs (real events, not string matching):
- 40 `error/TRANSPORT` finishes, 59 `llm/retry` events (40 TRANSPORT + 19 SERVER)
- every agent-turn TRANSPORT failure is retried; **no summarization failure ever is**
- all 5 manual `/compact` commands in the logs: 2 of the above failures, 3 successes

## Source

`dsh-compaction-basic/lib/index.js:507-511`:

```js
/** Classify one closed manual attempt without weakening cancellation precedence. */
function throwManualFailure(failure) {
	if (failure.stage === "commit") throw new ManualCompactionError("commit", "manual compaction did not commit cleanly", { cause: failure.error });
	if (failure.error instanceof SurfaceChangedError) throw new ManualCompactionError("changed", "the compacted history changed during manual compaction", { cause: failure.error });
	throw new ManualCompactionError("summary", "manual compaction could not produce a smaller summary", { cause: failure.error });
}
```

Every failure that is neither `commit` nor `SurfaceChangedError` — including a transport error — lands on the
last line and is rendered by `dsh-command-compact/lib/index.js:33` as the "no useful summary" text.
`TRANSPORT` is a catch-all in the DeepSeek adapter (`dsh-llm-deepseek/lib/index.js:1645`); an idle timeout
would be `TIMEOUT` and a caller abort `ABORTED`, so this really was an IO error during stream read.

## Suggested fix

Classify transport-class failures (`LlmError` with code `TRANSPORT`/`TIMEOUT`) as their own
`ManualCompactionErrorCode` (e.g. `transport`), and give `dsh-command-compact` a message that names the
network and tells the user the conversation is unchanged and safe to retry. This touches the closed union in
`packages/compaction/compaction/src/types.ts` and the semantics in `docs/subsystems/compaction.md`, so it is a
small but deliberate API change.

## Not asking for retries

I understand `dsh-llm-retry` documents that direct `ctx.llm.stream()` consumers remain single-attempt, and
that the automatic paths' `compactionRetries` / overflow retry are about insufficient shrink and an advanced
replacement generation rather than transport recovery. The request here is only about **correct failure
reporting**, not about adding retries.

## Related

- #4578 reports the same misleading message from the automatic overflow path
  (`CONTEXT_WINDOW_EXCEEDED` followed by "Compaction could not produce a useful summary").

## How to reproduce

```bash
cd /usr/local/lib/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh/node_modules/@deepseek-ai
sed -n '302p;433p;507,511p;566p;907p' dsh-compaction-basic/lib/index.js
sed -n '33p' dsh-command-compact/lib/index.js
sed -n '46p;50p' dsh-command-compact/README.zh.md

# then run /compact twice in a session with a flaky connection and read the log:
#   compaction/end.error  -> the real cause
#   command/done.text     -> always the "useful summary" text
```

---

## 中文摘要

手动 `/compact` 遇到网络层 `TRANSPORT` 失败时，用户看到的是
`Compaction could not produce a useful summary.`，而真因
（`DeepSeek API stream from https://api.deepseek.com failed`）只写在
`compaction/end.error` 里，界面不展示。

`dsh-compaction-basic/lib/index.js:510` 的 `throwManualFailure` 把「非 commit、非 SurfaceChanged」
的一切失败都归成 code `summary`，再由 `dsh-command-compact/lib/index.js:33` 渲染成那句文案 —— 这与
`dsh-command-compact/README.md` 的明文契约冲突（该文案只对应「无法产生有用的摘要」，
且「除这些预期情形外的失败会以错误形式呈现，而不会被静默转换」）。

建议：为传输类失败新增一个 code（如 `transport`），并给出指向网络、提示可安全重试的文案；
需要同步 `dsh-compaction` 的 closed union 与 `docs/subsystems/compaction.md`。

注：本报告不要求给摘要调用加重试 —— `ctx.llm.stream()` 直连消费方按设计就是单次尝试。

discussions.title: [BUG] 0.1.5-rc1 旧版本创建的preset加载错误
discussions.body:
## English TL;DR

A breaking config-field rename in the official `@deepseek-ai/dsh-persona` plugin (`text` → `prefix`, shipped in 0.1.5-rc.1) silently breaks every user custom agent preset that references persona. Because custom presets persist under `~/.dsh/.agent-presets/` and survive both DSH upgrades and reinstalls, a routine version bump bricks all "New Session" creation: the UI shows nothing, the only trace is `persona: invalid config: $.prefix missing required value` in the Host log. Client-side `startSession()` swallows the failure into `console.warn`. No preset validation runs on upgrade, no migration of user preset files, no UI error surfaced.

## 🐛 问题描述

0.1.5-rc.1 中官方插件 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-persona` 将配置字段从 `text` 重命名为 `prefix`（`Config` schema 从 `text: z.string().required()` 改为 `prefix: z.string().required()`），但既没有版本迁移脚本，也没有在升级时校验用户自定义预设。用户存放在 `~/.dsh/.agent-presets/` 下的自定义预设（如 `dailyagent`）中所有引用 persona 的配置条目全部失效。由于 `agent-presets` 默认值指向该自定义预设，所有新会话的 session resume 阶段挂载预设时失败，sessionController 服务不可用，「新会话」按钮点击无任何可见反应。

## 复现步骤

1. 安装 DSH ≤ 0.1.4.x，在「设置 → Agent 预设」中创建一个引用 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-persona` 的自定义预设，配置形如：
   ```yaml
   - id: persona
     name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-persona'
     config:
       text: "你是一个日常事务助理..."
   ```
   将该预设设为 In use。
2. 升级 DSH 到 0.1.5-rc.1（`pnpm add -g @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.5-rc.1` 或 source build）。
3. 启动 `dsh web`，打开任意已有会话，点击「新会话」（+）。

## 期望行为

- 升级时自动迁移用户预设配置中的已重命名字段（`text` → `prefix`），或在 UI 中明确提示"以下预设配置已过时，请手动更新"；
- 若当前激活预设不可用，新会话创建失败时应在 UI 上显示可见错误（含错误码 `persona: $.prefix missing required value`），并提供一键回退到内置默认预设的操作；
- 最坏情况下，不应使 sessionController 不可用导致全部会话操作瘫痪。

## 实际行为

- 点击「新会话」无任何可见反应，界面不变化、不报错、不加载；
- 切模型报错：`模型操作失败：gateway/internal: resume failed for session "…": RemoteError: agent-presets: preset "dailyagent" failed to mount: failed to apply loader entry persona (@deepseek-ai/dsh-persona): invalid config: - $.prefix missing required value (at prefix) (/Users/lion/.dsh/.agent-presets/dailyagent/agent.cordis.yml)`；
- 设置 → 模型页面空白无内容；
- Host 进程初始化后持续高 CPU（~90 秒），最终静默完成后 API 响应极度延迟；
- 仅在浏览器 F12 Console 或 Host stderr 中可见错误，UI 完全静默。

## 代码定位

**服务端（persona 配置 schema 破坏性变更）**

`packages/preset/persona/src/index.ts`：

```typescript
// 旧版（≤0.1.4.x）
Config = z.object({ text: z.string().required() })

// 新版（0.1.5-rc.1）
Config = z.object({ prefix: z.string().required() })
```

无版本迁移逻辑、无 deprecation warning、无 fallback 到旧字段名。

**客户端（静默失败）**

`packages/client/ui-workspace/src/client/navigation.ts:154-172`，`startSession()`：

```typescript
startSession(workspaceId?: WorkspaceId): void {
  // ...
  void this.openWorkspace(target).catch(
    (reason: unknown) => { console.warn('new session failed:', reason) },
  )
}
```

失败分支仅 `console.warn`，UI 无任何反馈。

**预设持久化（重装无法自救）**

自定义 Agent 预设持久化在 `~/.dsh/.agent-presets/`（用户主目录），不在 npm 安装目录下。重装 DSH 后该文件原样保留；只要它仍是 In use 预设，重装完成后新会话依旧全部失败。

**附加问题：llm-pi-ai settings 校验级联故障**

`packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/src/index.ts:298-304`，`validate` 回调在 `registering = false` 后调用 `assertServiceable(value, current())`（strict 模式），当用户 `settings.yaml` 中 `opencode` provider 的 models 缺少 `api` 字段时抛出 `PiAiCatalogError`，导致 llm-pi-ai 命名空间更新失败，可能级联导致 Host 服务初始化卡死。此问题在 npm 包 0.1.5-rc.1 中同样存在。

## 与现有讨论的关系



## 影响

1. **会话操作全面瘫痪**：新会话、切模型、设置-模型页、session resume 全部失效，用户只能通过浏览器 F12 看到错误；
2. **升级即砖**：从 ≤0.1.4.x 升级到 0.1.5-rc.1 后，任何引用 persona 的自定义预设全部失效，In use 预设指向该预设时整个工作区无法创建新会话；
3. **重装无效**：自定义预设持久化在 `~/.dsh/.agent-presets/`，重装 DSH 完全无法修复，用户最常见的自救手段在此失效，只会加深"DSH 本身坏了"的误解；
4. **级联故障**：llm-pi-ai 的 `assertServiceable` strict 模式校验会在 settings 变更时抛异常，导致 Host 初始化卡死（CPU 90%+ 持续 90 秒），加剧 sessionController 不可用；
5. **恢复成本高**：用户需要知道去编辑 `~/.dsh/.agent-presets/dailyagent/agent.cordis.yml` 把 `text` 改成 `prefix`，或切换到内置默认预设，这远超普通用户的排查能力。

## 改进建议

1. **配置字段重命名需版本迁移**：对官方插件的配置 schema 做字段重命名时，提供 `postinstall` 迁移脚本或在 Host 启动时自动修复用户预设文件中的旧字段名，至少输出明确的 deprecation warning；
2. **预设挂载失败时 UI 报错**：新会话失败时在 UI 显示 toast/banner，附 wire 错误码和 message（数据已在响应里，无需新增接口），并提供一键回退到内置默认预设的操作；
3. **升级时校验预设可用性**：在 `dsh` 升级后首次启动时做一次预设 mount 试探（dry-run），不可用则警告用户并阻止设为默认；
4. **llm-pi-ai validate 改用 deferred 模式**：settings 变更时不应因单个 model 配置不全就抛异常中断整个命名空间注册，与注册阶段保持一致用 `resolveProfiles(value.providers, 'deferred')`；
5. **startSession 失败需 UI 反馈**：`navigation.ts` 的 `startSession()` 失败分支应调用全局错误通知机制（toast/error banner），而非仅 `console.warn`。

discussions.title: 【功能建议】Agent Team模式建议加入可以让Lead给teammate指定模型的功能
discussions.body:
今天简单体验了一下实验性的Agent Team模式，在我的应用场景下，相比于传统的subagent，有一定程度上的效率提升。
但在体验中发现无法给teammate指定不同模型。
因为我的应用场景中有让一个或多个teammate执行简单任务的需求，这种时候可以让teammate使用更廉价的模型或者本地模型。
希望未来的版本可以给Agent Team模式加入指定teammate模型的功能。

discussions.title: [Bug] Windows 上「在文件资源管理器中显示」在含中文/非 ASCII 的路径下只打开默认文件夹，不定位文件
discussions.body:
## 环境

- `@deepseek-ai/dsh` **0.1.5-rc.1**（桌面端 `dsh_pkg_tag`: `dsh-0.1.5-rc.1-34455899979`）
- Windows build **26200.9445**，系统 ACP = **936**，语言 zh-Hans
- 入口：收尾交付卡片的「在文件资源管理器中显示」→ `session.openWorkspacePath({ action: "reveal" })`

## 现象

目标路径含中文（或任意非 ASCII 字符）时，点击「在文件资源管理器中显示」只弹出一个资源管理器窗口并停在默认位置（桌面/文档），**既不进入目标目录也不选中文件**。路径为纯 ASCII 时正常。

## 复现

1. 把文件放在含中文的目录，例如 `G:\DSH\本地模型\示例.txt`
2. 用 `present` 声明该文件，在收尾回复的交付卡片上点「在文件资源管理器中显示」
3. 结果：打开桌面（默认文件夹），没有跳到 `本地模型` 目录，也没有选中 `示例.txt`

## 根因

`packages/util/native-command`（构建产物 `lib/index.js` 的 `revealNativePath`）在 Windows 分支把整条路径百分号编码成 file URL：

```js
const target = pathToFileURL(windowsPath, { windows: true }).href.replaceAll(",", "%2C");
await run("explorer.exe", ["/select,", target], signal);
```

`explorer.exe` 对 `/select,` 的参数只按 **ASCII** 解码百分号转义：`%2C` / `%23` / `%25` 能正确还原，而 `%E4%B8%AD`（UTF-8 多字节）解码后不是正确字符，路径不存在，Explorer 便静默回退到默认文件夹。

本机实测（判定方式：`Shell.Application.Windows().Document.FocusedItem.Path`）：

| 传给 `/select,` 的目标形式 | 中文路径 | 含逗号路径 |
|---|---|---|
| 本地路径 `G:\...\a.txt` | ✅ | ❌ 打开桌面（逗号被当分隔符） |
| 整串编码 file URL（现实现） | ❌ 打开桌面 | ✅ |
| file URL + 非 ASCII 原样，仅转义 `%` `,` `#` | ✅ | ✅ |

补充观测：把非 ASCII 字节换成 `%XX` 一律失败（UTF-8 与 GBK 字节都试过，含保留 `.txt` 不编码的对照组）；file URL 里保留非 ASCII 字面字符则成功。说明问题只在「多字节字符被转义」这一点上。

## 建议修复

只转义参数语法需要的字符，其余（含非 ASCII）原样保留：

```js
const slashed = windowsPath.replaceAll("\\", "/");
const url = slashed.startsWith("//") ? `file:${slashed}` : `file:///${slashed}`;
const target = url.replace(/[%,#]/g, (c) => ({ "%": "%25", ",": "%2C", "#": "%23" }[c]));
```

本机按此改法验证：纯 ASCII、含逗号、含中文、中文+空格+逗号四类路径全部正确进入目录并选中文件。

## 影响面

所有非 ASCII 路径（中文用户名 `C:\Users\张三\…`、中文目录、中文文件名）下 reveal 失效，对中文用户几乎必现。`packages/util/native-command/README.md` 当前描述为「Explorer receives an encoded file URI as a separate argument」，与非 ASCII 场景的实际行为不符，建议随修复一并更新。

## 附：判定脚本（复现/验证用）

```powershell
# 点「在文件资源管理器中显示」前后各跑一次，看窗口地址与选中项
(New-Object -ComObject Shell.Application).Windows() |
  ForEach-Object { "$($_.LocationName) | $($_.Document.FocusedItem.Path)" }
```

以上内容均由ds-v41-flash生成

discussions.title: 插话消息请显示是否已读取，并允许在读取前修改或撤回
discussions.body:
## 遇到了什么问题

我使用 DSH Desktop，在 Agent 正在工作时提交插话（steer）。消息提交后，我看不到明确的“未读取”或“刚刚读取”状态，也找不到在它尚未被读取时修改、撤回的入口。

比如刚发完一句补充要求，马上发现写错了，或者想换一种说法。我需要知道：它还在等，还是已经交给模型了？如果还没读取，希望能直接改掉或撤回，而不是只能再发一条纠正，让 Agent 同时面对两条互相冲突的要求。

## 希望的体验

| 消息状态 | 显示什么 | 用户可以做什么 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 已提交，仍在等待处理 | 未读取／等待处理 | 修改、撤回 |
| 已交给模型处理 | 刚刚读取／已读取 | 追加更正；不再承诺能撤回已经进入模型请求的内容 |
| 已成功撤回 | 明确反馈撤回成功 | 确保原消息不会在之后被送给模型 |

- 普通排队消息和 steer 都应能看清当前状态，不要让用户猜。
- 修改、撤回应只影响选中的那条尚未处理的消息，不必停止整个 Agent，也不应清空其他消息。
- 如果点击撤回时消息恰好已经开始处理，请明确告诉用户“已开始处理，无法撤回”，而不是显示撤回成功。
- “已读取”应依据实际送入模型请求的进度，而不是服务器刚接受提交就标为已读。它也不表示模型一定理解或遵循了这条要求。如果系统只能确认消息已被运行时取走，可以如实显示“开始处理”，避免夸大状态含义。

## 为什么反馈到 Harness，而不是只报 Desktop

2026-09-10 核对了 Desktop 的安装包和 Harness 官方 master：

- 本机安装元数据：DSH Desktop 0.7.2；官方 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-chat` 包版本为 0.1.2-alpha.1。
- Desktop 使用的官方 `PendingSteeringBubble` 组件与上游当前处理一致：待处理消息画成普通聊天气泡，没有读取状态标签，也没有修改、撤回操作。
- 上游对应实现：[MessageItem.tsx](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/packages/client/ui-chat/src/client/chat/MessageItem.tsx)。
- 官方已有一份[移除插话标签的设计说明](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/.agents/notes/archived/simplification/2026-08-10-web-remove-steering-interjection-caption.md)，明确记录待处理 steer 与普通已发送气泡外观相同，只有缺少时间显示的区别。

这里并不是要求恢复一个永久的“插话”标签。“这是插话”说明消息类型；“还没读取，可以撤回”说明当前进度和用户还能做什么。消息在对话中的位置无法替代后者。

以上为实际使用反馈与安装代码、上游源码核对；没有另外在干净 Web 环境中运行端到端复现，不将其描述为已完成的跨平台测试。

## 一个简单的验收场景

1. Agent 正在执行一个尚未结束的步骤，用户提交一条 steer。
2. 在这条消息尚未被取走处理时，界面持续显示“未读取／等待处理”。
3. 用户能修改它，之后模型只收到修改后的内容；或者撤回它，之后模型不再收到这条内容。
4. 如果未修改或撤回，消息交给模型处理后，状态随真实进度更新。
5. 操作过程中，Agent 原来正在做的事情和其他排队消息不受影响。

## 相关讨论

[#4631](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/4631) 讨论的是发给子 Agent 的消息队列查看、删除和排序。本条侧重用户在聊天界面提交 steer 后的读取状态与读取前修改、撤回体验。

希望作为官方 Web 聊天组件的通用体验支持，让使用该组件的 Desktop 也能受益。如果已有可用入口或设置，也请指出。

discussions.title: [BUG] 0.1.5-rc.1 会话历史永久无法加载:v0→v1 拒绝已发布的 v0 形状(permission/preset 带 origin)
discussions.body:
## English TL;DR

`@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-format-v0-to-v1` refuses a **released** v0 payload shape, which makes the affected sessions permanently unopenable. Some earlier 0.1.x build wrote the session's **first** `permission/preset` event as `{"preset":"workspace-write","origin":"default"}`, but the frozen v0 inventory declares only `preset`:

`packages/session/session-format-v0-to-v1/src/dispositions.ts:76`
```ts
'permission/preset': disposition(['preset']),
```

`assertReleasedEventPayload()` → `assertReleasedV0Keys()` then throws `has unexpected member "origin"`. The migration leaves the source artifact unchanged (by design), so retrying never helps and there is no self-heal: that session's history cannot be loaded again.

Suggested one-line fix — declare the member instead of rejecting the session:

```diff
-  'permission/preset': disposition(['preset']),
+  'permission/preset': disposition(['preset'], ['origin']),
```

`dispositions.ts` states that every listed member is preserved by the identity edge, and `origin` is a member that really was released, so admitting it matches the existing contract. (Dropping it in the migration would also be fine, but that has to be an explicit decision, not a side effect of strict validation killing the whole session.)

## 错误信息

```
历史加载失败：failed to observe session "session-<id>": @deepseek-ai/dsh-session-format-v0-to-v1 refuses this format v0 Session: permission/preset 0 data has unexpected member "origin"; source v0 artifact remains unchanged (raw log: …/session.jsonl.zstd)
```

## 最小复现

不需要真实会话,直接调用迁移包自己的校验函数即可复现:

```js
import {
  assertReleasedEventPayload,
  RELEASED_V0_EVENT_DISPOSITIONS,
} from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-format-v0-to-v1'

// 受影响会话里 seq=0 的那个事件(会话的第一个事件),逐字取自真实文件
assertReleasedEventPayload(
  { type: 'permission/preset', seq: 0, time: 1, data: { preset: 'workspace-write', origin: 'default' } },
  0,
)
// => SessionFormatError: permission/preset 0 data has unexpected member "origin"

// 当前写入方产出的同一事件则被接受
assertReleasedEventPayload(
  { type: 'permission/preset', seq: 0, time: 1, data: { preset: 'workspace-write' } },
  0,
)
// => ok

RELEASED_V0_EVENT_DISPOSITIONS['permission/preset']
// => { required: ['preset'], optional: [], opaque: [] }
```

## 证据:`origin` 是"已发布的真实数据",不是文件损坏

对一个 13.1 MB / 35,916 帧 / 46,969 事件的会话逐帧解压后统计:

- 整个会话里**只有一个**事件的 `data` 带 `origin` —— `permission/preset`,`seq = 0`(会话的第一个事件),值 `"default"`;
- 同一会话另外 3 个 `permission/preset` 事件都是 `{"preset":"…"}`,**没有** `origin`;
- 逐事件对照冻结布局表:**missing required = 0**;唯一的 unexpected member 就是这一处;
- 扫本机全部 **55 个会话,只有 2 个**带这个形状 → 写入方在某个版本之后不再写 `origin`,而更早写下的会话永久无法加载;
- 对照:能正常加载的会话,同一事件一律是 `{"preset":"workspace-write"}`。

> 附带说明(避免误判):`text-chunks` / `reasoning-chunks` / `tool-call-chunks` 不在冻结表里,但它们由 codec 的 `PACKED_TAGS` 分支走 `decodePackedRun`,**不会**经过 `assertReleasedEventPayload`;健康会话同样含这些类型。把它们也丢进该校验会产生数千条假违规,分析时要注意。

## 影响

任何由受影响版本创建、且该事件带 `origin` 的 v0 会话**永远打不开**。迁移按设计不改动源文件,所以重试、重启、升级都不会自愈,用户侧没有任何恢复手段。这类会话可能不止一个,而且往往是最大的那几个(长期使用的会话)。

## 环境

- DSH `0.1.5-rc.1`(`@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-format-v0-to-v1` 版本同为 `0.1.5-rc.1`)
- Windows 10.0.26200 · Node v24.15.0
- 会话为更早的 0.1.x 版本所创建(v0 格式,`session.jsonl.zstd` 拼接帧容器)

## 备注

如果需要,我可以提供一个**脱敏的最小 v0 作品**(header + 该事件,拼接帧容器,含 content checksum)作为测试夹具,或按你们的规范补一个 `tests/` 用例。本机已用"只重写含该事件的那一帧、其余帧逐字节保留"的方式验证过:修复后 6 项断言(帧数/逐帧校验和/事件数/零违规/仅目标帧变化/违规字段消失)全部通过 —— 也就是说数据侧没有其它障碍,补声明后这些会话即可加载。

discussions.title: [BUG] 行尾处理：read 把「仅 CR 换行」的文件算成 1 行；edit 把「首 4KB 无换行」的 CRLF 文件整份改写成 LF
discussions.body:
> 环境：`dsh` **0.1.5-rc.1**（Windows + PowerShell 7）；涉及包 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-fs@0.1.5-rc.1`、`@deepseek-ai/dsh-fs-local@0.1.5-rc.1`。
> 两个问题都出在行尾（line ending）处理上，均实测可复现。

---

## 问题 1：仅用 CR（`\r`）换行的文件，read 只算 1 行

### 复现

```bash
# 3 行，行分隔符是单独的 CR（不是 CRLF）
printf 'l1\rl2\rl3' > cr-only.txt      # 8 字节，CR=2 LF=0
```

read 工具输出：

```
1: l1l2l3

(End of file - total 1 lines)
```

真实行数是 3（`[IO.File]::ReadAllLines().Count` = 3、`Get-Content .Count` = 3）：三行被拼成一行，中间的裸 CR 字节直接混进了模型可见文本。

### 连带影响

- **`offset` 失效**：`read cr-only.txt offset=2` → `Error: offset 2 is out of range for "cr-only.txt" (1 lines)`，第 2、3 行无法寻址。
- **read 的视图喂不进 edit**：把 read 输出的两行（`l1\nl2`）当 `old_string` → `Error: old_string was not found`（文件里是 `\r` 不是 `\n`）。读到的视图和编辑的匹配口径不一致。
- 只看 read 输出的调用方会误判「这个文件只有 1 行」，据此做截断/覆盖判断就会出错。

### 根因（两处叠加）

1. `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-fs`：切行只认 `\n`，`stripCarriageReturn()` 只删**行尾**那个 `\r`（服务 CRLF，不服务 CR）：

```js
while ((newlinePos = chunk.indexOf("\n", startPos)) !== -1) { /* flush */ }
function stripCarriageReturn(line) {
  return line.endsWith("\r") ? line.slice(0, -1) : line;
}
```

2. `@deepseek-ai/dsh-fs-local`：`normalizeLineEndings()` 只折叠 CRLF，注释里也写明 lone CR 原样保留：

```js
/** Collapse CRLF to LF ... Lone `\r` bytes (not followed by `\n`) are left untouched. */
function normalizeLineEndings(content) { return content.replaceAll("\r\n", "\n"); }
```

下游一律按 `split("\n")` / `indexOf("\n")` 处理，于是 CR-only 文件永远只有「一行」。

### 建议

把 lone CR 也当换行终止符：`content.replaceAll("\r\n", "\n").replaceAll("\r", "\n")`，或统一按 `/\r\n|\r|\n/` 切分。CR-only 是经典 Mac OS（≤9）和部分老工具导出文件的合法换行形式；Python `str.splitlines()`、Node `readline`、`git` 都把它当换行处理。

---

## 问题 2：edit 会把「前 4096 字节内没有换行」的 CRLF 文件整份改成 LF

### 复现

```powershell
# 纯 CRLF 三行，首行 5000 字节
$s = ('A' * 5000) + "`r`n" + "second`r`n" + "third`r`n"
[IO.File]::WriteAllText('crlf-longline.txt', $s, (New-Object Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))
# 5017 字节，CR=3 LF=3
```

`read` 正常（`total 3 lines`），随后用 edit 把 `third` 改成 `THIRD`，磁盘字节变成：

```
after edit: bytes=5014 CR=0 LF=3     ← 3 个 CR 全部消失，整份文件被改成 LF
```

对照实验（同样 CRLF，但首行很短）：edit 后 `CR=2` 保持不变 → 变量确实就是「**前 4096 字节里有没有换行**」。

### 根因

`detectLineEndings()` 只看前 4096 字节采样：

```js
function detectLineEndings(raw) {
  const sample = raw.slice(0, 4096);
  const crlfCount = sample.split("\r\n").length - 1;
  return crlfCount > sample.split("\n").length - 1 - crlfCount ? "CRLF" : "LF";
}
```

采样区间内没有换行 → `crlfCount = 0`、`lfCount = 0` → 判成 `"LF"` → 写回时 `restoreLineEndings(content, "LF")` 原样返回、不再补 `\r`，于是全文件的 `\r\n` 变成 `\n`。

首行超过 4 KB 并不罕见（压缩过的 JS/JSON、单行 CSV、生成代码），而这个改写是**静默**的：git 里表现为整文件 diff，开 `core.autocrlf=false` 的仓库与依赖 CRLF 的 Windows 工具链都会受影响。

### 建议

`detectLineEndings()` 不要用固定 4 KB 采样：至少扫到第一个换行为止（或全文件统计）；无法判定时保持原字节不变（写回不改行尾）。

---

## 已实测「不是问题」的部分

- CR-only 文件经 `edit` 写回后 CR 仍在（`CR=2` 保持不变）→ 问题 1 只在读侧，不破坏文件内容；真正改字节的是问题 2。

（问题 1 的代码在 `packages/fs/tool-fs` 的 `buildWindow` / `stripCarriageReturn`；问题 2 在 `packages/fs/fs-local` 的 `normalizeLineEndings` / `detectLineEndings`，路径按各包 `package.json` 的 `repository.directory`。）

discussions.title: dsh-skills-anywhere: live skill provider — 60+ agents' skill dirs, Claude Code marketplaces, and any git skill repo, zero copies / 零拷贝接入其他 Agent 与 git 仓库的技能
discussions.body:
> Unofficial community plugin, independently developed and maintained (co-developed with AI). / 非官方项目，由社区成员独立开发维护（与 AI 结对开发）。

**Repo:** https://github.com/noteflowai/dsh-skills-anywhere · MIT · `dsh-plugin`

**English** · 中文在下方

## What it does

You already have skills in `~/.claude/skills`, `~/.codex/skills`, `~/.cursor/skills`, inside Claude Code plugin marketplaces, and in repos like `anthropics/skills`. dsh only scans `.dsh/skills` and `.agents/skills`.

`dsh-skills-anywhere` registers one extra provider on the built-in `ctx.skills` registry. The model keeps its normal `skill` tool and `/name` invocation; it just sees more skills:

- **60+ other agents' skill directories** (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Copilot, Windsurf, Kiro, Goose, OpenCode, Roo, Cline, Qwen Code, Trae, ...), project-level and user-level.
- **Claude Code plugin marketplaces**: the skills nested in `~/.claude/plugins/marketplaces/*/plugins/*/skills/*`.
- **Any git repository of skills**: `owner/repo`, sub-directory, branch, tag, commit, or GitHub tree URL. Shallow-cloned into a cache, refreshed in the background, pinned in a lock file.
- **Zero copies, zero symlinks.** Files are read where they live and re-read on every load, so an edit in Cursor shows up in dsh immediately.

It also dedupes symlinked/identical installs, repairs common frontmatter drift instead of dropping the skill, and renames colliding names (three plugins each shipping `configure`) so every skill stays reachable. `disable-model-invocation` / `user-invocable` are honoured.

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:noteflowai/dsh-skills-anywhere   # npm publish pending
npx dsh-skills-anywhere list        # what the model will see, without booting dsh
npx dsh-skills-anywhere add anthropics/skills
npx dsh-skills-anywhere doctor      # repaired / skipped / renamed / duplicate skills, with reasons
```

## How it integrates with dsh

- Pure official extension point: `ctx.skills.registerProvider()` from `@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill`. No UI, no routes, no changes to the shipped `dsh-skill-filesystem` / `dsh-tool-skill` rows.
- Ranks sit above the built-in roots (project 250, user 550, marketplaces 580, git sources 700), so a skill you wrote for dsh always wins a duplicate name.
- Catalog invalidation through `SkillProviderControl.invalidate()` on filesystem changes and completed syncs; dsh never waits on the network.
- Tested against the real `@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill` registry and real git repos (83 tests), and verified in a `dsh --profile web` boot on 0.1.5-rc.1.

Feedback, missing agents, and edge-case `SKILL.md` files are very welcome.

---

## 中文

你的技能已经分散在 `~/.claude/skills`、`~/.codex/skills`、`~/.cursor/skills`、Claude Code 插件市场以及 `anthropics/skills` 这类仓库里，而 dsh 只扫描 `.dsh/skills` 和 `.agents/skills`。

`dsh-skills-anywhere` 在内置 `ctx.skills` 注册表上多注册一个提供器。模型原有的 `skill` 工具和 `/name` 调用不变，只是能看到更多技能：

- **60+ 个其他 Agent 的技能目录**（Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、Gemini CLI、Copilot、Windsurf、Kiro、Goose、OpenCode、Roo、Cline、Qwen Code、Trae……），项目级与用户级。
- **Claude Code 插件市场**：`~/.claude/plugins/marketplaces/*/plugins/*/skills/*` 中嵌套的技能。
- **任意 git 技能仓库**：`owner/repo`、子目录、分支、标签、提交或 GitHub tree URL；浅克隆到缓存，后台刷新，lock 文件锁定。
- **零拷贝、零软链接。** 文件在哪就从哪读，每次加载重新读取；在 Cursor 里改完 dsh 立刻可见。

同时自动去重软链接/相同副本、修复常见 frontmatter 偏差、处理同名冲突（多个插件都带 `configure`），并遵守 `disable-model-invocation` / `user-invocable`。

**与 dsh 的集成方式：** 纯官方扩展点 `ctx.skills.registerProvider()`，零 UI、零路由，不改动自带的 skill 行；rank 位于内置根之后，你为 dsh 写的技能永远优先；通过 `invalidate()` 在文件变化和同步完成时刷新目录，从不阻塞在网络上。83 个测试直接跑在真实的 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill` 注册表上，并在 0.1.5-rc.1 的 `dsh --profile web` 中验证通过。

欢迎反馈、补充 Agent 目录，以及各种奇怪的 `SKILL.md` 边界情况。

discussions.title: session-format-v0-to-v1 converter refuses loadable v0 sessions over cosmetic fields (history load breaks after upgrade to 0.1.5-rc.1)
discussions.body:
## Environment
- Upgrade path: `@deepseek-ai/dsh` 0.1.2-rc.1 → 0.1.5-rc.1 (web profile)
- OS: Windows 11, Node 24.18
- Real production sessions (weeks of multi-agent work, 40+ subagents each)

## Symptom
After upgrading, opening any pre-upgrade session fails to load history:

```
failed to observe session "session-...": @deepseek-ai/dsh-session-format-v0-to-v1
refuses this format v0 Session: user/message 22 source summary requires notice form
(source v0 artifact remains unchanged)
```

The raw v0 artifact is untouched — the user simply loses all in-UI access to weeks of work after upgrading.

## Two distinct refusal triggers found (real sessions, both reproduced)
1. **`user/message` notice source carries `summary` but `form != "notice"`**
   → throws `summary requires notice form`.
   The `summary` is display metadata only; the session content does not depend on it.
2. **`permission/preset` data carries an extra `origin` key**
   → throws `has unexpected member "origin"` (the released-v0-keys table for `permission/preset` admits only `preset`).

## Why this hurts
A read-path converter failing closed on cosmetic/display fields means **every 0.1.2-era session becomes inaccessible after a routine upgrade**. In our case two main working sessions (430K+ tokens, 40+ subagents of history) were blocked.

## Suggestion
Tolerate-and-coerce on the read path instead of refusing:
- stray `summary` on a non-notice form → drop the field (metadata only)
- `permission/preset` data → admit `origin` as an optional key

## Local workaround confirmed
Coercing both cases (delete stray summary / admit optional origin) restores full history load on 0.1.5-rc.1 — verified against real affected sessions.

discussions.title: Slash autocomplete lists skill catalog entries but not plugin-registered host commands (e.g. /room)
discussions.body:
## Environment
- @deepseek-ai/dsh 0.1.5-rc.1, web profile, Node 24, Windows 11
- A plugin registers a host command: `ctx.get("commands").register({ name: "room", description: "...", input: { hint: "[create <name>|join <roomId>|..." } })` (verified present in the plugin source — dsh-background-agents)

## Symptom
Typing `/` in the web composer lists skill-catalog entries (62 items) but **not** the plugin-registered host command `/room`. The command still executes when the full text is typed and submitted — only the autocomplete/suggestion list omits it.

## Expectation
Host-side plugin commands registered via the commands API should appear in the slash trigger list alongside skills (or at least be documented as intentionally excluded).

## Impact
Discoverability: users cannot discover plugin commands from the UI; they work only when typed in full.

discussions.title: [BUG] dsh web 启动到打印 URL 约 18s，其中约 9.3s 来自 client-modules 每次启动重复 8 次全量重建组合包
discussions.body:
## 环境

- dsh `0.1.5-rc.1`（npm 全局安装）、node v26.7.0、Windows
- profile：默认 `web`（安装目录：`<npm-global>/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh`）

## 现象

`dsh web` 从执行到打印 `dsh web: http://127.0.0.1:...` 需要 **17–20 s（热缓存）**；重启后首次（冷缓存）实测 **34 s / 56 s**。

## 根因：`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-modules` 一次启动把组合包重建了 8 次

用 `NODE_OPTIONS` 注入预载模块统计 `compose()`，实测**一次启动执行 8 次**（t≈4.9 / 5.0 / 6.4 / 7.8 / 9.7 / 12.4 / 14.6 / 16.9 s）：

- 构造期先对**空表** `compose()` 一次，随后 `flush()` 再组合一次；
- 之后每个 client 插件激活都会触发一次 `queueMicrotask` flush，脏集每变化一次就**全量重建**。

每次 `compose()` 的输入与代价：

- 65 个 `client.js` 共 **10.66 MB**；其中 `dsh-client-ui-sidebar-documentpreview/lib/client.js` 单文件 **6.89 MB（内联 PDF.js，占 65%）**；
- 发布包内**没有任何 `.map`**，因此每个包都走 `identitySectionMap()`：`newlineCount()` 用 `for (const char of value)` **逐字符**遍历（合计 129,526 行），再用 `Array.from({ length }).join(';')` 生成逐行 mappings，并把**整份源码放进 `sourcesContent`**（生成的 map JSON 约 12 MB）；
- 除批次组合包外，还对**每个 record 单独 `buildCombo([record])` 一次**（又处理约 22.7 MB），而浏览器正常启动只请求批次 URL；
- `buildCombo()` 先把 10.7 MB 拼成一个大字符串再 `Buffer.from()`。

CPU profile（19.3 s 采样窗口）自耗时：

| 位置 | 自耗时 |
|---|---|
| `buildCombo` | 2,991 ms |
| `newlineCount` | 2,122 ms |
| `identitySectionMap` | 1,875 ms |
| `utf8Write`（大字符串 → Buffer） | 2,284 ms |
| **合计** | **≈9.3 s（约占整个启动 48%）** |

对照：把同等工作量在**同一台机器上单独跑一遍只要 0.93 s** —— 这 9.3 s 主要是重复劳动，不是机器慢。

## 复现与测量方法

1. **统计 `compose()` 次数**：用 `NODE_OPTIONS` 注入一个 `data:text/javascript` 预载模块，通过 `module.registerHooks()` 的 `load` hook 重写 `dsh-client-modules/lib/index.js`，把 `compose() {` 替换为带计数器与时间戳的版本：

   ```powershell
   $probe = 'import { registerHooks } from "node:module";
   registerHooks({ load(url, ctx, next) {
     const out = next(url, ctx)
     if (typeof url === "string" && url.includes("dsh-client-modules/lib/index.js")) {
       const src = out.source.toString().replace("compose() {",
         "compose() { console.error(\"[compose] t=\"+Math.round(performance.now()));")
       return { ...out, source: src }
     }
     return out
   } })'
   $env:NODE_OPTIONS = "--import=data:text/javascript," + [uri]::EscapeDataString($probe)
   node <npm-global>/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh/lib/bin.js web --no-open --port 0
   ```

2. **定位耗时**：`node --cpu-prof --cpu-prof-dir <dir> .../lib/bin.js web --no-open --port 0`，再把 `.cpuprofile` 按 callFrame 聚合自耗时。
3. **端到端对照**：切换新旧实现各启动一次，抓取 `/plugins/??...&rev=...` 批次 URL 与单包 URL（含 `.map`）的 sha1 与 `rev`。

## 建议的修复（已在本地验证）

1. `newlineCount()` 改用 `indexOf('\n', i + 1)` 循环；
2. `identitySectionMap()` 的 mappings 用 `';AACA'.repeat(lines - 1)` 生成，去掉 `Array.from`；
3. `compose()` 不再对每个 record 立即 `buildCombo`，改为**首次请求该 URL 时按 rev 记忆化生成**（新增 `recordArtifact()`，响应体改为惰性 `build()`）；
4. 激活期只组合一次：构造期同步扫描后 `compose()` 一次，`internal/plugin` 的延迟 flush 由**微任务改为宏任务合并**，一次激活突发只重算一次（8 → 2）；
5. `buildCombo()` 用 `Buffer.concat` 组装脚本，避免 10.7 MB 字符串中转。

实测（同一台机器，热缓存）：

| | 修复前 | 修复后 |
|---|---|---|
| `compose()` 次数 | 8 | **2** |
| 到打印 URL | 17.0 s / 18.3 s | **8.2 s / 9.4 s** |
| 批次 / 单包 / `.map` 字节 | — | **sha1 与 rev 完全一致** |

验证：`packages/client/modules` 测试 **82/82 通过**（含新增的「一次激活突发只重算一次」回归测试）、`tsc -b` 通过、`oxlint` 0 警告 0 错误、`tsdown` 打包成功。第 4 点改变了 flush 的粒度，原来的 `microtask` 契约与 README/注释已同步更新，并调整了一个等待微任务的既有测试。

> 补：仓库 PR 与 Issues 均已关闭（CONTRIBUTING 也说明暂不接受外部 PR），因此在此反馈。


<details>
