discussions.title: Bug/Design: approveEscalation 在 effectiveMode 为 danger-full-access 时拒绝同级/降级升级导致模型死锁循环
list_agents: carry a last-activity age per child — bare [running] is indistinguishable from a stalled child
discussions.body:
## The problem

A background subagent (continuable child) emits nothing to its parent between dispatch and final message — by design, and fine. But it means the parent's entire liveness view is `list_agents`' status word plus `job_output`'s `(no new output)`:

```
47f0d3fa-… [running] — Review bin script diff
```
```
(no new output)
[status: running]
```

**These are exactly what a healthy, working child looks like. They are also exactly what a stalled child looks like.** The model on the parent seat has no data to tell the two apart — and in practice it fills the gap with fabricated elapsed times.

## A real incident (2026-09-10)

A manager session dispatched three cross-family review children. Reconstructed afterward from the children's own session transcripts:

| Child | What the transcript shows | What the parent believed |
|---|---|---|
| glm-5.3-flash @ max | 19 steps over **3m55s**, every tool call answered | "has run **~28 minutes** with no report" — killed |
| gemini-3.8-flash | worked continuously for **10m40s**; last assistant message written the same second the `job_kill` landed | "ran **~15 min** without returning" — killed |
| gemini-3.8-flash | 8 steps in **47s**, every tool call answered | "no output before interrupt" — killed at 47s |

Every `turn/end` reads `aborted by parent`. Worse, the kills were self-fulfilling: interrupting a child mid-generation persists only the reasoning block, so all three kills produced an *empty closing message* that was then cited as further evidence of hanging. Every hypothesis the parent recorded (approval-prompt parking, provider outage, background-turn bug) was disproven by the transcripts. The root cause: a parent model judging liveness without a liveness signal.

## Proposal

Give `list_agents` rows a last-activity age, so *running and progressing* and *running and stalled* are one glance apart:

```
60a47bc3-… [running] last-event=16s ago — Liveness probe child
```

The runtime already has the data — every session event carries a timestamp. Two shapes we can see:

1. **Native (preferred):** the subagent service's `listChildren`/`listDescendants` rows add `lastActivity` (epoch ms of the child's most recent session event — live children: last log event; cold observation: last observed event; projection-cache hit: omit), and the `list_agents` render surfaces it humanized. Roughly 30 lines across `dsh-subagent` and `dsh-tool-subagent-control`; the tool description should also teach the semantics (fresh = progressing, stale = last step hasn't returned).
2. **Out-of-tree stopgap we shipped meanwhile:** a small plugin listening to `session/event` (per-session last-append map) plus a `tools/post-execute` waterfall that rewrites `list_agents` content lines. Works unmodified on 0.1.5-rc.1.

## Impact

Any workflow that dispatches background workers — reviews, research fan-out, long builds — hits the same decision point: *kill or wait?* Guessing wrong either throws away a child's completed work (the incident above lost ~15 minutes of finished review across three children) or parks the parent on a genuinely dead child. A per-row age turns a vibe call into a data read.

Happy to send the native change as a PR if the direction is welcome.

discussions.title: Bug: Web GUI file preview shows "file resource service unavailable" on Chromium <= 125 — protocolOf() relies on WHATWG URL host parsing for a non-special scheme
Bug: reasoning-only completions are reported as successful - the EMPTY_RESPONSE guard tests order.length, which counts the reasoning block
discussions.body:
## Summary

A provider completion that contains **only `reasoning_content`** and ends with `stop` is reported as a **successful** turn. No assistant text block and no tool call are produced, so the turn terminates with no visible output, no error, and no retry.

From the user side this looks like the model "thinking halfway and then stopping". The session log records `turn/end` with `reason.kind = "completed"`.

## Root cause

`@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-deepseek/lib/index.js` — the `translate()` consumer:

```js
// L1216-1224 — every opened block is pushed into `order`
function open(kind) {
    const block = { index: nextIndex++, kind, text: "" };
    order.push(block);
    return block;
}
```

```js
// L1239 — the degeneracy guard tests order.length
reason: reason.kind === "stop" && order.length === 0 ? {
    kind: "error",
    failure: {
        message: "model returned a completed response with no content",
        code: EMPTY_RESPONSE_CODE
    }
} : reason
```

```js
// L1258-1260 — a reasoning block is opened through the very same open()
const reasoning = delta?.reasoning_content;
if (typeof reasoning === "string" && reasoning.length > 0) {
    if (!reasoningBlock) {
        reasoningBlock = open("reasoning");   // <- order.push(), so order.length >= 1
```

So as soon as the model emits **any** `reasoning_content`, `order.length >= 1` for the remainder of the stream, and the `EMPTY_RESPONSE` branch at L1239 can never be taken. A genuine degenerate completion — reasoning only, no text, no tool call — is forwarded as a normal `stop`.

The JSDoc immediately above states the intended contract:

> A `stop` (or absent) finish with no opened blocks is a degenerate provider completion and maps to an `EMPTY_RESPONSE` error finish instead of a successful empty message.

The intent is correct; the predicate merely counts a block kind that must not count as content.

## A correct predicate already exists elsewhere in the codebase

`@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm/lib/index.js`:

- L1351 — `function assistantStreamHasVisibleText(stream)`
- L1378 (JSDoc) — *"Every streamed text-delta fragment joined in stream order; **reasoning and Tool-call fragments are excluded**."*

`dsh-llm` therefore already defines "visible" as text-only and explicitly excludes reasoning. The DeepSeek adapter's degeneracy guard uses `order.length` instead, so the two definitions disagree on whether a reasoning block is content.

## Suggested fix

Test for the absence of *visible* content rather than the absence of *any* block:

```js
const hasVisible = order.some((b) => b.kind === "text" || b.kind === "tool");
reason: reason.kind === "stop" && !hasVisible ? { /* EMPTY_RESPONSE */ } : reason
```

or reuse the `assistantStreamHasVisibleText` definition. Note that **reasoning followed by a tool call is a legitimate completion** and must not be classified as empty.

## Evidence from a local session log

Read-only inspection of `session.jsonl.zstd` (5.12 MB compressed → 21 MB, 4564 events); metadata only, no prompts, tool arguments, or tool outputs.

- The failure rate is not uniform within the session, but the split is **by model, not by reasoning effort**. The session's 27 `request/header` snapshots show `reasoningEffort: max` and `maxTokens: 65536` on **every** request — neither value ever changed:

  | model | turns | affected turns |
  | --- | --- | --- |
  | `deepseek-v4.1-flash-expires-on-0910` | 1-28 | **0** |
  | `deepseek-flash` | 29-51 | **7** (30.4%) |

  The model was swapped at 21:44 when the older, date-limited experimental model reached its expiry date. Two `model/selection` records three seconds apart (21:43:51 `high`, 21:43:54 `max`) are easy to misread as a settings change, but they are the new model's default being written and then immediately overridden: the first request on the new model already carries `max`.

  All 7 affected turns fall in the latter part of the new model's run (37-51); turns 29-36 on the same model were clean. So the model change is an aggravating factor, not the defect itself — it raises how often the model emits reasoning-only completions, while the guard predicate is what converts that into a silent success. The defect is upstream of any particular model or effort setting.

- For each of the 7 affected turns, per-turn `output_tokens` **equals** `reasoning_tokens`. No text tokens were billed at all — consistent with reasoning-only output.

- All 7 turns ended with `reason.kind = "stop"`. There is no `chunk.reason === "length"` anywhere in the session, and the largest single output was 11,214 tokens against a 65,536 budget — output truncation is excluded.

- No `llm/retry` event was emitted for any of the 7 turns. Because the finish surfaced as `stop` rather than `EMPTY_RESPONSE`, the retry policy never saw an empty-response failure it could act on.

- In at least one affected turn the model had already composed the next tool invocation in its reasoning but stopped before emitting it; the reasoning text is present in the log while the tool call is absent.

## Attempted workarounds

Attempts were made at two levels before the defect was isolated. None resolved the symptom, which is itself consistent with the root cause: **no caller-side setting can help, because the degenerate completion is never classified as a failure in the first place.**

### Configuration level

| attempt | change | observed effect |
| --- | --- | --- |
| raise the output budget, in case completions were being cut off | `maxTokens` `32768` -> `65536` | no change. The largest observed completion in the session is 11,214 tokens, so the budget was never the binding constraint |
| switch provider / model preset | provider and model preset changed | no change to the failure mode |
| swap the default model | `deepseek-v4.1-flash-expires-on-0910` -> `deepseek-flash` at 21:44, because the former carries its expiry date in its own name | **0 / 28 turns -> 7 / 23 turns.** The replacement model emits reasoning-only completions far more often, so the defect went from invisible to frequent |

A note on `reasoningEffort`, since it is the obvious suspect: it was **not** varied. It is `max` on every `request/header` snapshot in the session. Raising it is not a fix, and the model swap above is not evidence of a model-specific bug either — the guard predicate is wrong for *any* model that can open a reasoning block and then stop.

### Process level

The affected work consisted of long, multi-step tool chains, which is the shape that triggers the symptom most often. These measures were adopted while the defect was still unexplained:

| measure | intent | observed effect |
| --- | --- | --- |
| externalise the plan into a standing execution document - roadmap, a single progress ledger, enumerated decision points, and per-step confirmation | cut one long autonomous chain into short, explicitly confirmed segments | fewer long chains, hence fewer opportunities to hit the defect; it never removed it |
| register the work as a tracked goal object with a round cap | bound how far a single run can drift before control returns to the user | same |
| drive progress through short follow-up turns | re-enter after each step rather than one long run | each re-entry is a fresh completion, which sidesteps a stalled one |

These reduced exposure but did not eliminate it — every affected turn (37 through 51) occurred while the process measures were already in place. That is the strongest argument for fixing the classification in the adapter rather than expecting callers to work around it.

Also ruled out by direct inspection of the session log (4,564 events):

- **output truncation** - no `chunk.reason === "length"` anywhere in the session; the largest single output was 11,214 tokens against a 65,536 budget.
- **transport / rate-limit failures** - the only three `llm/retry` events in the session predate the affected range and belong to an unrelated older model configuration.
- **context-window exhaustion** - the window is 1,000,000 tokens and 41 `compaction/prune` events ran normally.
- **a second, concurrent client instance** - process inspection found exactly one client process running.

## Local workaround

A small out-of-tree plugin (`dsh-llm-empty-guard`) resolves the symptom on the affected installation **without patching the provider package**. It is included here as evidence that the defect is addressable at the adapter boundary, and in case it helps anyone else hitting the same symptom.

**Design - delegate, do not reimplement**

The plugin deliberately does **not** implement retry logic. `EMPTY_RESPONSE` is already the first entry of `DEFAULT_RETRYABLE_CODES` in `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm`, and the stock policy (5 attempts, exponential backoff) already handles it correctly. The only thing missing is that the failure is never *raised*.

So the plugin does exactly one thing - in the `llm/stream` waterfall it rewrites a reasoning-only `stop` finish into the `EMPTY_RESPONSE` finish the adapter should have emitted, yields the rewritten chunk, and lets the stock retry path do the rest:

```js
if (shouldRewrite(chunk, productive, reasoningChars, config.minReasoningChars)) {
    yield emptyResponseFinish(chunk);   // the only behavioural change
    continue;
}
yield chunk;
```

**Why it does not misfire**

- The decision is taken on the **terminal chunk** only, so a stream that emits reasoning and *then* text or a tool call is never touched.
- Visibility is decided with the harness's own `chunkHasVisibleText` rather than a third, private notion of "content" - deliberately avoiding a repeat of the two-definitions disagreement described above.
- Non-agent-loop streams pass through untouched.

**Verification** - 27/27 assertions pass across unit and waterfall-integration tests. The integration harness drives the real waterfall against a stubbed downstream and asserts the four critical paths: reasoning-only -> rewritten to `EMPTY_RESPONSE`; reasoning-then-text -> untouched; reasoning-then-tool-call -> untouched; non-agent-loop stream -> untouched.
## Expected behavior

Either:

1. a reasoning-only `stop` maps to `EMPTY_RESPONSE` and therefore enters the normal empty-response retry path, or
2. the turn is resumed/continued rather than recorded as a successful completion with no visible output.

## Environment

- **OS: Windows 10 Home (Chinese), 22H2, build 10.0.19045** - this corrects the original report, which said Windows 11. The defect reproduces on Windows 10.
- Node.js: v24.18.1
- CLI: `@deepseek-ai/dsh` **0.1.5-rc.1**
- provider / model: `deepseek-official` / `deepseek-flash`
- `reasoningEffort`: `max` when observed

discussions.title: [Bug] 会话 token 计数不含 teammates：一次 Agent Teams 运行实测低估 2.3×（17.8M vs 41.1M）
discussions.body:
**[Bug] Web GUI 会话 token 计数不含 teammates/子代理 — 一次 Agent Teams 运行实测低估 2.3×**

English below; 中文摘要见文末。

### Environment

- DSH from `master` at `c291e7961a` (0.1.5-rc.2 tip), Linux, `dsh web`.
- Session: `session-7a919d6c-0296-44b6-9743-289d1eaf9776` (workspace `/home/ztmdsbt/workspaces`, title 并行探测各项目代码行数), an Agent Teams run with one lead plus five `origin: 'subagent'` teammates (4 probers + 1 verifier).
- Surface: the composer stats strip (`conversation.composer.dock` → `StatsPills`), "Token 用量" pill and dialog.

### Summary

The composer strip's token pill reads only the current Session's durable `tokenUsage` projection, which folds that Session's own log. Teammate Sessions are separate durable Sessions (their own `tokenUsage` projections), and nothing adds them to the run's headline, so the counter reports the lead's usage while a team run costs substantially more.

### Measured, from the durable Session logs

Per-Session `tokenUsage` buckets (uncached input + cache read + cache write + output), i.e. exactly what the pill's headline sums:

| Session | Role | Durable token total |
| --- | --- | ---: |
| `session-7a919d6c…` | lead | 17,835,441 |
| `7abe70c3…` | prober | 1,015,903 |
| `5ee26b91…` | prober | 989,243 |
| `e21275e6…` | prober | 1,036,142 |
| `d4cc4642…` | prober | 956,935 |
| `2a0a0060…` | verifier | 19,273,656 |
| **team total** | | **41,107,320** |

The pill shows 17.8M tok; the run consumed 41.1M tok. The verifier teammate alone outspends the lead.

### Root cause

- `packages/llm/token-meter/src/usage-projection.ts` registers the `tokenUsage` projection: its `apply` folds one Session log. `TokenMeter` keeps one replay fold per Session (`packages/llm/token-meter/src/index.ts`, `_sync(session)`), and child Sessions are separate Sessions.
- `packages/client/ui-chat/src/client/chat/StatsPills.tsx` reads `useProjection('tokenUsage')` for the current Session only; no consumer aggregates descendants.
- Child usage exists only per row in the session header's subagent catalog (`packages/client/ui-subagent/src/client/SubagentHeaderLineage.tsx` reads each child's `projectionValues.tokenUsage` from the Session list). The catalog is collapsed by default, and the ordinary sidebar hides subagent Sessions, so the composer pill is the only total a user sees for the run.

### Reproduction

1. Start a Session that delegates to teammates/subagents (Agent Teams or the `subagent` tool).
2. Let the children run.
3. Read the composer strip's token pill — it reports the delegating Session's own total.
4. Compare with the sum of `projectionValues.tokenUsage` over the `origin: 'subagent'` descendants; the header's subagent catalog renders that value per child row.

### Proposed fix

Branch: `stofancy/deepseek-harness` @ `fix/composer-strip-subagent-usage` (commit `e652bf148e`), base `master`. Client-side aggregation over data the host already serves:

- New pure fold `sumSubagentTokenUsage` over the Session-list summaries' `projectionValues.tokenUsage`: transitive `origin: 'subagent'` walk with a cycle guard; an ordinary fork contributes nothing.
- `StatsPills` adds the descendant sum to the current Session's value, so the headline, cache-hit share, and bucket rows all describe the delegation tree; with at least one reporting descendant the dialog names `This session` / `Subagents` before the combined buckets.
- The `useSessions` selector passes a bucket equality: the Session-list store also publishes frames that leave the sum untouched (child timing publishes at token frequency, see #5205), and an equal re-derived value must not re-render the strip.
- Tests: a spec for the pure fold (transitive walk, fork exclusion, missing values, cyclic lineage), a component spec for the combined pill and the split rows, plus the updated existing suites. `tsc -b tsconfig.client.json`, `run-oxlint.ts packages/client/ui-chat`, `verify-client-ui-i18n`, translation pairing / md-links, and doc budgets pass; `vitest run packages/client packages/host` shows only the pre-existing `ui-trajectory/tests/client-bundle.client.spec.ts` failures of an unbuilt checkout.
- Known limit, recorded in the ui-chat README: descendants come from list summaries, so a cold summary that serves no retained projection value is missing from the headline until it arrives. If that matters, the robust owner is a host-side lineage aggregate (worth its own decision).

### Why there is no pull request

`deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness` has Issues and Pull Requests disabled for this account: `GET /repos/.../pulls` returns 404, `has_issues` is `false`, `gh pr create` fails with `stofancy does not have the correct permissions to execute CreatePullRequest`, and CONTRIBUTING.md states the project cannot accept external pull requests at the moment. Per that guide this post is the report, and the patch is published on the fork branch so maintainers can pull it: <https://github.com/stofancy/deepseek-harness/tree/fix/composer-strip-subagent-usage>.

### Related

- #5589 — `subagent` spawn does not return usage to the orchestrator (adjacent: that is the tool-result channel; this is the Web counter).
- #1886 / #2426 — `tokenUsage` projection undercounts (compaction, retries); same projection, different gap.
- #5014 / #5205 — Session-list publishing at token frequency; the reason the new selector carries an equality.

---

**中文摘要**：输入框统计条的 token 胶囊只统计当前会话自身的持久日志，teammate（`origin: 'subagent'` 子会话）各自的 `tokenUsage` 投影不会被计入。本次 Agent Teams 运行里，主会话 17,835,441 tok，五个 teammate 合计 23,271,879 tok，团队真实总量 41,107,320 tok，界面因此低估 2.3 倍；子代理用量只在默认折叠的会话头部目录里逐行可见。根因是 `tokenUsage` 投影按单个会话折叠，且 `StatsPills` 只读当前会话的投影。修复分支见上（客户端按会话列表汇总后代会话用量，并在弹窗中区分"本会话/子代理"）。

discussions.title: Bug: a settings write deletes an external edit that added a key inside the namespace it writes (still live on 0.1.5-rc.2)
discussions.body:
## Summary

A file-backed settings write can **delete user data it never observed**: an external edit that adds or changes a key *inside the namespace being written* is silently removed by that write. Still reproducible on `master` as of `0.1.5-rc.2`.

## Reproduction

With the shipped file provider (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-settings-file`, `watch: true`, default `debounceMs: 100`):

1. `settings.yaml` contains `ui-theme: { theme: light }`, and a plugin has registered a namespace with a schema that also accepts `fontSize`.
2. Something outside the process edits the file and adds a key **inside that same namespace**:

   ```yaml
   ui-theme:
     theme: light
     fontSize: 18
   ```

3. Before the watcher's debounce window elapses, the process performs an ordinary write:

   ```ts
   scope.update({ theme: 'darker' })
   ```

4. **The external key is gone from disk**, and the resolved value no longer contains it:

   ```yaml
   ui-theme:
     theme: darker
   ```

An unobserved edit adding a *different* namespace is unaffected, because the diff only touches the written namespace's path — which is why the existing sibling-namespace fold case in `watcher.spec.ts` passes and this one doesn't.

## Root cause

`SettingsProvider.write` derives the namespace's next section from the cached document at the front of the namespace's write queue, then hands that section to `persist`:

- `packages/settings/settings/src/index.ts` — `write()` computes `section` from `this.section(ns)` and calls `this.persist(ns, section)`.

`FileSettingsProvider.persistSection` then reconciles the on-disk text under its writer lock — correctly folding in the unobserved edit and publishing it into the seam — but renders the **queue-front** section:

- `packages/settings/settings-file/src/index.ts` — `await this.reconcileFromDisk()` followed by `renderYaml(ns, section)` / `renderJson(ns, section)`.

The YAML renderer's leaf diff treats a key that is present in the stored document and absent from the section it is given as a removal, so the externally added key is deleted. The seam diverges too: the reconciled document `publish` just committed is overwritten by the stale section. The JSON renderer replaces the whole namespace key, so it loses the key the same way.

## Impact

Silent loss of a user's manual edit to the settings document, plus a memory/disk divergence after the write — on the configuration surface, where a hand-edit inside a debounce window is the normal way to change a value.

## A fix, if useful

On a fork branch based on current `master`: `persist(ns, section, derive)` — where `derive(base)` re-applies the write's own intent (merge / replace / path ops) to a base — and the file provider applies it to the section of the document it reconciled, returning what it stored for the service to adopt for the in-memory document, the revision bump, and the commit. Untouched keys of the external edit survive; a key both sides changed still resolves to the later write, so same-namespace write-write races keep their last-write-wins outcome.

- Branch: https://github.com/MostafaAshry513/deepseek-harness/tree/fix/settings-write-reconciles-base
- Diff with the write-up and verification: https://github.com/MostafaAshry513/deepseek-harness/pull/1
- Agent Note: `.agents/notes/implemented/bug-fix/2026-09-10-settings-write-derives-its-reconciled-base.md`

Verification on that branch: two new `watcher.spec.ts` cases (this one, and one where the reconciled section cannot satisfy its schema) **fail on the pre-fix render and pass after**; 225 tests pass across the settings, settings-file, and consumer settings suites; per-file 100% coverage on both changed source files; `pnpm run typecheck` and `pnpm run test:docs` (16/16 gates) pass.

I could not open a pull request here — `has_pull_requests` is `false` for this repository and `CreatePullRequest` is refused — so this is posted as a Discussion instead. Happy to rebase, split, or hand it over in any form if it is useful.

discussions.title: Four Web GUI ideas with no upstream equivalent: in-app file viewer, past-message rewrite, queue rewind, subagent dock
discussions.body:
## Idea

Four Web GUI capabilities that have no equivalent in `master` (0.1.5-rc.2), implemented and in daily use in a fork. Posting them in case any are worth adopting — each is self-contained and they do not depend on each other.

I have deliberately **left out** composer file upload: `master` already ships `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-file-upload` (session-addressed, streaming intake, byte progress, cancellation, staged receipts), which is a better design than the base64-over-one-RPC version in the fork. No point proposing a weaker duplicate.

### 1. In-app file viewer

Clicking a file chip or tool-row file link opens a modal viewer instead of only handing the path to the host: text renders with line numbers and syntax highlighting, non-text answers with a binary-and-size notice, and the footer offers Download and Open-externally. On a remote or headless deployment this is the difference between "the agent says it wrote a file" and being able to read it from the same page. Backed by a bounded read RPC (8 MiB) that returns `{ name, dataBase64, mediaType? }`.

Pairs with an open-in-browser fallback: when the host reports that it cannot open a path natively (headless, no `xdg-open`, or an `ENOENT` from the opener even where a desktop was detected), the client opens the fetched bytes through a blob tab and falls back to a download when the tab is blocked — instead of surfacing a raw `spawn xdg-open ENOENT`.

### 2. Rewrite a past user message

A message action that forks the session at the cut turn and re-prompts with the edited text, so a typo or a wrong premise can be corrected without restarting the conversation or hand-editing the log. The cut is computed from the turn the message belongs to rather than assumed.

### 3. Queue rewind

The composer queue already shows pending turns; this adds a per-row "rewind from here" action that drops the row and everything after it and re-sends the edited text. Disabled on rows that carry no text. Useful when a queued instruction turns out to be wrong while the model is still working through earlier turns.

### 4. Subagent dock

A conversation dock strip listing child sessions with running/done counts, one row per child, switch-to-child and retry on failure, and a "back to main" pill in the subagent header when ancestry depth is greater than one. With several children in flight, the alternative is guessing from the transcript which one is which.

## Where they live

`dsh-local-full` on https://github.com/MostafaAshry513/deepseek-harness — a fork of the `0.1.1-rc.2` release, so the code is written against the pre-`ui-chat` split and would need porting to `master` rather than cherry-picking. `LOCAL-FORK.md` on that branch documents what differs and includes a security warning about the trust-fence changes that branch also carries (deliberately kept out of anything proposed here).

Also in that fork, and reported separately here, is a settings-write data-loss fix that is still live on `master`.

discussions.title: [Bug] /compact says a compaction is active when the agent is simply mid-turn
discussions.body:
**Summary.** A manual `/compact` that arrives while the agent is still finishing a turn is refused with a message that names the wrong cause — and the error classification makes the two cases indistinguishable for every consumer, not just `/compact`.

Found on DSH Desktop (harness 0.1.2-rc.1). The same code path is still present on `master`, so I'm reporting it rather than assuming it is known.

**What the user sees**

> Compaction is unavailable because this process has an active compaction, or the agent is not idle.

That is the single `busy` arm of `expectedFailure` in `packages/compaction/command-compact/src/index.ts:29`.

**Why the message is wrong for this case.** The refusal users actually hit is the agent loop rejecting the maintenance claim:

```ts
// packages/core/agent-loop/src/agent.ts:158
if (this.phase.kind !== 'idle') throw new Error(`agent "${this.id}" already has active work`)
```

`compactNow` catches everything and reports one code for all of it:

```ts
// packages/compaction/compaction-basic/src/index.ts:414
} catch (error: unknown) {
  throw new ManualCompactionError(
    'busy',
    'manual compaction requires an idle agent with no waking queued work',
    { cause: error },
  )
}
```

So "another compaction is in progress" (what the copy leads with), "the agent is not idle" (vague, but the real cause), a live unmatched bracket, and an unavailable admission all arrive as `busy`. The message leads with the case a user is least likely to have hit.

**Evidence from a real session log** (`session.jsonl.zstd`, `ts` in epoch ms):

| event | ts | delta |
| --- | --- | --- |
| last `step/end` of the answered turn | 1789070593953 | — |
| `command/run compact` | 1789070596493 | +2.5 s |
| `command/done` kind=error | 1789070596498 | +5 ms |
| next `turn/start` | 1789070640640 | +45 s |

The refusal landed 2.5 s after the turn's final step and 45 s before the next turn began: `phase.kind` was still `running`. Worth adding *why* the user thought the agent was idle — `agent/turn-stopping` hooks (title generation) run before `turn/end`, so the response visibly ends tens of seconds before the phase does. That window is exactly when someone reaches for `/compact`, and exactly when the message is wrong.

**Suggested change.** Classify at the boundary, then let each consumer name its own cause:

```ts
function isAgentWorkingError(error: unknown): boolean {
  return /already has active work$/u.test(errorMessage(error))
}

// in compactNow's catch
if (isAgentWorkingError(error)) {
  throw new ManualCompactionError(
    'agent-busy',
    'manual compaction did not start: the agent was still working',
    { cause: error },
  )
}
throw new ManualCompactionError(/* existing busy */)
```

`command-compact` gains an `agent-busy` arm — "the agent is still working on this session. Wait for the turn to finish, then run /compact again." — and `busy` narrows to the claim conflicts it already describes.

**Tests that currently encode the conflation** (these need updating, not just adding alongside):

- `packages/compaction/compaction-basic/tests/manual-compaction.spec.ts:213` — the fake agent throws the agent-loop string verbatim: `if (release === undefined) throw new Error('agent already has active work')`. The testkit comment calls it "a fake idle agent whose maintenance claim is scripted per test", so the string is effectively a contract.
- `…/manual-compaction.spec.ts:345` — `reports busy without summarizing when a prompt already owns the next turn`, asserting `code === 'busy'` at `:354`; also the cases at `:710` (`{ name: 'busy', …, release: undefined }`) and `:884`.
- `packages/compaction/command-compact/tests/command-compact.spec.ts:209` — pins the current user-facing string in a table.

**Working implementation, if useful.** I implemented this against the 0.1.2-rc.1 published artifacts, shipped it in our desktop shell, and added a test pinning the classifier, both refusal messages, and the patch: https://github.com/dataelement/dsh-desktop/pull/381

**Out of scope / open question.** This fixes only the diagnosis — `/compact` still will not start mid-turn. Making it wait for idle changes `runMaintenance` semantics for every maintenance caller (the scheduler currently defers when the claim is busy), so it reads like a separate product decision. Which direction would you prefer?

discussions.title: [Bug] llm-pi-ai/opencode-go: missing x-opencode-session header and deepseek-v4.1-flash catalog entry
discussions.body:
**Environment:** dsh 0.1.5-rc.2, `llm-pi-ai` with the `opencode-go` provider route (user settings), model `deepseek-v4.1-flash`.

Two defects on the same provider route; both are fixed in a reference branch linked below.

### 1. Every opencode-go request is refused with 400 `MissingSessionID`

OpenCode Go routes and prompt-caches per conversation on a stable `x-opencode-session` header and answers requests without it with:

```
400 {"type":"MissingSessionID","message":"Error from provider (Console Go): Request is missing x-opencode-session and cannot be routed efficiently. Please see https://opencode.ai/docs/go/#where-can-i-use-it"}
```

`@earendil-works/pi-ai` 0.85.1 never sends the header: its `sessionId` option maps only to the affinity headers that a model's compat flags name (`sendSessionAffinityHeaders`), and the opencode-go catalog entries set none of them. OpenCode's docs currently list DeepSeek Harness among clients whose session support is incomplete.

Fix approach: derive `x-opencode-session` from the seam's `GenerateOptions.sessionId` in the llm-pi-ai adapter. Main, compaction, and session-title calls all already stamp the session identity, so one conversation sends one stable value; a deployment-configured header wins case-insensitively, and a request without a session id sends none.

### 2. `deepseek-v4.1-flash` is not selectable

models.dev registered `deepseek-v4.1-flash`, but pi-ai 0.85.1's generated opencode-go catalog predates it, so the model is absent from every selector. Fix approach: a pnpm patch adds the flattened catalog entry (mirroring `deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp`) plus a guard test that fails, naming the patch, until a pi-ai release ships the model and the patch can be dropped.

### Reference implementation

Both fixes with tests are on a branch in my fork, two commits on top of current `master`: https://github.com/mohamed-bashir-dev/deepseek-harness/compare/master...mohamed-bashir-dev:deepseek-harness:fix/llm-pi-ai-opencode-go

The adapter spec covers sending the derived header on `opencode-go`, absence on another provider, the case-insensitive deployment override, and absence when the request names no session; the catalog guard spec covers the patched entry. Understood that external PRs are closed for now — happy to rework or hand this over in whatever form is useful.

discussions.title: [Bug] PM2 托管下 `dsh web` 静默空转：PM2 的 fork 容器用 `import()` 加载 `bin.ts`，`import.meta.main` 为 false（online 但不监听、日志 0 字节）
discussions.body:
**English TL;DR** — Under PM2, `dsh` never starts at all: PM2's fork container runs `node <node_args> .../pm2/lib/ProcessContainerFork.js <args>` and loads the app script with a dynamic `import()`, so `import.meta.main` is `false` inside `apps/cli/src/bin.ts` and `runCli()` is never called. The process stays alive on PM2's IPC channel, PM2 reports `online` with 0 restarts, out/err logs stay at 0 bytes, and nothing ever binds. This is the same entry guard as [#6124](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/6124) / [#6115](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/6115) / [#5082](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/5082), but triggered by the supervisor's loader instead of by Node < 24.2 — and the fix suggested in [#6124](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/6124) (`process.argv[1]` comparison) does **not** fix this case, because under PM2 `argv[1]` is the container, not `bin.ts`. Two verified workarounds are at the end.

---

## 1. 环境

| | |
|---|---|
| OS | Windows 11（Windows_NT 10.0.26100） |
| Node | v24.20.0（`import.meta.main` 正常为 `true`） |
| PM2 | 7.0.4（`pm2` 全局安装在 `%APPDATA%\npm\node_modules\pm2`） |
| dsh | master `c291e7961a`（0.1.5-rc.2 之后 139 个提交）；同一行为在 `dsh-v0.1.5-rc.1/rc.2` 上复现 |

## 2. 最小复现

`ecosystem.config.js`（PM2 托管是社区常见的常驻方案，参见 [#2749](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/2749) / [#4301](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/4301) / [#1102](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/1102)；仓库自身没有 PM2 文档）：

```js
export const apps = [{
  name: 'dsh-web',
  interpreter: 'node',
  interpreter_args: '--import tsx/esm',
  script: 'D:\\Dev\\deepseek-harness\\apps\\cli\\src\\bin.ts',
  args: 'web --port 3080 --no-open',
  cwd: 'D:\\Dev\\deepseek-harness',
  exec_mode: 'fork',
  autorestart: true,
  max_restarts: 10,
  restart_delay: 3000,
}];
```

```powershell
pm2 start ecosystem.config.js
pm2 list        # → dsh-web   online    ↺ 0
pm2 logs dsh-web --lines 50 --nostream   # → 两个日志文件都是空的
curl http://127.0.0.1:3080/              # → 连接被拒绝
```

**实际结果**：PM2 报告 `online`、重启次数 0，进程存活数十秒以上，但**不打印任何输出、不监听端口**；人工 `pm2 stop dsh-web` 之后记录为 `exited with code [1] via signal [SIGINT]`。

**预期结果**：与手工执行完全相同的命令一样，打印 URL 行并监听 3080：

```powershell
pnpm dsh web --port 3080 --no-open
# dsh web: http://127.0.0.1:3080/?token=... (LAN: http://192.168.x.x:3080/?token=...)
tsx apps/cli/src/bin.ts web --port 3080 --no-open      # 同样正常
```

也就是说：**同一个 argv、同一个 cwd、同一个 Node，只有经过 PM2 就完全不工作。**

## 3. 观测证据

### 3.1 PM2 记录

```
pm2 jlist → name=dsh-web  status=stopped  restart_time=0  exit_code=1
            node_version=24.20.0
            pm_exec_path=D:\Dev\deepseek-harness\apps\cli\src\bin.ts
            node_args=--import tsx/esm   args=web --port 3080 --no-open
            pm_cwd=D:\Dev\deepseek-harness
%USERPROFILE%\.pm2\logs\dsh-web-out-5.log    → 0 字节
%USERPROFILE%\.pm2\logs\dsh-web-error-5.log  → 0 字节
~/.pm2/pm2.log:
  05:51:47: PM2 log: App [dsh-web:5] starting in -fork mode-
  05:51:47: PM2 log: App [dsh-web:5] online
  （此后到人工 stop 为止，没有任何 exited / error 记录）
```

进程既没有退出也没有报错——它是**活着但不做事**。这一点很重要：它排除了"端口占用"（后者会大声抛 `EADDRINUSE` 并以非零码退出）、"tsx 缺失"、"Node 版本过低"（PM2 记录的是 v24.20.0）等假设。

### 3.2 PM2 实际 spawn 的命令行（决定性证据）

```powershell
Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "ProcessId=<dsh-web pid>"
# CommandLine = node --import tsx/esm C:\Users\<user>\AppData\Roaming\npm\node_modules\pm2\lib\ProcessContainerFork.js web --port 3080 --no-open
```

**`apps/cli/src/bin.ts` 根本不在命令行里。** PM2 在 fork 模式下启动的是它自己的容器 `ProcessContainerFork.js`，再由容器去加载应用脚本（脚本路径通过 `pm_exec_path` 环境变量传递），应用参数则被追加在容器路径之后。

自查一行（复现本问题的用户可以直接确认自己是否命中）：

```powershell
# Windows
Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -like '*ProcessContainerFork*' } | Select-Object ProcessId, CommandLine
```

```sh
# Linux / macOS
ps -ef | grep -i ProcessContainerFork | grep -v grep
```

如果在 PM2 托管的应用里看到 `... pm2/lib/ProcessContainerFork.js <args>`，那它的脚本就是被 `import()` 加载的，本文结论直接适用。该加载逻辑与平台无关（`ProcessContainerFork.js` 在 Linux/macOS 上同样如此），但本文只在 Windows 11 上实测。

### 3.3 PM2 容器如何加载脚本

`pm2/lib/ProcessContainerFork.js`（7.0.4）：

```js
// Require the real application
if (process.env.pm_exec_path) {
  if (ProcessUtils.isESModule(process.env.pm_exec_path) === true) {
    import(url.pathToFileURL(process.env.pm_exec_path));
  }
  else
    require('module')._load(process.env.pm_exec_path, null, true);
}
else
  throw new Error('Could not _load() the script');
```

`ProcessUtils.isESModule()` 对 `apps/cli/package.json`（`"type": "module"`）返回 `true`，所以走 `import()` 分支——**动态 import 的模块不是进程入口**。

### 3.4 探针实测

把一个 `.mjs` 探针（放在带 `"type": "module"` 的目录里）交给 PM2 托管，它报告：

```json
{
  "argv": ["...\\fnm_multishells\\...\\node.exe",
           "C:\\Users\\<user>\\AppData\\Roaming\\npm\\node_modules\\pm2\\lib\\ProcessContainerFork.js"],
  "importMetaMain": false,
  "importMetaUrl": "file:///.../probe.mjs",
  "pmExecPath": "...\\probe.mjs",
  "cwd": "D:\\Dev\\deepseek-harness",
  "node": "v24.20.0"
}
```

即：PM2 下 **`import.meta.main === false`**，而且 `process.argv[1]` 是容器、不是应用脚本（应用参数在 `process.argv.slice(2)` 里，能正常取到）。

### 3.5 结论

当前 `apps/cli/src/bin.ts` 末尾：

```ts
if (import.meta.main) {
  await runCli()
}
```

PM2 容器 `import()` 它时 `import.meta.main` 为 `false` → `runCli()` 一次都不执行 → 模块加载完就结束；进程因为 PM2 的 IPC 通道而保持存活，于是出现"online 但静默"。

## 4. 为什么其他所有启动方式都不受影响

只有"被 wrapper 用 `import()` 加载"的形态会撞墙；"作为真入口被 node 执行"的形态全部正常（`argv[1]` 就是 `bin.ts`，`import.meta.main === true`）：

- `pnpm dsh`（根 `package.json` 的 `scripts.dsh`）、`pnpm run demo:inspector`
- `packages/sdk/client/src/launch.ts`（`node --import tsx/esm <pkg>/src/bin.ts`，产物存在时用 `lib/bin.js`）
- `packages/experimental/webworker-packer/src/repository.ts`、`scripts/demo-ptc.mjs`
- 各类 e2e / 快照（`apps/cli/tests/**`、`apps/web/tests/**`、`snapshots/**`）

**仓库内已经有一条 wrapper 形态的正确做法**：`python/sdk-runtime/runtime-bootstrap.mjs`（Python 单文件运行时 / SEA 的入口，由 `scripts/build-exe-for-python-sdk.ts` 打包）import 构建产物后**显式调用** `runCli()`：

```js
const { runCli } = await import('@deepseek-ai/dsh/lib/bin.js')
await runCli()
```

关键时间线证据：**这个 bootstrap 文件与入口守卫是在同一个提交里引入的**（`e5dbccce8c`，`git show --stat` 显示 `python/sdk-runtime/runtime-bootstrap.mjs` 为 `new file`）。也就是说，守卫存在的原因正是"让 SEA bootstrap 能 import `lib/bin.js` 而不自动执行 CLI"；只是没有对外说明"外部进程管理器必须走同样的显式 `runCli()` 路径"。

**另有一条历史反证**：[#2749](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/2749)（0.1.0-rc.6，守卫引入之前）报告 PM2 注册的命令缺少 `--profile web` 时，PM2 下确实打印了 `error: --profile <name> is required` 并以非零码退出——说明**守卫出现之前，PM2 容器 `import()` 之后模块体是会执行的**，与本文结论一致。

## 5. 影响范围（按 tag）

| tag | 日期 | `apps/cli/src/bin.ts` 入口派发 | PM2 下 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0.1.0-rc.7 / rc.8 | 8/17、8/19 | 顶层派发（无守卫） | 正常 |
| 0.1.1-rc.1 / rc.2 | 8/21 | 顶层派发 | 正常 |
| 0.1.2-alpha.1 … alpha.5 | 8/28–9/2 | 顶层派发 | 正常 |
| 0.1.2-rc.1 | 9/3 | 顶层派发 | 正常 |
| **0.1.3-alpha.1** | 9/4 | 顶层派发 | **正常（最后一个干净版本）** |
| 0.1.3-alpha.2 | 9/7 | `import.meta.main` | **静默空转** |
| 0.1.5-alpha.1 / alpha.2 | 9/8、9/9 | `import.meta.main` | 静默空转 |
| 0.1.5-rc.1 / rc.2、master | 9/10 起 | `import.meta.main` | 静默空转 |

引入提交（2026-09-03）：

- `e5dbccce8c` `fix(subprocess): move SEA bootstrap to runtime packaging` —— 把顶层派发包成 `runCli()`，并加上守卫 `if (import.meta.url === pathToFileURL(resolve(process.argv[1])).href)`
- `423412b7bf` `fix(runtime): simplify executable entry dispatch` —— 守卫改成 `if (import.meta.main)`

**两个守卫形态在 PM2 下都失败**：`argv[1]` 是 `ProcessContainerFork.js`（不是 `bin.ts`）；`import.meta.main` 在动态 `import()` 的模块里是 `false`。换句话说，**"改回 `argv[1]` 判断"并不能修复本场景**（这一点是对 [#6124](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/6124) 建议的补充）。

## 6. 与既有讨论的关系（同守卫、不同触发面）

- [#6124](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/6124) —— 0.1.5-rc.1 在 Node < 24 上完全静默失败。触发面是 `import.meta.main === undefined`（Node < 24.2），**机制相同**（守卫为假 → 零输出 → exit 0），但**修复建议不覆盖本文场景**：它建议改回 `process.argv[1]` 判断，而 PM2 下 `argv[1]` 是容器路径，同样为假。
- [#6115](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/6115) / [#5082](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/5082) / [#4047](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/4047) / [#3455](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/3455) —— 同一守卫在发布包、构建脚本侧的表现。
- [#2749](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/2749) —— PM2 相关，但问题是注册命令缺参数（守卫之前），不是本机制。
- [#4301](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/4301) / [#1102](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/1102) / [#1098](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/1098) —— PM2/无控制台宿主下的控制台窗口弹窗，另一个问题。

`ProcessContainerFork`、`ecosystem.config` 在 Discussions 中均无命中，因此本文这个具体机制此前没有被记录过。

## 7. 已本地验证的两个 workaround

两个都在本机 PM2 7.0.4 + Windows + v24.20.0 上实测启动成功（打印 URL 行并监听端口）。

### A. 让 tsx 的 CLI 当入口（无需新增文件）

```js
export const apps = [{
  name: 'dsh-web',
  interpreter: 'node',
  // 不要再用 interpreter_args: '--import tsx/esm'
  script: 'D:\\Dev\\deepseek-harness\\node_modules\\tsx\\dist\\cli.mjs',
  args: 'apps/cli/src/bin.ts web --port 3080 --no-open',
  cwd: 'D:\\Dev\\deepseek-harness',
  exec_mode: 'fork',
}];
```

tsx 的 CLI 会把 `bin.ts` 作为**真正的入口**再执行一遍（`import.meta.main === true`），所以行为与手工 `tsx apps/cli/src/bin.ts ...` 完全一致。

代价：进程树变成 `PM2 容器 → tsx → dsh`，`max_memory_restart` 只观测到最外层的 tsx（很小），真正吃内存的是孙子进程，内存上限实际失效（`pm2 stop/delete` 的 tree-kill 仍然正常）。

### B. 用一个显式调用 `runCli()` 的 launcher（单进程，推荐）

```js
// pm2-dsh-web.mjs —— 与 ecosystem.config.js 同级
import { runCli } from './apps/cli/src/bin.ts'
await runCli()
```

```js
export const apps = [{
  name: 'dsh-web',
  interpreter: 'node',
  interpreter_args: '--import tsx/esm',
  script: 'D:\\Dev\\deepseek-harness\\pm2-dsh-web.mjs',
  args: 'web --port 3080 --no-open',
  cwd: 'D:\\Dev\\deepseek-harness',
  exec_mode: 'fork',
}];
```

实测 PM2 上报的 PID **本身就是占用端口的进程**（无额外子进程），因此 `max_memory_restart`、stop/kill 语义都正常。

## 8. 建议的上游修复方向

1. **把 CLI 主体与入口分开**：把 `runCli` 移到独立模块（例如 `apps/cli/src/cli.ts`），`bin.ts` 只保留**无条件**的顶层派发。这样既不需要任何入口守卫（PM2、systemd、Electron 等所有 wrapper 都能工作），也不影响 SEA 路径——只需把 `python/sdk-runtime/runtime-bootstrap.mjs` 的 import 目标从 `lib/bin.js` 改为该模块（它本来就是显式调用 `runCli()`，改成 import 主体模块后不会产生双重执行）。
2. **或者**保留守卫，但把"外部进程管理器必须调用 `runCli()`"文档化，并提供官方 launcher 文件；同时在 README/安装指南的 PM2 章节直接给出上面 B 的写法。
3. **无论如何都要 fail loud**：任何"加载了但什么都没做"的入口路径，都应该以非零码退出并给出明确诊断，而不是 online + 零输出。这与 [#6124](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/6124) / [#6115](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/6115) 的诉求一致（`apps/cli/package.json` 补 `engines` 是同一方向的另一条线）。

## 9. 附：复现用探针

```js
// probe.mjs —— 放在含 {"type":"module"} 的 package.json 的目录里
import { writeFileSync } from 'node:fs'
writeFileSync(new URL('./probe-out.json', import.meta.url), JSON.stringify({
  argv: process.argv,
  importMetaMain: import.meta.main,
  pmExecPath: process.env.pm_exec_path,
  cwd: process.cwd(),
  node: process.version,
}, null, 2))
console.log(`PROBE RAN import.meta.main=${String(import.meta.main)}`)
```

```powershell
pm2 start .\probe.mjs --name dsh-probe
type .\probe-out.json
```

---

*本文所有结论均在本机实测取得：PM2 7.0.4 / Windows 11 / Node v24.20.0 / dsh master `c291e7961a`；受影响 tag 范围由各 tag 的 `apps/cli/src/bin.ts` 内容比对得出。*

discussions.title: Bug: subagent-codex runs intermittently never settle - the child completes its turn and exits, but the dsh-side run hangs until a server restart
discussions.body:
## Summary

Intermittently, a `subagent_codex` tool call **never returns**. The delegated Codex child runs its turn to completion — streamed output, file side effects written — and exits, but the dsh-side run stays `Running` forever (UI: "Deep diving…"). Cancellation does nothing. Only restarting the dsh server clears it, and the call is then recorded as `The tool call was interrupted after it was recorded, but no result was durably recorded. Its outcome is unknown.` / `TOOL_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN`.

This breaks any unattended flow that needs a Codex delegation's return value.

## Environment

- dsh **0.1.5-rc.1** (`npm exec @deepseek-ai/dsh web`), profile `web`
- Custom agent preset enabling `@deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent-codex` and `@deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent-claude-code` (tools `subagent_codex` / `subagent_claude_code`; `backgroundMode: one-shot`, `maxDepth: provider-managed`)
- Linux x86_64, Node v26.8.1
- Bundled Codex: `@openai/codex` **0.153.4** (profile-local); native `codex-linux-x64` app-server
- Provider `permissionMode` varied during observations (`never` default, `approve-for-me`, and a session-level full-access preset); the hang reproduces across all of them, with default read-only sandbox too

## Frequency

Over one evening: **≥6 hung calls, ≥9 settled calls**. Hangs often cluster within a server instance (a freshly restarted instance hung on its very first Codex call with zero concurrency; another instance ran 5 Codex/Claude calls back-to-back with 5/5 settling). The same short prompt (`git status --short`) sometimes settles in ~10 s and sometimes hangs forever.

Not concurrency-related in the hung cases: several hangs were the only running call in the whole instance.

## Reproduction (nondeterministic — roughly half the time)

1. Start `dsh web` with a profile exposing `subagent_codex`.
2. Open a session and send: `Use subagent_codex to run` `git status --short` `and return only its output.`
3. If it settles, retry the same call — eventually one never settles.

## Evidence that the hang is dsh-side (the child completes and exits)

Codex children log to `~/.codex/logs_2.sqlite` (table `logs`; body column `feedback_log_body`; `process_uuid` = `pid:<n>:…`). Children spawned by dsh are identifiable by `app_server.client_name="deepseek-harness"` (the VS Code extension logs as `"VS Code"`).

Query used:

```sql
SELECT substr(process_uuid,1,16) pid, datetime(ts,'unixepoch') ts, level, target,
       substr(feedback_log_body,1,120) body
FROM logs WHERE process_uuid LIKE 'pid:<N>:%' ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 8;
```

- **Settled run** (completed normally): pid 3763198, 2026-09-10 22:23:53 → 22:24:43 UTC. Final rows: a burst of
  `codex_app_server::outgoing_message: app-server event: item/agentMessage/delta targeted_connections=1`.
- **Hung run**: pid 3789156, 22:43:48 → 22:43:58 UTC. Final rows are **identical** — a burst of `item/agentMessage/delta`. The process was gone by 22:44:47 (no child in `ps`); the dsh call was still `Running` minutes later.
- **Hung run with file side effects**: pid 3796085, ~22:48 → 22:49:43 UTC. This delegation actually **created a file in the workspace** (`.review-loop/plan.md`), streamed its answer, and exited — and the dsh-side call still never settled.

So the child's lifecycle and log signature are indistinguishable between settled and hung runs: the child finishes, streams its final answer, and exits; the dsh side simply never concludes the run.

## Workarounds attempted

- **Concurrency ruled out**: reproduced with a single in-flight call, and even as the first-ever call on a freshly restarted server.
- **Permission modes**: default (`never`, read-only), `approve-for-me` (workspace-write), and a session-level full-access preset — all reproduce; not permission-related.
- **Process level**: the child always finishes and exits quickly; nothing lingers to kill. UI Cancel/Stop does not recover the call.
- **Downstream mitigation**: all subagent payloads are now checkpointed to files by the caller, so a hang costs only a restart — never the work product.

## Impact

- The session's turn stays stuck until the dsh server is restarted; the call is then recorded as `TOOL_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN`, with its result permanently lost — even when the child already performed its file edits.
- Any unattended flow that needs a Codex delegation's result (e.g., a Codex↔Claude review loop) is not viable without a restart-workaround on every hang.

## Additional notes

- `rc.2` does **not** fix this: the subagent packages are byte-identical between rc.1 and rc.2 (only `package.json` version bumps; rc.2 release notes list two UI changes). Not retested there in depth.
- During one hung-era run the child logged `ERROR codex_core::tools::router: error=collab spawn failed: no thread with id: …` (collab sub-thread vs `ephemeral: true` thread). The child continued fine; likely unrelated, noting it for completeness.
- `subagent_claude_code` calls settled in every observed run (same service, different provider) — but we did not stress it; the file-registration/teardown path difference may matter.

## Possible investigation pointers (speculative)

- The settlement path in `@deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent-codex` (`CodexAppServerWire`, `settleRunResult`, `subprocessRunHandle`): what does the provider await before publishing a result — a terminal `turn/completed` notification, child quiescence, or the subprocess owner's "prove it is quiescent" step? The wrapper (`node …/@openai/codex/bin/codex.js app-server --stdio` → native `codex app-server --stdio`) exits promptly after streaming; a race between the terminal notification and process exit would match the evidence.
- Child processes are created as `ephemeral: true` threads over an app-server `--stdio` connection; hung runs show no lingering child, so nothing is left to clean up — the handle in dsh appears orphaned rather than the process.

Happy to provide the full sqlite log extracts (or additional fresh reproductions) if useful.

Session v2→v3 migration rejects a log whose turn/end was skipped by user steering
discussions.body:
Session v2→v3 migration rejects a log whose turn/end was skipped by user steering

Environment

  • dsh 0.1.5-rc.2 (tag dsh-v0.1.5-rc.2, commit fb2c4b9e69)

  • Node v22.23.2, Windows 11

  • The affected Session was written by an earlier build (format v2) and is being read after upgrading from 0.1.3-alpha.1 (format v2 → v3)

Symptom

Opening a pre-upgrade Session fails; the v2 artifact itself is untouched:

failed to observe session "session-1cd4d9e1-…":
Session migration from v2 to v3 refuses the transformed artifact:
turn/start 63 does not open expected turn 62;
source v2 artifact remains unchanged
(raw log: …\sessions\<profile>\session-1cd4d9e1-…\session.v2.jsonl.zstd)

Evidence decoded from the artifact

All 3428 Zstandard frames decode cleanly (7142 events, 0 parse failures). Turn pairing:

Both share the theme that an interrupted turn is not a fully supported log state, but the failing component, the trigger position, and the observable failure all differ. Fixing one does not fix the other.

# Session v2→v3 migration rejects a log whose `turn/end` was skipped by user steering **Environment** - dsh `0.1.5-rc.2` (tag `dsh-v0.1.5-rc.2`, commit `fb2c4b9e69`) - Node `v22.23.2`, Windows 11 - The affected Session was written by an earlier build (format **v2**) and is being read after upgrading from `0.1.3-alpha.1` (format v2 → v3) **Symptom** Opening a pre-upgrade Session fails; the v2 artifact itself is untouched: ``` failed to observe session "session-1cd4d9e1-…": Session migration from v2 to v3 refuses the transformed artifact: turn/start 63 does not open expected turn 62; source v2 artifact remains unchanged (raw log: …\sessions\\session-1cd4d9e1-…\session.v2.jsonl.zstd) ``` **Evidence decoded from the artifact** All 3428 Zstandard frames decode cleanly (7142 events, 0 parse failures). Turn pairing: | event | count | turns | | ------------ | ------ | --------------------------------------------------- | | `turn/start` | 83 | 1,2,3,…,83 (dense, no gaps) | | `turn/end` | **82** | 1,2,3,…,**61, 63**,64,…,83 — **turn 62 is missing** | The skip is a normal **user-steering splice**, not a torn write. The full turn-62 tail: ``` seq=5809 assistant/attempt {turn:62, step:29, stream:[]} seq=5810 step/end {turn:62, step:29} seq=5811 agent/inbox/spliced {target:"next-turn", start:0, inserted:[ ]} seq=5812 turn/start {turn:63} ``` `nextTurn` advances only in the `turn/end` arm of the relationship validator, so a single missing `turn/end` desynchronizes every later turn: ``` turn/start 63 while open=62 next=62 @seq 5812 ← first failure turn/start 64 while open=null next=63 @seq 5883 turn/start 65 while open=null next=64 @seq 5891 turn/start 66 while open=null next=65 @seq 5925 turn/start 67 while open=null next=66 @seq 5986 … 21 mismatches total ``` **Root cause: the escape hatch exists but is never enabled in production** `packages/session/session-format-v0-to-v1/src/relationships.ts` already models this exact shape: ```ts // line 38 readonly legacyInterruptedTurnRestart?: true // lines 80-98 case 'turn/start': { const previous = artifact.events[event.seq - 1] if (extensions.legacyInterruptedTurnRestart === true && openTurn !== null && openStep === null && data['turn'] === openTurn + 1 && nextTurn === openTurn && previous?.type === 'agent/inbox/spliced') { const splice = releasedV0Record(previous.data, `agent/inbox/spliced ${previous.seq} data`) if (splice['target'] === 'next-turn' && Array.isArray(splice['inserted']) && splice['inserted'].length > 0) { openTurn = null nextTurn += 1 // ← repairs the desync } } if (openTurn !== null || data['turn'] !== nextTurn) { throw new SessionFormatError(`turn/start ${JSON.stringify(data['turn'])} does not open expected turn ${nextTurn}`) } … ``` Every condition matches the log above: `openTurn === 62`, `openStep === null` (seq 5810 closed step 29), `data['turn'] === 63 === openTurn + 1`, `nextTurn === 62`, `previous.type === 'agent/inbox/spliced'` (seq 5811), `splice.target === 'next-turn'`, `inserted.length > 0`. However, a repo-wide search shows the flag is set **only in test code**: - `packages/session/session-format-v0-to-v1/src/relationships.ts:38,82` — definition and use - `packages/session/session-format-v0-to-v1/src/testing/validation.ts:29,42` — test helper (`{ legacyInterruptedTurnRestart: true }`) - `packages/session/session-format-v0-to-v1/tests/relationships.spec.ts:386` — unit test The production migration path never passes it, and the parameter is not plumbed through: - `packages/session/session-format-v2-to-v3/src/validation.ts:73` `restoreReleasedV2Artifact({ …header version 2, events }, knownEventTypes, 3)` — no `extensions` argument - `packages/session/session-format-v1-to-v2/src/validation.ts:148` `restoreReleasedV2Artifact(artifact, knownEventTypes, relationshipHeaderVersion = artifact.header.version)` — signature has no `extensions` parameter, so callers cannot opt in - the failure surfaces as a migration refusal at `packages/session/session-format/src/catalog.ts:246` **Impact** - A Session that `0.1.3-alpha.1` (format v2) opened normally becomes **unreadable** after upgrading to `0.1.5-rc.2`. The upgrade is what breaks it, not the log. - Fail-closed behavior is correct here: the v2 artifact is not modified or deleted (`source v2 artifact remains unchanged`), so no data is lost. - Scope in this profile: **1 of 35** Session artifacts. The other 34 (18 × v0, 15 × v2, plus new v3) are unaffected. - The trigger is ordinary user steering — sending a message while a turn is running — so other users are likely to hit it on Sessions they steered. **Suggested fixes** 1. Thread `legacyInterruptedTurnRestart: true` through the migration restore chain so v2→v3 accepts the same interrupted-turn shape the validator already models: - add an optional `extensions` parameter to `restoreReleasedV2Artifact` (`session-format-v1-to-v2`) and forward it to `assertReleasedArtifactRelationships` - pass it from `restoreReleasedV3Artifact` (`session-format-v2-to-v3`) 2. Or make the v3 relationship pass accept the "step closed + `agent/inbox/spliced` with `target: "next-turn"`" restart natively, since that sequence is produced by the current steering path rather than by legacy data. **Workaround** None required for data integrity. The unreadable Session's v2 artifact is preserved and can be opened once a fix lands; the rest of the profile is unaffected. **Related but distinct** [[Discussion #3631](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/3631)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/3631) covers a neighbouring theme: a log state produced by an interrupted turn has no first-class handling. There, a **trailing** `turn/end` with `reason.kind: "aborted"` (plus `session/end-seed`) makes the client history read path silently degrade to "no more history" (`dsh-client-runtime` `loadOlder()`), observed on `0.1.0-rc.6`/`rc.7`. This report is a different defect in a different layer and version: | | #3631 | this report | | ------------- | -------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------ | | engine | `0.1.0-rc.6`/`rc.7` (Aug 2026, pre-migration) | `0.1.5-rc.2` (Sep 2026) | | artifact | `session.jsonl.zstd` (v0/v1) | `session.v2.jsonl.zstd` (v2) | | trigger | trailing `turn/end` with `reason.kind: "aborted"` | mid-log turn skipped by a `target: "next-turn"` steering splice | | failing layer | Client read path (`loadOlder()`), **silent** degradation | migration relationship validation, **explicit** refusal | | symptom | blank history pages; Session still opens | Session cannot be opened at all | Both share the theme that an interrupted turn is not a fully supported log state, but the failing component, the trigger position, and the observable failure all differ. Fixing one does not fix the other.

discussions.body:
> 非官方社区项目，由社区成员独立开发和维护。本项目与 DeepSeek 或 Xiaomi 官方无隶属关系，也不代表官方推荐。

## 项目地址

GitHub：https://github.com/ppy-web/dsh-plugin-xiaomi-mimo-tts

npm：https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-xiaomi-tts

dsh-xiaomi-tts 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 添加 Xiaomi MiMo TTS 语音朗读能力。

## 主要功能

- 在对话操作栏中提供一键“朗读”按钮
- 支持 `mimo-v2.5-tts` PCM 流式播放
- 支持 MP3、WAV 完整音频播放
- 支持通过文字描述创建自定义音色
- 支持浏览器 Web Speech API 本地语音兜底
- 自动清理网址、文件路径、代码块、表情符号等无意义内容
- 提供可配置的点击音效和任务状态音效
- 向其他 Web 插件提供可选的 PCM 流式播放服务

## 截图

![设置界面](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ppy-web/dsh-plugin-xiaomi-mimo-tts/main/assets/setting.png)

![朗读界面](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ppy-web/dsh-plugin-xiaomi-mimo-tts/main/assets/image.png)

在线预览：

https://ppy-web.github.io/dsh-plugin-xiaomi-mimo-tts

## 与 DSH 的集成方式

插件由 Host 插件和 Web Client 两部分组成：

- Host 负责保存 Xiaomi MiMo API Key，并代理语音合成请求
- Web Client 提供设置界面、对话朗读入口和播放状态管理
- PCM 音频流在浏览器端通过 Web Audio 播放
- 支持浏览器本地语音作为兜底方案

其他 Web 插件也可以调用本插件提供的播放服务：

```ts
ctx.get('xiaomiMimoTts')?.play('欢迎回来')

discussions.title: [Bug] Web composer stuck in IME composition — Enter stops submitting, keystrokes duplicate (Windows + Microsoft Pinyin / 微软拼音)
discussions.body:
# Web composer can get permanently stuck in IME composition: Enter stops submitting and keystrokes produce duplicate/incorrect text

> **中文摘要（TL;DR）**
>
> Web 输入框的输入法（IME）组合状态会**永久卡死**。卡死后：
> 1. **回车无法发送消息**，被直接吞掉；
> 2. 按一个键会产生**多个效果**（文字重复 / 插错位置）；
> 3. 拼音不能整词上屏，被拆成**单个音节各自变成错字**，还会残留英文字母
>    （实测出现 `你好t尼哈奥尼哈尼赫尼`，同时输入法候选框仍开着）。
>
> 只有**刷新页面**或**退出会话重进**才能恢复。
>
> 疑似原因：`dsh-client-ui-conversation` 的 `registerComposerKeymap` 用一个闭包变量
> `composing` 记录是否在组词，它**只能由 `compositionend` 清除，没有任何兜底**
> （不超时、失焦也不清）。一旦该事件丢失，`composing` 永久为 `true`，回车处理里的
> 第一句 `isComposingEvent(event, recentlyComposing)` 就会把回车吞掉，其他按键也会
> 走组词分支。
>
> 环境：Windows 11 + 微软拼音 + `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.5-rc.1`（Web 界面）。
> 录屏证据见本贴附件。

## Summary

In the DSH Web UI, the message composer can enter a state where its IME
composition handling is permanently stuck in the "composing" state. While stuck:

- **Enter no longer submits the message** — it is silently swallowed.
- **Ordinary keystrokes produce multiple / incorrect effects** (duplicated text,
  text inserted at the wrong place).
- Pinyin is committed as isolated syllables mapped to wrong characters, and stray
  Latin letters are left in the draft (observed: `你好t尼哈奥尼哈尼赫尼`).
- The state **does not clear by itself**. It only clears when the composer is
  rebuilt — reload the page, or leave the session and come back.

## Environment

- DSH: `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.5-rc.1` (latest on npm at the time of writing),
  launched as `npx @deepseek-ai/dsh@latest web`
- OS: Windows 11
- Input method: **Microsoft Pinyin (微软拼音)** — the candidate list included the
  built-in kaomoji candidate `\(@^0^@)/`
- UI: DSH Web GUI at `http://127.0.0.1:3080`
- Affected package: `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-conversation@0.1.5-rc.1`
  (line numbers below are from the published `lib/client.js` bundle)

## Steps to reproduce

1. Open the DSH Web UI and focus the message composer.
2. Type Chinese text with the IME.
3. Intermittently — during ordinary typing, with no session switch and no reload —
   the composer enters the stuck state.

So far the failure has been observed several times but is not yet deterministic.
It may be timing-dependent.

## Actual behaviour

While stuck, the IME candidate window stays open, pinyin is not converted as a
whole word, and the committed text contains both wrong single characters and raw
Latin letters. Pressing Enter does nothing at all.

## Evidence

A 9.7 s screen recording was captured by the reporter. 19 frames (2 fps) were
extracted and OCR'd with the Windows OCR engine (`zh-Hans-CN`).

The draft content was **stable across many consecutive frames**, i.e. it is
committed text, not a transient composition rendering:

```
你好t尼哈奥尼哈尼赫尼
```

A bare Latin `t` sits between Chinese characters, and `hao` appears split into
`哈` (`ha`) + `奥` (`ao`) — the signature of a composition that was aborted
mid-word and then committed in fragments.

At the same time the IME candidate window held candidates for `nihao`:

```
1 你好   2 你号   3 似好   4 倪浩   5 \(@^0^@)/   6 你
```

The reporter's description of the failure:

- "回车发不出去" — Enter cannot send the message.
- "其他按键按下有多个效果" — other keys produce multiple effects.
- "退出重进又好了" — leaving the session and re-entering restores normal behaviour.

## Suspected cause

There are two independent pieces of "is composing" state. Both are cleared only by
a `compositionend` event, and neither has any fallback.

### 1. DSH's own keymap flag

`registerComposerKeymap` in `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-conversation/lib/client.js`:

```js
let composing = false;
let composingUntil = 0;
const onCompositionStart = () => {
  composing = true;
};
const onCompositionEnd = () => {
  composing = false;
  composingUntil = Date.now() + 10;
};
const recentlyComposing = () => composing || Date.now() < composingUntil;
```

registered on the editor root:

```js
return Eu(editor.registerRootListener((root, prevRoot) => {
  prevRoot?.removeEventListener("compositionstart", onCompositionStart);
  prevRoot?.removeEventListener("compositionend", onCompositionEnd);
  root?.addEventListener("compositionstart", onCompositionStart);
  root?.addEventListener("compositionend", onCompositionEnd);
}), ...);
```

and the Enter command:

```js
editor.registerCommand(cn$1, (event) => {
  if (event?.shiftKey === true) return false;
  if (event !== null && isComposingEvent(event, recentlyComposing)) return true;
  if (handlers.arbitrate("enter", false) !== "pass") { ... }
  ...
  handlers.submit(event?.ctrlKey === true || event?.metaKey === true);

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/510422ce-fdbd-40b0-bb78-b3d2dd8ec954


  return true;
}, 4),
```

with:

```js
function isComposingEvent(event, recentlyComposing) {
  return event.isComposing || event.keyCode === 229 || recentlyComposing();
}
```

`composing` is a closure variable cleared **only** by a `compositionend` delivered
on the current root element. If that event is never delivered, `composing` stays
`true` forever, and `isComposingEvent(...)` then returns `true` for **every**
key event (a plain Enter has `isComposing === false` and `keyCode === 13`, but the
`recentlyComposing()` term is stuck true). The Enter handler therefore returns
`true` — "handled" — without ever calling `handlers.submit()`. This matches
"Enter cannot send" exactly.

A `compositionend` can plausibly be lost when:

- the editor root is detached / re-attached mid-composition —
  `ComposerContentEditable` calls `editor.setRootElement(null)` in its effect
  cleanup, and the shell calls it in `dispose()`;
- Lexical reconciles and replaces the composed text node while the composition is
  in flight;
- the composition otherwise ends without a finalize event on that root.

### 2. Lexical's internal composition state

The bundled Lexical core under the same file tracks composition itself
(`compositionPhase`, `isComposing()`, the `insertCompositionText` branch of the
`beforeinput` handler). A missed `compositionend` leaves that state stuck in the
same way, which routes subsequent `beforeinput` events through the composition
branch and explains the duplicated / mis-positioned insertions
("other keys produce multiple effects").

## Suggested fix

- Clear `composing` on `blur` / `focusout` of the root, and whenever
  `registerRootListener` swaps the root element.
- Add a bounded fallback: clear `composing` if no composition-related event has
  been observed for N ms.
- Do not swallow Enter solely because `recentlyComposing()` is true. Prefer the
  per-event signals (`event.isComposing`, `event.keyCode === 229`) and use the
  sticky flag only for the documented Safari case it was added for.
- Review whether the editor root can ever be detached while a composition is in
  flight, and re-establish composition state if it can.

## Workaround

Reload the page (F5) or leave the session and re-enter. Rebuilding the composer
clears the stuck state.

discussions.title: [生态观察 #002] DeepSeek Harness v0.1.5 生态影响实测:零兼容破坏、Node 静默坑与 1522 插件的分层时刻
discussions.body:
# DeepSeek Harness v0.1.5 观察:平台收拢基础体验,生态分层正式成形

> DSH Insights · 观察报告 #002 · 2026-09-11 · 数据快照可复核(/data/)· 兼容矩阵 = 权威集 10,534 个插件中已发布 npm 且带 web client 的 2,431 个 × 4 档 shell 逐插件实测 · 启发式评估,非安全审计

## 核心判断

**DeepSeek Harness v0.1.5 是 dsh 平台史上一道分水岭:它标志着「基础体验内置化、差异化上移插件层」的生态分层正式成形。** 文件树/预览进内核、左右侧栏标准化扩展入口、模型与 harness 共同训练 —— 平台在收拢地基的同时,给插件层留出了更明确、也更高门槛的位置。这个版本对生态的"破坏"几乎不在 API 层(兼容实测零破坏),而在**定位层、沟通层与分发层**:1522 个基础体验类插件需要重新回答"我为什么存在",却没有从官方得到任何回答这一问题的指引,而 npx 入口的 Node 静默坑则在无声损耗整个生态的新用户漏斗。

## 一、这个版本的核心价值:三条主线

**1. 模型 × 平台共同进化成为产品形态。** V4.1 Flash 针对标准/PTC/极简三种模式专项训练,配合「保留 KV Cache 更新系统提示词」—— 模型不再是外挂而是被训练进 harness 的交互协议。这定义了 dsh 与通用 agent 框架的差异:模型行为与平台功能的耦合迭代。对插件作者的含义:**靠近模型-平台协议的扩展点,比堆 UI 功能有更长的半衰期**。

**2. Agent 组织结构成为一等公民。** 父子 agent 双向通信、排队/插话/停止、Agent Teams 共享任务列表(实验性、默认关闭)。多 agent 协作从"自己拼"变成平台原语 —— 这是插件生态的下一波机会带:团队编排、进度观测、成员间工具路由都还没有成熟插件。

**3. 扩展入口标准化。** 左右两侧 Sidebar 的标准注册位 + 多标签/分栏/全屏展示。入口的标准化通常先于生态的繁荣(参考浏览器扩展的历史),它降低了安装意愿门槛,但也把"占位"价值收归平台。

## 二、兼容性:一次被数据证明的平稳升级

权威集 10,534 个插件中,6,859 个尚未发布 npm(无法实测),3,675 个已发布者中 1,242 个为 CLI/TUI 形态(无 client bundle)—— 余下 **2,431 个 web 形态已发布插件**的最新版 client bundle,对四档 shell 的模块表逐插件实测:

| shell | ok | broken | conditional |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0.0.1-rc.5(旧 latest tag) | 2332 | 81 | 0 |
| 0.1.2-rc.1(主流存量线) | 2266 | 144 | 3 |
| 0.1.5-alpha.2 / rc.1 | 2266 | 144 | 3 |

**0.1.2 → 0.1.5:零迁移(0 治愈、0 新破坏)。** 模块表在两个版本间完全一致 —— 在 5 个 release、3 个含 breaking 的密集发布节奏下,平台守住了"不改删模块"的纪律,这是对生态最重要的承诺,值得被明确看见。

144 个存量 broken 里 **132 个(92%)坏在同一个从未进入任何已发布 shell 模块表的模块**(`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-runtime/client`)。这与其说是兼容问题,不如说是**生态知识传播问题**:132 个作者在互不知情的情况下踩了同一个坑,而修法(迁移到 0.1.2-alpha.2 起收录的同名 API `dsh-client-store`)是确定且廉价的。一个坑被独立踩 132 次,说明生态缺少"修法知识"的分发层 —— 比模块本身更值得建设。

## 三、定位层冲击:1522 个插件需要重新回答"我是谁"

「侧栏 / 工作区」「文件浏览 / 预览」两类目共 **1522 个插件(权威集 14%)** 与本次内置功能正面重叠,其中头部三家(dsh-better-sidebar 4.3 万、dsh-univer-office 2.7 万、dsh-context 1.5 万周下载)承载着生态约 8.5 万/周的基础体验流量。

判断:**这不是收编,是分层。** 基础浏览/预览属于"用户预期开箱即得"的地基,平台收拢它对用户净收益为正;插件层的生存空间整体上移一格 —— 更深的格式支持、编辑能力、外部系统集成、与模型协议耦合的工作流。历史经验(浏览器扩展、VS Code)表明:入口标准化之后的三年,通常是插件生态总量的扩张期而非收缩期。但**个体**确实面临洗牌:与内置同质的插件,窗口期只到用户发现"内置已经有了"为止。

但上述乐观判断成立有一个前提:**开发者相信投入还能回收** —— 而当前恰恰缺这一环。被重叠类目的作者面临的是三重不确定:不知道自己的下一块功能何时被吸收、不知道内置边界在哪里、不知道官方如何看待自己刚刚验证过的需求(头部侧栏/预览插件用数月积累证明了这些是真实需求,平台随即将其收为基础能力,却没有对这段"需求验证劳动"给出任何姿态 —— 哪怕一句致谢或推荐迁移方向)。

**打击积极性的是不确定性,不是内置化本身。** 理性的插件作者会在下次投入前先问"这会不会是下一个被吸收的",答案没人能给 —— 于是减少投入、转向观望,长尾创新枯竭,最终"一切皆插件"的愿景反被自己的成功侵蚀。这不是假设:吸收带头部作者的作品下周还会更新吗,是本站后续会持续跟踪的先行指标。

对官方的一个提醒:公告预告的「内置插件管理面板」是下一块落地区域,建议提前公布与现有插件管理类工具的边界,给生态留出调整时间。

## 四、分发层暗坑:整个生态的新用户漏斗在无声漏水

`@deepseek-ai/dsh` 0.1.5 的 CLI 入口以 `if (import.meta.main)` 守卫,该属性在较旧 Node 上为 `undefined` —— **所有命令零输出、退出码 0**。实测:Node 22.14 / 23.11 / 24.0 / 24.1 静默失败,**24.21 / 25.9 / 26.8 正常**(精确引入版本待官方确认,见官方 Discussions #6124,社区已 3 例独立确认)。

影响的是生态整体而非 dsh 本体:一个潜在用户按公告执行 `npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web`,得到"什么都没发生",他的归因大概率不是"我的 Node 旧了"而是"dsh 不能用"—— 生态里所有插件的潜在装机量都从这同一个漏斗流过。修复成本极低(声明 engines + 启动守卫),收益是整个漏斗。

## 五、公告效应:温和的正向

DeepSeek Harness 官方公告发布当日(09-10),权威集按仓库创建日的新增:09-08 82 → 09-09 78 → **09-10(公告日)98**,周内次高(次于 09-03 的 102)。公告带来了真实的创作者流入,但生态的主增量仍来自日常惯性 —— 单日脉冲不是这个生态的增长模式,持续的开发者体验才是。

## 六、给三方的建议

**给 dsh 团队**:① 发版即移正 dist-tag(npm `latest` 曾长期指向远古 0.0.1-rc.5);② 补 `engines` 声明与启动守卫,消灭静默失败(#6124);③ 若未来强制校验 `engines.dsh`,需先定义预发布语义 —— 标准字面解读会把 `>=0.1.0-rc.6` 判为不兼容 0.1.1-rc.x,与作者意图相反(已有作者因此弃用声明);④ 把"不改删模块表"的纪律写进公开承诺 —— 本版已经做到了,说出来价值更大;⑤ **内置化路线图提前 1~2 个版本预告吸收范围**,并发布「内置边界宣言」:平台只收"用户预期开箱即得"的基础层,深度格式、编辑、跨系统集成永久留给插件 —— 给生态一颗定心丸;
⑥ **对被重叠的头部插件给出官方姿态**:推荐替代、邀请共建、或至少公开致谢其需求验证价值;一个「被吸收插件迁移指南」的成本远低于流失一批头部作者的代价。

**给插件作者**:基础体验同质区(浏览/预览/简单侧栏)的窗口正在关闭,向"内置不做"的方向迁移:深度格式、编辑、跨系统集成、模型协议耦合的编排;依赖运行时能力探测而非静态版本声明;132 个存量坑的修法是确定的一行级迁移,早修早安。

**给用户**:升级兼容风险实测为零,放心升;升级前先 `node --version`(< 24.21 会静默失败,升 Node 即解)。

**关于本站**:DSH Insights(dsh-insights.com)是一个独立的 dsh 生态观察站:插件健康评级、实测兼容矩阵、修法案例库与定期的生态报告,数据、规则与管线全部开源,每条结论可回溯到原始数据。插件作者可以在详情页核对每一项评分依据、免费领取 README 健康徽章;本文的全部数字同样来自它的公开快照。

---
