discussions.title: [Feature Request] Configurable composer send shortcut: Ctrl/Cmd+Enter to send, Enter inserts a newline
discussions.body:
### The problem

The composer currently binds the bare **Enter** to send and **Shift+Enter** to a line break, with no way to change it. For users writing long, multi-line prompts (which is the norm when orchestrating agents), Enter-as-send is a footgun: one accidental keystroke submits a half-written instruction. Most chat/agent front-ends (Slack, Discord, VS Code Copilot Chat, ChatGPT, Claude) offer a "Ctrl+Enter sends, Enter breaks line" mode for exactly this reason.

### Proposed design

A durable preference in the existing `ui-conversation` settings namespace:

- **Field**: `sendShortcut: 'enter' | 'ctrlEnter'` (default `'enter'` — current behavior; the schema default keeps old documents valid)
- **`'enter'`** (default): unchanged — Enter sends, Shift+Enter breaks the line
- **`'ctrlEnter'`**: the bare Enter falls through to the editor's native line break; only the Ctrl/Cmd chord reaches the submit gesture. The chord keeps the existing "accelerated gesture" semantics (the opposite of the busy-Enter preference while an agent is running)
- **Settings UI**: one new row in Settings → General, right below the existing busy-Enter row ("Send shortcut: Enter sends / Ctrl+Enter sends (Enter breaks line)"), zh + en locale strings included

### Why this can't live in an external plugin

The Enter decision happens inside the composer keymap (`packages/client/ui-conversation/src/client/input/editor/keymap.ts`) at `COMMAND_PRIORITY_CRITICAL`, before any extension point. An external plugin can neither intercept that decision nor substitute the composer bar without forking the whole skeleton, so the change has to be core.

### Implementation

A complete, tested patch is attached (`send-shortcut.patch` — 17 files, +196/−22), following the existing busy-Enter preference architecture end to end:

- `submission-settings.ts`: field, vocabulary, schema default (old documents stay valid)
- `submission-policy.ts`: reactive store, `setSendShortcut`, host adoption without write-back
- `keymap.ts`: one optional handler (`sendOnCtrlEnter`) — absent means Enter-sends, so every existing embedding keeps working
- `InputBar.tsx`: wires the live preference through the existing gate ref (no re-arm per keystroke)
- `SendShortcutRow.tsx`: the Settings row (mirrors `EnterBehaviorRow`'s shape and styling, reuses its module CSS)
- contract/slots/locales/exports updated

**Verification**:

- `tsc -b tsconfig.client.json` — clean
- All **430 tests in 102 suites** of `packages/client/ui-conversation` pass, including:
  - `keymap-routing`: synthetic keydowns — in ctrlEnter mode the bare Enter is not consumed and never submits; Ctrl and Cmd chords both submit; Shift+Enter stays a native break in both modes
  - `input-bar` (component bench): rendered composer — bare Enter does not submit while the chord does (with busy-state gesture semantics); flipping the preference live flips the bare-Enter behavior
  - `submission-policy`: defaults, scope write-through, host adoption
  - `host`: schema registration, defaults, invalid-value rejection, dispose
  - `apply-wiring` / `input-matrix` / `input-scenarios` / `skeleton`: props-contract adapters updated for the new hook

### Alternatives considered

- **Doing nothing**: Shift+Enter already covers line breaks, but it doesn't help the accident case — Enter is the muscle-memory key for "newline" in every text editor, and an accidental submit of a half-written multi-line prompt is disruptive (queued into a running agent or sent mid-thought).
- **A browser-side keyboard shim plugin**: rejected — it would fight the editor's own keymap and break with IME composition handling (the keymap's composition guards exist precisely because of that).

Happy to rework any part of this to match the team's preferred shape if the feature is accepted — e.g. a different field name, a third mode, or folding the row into the existing busy-Enter row.
[send-shortcut.patch](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/32087070/send-shortcut.patch)

discussions.title: [Bug] revealNativePath ("Show in File Explorer") silently fails for non-ASCII/CJK paths on Windows
discussions.body:
**Title:** `[Bug] revealNativePath ("Show in File Explorer") silently fails for non-ASCII/CJK paths on Windows`

**TL;DR（中文）**：Windows 上「在文件资源管理器中显示」对含中文的路径无效。`revealNativePath()` 把路径转成**百分号编码的 `file://` URL** 再交给 `explorer.exe /select,`，而 Explorer 的 `/select,` 只认字面文件路径、不做 URL 解码，于是定位失败并静默回退到默认文件夹（桌面）；同时 explorer 的退出码 1 被容忍，UI 还显示"已请求…"的假成功。纯 ASCII 路径正常，所以现有测试覆盖不到。

**Package:** `@deepseek-ai/dsh-native-command@0.1.5-rc.1`
**File:** `packages/util/native-command/src/path-opener.ts` → `revealNativePath()`
**Host:** Windows 11 23H2, build 22631.4890, zh-CN (ACP 936), Node v24.19.0
**Verified against:** `master` (source fetched 2026-09-11 — the code below is still present)

## Summary

On a Windows host, the "Show in File Explorer" action of a presented deliverable does nothing when the file path contains non-ASCII characters. The request reports success and the UI shows a success status, so the failure is silent and looks like a client-side or OS problem.

## Steps to reproduce

1. On a Windows host, place any file under a path containing non-ASCII characters, e.g. `I:\工作文档\测试\report.docx`.
2. Let the agent `present` the file, then pick **在文件资源管理器中显示 / Show in File Explorer** from the card menu.
3. The UI reports success (`presented.revealed`), but no Explorer window selects the file — usually a window opens at the Desktop instead.

## Expected

Explorer opens the containing folder with the file selected.

## Actual

Nothing is selected. Silent failure, reported to the UI as success.

## Root cause

```ts
// Explorer parses commas itself; a file URI preserves commas and whitespace in the path.
const target = pathToFileURL(windowsPath, { windows: true }).href.replaceAll(',', '%2C')
try {
  await run('explorer.exe', ['/select,', target], signal)
} catch (error) {
  signal.throwIfAborted()
  // Explorer can exit 1 after delegating to the existing desktop process.
  if (!(error instanceof Error) || !('code' in error) || error.code !== 1) throw error
}
```

`pathToFileURL()` percent-encodes non-ASCII path segments as UTF-8, so the argument becomes:

```
/select, file:///I:/%E5%B7%A5%E4%BD%9C%E6%96%87%E6%A1%A3/.../%E9%85%8D.docx
```

`explorer.exe /select,` takes a **literal filesystem path** and never URL-decodes its argument, so the target cannot be resolved. Explorer falls back to its default folder instead of failing loudly, and the tolerated exit code 1 means `revealNativePath()` resolves normally — the caller has no way to detect the failure.

## Minimal reproduction (no dsh required)

```powershell
$f   = 'I:\工作文档\测试\report.docx'
$url = ([uri]$f).AbsoluteUri          # file:///I:/%E5%B7%A5%E4%BD%9C%E6%96%87%E6%A1%A3/...

Start-Process explorer.exe -ArgumentList '/select,', $url   # ✗ nothing selected, window opens at Desktop
Start-Process explorer.exe -ArgumentList '/select,', $f     # ✓ folder opens with the file selected

# ground-truth check for the selection:
# (New-Object -ComObject Shell.Application).Windows() |
#   ForEach-Object { $_.Document.FocusedItem.Path }
```

Measured results (clean baseline, selection verified via `Shell.Application.Windows().Document.FocusedItem.Path`):

| argument after `/select,` | file selected |
| --- | --- |
| `I:\工作文档\…\完形高频固定搭配.docx` (literal path) | ✅ |
| `file:///I:/工作文档/…/完形高频固定搭配.docx` (raw CJK URI) | ✅ |
| `file:///I:/%E5%B7%A5%E4%BD%9C…/%E9%85%8D.docx` (percent-encoded — **current code**) | ❌ falls back to Desktop |
| `file:///C:/Windows/win.ini` (ASCII URI) | ✅ |

The last row is why this went unnoticed: a URI with nothing to escape works, so the code behaves correctly for ASCII-only paths.

## Suggested fix

Hand Explorer the literal path:

```ts
await run('explorer.exe', ['/select,', windowsPath], signal)
```

If comma preservation is genuinely required, note that the current approach probably does not achieve it either — Explorer does not URL-decode `%2C`, so a path containing a comma is likely broken today as well. Worth verifying before keeping the URI form; a conservative alternative is to keep it only for pure-ASCII paths:

```ts
const target = /^[\x20-\x7E]*$/.test(windowsPath)
  ? pathToFileURL(windowsPath, { windows: true }).href.replaceAll(',', '%2C')
  : windowsPath
```

## Suggested test vector

A unit test over `revealNativePath()` internals with a non-ASCII `windowsPath` asserting the argv handed to the runner is `/select,` + the literal path (not a `file://` URI). A Windows-only integration test that asserts `Shell.Application.Windows().Document.FocusedItem.Path`, rather than the command's exit code, would have caught this.

## Scope

Any Windows host whose workspace path contains non-ASCII characters — including a Web UI served from such a host, since the command runs on the Host, not in the browser.

discussions.title: [Bug]dsh删了我的文件,如果反馈有帮助，希望可以修复。
discussions.body:
# `mount-sandbox-inner.sh`：`umount` 失败被忽略，随后 `rm -rf "$stage"` 穿过仍然存活的**读写** bind 挂载，删除了用户真实的工作目录

## 摘要

bash 工具的挂载沙箱会创建一个临时 "stage" 目录、`chroot` 进去，并把用户的工作目录以**读写**方式 bind 挂载到其中。退出时，它的清理 trap 执行：

```bash
cleanup() {
  set +e
  umount -R "$stage" >/dev/null 2>&1   # 退出码被丢弃
  rm -rf -- "$stage"                   # 无论如何都会执行
}
trap cleanup EXIT
```

只要被包裹的命令**留下任何一个进程**挂在沙箱上（后台任务、`setsid`/`nohup` 脱离的守护进程、尚未退出的子进程、cwd 或 root 仍在 stage 内的 shell），`umount -R` 就会失败——报 `EBUSY` / `target is busy`（退出码 32）。由于这个失败被吞掉，紧随其后的 `rm -rf` 会**穿过那个仍然挂载着的读写 bind**，把用户真实的工作目录删掉。

stage 里其余的挂载**全是只读的**，因此工作目录是**唯一**可能被毁掉的东西——而它会被**静默地、彻底地**删除；与此同时所有只读路径只是刷出无害的 `Read-only file system` 噪音。在我们的案例中，一棵积累了数周的项目目录树（含 `.git`）在几秒内被清空，并且同一天内发生了三次，直到我们定位到原因。

## 影响

- **用户的工作目录被完全、静默地销毁。** 不是部分失败，没有任何警告——下一条命令执行时，目录就没了。
- 失败**不会通知用户**：`umount` 的错误被重定向到 `/dev/null`，而 `rm` 的错误全都是关于**只读**路径的，看起来就像沙箱里常见的权限噪音。
- 它是**偶发且罕见的**（数百次沙箱调用中只出现寥寥数次），因此极难归因。而触发条件恰恰是完全正常的用法：留下了一个后台进程。
- 这一点被一个事实放大：在编码 agent 里跑长时间脱离的任务是很平常的事（`cmd &`、`setsid nohup ... &`），而且 agent 自己也可能把命令放到后台执行。

## 环境

- `@deepseek-ai/dsh` **0.1.5-rc.1**
- Linux，以 root 运行并具备 `CAP_SYS_ADMIN`（`mount` 调用所需）
- ext4；工作目录与沙箱 stage 根目录位于**同一个文件系统/设备**上
  （这一点很关键——见下文"为什么显而易见的防护无效"）
- 沙箱入口：`mount-sandbox-runner.sh` →
  `unshare --mount --fork --propagation private /bin/bash mount-sandbox-inner.sh "$workspace" "$@"`

## 根因

`mount-sandbox-inner.sh`（节选，发行版本）：

```bash
workspace="$1"
shift
stage="$(mktemp -d "$SANDBOX_TMP_ROOT/dsh-mount-sandbox.XXXXXX")"

cleanup() {
  set +e
  umount -R "$stage" >/dev/null 2>&1     # <-- 失败被丢弃
  rm -rf -- "$stage"                     # <-- 照常执行
}
trap cleanup EXIT

mkdir -p "$stage"/{dev,proc,tmp,etc,opt,var,run,usr,data}
...
mount --bind "$stage" "$stage"
mount -o remount,bind,ro "$stage"        # 沙箱根目录（"/"）是只读的

for path in /usr /etc /opt /var /run; do
  mount --bind "$path" "$stage$path"
  mount -o remount,bind,ro "$stage$path" # 只读
done
mount --bind /proc "$stage/proc"; mount -o remount,bind,ro "$stage/proc"

mount --bind /data "$stage/data"                 # 工作目录的父目录
mount -o remount,bind,ro "$stage/data"           # 只读
mount --bind "$workspace" "$stage$workspace"     # <-- 真实的用户工作目录……
mount -o remount,bind,rw "$stage$workspace"      # <-- ……以【读写】方式挂载

chroot "$stage" /bin/bash -c '...' "$workspace" "$@"
```

四个事实共同构成了这个缺陷：

1. **工作目录以读写方式 bind 进 stage**，而且它是沙箱里**唯一**的读写目录。在存活的沙箱内实测：

   | 只读 | 可写 |
   |---|---|
   | `/`、`/usr`、`/etc`、`/opt`、`/var`、`/run`、`/proc`，以及父目录包装层 | `/dev/{null,zero,random,urandom}` 与 **`$workspace`** |

2. **只要有进程还挂在上面，`umount -R` 就会以 `EBUSY` 失败。** 被包裹的命令是以
   *`/` = stage* 的方式 `chroot` 运行的，因此它派生出的**每一个**进程的 root 都在 stage 里。
   只要有一个子进程活着，就足以让卸载失败。

3. **失败被丢弃**（`set +e` 加 `>/dev/null 2>&1`），于是 `rm -rf` 照常执行，并顺着那个
   仍然存活的 bind 挂载递归——也就是递归进了真实的工作目录。

4. **用户看不到任何提示**：`rm` 会对所有只读挂载刷出成千上万条
   `Read-only file system` 错误（看起来像是预期内的噪音），而对唯一可写的那条路径，
   它一条消息都不打就删干净了。

有一个次要现象可以佐证整个时序：stage 目录会保留下来，其下所有子目录**都存在但为空**——
`rm` 把内容掏空了，却无法 `rmdir` 那些还活着的挂载点。等到最后一个进程退出，这个私有挂载
命名空间被销毁，挂载随之消失，于是只剩下这些看起来人畜无害的空壳。**它们就是每一次事故的指纹。**

## 最小复现（独立脚本，不需要 DSH）

```bash
stage=$(mktemp -d /tmp/stage.XXXXXX)
work=/tmp/workspace                      # 代替真实项目目录
mkdir -p "$stage/mnt" "$work"; echo important > "$work/file"

mount --bind "$stage" "$stage"
mount -o remount,bind,ro "$stage"
mount --bind "$work" "$stage/mnt"        # 工作目录，读写
mount -o remount,bind,rw "$stage/mnt"

# 被包裹的命令留下这种东西是再正常不过的事：
( cd "$stage/mnt" && sleep 60 & )
sleep 1

umount -R "$stage"; echo "umount rc=$?"
#   实测输出：umount: /tmp/stage.XXXXXX/mnt: target is busy.
#             umount rc=32

rm -rf -- "$stage"                        # 这正是 trap 所做的事
ls "$work"                                # 实测：真实目录已被清空
```

对照组（无进程占用）：`umount -R` 返回 `0`，`rm -rf` 完全无害——这也是它为什么只是偶发。

## 为什么显而易见的防护无效

`rm -rf --one-file-system` **挡不住**这个问题。bind 挂载与它来源的文件系统共享同一个
`st_dev`，因此 `rm -x` 会毫不犹豫地穿过去。**只有真正把挂载 detach 掉，后续的 `rm -rf` 才是安全的。**

## 建议修复

把删除动作建立在**已验证完成**的卸载之上。**惰性卸载（`-l`）即使在 target busy 时也能成功**，
而它已经足以消除危险——因为挂载在 `rm` 执行之前就已经从命名空间里被摘掉了：

```bash
cleanup() {
  set +e
  # 先尝试普通递归卸载，失败则退回惰性卸载。惰性卸载在 target busy 时依然成功，
  # 这正是下面那条 rm -rf 变得安全的原因。
  umount -R "$stage" 2>/dev/null || umount -R -l "$stage" 2>/dev/null

  # 只要底下还有任何挂载，就绝不删除。
  if grep -q -- " $stage" /proc/mounts 2>/dev/null; then
    echo "mount-sandbox: refusing to remove $stage: still mounted after umount -R -l" >&2
    return
  fi

  # 只删除确实是我们自己创建的 stage 路径。
  case "$stage" in
    "$SANDBOX_TMP_ROOT"/dsh-mount-sandbox.??????) ;;
    *) echo "mount-sandbox: refusing to remove unexpected path $stage" >&2; return ;;
  esac

  rm -rf -- "$stage"
}
```

三种写法在同一个 busy 挂载上的实测表现：

| 情况 | 命令 | 结果 |
|---|---|---|
| 无进程占用 | `umount -R $stage` | rc=0，挂载清除 |
| 有进程 cwd 在其中 | `umount -R $stage` | **rc=32，"target is busy"**，挂载仍在 |
| 有进程 cwd 在其中 | `umount -R -l $stage` | **rc=0，挂载清除** |

另外值得考虑的三项加固：

- 在不需要写入的场景下**根本不要以读写方式 bind 工作目录**；用 overlay 或直接拷贝可以
  从根上消除这一类缺陷。
- **把 teardown 失败报告给用户**，而不是丢弃——一个无法正常拆除的沙箱，本身就是用户应当
  知道的状态。
- 在卸载之前**先结束/等待沙箱的进程组**，这样残留子进程从一开始就无法让挂载变成 busy。

## 用户侧的临时规避（在修复发布之前）

把已安装的 `mount-sandbox-inner.sh` 按上面的 `cleanup()` 打补丁（或者至少做到：`umount`
失败时拒绝执行 `rm -rf`），并且避免在沙箱命令里留下后台/脱离的进程。

## 取证特征

如果你怀疑这件事已经发生过：

- 去找那些残留的 `dsh-mount-sandbox.*` 目录，它们下面的子目录**存在但全为空**。它们的
  mtime 就是出事那一刻，每一份对应一次失败的 teardown。
- 那个时刻包装器的 stderr 里会有大量形如
  `rm: cannot remove '<stage>/...': Read-only file system` 的行——这是只读挂载在拒绝删除，
  恰好证明 `rm` 当时仍在遍历一个活着的 stage。
- 真正消失的目录**只有一个**：那个以读写方式 bind 进来的工作目录。

discussions.title: Sidebar: stack multiple footer actions vertically (wide plugin footers get squeezed)
discussions.body:
## Problem

When multiple plugins register into the `sidebar.footer.action` seat at once (for example `dsh-knowledge`'s icon button next to `dsh-workvista`'s project worktable), the seat lays its occupants out in a **horizontal flex row** (`.footerActions` in `packages/client/ui-sidebar/src/client/SidebarRoot.module.css`). A wide plugin footer that requests `width: 100%` (the worktable) loses its space next to sibling buttons, and the sidebar footer becomes cramped.

## Suggested fix (CSS-only, no slot/API changes)

Stack the seat vertically:

```css
.footerActions {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 4px;
}
```

- Every footer action gets its own full-width row.
- In collapsed (rail) mode the same column direction carries over: footer icons stay vertically centered, consistent with the rail's existing vertical icon language.
- `.settingsArea` and the owner/slot contracts are untouched; each occupant still owns its button geometry.

## Verification

- `pnpm vitest run packages/client/ui-sidebar` → 28 test files / 241 tests passed (including the sidebar snapshot suite).
- Manual, in a Web profile with both `dsh-knowledge` and `dsh-workvista` installed: footer actions stack vertically; the worktable keeps its full width. The `client-hmr` stat-poll chain hot-swaps the rebuilt `ui-sidebar` bundle without a server restart.

## Patch

Branch: https://github.com/AndyPBI/deepseek-harness/tree/fix/sidebar-footer-actions-vertical
Commit: https://github.com/AndyPBI/deepseek-harness/commit/e7b5e49f99

One file, +5/-1. The team is welcome to take it as-is or adapt it to DSH conventions.

discussions.title: [Bug Report] session.fork 的 seed 多带一条 user prompt：turn/end 与下一个 turn/start 之间的事件被扫进子会话，子会话重跑父会话的下一条任务
discussions.body:
`session.fork` cuts its seed by walking forward from the boundary `turn/end` until the next `turn/start`. Everything *between* those two events — notably the durable `agent/inbox/spliced` that admits the **next** user prompt — is therefore included in the child's seed. Because pending input is rebuilt by folding `agent/inbox/spliced` (`dsh-agent-loop` inbox projection), the forked child starts with the parent's **next prompt already queued** and re-runs a task the parent already completed.

## 环境

- `dsh` 0.1.5-rc.1（全局安装，Homebrew node_modules）
- `@deepseek-ai/dsh-api-session-controller` 0.1.5-rc.1，缺陷在 `lib/index.js:683-685`（`fork()`）
- Node v26.8.1，macOS (darwin/arm64)
- 入口：会话内「已完成轮次最后一条消息」下方的分支按钮（zh 文案「在新对话中分支」，`dsh-client-ui-chat` 的 `TurnTailNodeView.onBranch` → `ctx.sessions.fork({ sessionId, atSeq, increaseTitle: true })`）
- 侧边栏会话行菜单「分叉会话」（`dsh-client-ui-workspace`，不带 `atSeq`）同样复现

## 复现步骤

1. 与 DSH 跑完一个轮次 turn N（例如「装插件」这类多步任务）。
2. 提交下一条 prompt（turn N+1 已开始或已完成）。
3. 在 **turn N** 的最后一条回复上点「在新对话中分支」。
4. 观察子会话：它一打开就带着 turn N+1 的那条 prompt 作为待处理输入，并直接把 turn N+1 的任务重跑一遍。

预期：子会话的 seed = 「到 turn N 的 `turn/end` 为止」的一个完整已完成轮次前缀。
实际：seed 额外包含 turn N+1 的用户 prompt（以及 `turn/end` 与下一个 `turn/start` 之间的其他事件）。

侧边栏「分叉会话」（取最后一个 `turn/end`）在父会话存在排队/进行中的下一条提交时同样中招；对子会话再次分叉会累积多条多出来的 prompt。

## 根因

`@deepseek-ai/dsh-api-session-controller/lib/index.js`：

```js
const lastSeq = source.events.at(-1)?.seq ?? -1;
const boundary = (atSeq === undefined ? undefined : source.events.find((event) => event.type === "turn/end" && event.seq >= atSeq))
  ?? (atSeq === undefined || atSeq > lastSeq ? source.events.findLast((event) => event.type === "turn/end") : undefined);
if (boundary === undefined) throw new RemoteError("session/fork-unavailable", /* … */);

let cut = SessionLogOffset(boundary.seq + 1);
while (cut < source.events.length && source.events[cut]?.type !== "turn/start") cut = SessionLogOffset(cut + 1);   // ← 684-685
```

`slice(0, cut)` 于是包含 `boundary.seq + 1 … (下一个 turn/start - 1)` 的全部事件。而 DSH 的日志顺序（实测）是：

```
turn/end(N)  →  agent/inbox/spliced { inserted: [下一条用户 prompt] }  →  turn/start(N+1)
             →  agent/inbox/spliced { removedCount: 1, inserted: [] }   →  step/start  →  user/message
```

也就是说，**分叉点之后的下一条用户提交恰好落在这个被扫入的窗口里**。

子会话的待处理输入不是快照，而是 fold 出来的：`dsh-agent-loop` 的 `inboxProjectionDefinition` 对每个 `agent/inbox/spliced` 做

```js
const next = inbox.toSpliced(splice.start, splice.removedCount ?? 0, ...splice.inserted);
```

所以被继承的那条 splice 会把父会话的下一条 prompt 变成子会话的 `next-turn` 待处理项；子会话 resume / 打开后循环 claim 该输入并开一轮，于是父会话已跑过的任务被重跑。

`fork()` 自己的文档注释写的是 “Create a new ordinary Session from **one completed-turn prefix**”，`boundary.seq + 1` 才符合该语义。

## 证据（本机真实日志）

父会话 `session-892cd3e7-3a93-48a9-982b-0072d486201c`（2026-09-10T23:07:06，`isSeeded:false`）：

```
695  turn/end            {"turn":3,"reason":{"kind":"completed"}}
696  session/end-seed    {}
697  agent/inbox/spliced {"target":"next-turn","start":0,"inserted":[{"content":[{"type":"text","text":"我刚在本地使用 Local daemon 方式安装了 Hindsight，你检查一下是否可肜。"}], …}]}
698  turn/start          {"turn":4}
699  agent/inbox/spliced {"target":"next-turn","start":0,"removedCount":1,"inserted":[]}
702  user/message        "我刚在本地使用 Local daemon 方式安装了 Hindsight，你检查一下是否可用。"
```

在 turn 3 的尾部（`atSeq` ≈ 693 的 assistant/message）分叉 → `boundary = 695`，`cut` 被 `while` 推到 **698**，seed = `events[0..697]`，**最后一条正是 697 的那条 splice**。

子会话 `session-54d4d9dd-…`（2026-09-11T13:00:34，`isSeeded:true`，`parentSession: session-892cd3e7-…`）：

```
695  turn/end            {"turn":3,…}          ← 继承
696  session/end-seed    {}                   ← 继承
697  agent/inbox/spliced {"inserted":[ …"我刚在本地…" ]}   ← 继承（不该有）
698  session/end-seed    {"inherited":true}   ← fork cut 标记（inheritedEventCount = 698）
701  turn/start          {"turn":4}           ← 子会话自己的第一轮
705  user/message        "我刚在本地使用 Local daemon 方式安装了 Hindsight，你检查一下是否可用。"
```

另一个子会话 `session-6715d80f-…`（2026-09-11T13:09:53，同一父会话）完全同构：inherited 标记在 698，首个 `user/message` 在 seq 707，内容与父会话 turn 4 的 prompt 逐字相同。**两个 fork 子会话各把父会话的下一条任务重跑了一遍。**

fork 链上的叠加效应：`session-1b17eb0b-…`（父为上面那个已是 fork 的 `54d4d9dd`）的 inherited 标记在 701，其 seed 尾部是 696/697/698（继承的 splice + 标记）+ 699 `session/title` + 700 又一条 `agent/inbox/spliced`，即一次分叉继承了**两条**排队 prompt。

最小验证（对任意 v3 日志）：

```python
import json
evs = [json.loads(l) for l in open("session.v3.jsonl") if l.strip() and "seq" in l]
at_seq = 693                                   # 分支按钮传入的 atSeq
boundary = next(e for e in evs if e["type"] == "turn/end" and e["seq"] >= at_seq)
cut = boundary["seq"] + 1
while cut < len(evs) and evs[cut]["type"] != "turn/start":
    cut += 1
print("boundary", boundary["seq"], "cut", cut)
for e in evs[boundary["seq"]:cut]:
    print("  swept into seed:", e["seq"], e["type"])
# 实测输出：697 agent/inbox/spliced  ← 下一条用户 prompt
```

## 建议修复

```js
const cut = SessionLogOffset(boundary.seq + 1);
```

即删掉那个 `while`。`boundary.seq + 1` 本身就是完整的已完成轮次前缀，子会话的 `session/end-seed {inherited:true}` 标记仍会落在同一位置（`inheritedEventCount = cut`），不违反 v2/v3 seeded-header 的 “last inherited end-seed marker === cut” 约束。

如果确实需要在 seed 里保留 `turn/end` 之后的若干非轮次事件（`session/title`、sandbox/approval 状态等），也请**显式排除**带 `inserted` 的 `agent/inbox/spliced` —— 那一条不是历史，而是「未来的输入」，继承它必然改变子会话的执行语义。

补充建议：即便保留扫描，也应当把 `agent/inbox/spliced` 视为 cut 的硬边界（或对继承的 pending 输入做一次 `outcome:"canceled"` 的显式清空），否则用户无法通过 UI 区分「历史」与「会被执行的待办」。

## 临时规避（用户侧）

- 分叉点之后还没有新提交时立刻分叉：此时父会话最后一条事件就是 `turn/end`，`cut` 等于日志长度，分叉干净。
- 侧边栏「分叉会话」同理，需在无排队/无进行中轮次时使用。
- 已中招的子会话：立即中止，并在队列（QueueDock）里 Edit/Remove/Steer 掉那条多出来的消息；注意子会话可能在打开瞬间就已开跑。

## 相关

- Discussion #450 另一个 fork 缺陷（fork 丢失读取观察状态）—— 与本条无关，但同属 `session.fork`。
- 生态对照：`dsh-better-sidebar` 的「保存为新会话」显式判断 `threadTrailingPending`（最后一条 `user/message` 未被 `turn/end` 回答）并**不**把待处理追问带进新会话，可作为期望语义的参考实现。

discussions.title: [开源插件] Dolphin（小海豚）：非科班大一学生的暑期作品，一个跨平台的主动巡检型安全防御插件
discussions.body:
1. 自我介绍
大家好，我是一名非科班大一学生（水土保持专业），暑期自学了 AI 一些知识和 PyTorch。因为想在自己用的 DSH 生态里解决点实际问题，就折腾出了这个小插件。第一次来社区发帖，想跟大家分享交流一下。
2. 插件是什么？解决了什么痛点？
这个插件叫 Dolphin，定位是“主动巡检型安全防御”。不被动等告警，而是定期通过 SSH 去目标主机跑扫描评估。
3. 开发过程中踩过的坑
• 踩过 Windows/Linux 跨平台路径错位的坑。远程传规则文件老是找不到，后来我加了个 detectRemoteTempBase 才统一了映射（v0.2.4 的修复）。
• 远端没装 semgrep 怎么办？我做了三级隔离部署链（pipx → venv → 便携 wheel 包），绝不污染对方生产环境。
4. 当前现状 & 寻路
插件目前已经发布到 GitHub 和 npm，9月9号刚更新了 v0.2.4，目前下载量还能看。但我心里很清楚自己还在摸索阶段。
下一步想优化跨平台的隔离策略，想请社区的前辈们指点两句，或者如果有用过的朋友，欢迎给我提 Issue。
5. 结尾和链接
附上 GitHub 仓库和 npm 链接。感谢大家的时间。
GitHub 仓库：https://github.com/ccr-wer/dsh-dolphin-security
npm 包页：https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-dolphin-security
（我是四川水利职业技术学院的，有在成都读书的友友吗，可以扩个列吗）

discussions.title: [Bug] 摘要调用丢失 reasoningEffort，导致 /compact 在 provider 默认档位不被支持时必然失败，并被报成「could not produce a useful summary」
discussions.body:
## 环境

- dsh `0.1.5-alpha.2`（本地安装版），同一段代码在 `master` 上复核过
- 路由：`opencode-go-response` / `deepseek-flash`
- 证据：本机 3 个会话日志（2 个失败 + 1 个成功对照），外加 `~/.dsh/settings.yaml`

*说明：问题由我在真实使用中复现并提供证据，根因定位与本文起草有 AI 协助；每条技术结论我都对着源码与会话日志核对过。如有说错的地方欢迎指出。*

## Summary

在当前配置下 `/compact` **必然失败**，而且用户看到的报错掩盖了真实原因。

真实原因：压缩摘要调用（`summarizeWithLlm`）只从最近一次路由请求的 header 里取 `provider` / `model`，**丢掉了 `reasoningEffort`**。于是 pi-ai 适配器回退到 provider 级默认档位 `reasoning`；该默认档位恰好是 `deepseek-flash` 不支持的 `xhigh`，适配器直接抛错，整个压缩事务失败。

这个错误最终被归类成 `summary` 阶段失败，`/compact` 显示为：

> Compaction could not produce a useful summary. The conversation is unchanged; the attempt is recorded in the session log.

也就是说，用户被指向"摘要质量不行"，而真正的原因是"辅助调用用了模型不支持的推理档位"。

**与已有讨论的关系（重要）：** 本问题的*根因*不是新发现——[#3002](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/3002) 与 [#1944](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/1944) 已经报告过"摘要调用丢失 reasoningEffort"，但那两篇聚焦的是**前缀缓存失效与计费**损失。[#6184](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/6184) 报告的是同一句错误信息掩盖真实原因，但它的根因是 `TRANSPORT`。

本篇补充的是同一个根因的**第二个、更严重的后果**：当路由存在一个不等于会话实际档位的 provider 级默认值时，丢失 `reasoningEffort` 会把压缩从"多花点钱"变成"**完全不可用**"，并套上同一层错误掩盖。根因修复建议我认同 #3002 的最小改法，此处不重复；本篇价值在于记录该后果及其可复现的对照证据。

## 证据

同一份代码路径、同一个 `/compact` 命令，两个会话失败、一个会话成功：

| 会话 | 路由/模型 | header `reasoningEffort` | `compaction/start` | `compaction/summary` | `compaction/end` |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `session-9c6af326…`（v3） | `opencode-go-response` / `deepseek-flash` | `high` | seq 623 | **0 条（从未成功）** | seq 624，`error="pi-ai provider \"opencode-go-response\" model \"deepseek-flash\" does not support reasoning effort \"xhigh\""` |
| `session-c3c31312…`（v3） | `opencode-go-response` / `deepseek-flash` | `high` | seq 939 | **0 条（从未成功）** | seq 940，同上错误字符串 |
| `session-8597c945…`（yidayun，v2，成功对照） | `opencode-go-response` / `deepseek-v4-flash` | `xhigh` | seq 983 | seq 984（`shadowedTokenCount: 217908`） | seq 986（无 `error`） |

关键观察：

1. 两个失败会话的 `request/header` 里，会话自身实际使用的档位是 `reasoningEffort: "high"`，而 `deepseek-flash` 声明的档位是 `low / high / max`——`high` 是被支持的。**正常对话能跑通，只有压缩失败**，说明失败与"用户档位"无关，而与"压缩调用丢失档位后回退到的默认值"有关。
2. 失败会话中 `compaction/summary` 事件数为 0，即该配置下 `/compact` 从未成功过，不是偶发。
3. 成功对照表明：同一段压缩代码，只要回退后的档位落在模型支持集合内就能正常产出摘要。所以问题精确定位在档位解析，而不是压缩事务本身。

`~/.dsh/settings.yaml` 中的相关配置：

```yaml
llm-pi-ai:
  providers:
    opencode-go-response:
      reasoning: xhigh          # provider 级默认；同时服务 muse-spark 与 deepseek-flash
      models:
        - id: deepseek-flash
          reasoningEfforts:
            low: low
            high: high
            max: max            # 没有 xhigh
```

`settings.yaml` 里没有任何 compaction 相关配置，因此 `summarizationProvider` / `summarizationModel` 为空，摘要目标回退为最近一次路由的 header（即 `opencode-go-response` / `deepseek-flash`）。

## 源码定位（master）

1. `packages/compaction/compaction-basic/src/summarizer.ts:126-141`：只从 `agent.session.requestHeader()?.config` 解析出 `provider` / `model`。
2. `packages/compaction/compaction-basic/src/summarizer.ts:151-160`：构造 `GenerateOptions` 时列了 `provider` / `model` / `messages` / `tools` / `maxTokens` / `sessionId` / `purpose` / `signal`，**没有 `reasoningEffort`**。
3. `packages/compaction/compaction-basic/src/index.ts:53-61`（`routedTarget`）：同样只挑 `provider` / `model` 两个字段。
4. `packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/src/adapter.ts:344-347`：`const reasoning = resolveReasoningLevel(model, options.reasoningEffort ?? profile.reasoning)` —— 请求没给档位时回退到 **provider 级** `profile.reasoning`。
5. `packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/src/adapter.ts:158-169`：回退档位不在模型支持集合内则抛 `UNSUPPORTED_REASONING_EFFORT`。
6. `packages/compaction/compaction-basic/src/region.ts:277-297`（`throwManualFailure`）：非 `commit`、非 `SurfaceChangedError` 的失败统一抛 `ManualCompactionError('summary', 'manual compaction could not produce a smaller summary')`。
7. `packages/compaction/command-compact/src/index.ts:37-41`：`summary` 码映射为 "could not produce a useful summary"。

补充一点：provider 级 `reasoning` 是**路由级**字段（`packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/src/config.ts:150-153`），而 model 级 profile（`packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/src/catalog.ts:574-608`）**没有** `reasoning` 字段。因此无法把 `xhigh` 只作用在支持它的 `muse-spark` 上、而不影响同路由的 `deepseek-flash`——这也是该配置容易踩坑的原因之一。

## 最小复现

1. 配一个 provider 路由，其 `reasoning` 默认档位是该路由下某个模型不支持的（例：`opencode-go-response.reasoning: xhigh`，而 `deepseek-flash` 只声明 `low/high/max`）。
2. 让主对话使用一个受支持的档位（例：`agent-default-model.reasoningEffort: high`），确认对话正常。
3. 执行 `/compact`。
4. 观察会话日志：出现带 `error` 的 `compaction/end`，且没有 `compaction/summary`；UI 显示 "could not produce a useful summary"。

## 影响

- 该配置下 `/compact` **100% 失败**（自动压缩同理，只是错误被 `agent/pre-step` 的 catch 降级为 `logger.warn` 的 "step compaction failed: …"，所以更不易察觉）。
- 错误归因误导：真实原因（不支持的推理档位）只落在日志字段 `compaction/end.error` 里，用户看到的是"摘要质量"。
- 对不熟悉 provider 级默认值语义的用户，表现为"我明明能正常聊天，却永远压缩不了"。

## 临时规避

将 provider 级默认档位改为该路由**所有**模型都支持的档位（例如 `high`），或为压缩单独指定 `summarizationProvider` / `summarizationModel` 走一个无此默认值的路由。这只能绕开症状，不能修复"压缩调用未忠实复刻被压缩请求"这一缺口。

## 建议

根因修复同 #3002 / #1944（把最近一次路由的 `reasoningEffort` 在目标路由一致时转发给摘要调用）。在此基础上，建议顺带考虑：

- 当摘要调用因 `UNSUPPORTED_REASONING_EFFORT` 这类**请求封装**错误失败时，不要归类为 `summary`；它和"摘要质量/体积"是两个不同阶段，混在一起会让用户排查方向完全跑偏（与 #6184 的诉求一致）。

discussions.title: 0.1.5-rc.1 轮次「用时」面板不显示输出速度与首 token 用时（数据已落盘但未渲染）
discussions.body:
感谢开源这个项目。报告一个 `0.1.5-rc.1` 的 Web UI 问题：

## 环境

- 版本：`0.1.5-rc.1`（`npx -y @deepseek-ai/dsh@latest web` 原样启动，无任何插件 / overlay）
- 系统：macOS (Apple Silicon)，Chrome 访问 Web UI

## 复现步骤

1. 新建项目，向 Agent 提问（触发多步工具调用的回合，如 web 搜索 / `web_fetch`）
2. 回合结束后立即点击消息下方的「用时」胶囊

## 实际结果

弹窗只有「本轮总用时」一行，「输出速度（tok/s）」和「首 token 用时」两行始终不显示。多步 Agent 回合必现。

## 期望结果

面板显示输出速度与首 token 用时（`TurnTimePanel` 的 `tokensPerSecond` / `ttftMs` 两行）。

## 排查发现（供参考）

会话日志（`session.v3.jsonl.zstd`）里数据是完整的：每步都有 `step/start` 时间戳、流式增量批次（`chunk` 信封内的 `text-chunks`，含 `dt` 增量数组）、`usage`。但前端折叠层的 `isTokenDelta` 只识别 `text-delta` / `reasoning-delta` / `tool-call-delta` 单增量类型，不识别持久化的 `text-chunks` 批次格式，导致从会话记录恢复节点时 `firstTokenTime` 恢复不出来，两行被按「数据不可知」隐藏。疑似增量批次在回放链路上没有被解包（或解包后丢失时间戳）。

另外对比了 rc.2 的 `dsh-client-ui-chat`，该区域与 rc.1 无差异，问题应仍在。

discussions.title: V8-level fatal (uncatchable, process-wide) crash in @deepseek-ai/dsh-tools schema validation recursion while a turn starts (0.1.5-rc.1)
discussions.body:
### Summary

The whole harness process died at once (uncatchable, V8-level fatal) inside the recursive JSON-schema validation chain of `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools`, while a turn was starting / an inbox splice (`#next-step`) was being processed. All live turns — including several background agents mid-delivery — were killed. Durable session logs survived (work products had landed on disk seconds before), but the process was simply gone: gateway port went to connection-refused immediately, no graceful shutdown, nothing JS-level could intercept it.

### Environment

- Harness core: 0.1.5-rc.1, Windows 11 x64 (build 10.0.22631), Node v24.18.0
- Preset: `ptc` (code mode); ~13 plugins, including dsh-background-agents 0.9.5, dsh-mneme 0.7.29, dsh-openwolf, a community auto-continue plugin, and a runtime-injector plugin that registers additional dev tools
- Crash evidence: a single V8 fatal dump in the harness stderr log (full 31 KB file available on request)

### Timeline (local, UTC+8)

- 12:52 boot — green (stderr only `ExperimentalWarning`)
- 12:52–14:06 — normal multi-agent work; background agents delivered twice in this window (a 267-line frontend page at 14:06:14, a 116-line research file at 14:06:04)
- Minutes before death: 8 × `turn/end:error` events observed by our auto-continue plugin; it attempted automatic recovery twice — both failed
- 14:06:21 — last durable write: a child agent mid-turn (step 13, right after a `run_code` tool call). The process died at that moment; port closed; zero processes remained.

### The fatal dump (excerpt, verbatim)

```
Stacktrace:
    ptr0=00000222995C1271
    ptr1=0000000000000000
    ...
    failure_message_object=00000097BADF3C80

==== JS stack trace =========================================

    0: ExitFrame
    2: hasIntrinsicConstructor [...] @deepseek-ai/dsh-tools/lib/index.js:60
    3: isIntrinsicObjectPrototype [...] @deepseek-ai/dsh-tools/lib/index.js:70
    4: isPlainJsonRecord [...] @deepseek-ai/dsh-tools/lib/index.js:82
    5: isJsonSchemaRecord [...] @deepseek-ai/dsh-tools/lib/index.js:108
    6: checkSchemaNode [...] @deepseek-ai/dsh-tools/lib/index.js:182
```

Frame 6's arguments include an Object, the string `#schema`, an empty JSArray, and a **Set** (a visited set — cycle detection is present on this path). The `==== Details ====` section of the same dump shows the crash-time frames include the agent turn driver — the `turn()` function of the session/agent machinery whose next statement is `this.session.append("turn/st…` — plus the string `#next-step` (the inbox-splice target). The five schema-walker functions above appear **15 times** across the dump, i.e. the recursion cycle repeating.

Notably, the failure message itself was never printed as text — only `failure_message_object` and raw pointers — consistent with a V8-level fatal that dies before it can stringify anything.

### Reading

- `checkSchemaNode` walks a JSON schema recursively (`isJsonSchemaRecord` → `isPlainJsonRecord` → `isIntrinsicObjectPrototype` → `hasIntrinsicConstructor` → back into `checkSchemaNode`).
- Hypothesis (clearly labeled as such): a pathological tool-schema object — cyclic through a path the visited Set does not cover (e.g. a prototype-chain loop), or pathologically deep nesting — drives this walker into unbounded recursion; the resulting stack overflow surfaces as a native V8 fatal that no `try/catch` can intercept.
- Whether this shares a root with a same-morning incident (on the previous boot, every background-agent turn failed instantly at startup, zero output, no session file; a restart cleared it) is unknown — but both sit in the turn-driver / tool-schema subsystem.

### Impact

One bad schema anywhere in the toolset can kill the entire process: all sessions, all background agents, no cleanup, nothing catchable. Durable logs saved the data, but all in-flight work was lost. Recovery required a full restart.

### Requests

1. Harden `checkSchemaNode`: hard depth cap + full cycle detection (including the prototype chain), raising a normal, catchable error that names the offending path/node.
2. Validate each tool's schema once at registration time and reject (or quarantine) the offending tool with a clear message — instead of letting a mid-turn native crash decide for everyone.
3. If feasible, degrade turn-assembly failures to a per-agent turn error rather than a process-level fatal.

discussions.title: [Bug] 启用带连字（ligature/calt）的字体后，Web 输入框开头字符不显示
discussions.body:
# Bug：启用带连字（ligature/calt）的字体后，Web 输入框开头字符不显示

## 摘要 / Summary

在 Web UI（`dsh web`）中，通过自定义 CSS 把界面字体换成**默认启用连字 / 上下文替代（`calt`）的字体**后，在会话输入框（composer）中连续输入大量符号（例如一行 `-`）时，**开头的若干字符不可见**——字符确实存在于 DOM 中、光标位置正常，但左侧一段没有绘制出来。撤销该字体样式后立即恢复正常。

## 复现步骤 / Reproduction

1. `npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web` 启动 Web UI。

2. 用 Stylus / 用户样式把界面字体指向一个默认启用连字与上下文替代的字体，例如 Maple Mono NF CN：

   ```css
   :root, html, body {
     --dsw-font-family: "Maple Mono NF CN", Consolas, monospace !important;
     --ds-font-family-code: "Maple Mono NF CN", Consolas, monospace !important;
   }
   body, button, input, select, textarea { font-family: var(--dsw-font-family) !important; }
   ```

3. 刷新页面，在底部输入框中连续输入一行符号，例如 `--------------------`（或先输入 `-` 若干再输入文字）。

4. 观察输入框左侧：**开头的若干 `-` 没有绘制出来**，视觉上像是从中间开始。

## 实际行为 / Current behavior

- 开头一段字符不可见；DOM 与 `Range.getClientRects()` 均正常（单个文本矩形，起点在编辑器左内边距 14px 处），说明**排版正确、只是没有绘制 / 字形被替换后未正确渲染**。
- 控制台无报错。
- 关闭该字体样式后恢复正常。
- 换成不带连字特性的字体（如 Anthropic Sans/Serif/Mono 系列）也不出现该问题。

## 预期行为 / Expected behavior

输入框内所有字符都应正常绘制，不应因为所选字体启用了连字 / 上下文替代而丢失可见性。

## 可行的规避方式 / Workaround

在用户样式中显式关闭这些字形特性即可恢复：

```css
*, *::before, *::after {
  font-variant-ligatures: none !important;
  font-feature-settings: "liga" 0, "clig" 0, "calt" 0, "dlig" 0, "rlig" 0 !important;
}
```

## 建议的上游修复 / Suggested fix

在 composer 的 contenteditable 样式上直接关闭连字，不要依赖用户样式：

```css
/* 输入框 / contenteditable 相关选择器 */
font-variant-ligatures: none;
font-feature-settings: "liga" 0, "calt" 0, "dlig" 0;
```

即：正文与代码块可以保留连字，但**编辑区应强制使用标准字形**，以避免用户更换字体后出现“字符不显示”的问题。

## 环境 / Environment

- DSH：`@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.5-rc.1`（npm 全局安装）
- 浏览器：Chrome（Stylus 扩展注入用户样式）
- 系统：Windows，NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1070（ANGLE / D3D11）
- 相关字体：`Maple Mono NF CN`（本地安装，`calt` 默认开启）

## 备注 / Notes

我尝试在 headless Chromium（同一台机器，包含 GPU/ANGLE、SwiftShader、1x/1.25x/2x 缩放、有头/无头）中复现，均未复现：DOM 文本、文本矩形与渲染像素都正常。该问题只在用户本机 Chrome 中稳定出现，因此可能与具体渲染路径相关；这里提供的因果判断（连字特性 → 字形替换 → 未绘制）是经过用户端 A/B 验证的结论：启用该字体的样式必然复现，关闭必然恢复，且加上述 `font-feature-settings` 关闭连字后即修复。

## 与已有讨论的关系 / Related discussions

发帖前已检索全部 800 条 Discussion 的标题（中英文症状词：字体/字形/连字/输入框/符号/显示/不显示/渲染/消失/font/glyph/ligature/composer），并逐条阅读了最接近的 5 条正文。**未发现同一问题的重复提交**，但以下两条相关，特此说明区别：

- **#808「Web UI: chat composer disappears after pressing Backspace」** —— 症状最接近（输入的文字不再渲染），但触发条件是按 **Backspace**、版本为 `0.1.0-rc.6`；本问题是**更换字体触发**、版本 `0.1.5-rc.1`，且输入框与文字均正常存在，只有开头一段未绘制。两者可能是同一渲染脆弱点的不同触发路径，建议维护者一并参考。
- **#820「输入框光标过细…」** —— 其描述的实现（原生 `<textarea>` + `color:transparent` + `.backdrop` 镜像层）在当前 `0.1.5-rc.1` 中已不存在：输入框现为 Lexical `contenteditable`，文字使用 `color: var(--dsw-alias-label-primary)` 直接绘制，包内已无 `_backdrop` / `_mirror`。因此该文所述根因不适用于本问题，仅作为历史背景。

其余候选不相关：**#696** 为 RTL/双向文本排序错误（另一类失败），**#398** 为统计行省略号截断，**#277** 为 Markdown 删除线渲染。

discussions.title: `dsh-client-connection@0.1.5-rc.1`: `connection.rpc.handle()` fails with "cannot get property webServer without inject" when called from a plugin's own `ctx.inject(["connection"], ...)` callback
discussions.body:
## Summary

`HostConnectionService.register()` (the implementation behind the public `connection.rpc.handle(channel, handler)` API) accesses `this.ctx.webServer` directly. But `this.ctx` is the Context captured when `HostConnectionService` was constructed inside `dsh-client-connection`'s own `apply()` — a Context that was never injected with `webServer`. Only a *separate*, later `ctx.inject(["webServer"], webCtx => ...)` callback inside the same `apply()` function (used for mounting the fixed `/api` route) actually has `webServer` access.

As a result, **every third-party plugin that calls the documented public API `connection.rpc.handle(channel, handler)`** to register its own RPC channel throws at registration time:

```
Error: cannot get property "webServer" without inject
```

This breaks the plugin's channel silently: the plugin's own `try/catch` around the *outer* `ctx.inject(["connection"], ...)` call does not see this error (it's thrown inside a nested nested nested `effect`/`inject` callback that is not run synchronously — see reproduction below), so the plugin logs no error and appears to have registered successfully. The channel is simply never mounted. Any HTTP request to that channel's path then falls through to the SPA static-file fallback route (`dsh-host-frontend-static`), which returns **405** for any non-GET/HEAD method instead of reaching the plugin's handler.

## Environment

- `@deepseek-ai/dsh`: `0.1.5-rc.1`
- `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-connection`: `0.1.5-rc.1`
- `@deepseek-ai/dsh-host-webserver`: `0.1.5-rc.1`
- OS: Windows 11
- Node: v22.23.2
- Reproduced with third-party plugin `dsh-plugin-subscriptions@0.8.0` (https://github.com/V1ki/dsh-plugin-subscriptions), which calls `connection.rpc.handle('/subscriptions-auth', handler, { authority: 'loopback' })` from inside its own `ctx.inject(["connection"], ctx => { ... })` callback — exactly the pattern the package's own doc comment describes as supported (`register(owner, channel, handler)` takes an arbitrary calling Context as `owner`).

This is very likely **not specific to this one plugin** — any plugin using the public `dsh-client-connection` RPC registration API from its own deferred/injected context will hit the same failure, because the bug is in `HostConnectionService.register()` itself, not in the third-party plugin.

## Reproduction

1. Install any plugin that registers an RPC channel via `ctx.inject(["connection"], (ctx) => { const connection = ctx.get("connection"); connection.rpc.handle("/my-channel", handler); })`.
2. Boot `dsh web` normally (no special config needed).
3. Send an authenticated `POST` request to `/my-channel/<endpoint>` with a valid `client-request` envelope.
4. Observe: **HTTP 405** instead of the plugin's actual response (200/400/401/etc.).
5. Send a `GET` to the same path: observe **HTTP 404** — confirming the SPA static-file fallback (`dsh-host-frontend-static`) is answering, not the plugin's route, because the route was never registered in `dsh-host-webserver`'s route table.

### Confirmed via added diagnostics (this session)

Adding `process.stderr.write(...)` diagnostics directly inside `dsh-client-connection`'s `register()` method showed:

```
register() called for channel /subscriptions-auth
webServer injected for channel /subscriptions-auth      <- the inject(["webServer"], webCtx => ...) callback DOES fire
calling webCtx.webServer.register for /subscriptions-auth
fiber REJECTED for /subscriptions-auth: Error: cannot get property "webServer" without inject
    at Fiber.<anonymous> (.../dsh-client-connection/lib/index.js:623:29)   <- webCtx.webServer.register(route) itself
    at .../cordis/lib/index.js:1141:34
    at Object.callback (.../dsh-client-connection/lib/index.js:621:18)
    at Fiber.execute (.../cordis/lib/index.js:1070:28)
    at .../cordis/lib/index.js:1141:34
    at Proxy.inject (.../cordis/lib/index.js:1600:15)
    at Proxy.register (.../dsh-client-connection/lib/index.js:619:23)
    at Object.apply (.../cordis/lib/index.js:120:36)
    at Object.handle (.../dsh-client-connection/lib/index.js:543:39)
    at Fiber.<anonymous> (.../dsh-plugin-subscriptions/lib/index.js:1456:38)
```

Notably: even inside the callback that `ctx.inject(["webServer"], webCtx => ...)` hands back (where `webCtx` should, by definition, carry `webServer` access), calling `webCtx.webServer.register(route)` **inside a further nested `webCtx.effect(...)` call** still throws "cannot get property webServer without inject". This suggests the failure is not simply "the wrong Context object was captured" (the originally-suspected bug — `HostConnectionService.ctx` never being updated to the `webServer`-carrying Context created at `apply()` time) but something about how Cordis's service-access guard interacts with `inject`/`effect` call chains that cross plugin boundaries and are nested several levels deep (subscribing plugin's `effect` → `dsh-client-connection`'s `register()` → its own `inject` → its own `effect`).

Original (unmodified) code path, for reference:

```js
// dsh-client-connection/lib/index.js
register(owner, channel, handler) {
  assertChannel(channel);
  const fetchHandler = rpcFetchHandler(channel, handler);
  const route = { kind: "prefix", path: channel, handler: /* ... */ };
  return owner.effect(() => owner.webServer.register(route), `client-connection: ${channel} rpc channel`);
  //                         ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ throws here; `owner` (== `HostConnectionService.ctx`,
  //                         captured at construction time in apply()) was never injected with webServer.
}
```

```js
// same file, apply() — the ONLY place in this file that successfully talks to webServer:
async function apply(ctx, config) {
  // ...
  const connection = new HostConnectionService(ctx, trustedHosts, /* ... */);
  ctx.inject(["webServer"], (webCtx) => {
    // ... only this webCtx (never propagated to `connection.ctx`) can reach webServer directly.
    webCtx.effect(() => webCtx.webServer.register(route), "client-connection: /api route");
  });
}
```

## Two fix attempts tried this session (both insufficient — documenting for maintainers)

**Attempt 1** — reassign `connection.ctx = webCtx` inside the `apply()`-level `ctx.inject(["webServer"], ...)` callback, so later calls to `register()` (from any plugin) see a Context that has `webServer`. Not fully tested before attempt 2 looked more correct; abandoned due to an inherent race (no guarantee `register()` is called from third-party plugins strictly after this reassignment runs).

**Attempt 2** — change `register()` itself to defer via its own `owner.inject(["webServer"], webCtx => webCtx.effect(() => webCtx.webServer.register(route), ...))`, mirroring the pattern already used successfully for the `/api` route inside `apply()`. This **did** avoid the immediate synchronous throw (the outer `ctx.inject(["connection"], ...)` callback in the calling plugin no longer sees an exception), but the *inner* `webCtx.webServer.register(route)` call **still** throws the same "cannot get property webServer without inject" error, confirmed via `fiber.then(onFulfilled, onRejected)` on the returned Fiber. See stack trace above.

This means the bug is deeper than "the captured Context lacks webServer" — even a freshly-injected `webCtx` fails when accessed from inside a nested `effect()` that itself originates from a call chain crossing from a *different* plugin's own `effect`. Both attempted fixes were reverted; the shipped `0.1.5-rc.1` code is currently unmodified in this environment.

## Impact

Any plugin's Settings/Subscriptions-style RPC channel (registered via the public `connection.rpc.handle()` API from the plugin's own injected context) silently fails to mount. The plugin appears to load without error; only a live HTTP probe reveals the channel is unreachable (405 for POST, 404 for GET). This is a functional regression for third-party plugin authors following the documented/supported registration pattern, and is likely to affect other plugins beyond the one used to reproduce it here.

## Suggested areas to investigate

- Whether Cordis's service-access guard (`"cannot get property ... without inject"`) is scoped per-Fiber rather than per-Context-object, and whether a Context returned by `inject()` genuinely carries a *usable* access grant when the code accessing it runs inside a further nested `effect`/`inject` initiated from outside the plugin that originally called `inject()`.
- Whether `HostConnectionService.register()` needs to capture/refresh its Context differently, or whether `dsh-client-connection` needs to expose a different public API shape that plugins are expected to use instead of directly calling `owner.effect(() => owner.webServer.register(route))` with an `owner` the plugin does not fully control the injection state of.

discussions.title: Composer: with an IME, the Enter that ends a composition inserts a newline instead of sending (since the Lexical migration)
discussions.body:
## Summary

With an IME active (Korean, 2-set), the first <kbd>Enter</kbd> after typing inserts a newline instead of sending; a second <kbd>Enter</kbd> sends. Typing in English, a single <kbd>Enter</kbd> sends as expected.

The composer's composition *detection* is not the problem — it is intact and careful. What changed is that the same "detect and bail" strategy stopped being sufficient when the composer moved from a native `<textarea>` to Lexical.

## When it changed

`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-conversation` dependencies:

| version | composer |
| --- | --- |
| `0.1.1-rc.2` | native `<textarea>` (no lexical dependency) |
| `0.1.2-rc.1` | `lexical`, `@lexical/text`, `@lexical/utils`, `@lexical/history`, `@lexical/plain-text` |
| `0.1.5-rc.2` | Lexical, bundled into `lib/client.js` |

`0.1.1-rc.2` handled this correctly. Its keydown path read composition from three signals and returned early:

```js
const composing = composingRef.current || e.nativeEvent.isComposing || e.nativeEvent.keyCode === 229;
...
if (e.key !== "Enter") return;
if (composing) return;
```

In a `<textarea>` that is enough: the IME consumes the Enter that ends a composition, so no newline is inserted.

## What happens now

`registerComposerKeymap` in `lib/types/client/input/editor/keymap.js` carries the same three-signal check across — `isComposingEvent(event, recentlyComposing)` is `event.isComposing || event.keyCode === 229 || recentlyComposing()`, with `recentlyComposing` tracked from `compositionstart`/`compositionend`. That part is faithful to the old behaviour.

The Enter handler, however, bails by returning `true` without calling `preventDefault()`:

```js
editor.registerCommand(KEY_ENTER_COMMAND, (event) => {
  if (event?.shiftKey === true) return false;
  if (event !== null && isComposingEvent(event, recentlyComposing)) return true;   // <-- no preventDefault
  if (handlers.arbitrate("enter", false) !== "pass") { event?.preventDefault(); return true; }
  event?.preventDefault();
  ...
}, 4)
```

Returning `true` at `COMMAND_PRIORITY_CRITICAL` stops Lexical's own Enter handling, but the keydown's default action is never prevented — so the browser proceeds to `beforeinput` with `insertParagraph` and a line break lands in the editor. The composition is committed by the same keypress, so the next Enter is no longer "composing" and sends.

Two contrasts in the same function support this reading:

- The **space** handler returns `false` while composing, which lets the normal path run rather than claiming the event.
- Every **non-composing** branch of the Enter handler calls `event?.preventDefault()` before acting.

## Suggested direction

Either call `event.preventDefault()` alongside `return true` in the composing branch, or return `false` there the way the space handler does — whichever matches the intent for Lexical's insertion path. I have not opened a PR because `CONTRIBUTING.md` says external pull requests are not being accepted at the moment.

## Honest scope of this report

- The symptom is observed in an unofficial desktop shell that embeds the harness. The composer and the code quoted above are upstream's, unmodified, but I have not reproduced it under `dsh web` — so if the shell matters here, that is worth knowing and I would rather say so than imply coverage I do not have.
- The mechanism above is read from the shipped bundle and from the version comparison, not from an instrumented trace of the `beforeinput` sequence.

Happy to gather anything more specific that would help.

discussions.title: [Bug] 桌面打包 prepare:dsh 必然失败：烟雾测试仍在 require 已被替换的 fs-ext
discussions.body:
## 一句话

`pnpm run package:desktop:win:x64:unsigned` 在本机 **100% 失败**，根因不是环境缺编译器，而是 `runtime-payload-smoke.mjs` 仍在 `require('fs-ext')` 校验一个**仓库已用 `@deepseek-ai/node-addon-system` 替换掉**的模块，而该模块在**全仓库零依赖声明**，因此任何人在任何机器上都无法安装它。

---

## Summary

桌面打包流程走到 `prepare:dsh` 阶段时，产物烟雾测试强制 `require('fs-ext')` 失败并中止，导致 Windows 桌面安装包无法产出。该失败**与本地工具链无关**：`fs-ext` 既不在任何 `package.json` 中声明，也不在 `pnpm-lock.yaml` 中，`pnpm install` 不可能把它装进载荷，故该断言恒为假。

受影响用户：任何尝试从源码构建桌面版（`package:desktop:*`）的人。同时 `project-manager.ts` 生成的工作区配置里仍列出 `fs-ext: true` 构建许可，会误导后续排查方向。

---

## Reproduction

```powershell
cd <repo>
node apps\desktop\node_modules\pnpm\bin\pnpm.mjs --filter "@deepseek-ai/dsh-desktop" run package:win:x64:unsigned
```

该命令在 `prepare:dsh` 步骤稳定失败。

最小复现（跳过前面的构建）：

```powershell
node apps\desktop\node_modules\pnpm\bin\pnpm.mjs --filter "@deepseek-ai/dsh-desktop" run prepare:dsh
```

---

## Current behavior

退出码 1，关键输出：

```
Error: Cannot find module 'fs-ext'
Require stack:
- <repo>\apps\desktop\.desktop-build\targets\win-x64\dsh\package.json
    at checkFsExt (file:///<repo>/apps/desktop/tests/fixtures/runtime-payload-smoke.mjs:69:17)
    at file:///<repo>/apps/desktop/tests/fixtures/runtime-payload-smoke.mjs:124:3 {
  code: 'MODULE_NOT_FOUND'
}
    [cause]: Error: Command failed:
      <repo>\apps\desktop\.desktop-build\targets\win-x64\runtime\node\node.exe
      <repo>\apps\desktop\tests\fixtures\runtime-payload-smoke.mjs
      <repo>\apps\desktop\.desktop-build\targets\win-x64\dsh
[ERR_PNPM_RECURSIVE_RUN_FIRST_FAIL] @deepseek-ai/dsh-desktop@0.1.5-rc.2 prepare:dsh: `tsx scripts/prepare-dsh.ts`
Exit status 1
```

`runtime-payload-smoke.mjs:67-81` 的检查项：

```js
/** fs-ext implements seek on Windows through SetFilePointerEx and on POSIX through lseek. */
function checkFsExt() {
  const fsExt = requireRuntime('fs-ext')   // <-- 第 69 行抛错
  ...
}
```

### 为什么这不是环境问题

1. **全仓库所有 `package.json` 均未声明 `fs-ext`**（`Get-ChildItem -Recurse -Filter package.json | Select-String '"fs-ext"'` 零命中；`pnpm-lock.yaml` 里只有同名的 `fs-extra`）。`prepare-dsh.ts:112/117` 用 `pnpm install --lockfile-only` → `--prod --frozen-lockfile` 安装，闭包由声明决定，因此 `fs-ext` 永远不会进入 `dsh/node_modules`。
2. **该模块已被仓库主动替换。** `.agents/notes/implemented/architecture/2026-09-07-prebuilt-system-primitives.zh.md`：
   > JSONL 写入方依赖的 `fs-ext` 在用户安装时编译 NAN addon…… `native/system` 中独立版本的 `@deepseek-ai/node-addon-system` 包族分发既有 `landlock-run` 可执行文件和使用**稳定 Node-API v8** 的 `system.node` addon。……**入口包和平台包都不在安装期间编译。**

   并且 `@deepseek-ai/node-addon-system-0.1.2.tgz` **确实已在** `.desktop-build/targets/win-x64/package-set/desktop-packages/` 中，会进入载荷。
3. **本地 C++ 工具链是齐的**（VS Community 2022，MSVC `cl.exe` 14.44.35207 + Windows SDK），原生模块本身没有问题；`node-pty@1.2.0-beta.15` 与 `koffi@3.1.1` 在 `.pnpm` 中均已安装且 `pnpm-workspace.yaml` 的 `allowBuilds` 已放行。

### 相关遗留引用

- `apps/desktop/scripts/runtime-file-policy.ts:26,29` —— 仍在按 `fs-ext` 包名排除 `build/Release/obj`、保留 `fs_ext.node` 等编译产物规则
- `apps/desktop/src/project-manager.ts:109` —— 生成的工作区配置里仍写 `allowBuilds: fs-ext: true`

---

## Expected behavior

`pnpm run package:desktop:win:x64:unsigned` 正常产出未签名安装包；`prepare:dsh` 的产物烟雾测试改为校验当前实际分发的预编译原语（`@deepseek-ai/node-addon-system` 的 `system.node`，含 Windows 上的 seek/lock 语义），而不是已淘汰的 `fs-ext`。

建议一并处理：
- 删除 `runtime-payload-smoke.mjs` 中针对 `fs-ext` 的检查（或替换为对新 addon 的等价 seek 断言）
- 清理 `runtime-file-policy.ts` 中 `fs-ext` 专用规则
- 从 `project-manager.ts` 的 `allowBuilds` 列表移除 `fs-ext`

---

## Environment

| 项 | 值 |
|---|---|
| 平台 | Windows 11 x64 |
| 仓库版本 | `c291e7961a`（master，2026-09-10 22:17:09 +0800），`@deepseek-ai/dsh-desktop@0.1.5-rc.2` |
| Node.js | v24.20.0（满足 `engines: ^22.19.0 \|\| >=24.0.0`） |
| pnpm | 11.7.0（`apps/desktop/node_modules/pnpm`，与 `packageManager` 声明一致） |
| Electron | 44.x（声明于 `apps/desktop/package.json`） |
| C++ 工具链 | Visual Studio Community 2022，MSVC 14.44.35207，Windows SDK 10 已安装 |
| 命令 | `pnpm --filter @deepseek-ai/dsh-desktop run package:win:x64:unsigned` |

### 未测到的部分

打包在 `prepare:dsh` 即中止，因此 `electron-builder` 阶段、NSIS 安装包生成、产物体积、运行期行为均**未验证**。修好该断言后是否还有第二处同类遗留，我无法确认——`fs-ext` 的引用分布在烟雾测试、文件策略、工作区配置三处，迁移可能不止影响一处。

---

## 附：本文档不含敏感信息

无。仅包含路径、命令与日志。

discussions.title: dsh CLI exits silently (code 0) on Node.js without import.meta.main (including all of v23)
discussions.body:
## Bug

`npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web` (and `--help` / `--version`) prints nothing and exits 0. The CLI never starts.

Affects Node.js **v23.x (entire line)**, **v22 < 22.18.0**, and **v24 < 24.2.0**.

## Environment

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| OS | macOS (darwin, ARM64) |
| Node.js | v23.10.0 (EOL 2025-06-01) |
| Bun | 1.3.14 (works) |
| Package | `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.5-rc.1` / `0.1.5-rc.2` |

```console
$ node -e "console.log('main' in import.meta, import.meta.main)" --input-type=module
false undefined
```

Published `package.json` has no `engines` field.

## Repro

```bash
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web        # no output, exit 0
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh --help     # no output, exit 0
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh --version  # no output, exit 0
```

Shebang is `#!/usr/bin/env node`. Direct Bun invocation works:

```bash
bun node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh/lib/bin.js -V
# 0.1.5-rc.2
```

## Root cause

`lib/bin.js` ends with:

```js
if (import.meta.main) await runCli();
```

On Node.js without `import.meta.main` this is `undefined`, so `runCli()` never runs.

| Line | First version with `import.meta.main` | Date |
|---|---|---|
| Current | v24.2.0 ([nodejs/node#57804](https://github.com/nodejs/node/pull/57804)) | 2025-06-09 |
| v22 LTS | v22.18.0 (backport) | 2025-07-31 |
| v23 | never | EOL 2025-06-01, two days before v24.2.0 |

v23 sits between 22 and 24 by version number but never received the feature. `engines: ">=22.18.0"` would incorrectly match v23.x.

## Suggested fix

**A.** Declare engines that exclude v23:

```json
{ "engines": { "node": ">=22.18.0 <23.0.0 || >=24.2.0" } }
```

npm only hard-fails this with `engine-strict`.

**B.** Fallback entry guard (if older Node.js / v23 should still work):

```js
import { pathToFileURL } from "node:url";

const isMain =
  import.meta.main ??
  (Boolean(process.argv[1]) &&
    import.meta.url === pathToFileURL(process.argv[1]).href);

if (isMain) await runCli();
```

**C.** If Bun is the only runtime, change the shebang to `#!/usr/bin/env bun` and document it. That contradicts the current `npx` + `#!/usr/bin/env node` path.

Silent `exit 0` is the worst CLI failure mode.

## Workaround

Upgrade Node.js to **>=22.18.0 excluding v23**, or **>=24.2.0**. Or run with Bun:

```bash
bun node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh/lib/bin.js web
```

discussions.title: `session event "system/message" is not surface-eligible and cannot carry surfaceOp` —— 成因、排查方法与修复
discussions.body:
以下由DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash分析并生成。

## 1. 现象

升级dsh版本后，在 `dsh --profile web` 的浏览器 UI 中（以及终端日志里）出现：

```
session event "system/message" is not surface-eligible and cannot carry surfaceOp
```
无法查看旧的对话记录，而且无法选择模型。

环境：

- `dsh --version` → `0.1.5-rc.1`
- 安装来源：`npm i -g @deepseek-ai/dsh`，安装在 `%USERPROFILE%\..\nodejs`（普通 Node 全局目录）
- 触发路径：`web` profile；此前用 marketplace 装过若干 out-of-tree 插件（`dsh-context`、`dsh-better-sidebar`、`@linxin666/dsh-client-ui-git-graph`、`dsh-client-ui-skill-explorer`），报错发生在插件装卸期间 / host 升级前后
- 关键特征：**host 自身能正常启动**（`dsh --profile web --no-open --port 8099` 无报错、UI 正常加载、控制台 0 error），错误只在插件参与时才出现

## 2. 这条报错的确切来源

全仓库只有一处抛出该字符串（`packages/core/session/src/surface.ts`，`surfaceOpOf()`）：

```ts
const SURFACE_EVENT_TYPES = new Set<string>([
  'system/message',      // ← 只有较新版本才有这一项
  'user/message',
  'assistant/message',
  'tool/result',
])

if (!isSurfaceEligibleType(event.type)) {
  // Unknown ignorable records retain opaque metadata without affecting history.
  if (!KNOWN_SESSION_EVENT_TYPES.has(event.type) && event.ignorable === true) return
  if (raw.surfaceOp !== undefined) {
    throw new Error(`session event "${event.type}" is not surface-eligible and cannot carry surfaceOp`)
  }
  ...
}
```

`validateSurfaceMetadata()`（同文件）由这些路径调用：

- `Session.append()` 与 seed/restore 校验：`packages/core/session/src/index.ts`
- `foldSurface()`：会话回放 / snapshot / session-query
- wire 校验：`packages/api/session-controller/src/client/session-wire-event.ts`（浏览器端历史分页与 live 帧）

**结论：抛出这句话的那个 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-session` 副本，其 `SURFACE_EVENT_TYPES` 里没有 `system/message`。** 也就是说——事件本身没写错，是**读取/校验它的那份库太旧**。

## 3. `system/message` 什么时候变成 surface 事件的

`system/message` 是在 commit **`ee956c720d`（2026-09-06，"refactor(session): represent the system prompt as surface node zero"）** 才加入 `SurfaceEventType` 的（设计说明：`.agents/notes/implemented/architecture/2026-09-02-system-prompt-as-surface-node.md`）。在那之前，系统提示词存放在 log-only 的 `request/header.system` 里，`system/message` 根本不存在。

已发布版本的运行时集合（核对各 tag 的 `packages/core/session/src/surface.ts`）：

| 版本 | `SURFACE_EVENT_TYPES` |
|---|---|
| `0.1.1-rc.2`、`0.1.2-rc.1`、`0.1.3-alpha.1/2` 及更早 | `user/message`、`assistant/message`、`tool/result`（**3 个**） |
| `0.1.5-alpha.1`、`0.1.5-alpha.2`、`0.1.5-rc.1`、`0.1.5-rc.2` | 上述 3 个 + `system/message`（**4 个**） |

所以：**旧库读到新 host 写出的 `system/message`（带 `surfaceOp`）时，必然抛这句。**

## 4. 排查方法（逐步可复现）

### 4.1 先确认 host 本身是新的

```powershell
dsh --version
npm ls -g @deepseek-ai/dsh-session
```

如果 host 已是 `0.1.5-*`，那问题就不在安装本身，而在**第二份旧副本**。

### 4.2 枚举机器上所有 `dsh-session` 副本及其版本

```powershell
Get-ChildItem -Path "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh", "$(npm root -g)" -Recurse -Directory -Filter dsh-session -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
  Where-Object { $_.FullName -like "*@deepseek-ai*" } |
  ForEach-Object { "{0}  =>  {1}" -f $_.FullName, (Get-Content "$($_.FullName)\package.json" -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json).version }
```

本次排查结果（问题实例）：

```
%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\node_modules\@deepseek-ai\dsh-session                    0.1.5-rc.2
%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\web\node_modules\@deepseek-ai\dsh-session                0.1.2-rc.1   ← 元凶
<global node_modules>\@deepseek-ai\dsh\node_modules\@deepseek-ai\dsh-session         0.1.5-rc.2
```

注意：`%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\<profile>\node_modules` 里还有整套同代的旧依赖（`dsh-llm`、`dsh-settings`、`dsh-invariants`、`dsh-brand`、`dsh-scope` … 均为 `0.1.2-rc.1`），不只是 `dsh-session`。

### 4.3 直接验证哪份副本会抛错

确认旧副本里没有 `system/message`：

```powershell
Select-String -Path "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\web\node_modules\@deepseek-ai\dsh-session\lib\index.js" -Pattern 'SURFACE_EVENT_TYPES' -Context 0,4
# 输出里只有 "user/message" "assistant/message" "tool/result"
```

再用它跑一次最小复现（`<copy>` = 上面那个目录）：

```js
// node --input-type=module -e "<此脚本>" file:///C:/Users/<you>/.dsh/profiles/web/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-session/lib/index.js
const mod = await import(process.argv[process.argv.length - 1])
const event = {
  type: 'system/message', seq: 0, time: 1,
  data: { turn: 1, step: 1, message: { role: 'system', content: [] } },
  surfaceOp: 'append',
}
try {
  mod.foldSurface([event])
  console.log('NO ERROR')
} catch (e) {
  console.log('THROWN:', e.message)
}
```

输出：

```
THROWN: session event "system/message" is not surface-eligible and cannot carry surfaceOp
```

同一份副本用新版（`0.1.5-rc.2`）跑则不会抛错——至此定位完成。

### 4.4 确认插件解析路径是否被 profile 目录遮盖

```powershell
node -e "const r=require('module').createRequire('C:/Users/<you>/.dsh/profiles/web/x.js');console.log(r.resolve('@deepseek-ai/dsh-session/package.json'))"
```

问题状态下指向 `...\profiles\web\node_modules\...`（旧），修复后指向安装目录（新）。

> 为什么 host 不受影响：`dsh.profile.bundles` 里的包**优先从安装目录解析**，所以 `dsh-base` / `dsh-web-app` 走的是 `0.1.5-rc.2`；而 out-of-tree 插件从 profile 目录解析，就会拿到 profile 私有的旧副本。这正是"host 启动正常、插件一参与就报错"的原因。

### 4.5 查 marketplace 的兼容性日志（成因佐证）

`%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\web\.dsh-market\log.ndjson`：

```json
{"level":"warn","event":"install-compat","detail":"dsh-context: introduced host-compatibility risks — @deepseek-ai/dsh-session@>=0.1.2-rc.1 vs 0.1.1-rc.2; @deepseek-ai/dsh-settings@>=0.1.2-rc.1 vs 0.1.1-rc.2"}
{"level":"warn","event":"update-compat","detail":"dsh-better-sidebar@0.19.0 declares ^0.1.5-rc.1; this host is 0.1.2-rc.1 — refused before installing"}
{"level":"warn","event":"update-compat","detail":"dsh-better-sidebar: introduced host-compatibility risks — @deepseek-ai/dsh-session@^0.1.5-rc.1 vs 0.1.2-rc.1; ..."}
```

日志明确显示：装插件时 host 还是 `0.1.1-rc.2` / `0.1.2-rc.1`，而插件声明的依赖是 `>=0.1.2-rc.1` / `^0.1.5-rc.1`，于是插件把一整代旧的 `dsh-session` 拉进了 profile。

## 5. 根因

**插件私有依赖闭包与 host 版本错配，且旧副本在 profile 目录里 `shadow` 掉了安装里的新副本。**

完整链条：

1. `system/message` 只在 host ≥ `0.1.5-alpha.1` 时才是 surface 事件；旧版 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-session`（≤ `0.1.3-alpha.2`）的 `SURFACE_EVENT_TYPES` 只有 3 个类型。
2. 插件被安装时，pnpm/npm 会把**插件声明的** `dsh-session` 装进 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\<profile>\node_modules`；插件代码从该目录解析模块，优先拿到这一份。
3. 之后 host 升级（日志中确实存在 `0.1.1-rc.2` → `0.1.2-rc.1` → `0.1.5-rc.1` 的迁移），开始按新规则写/发 `system/message`（surface node 0，带 `surfaceOp`）。
4. 插件侧仍是旧 `dsh-session`，`validateSurfaceMetadata` / `foldSurface` / wire 校验拒绝 `system/message` + `surfaceOp` → 抛出该错误。
5. **卸载插件后依赖子树没有被清理**，`profiles\web\node_modules` 里的旧代闭包原地留存（`pnpm-lock.yaml` 的 importers 已经是空的，但目录还在，旁边还留着 npm 的 `package-lock.json`），于是即便插件已卸载，后续任何从 profile 目录解析 `dsh-session` 的代码仍会踩到旧副本。

为什么会出现"另装一份旧版"而不是复用 host 的：**semver prerelease 规则**。`^0.1.3-alpha.2` 只匹配 `0.1.3-alpha.2` 及之后**同一 `major.minor.patch` 元组**的预发布版本，**不匹配** `0.1.5-rc.2`。所以按旧范围解析时只能下载旧的同代版本，形成新旧共存。

补充说明：机器上并不存在"多个 dsh 安装"。`D:\Environments\nodejs` 只是 nvm `D:\Programs\nvm\v24.15.0` 的 junction，指向同一个安装；真正多出来的只是 profile 目录里的那份插件依赖。

## 6. 解决方案

### 6.1 立即修复：清掉 profile 里的旧依赖残留

插件已经卸载（`package.json` / patch 里都没有引用了），`node_modules` 属可再生状态，直接删：

```powershell
Remove-Item -Recurse -Force "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\web\node_modules"
```

若插件仍在使用，正确做法是让整棵树同代：先 `dsh plugin --profile web prune`（转发到 pnpm），或直接删掉 profile 的 `node_modules` 后重装插件。

### 6.2 验证修复

```powershell
# 1) 只剩安装里那一份
Get-ChildItem -Path "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh", "$(npm root -g)" -Recurse -Directory -Filter dsh-session -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
  Where-Object { $_.FullName -like "*@deepseek-ai*" } |
  ForEach-Object { "{0} => {1}" -f $_.FullName, (Get-Content "$($_.FullName)\package.json" -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json).version }

# 2) profile 目录现在解析到安装里那份（路径应为 <global node_modules>\@deepseek-ai\dsh\node_modules\...）
node -e "const r=require('module').createRequire('C:/Users/<you>/.dsh/profiles/web/x.js');console.log(r.resolve('@deepseek-ai/dsh-session/package.json'))"

# 3) 启动一次
dsh --profile web --no-open --port 8099
```

本次实测：清理后只剩一份 `0.1.5-rc.2`；profile 解析指向安装目录；`dsh --profile web` 启动正常，浏览器打开 UI 并切换 workspace，控制台 0 error。

### 6.3 日常更新顺序（避免复发）

1. **先升 host**：`npm i -g @deepseek-ai/dsh@<channel>`（`latest` / `next` / `alpha`），重启 dsh。
2. **再更新插件**；marketplace 弹出的 `refused before installing` / `host-compatibility risks` 是保护，不是 bug —— 出现就先去升 host。
3. **跨代更新（如 0.1.2 → 0.1.5）时清一次 profile 的 `node_modules`**，不要让两代共存。
4. 收工后按 6.2 的第 1、2 条各验一次。
5. 排查入口固定：`%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\<profile>\.dsh-market\log.ndjson`。

## 附：一句话结论

`system/message` 是 `0.1.5-alpha.1` 起才进入 surface 的事件类型；当 profile 目录里残留着旧代 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-session`（本例 `0.1.2-rc.1`）时，插件会优先加载旧库，用旧规则校验新 host 写出的事件，于是抛出 `not surface-eligible and cannot carry surfaceOp`。删掉 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\<profile>\node_modules` 里的旧依赖闭包即可，之后保持 host 先于插件更新。

discussions.title: [Bug][Windows] 在 ACL 受限令牌沙箱下 Ninja 永久挂起：子命令已执行完毕，但 Ninja 永不退出
discussions.body:
在 Windows `workspace-write` 沙箱（`@deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox-windows-acl`）下，**所有由 Ninja 驱动的构建都会挂起**。Ninja 启动的构建命令都能正确执行并产出结果，但 Ninja 自身永不终止——退出码始终是 `STILL_ACTIVE`（`0x103`），且**没有任何存活的子进程**。因此任何用 `-G Ninja` 配置的 CMake 工程都会卡死在 `-- Detecting C compiler ABI info`，因为 CMake 在等待一个永远不会返回的 Ninja 进程。

同一个 Ninja 二进制在 DSH 之外（例如 ZCode / 普通终端）工作正常，所以问题特定于受限令牌环境。

## 环境

| 项目 | 值 |
|---|---|
| DSH | `@deepseek-ai/dsh` **0.1.5-rc.1** |
| Node | v24.19.0 |
| 操作系统 | Windows 11 Pro 25H2 |
| Shell 工具 | `pwsh`（Windows PowerShell 5.1，ConsoleHost） |
| 沙箱模式 | `workspace-write` |
| Ninja | `C:\msys64\ucrt64\bin\ninja.exe`，**1.13.2** —— 原生 mingw-w64，仅导入 `KERNEL32.dll`、`libgcc_s_seh-1.dll`、`libstdc++-6.dll` 与 UCRT（**不含 `msys-2.0.dll`**） |
| CMake | 4.4 |
| 编译器 | clang 22.1.8 与 gcc 16.2.0（均为 UCRT64） |

确认 shell 处于受限状态：`%TEMP%` 被改写为 `C:\Users\<user>\AppData\Local\Temp\dsh-XXXXXX`，且 `icacls <workspace>` 显示常驻沙箱 ACE `S-1-4-666705473-318310110:(OI)(CI)(W,D,DC)`。

## 复现步骤

最小化、仅限工作区内、无需真实工程。`build.ninja`：

```ninja
rule probe
  command = cmd.exe /c echo hello > out.txt
  description = TRIVIAL-STEP

build out.txt: probe
```

然后在 DSH shell 中执行：

```powershell
ninja -C <dir> -v
```

### 预期行为

```
[1/1] cmd.exe /c echo hello > out.txt
```

Ninja 退出码为 0，并生成 `out.txt`。

### 实际行为

Ninja **永不返回**。用 20 秒看门狗杀掉它之后检查：

* `out.txt` **已经生成** —— 子命令确实执行并完成了工作
* `GetExitCodeProcess(ninja)` 仍返回 `0x103`（`STILL_ACTIVE`）
* `CreateToolhelp32Snapshot` 进程快照显示 Ninja 的**直接子进程数为 0**
* Ninja 完全没有输出 stdout/stderr（即便加了 `-v`）

现成的带看门狗复现脚本见附件 `repro-ninja-hang.ps1`。

### 由此导致的 CMake 症状

```
$ cmake -S . -B build -G Ninja -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=clang
-- The C compiler identification is Clang 22.1.8
-- Detecting C compiler ABI info
<永久挂起>
```

## 已排除的原因

我编写了原生 C 探针，逐条复刻 Ninja 的 Win32 创建子进程序列，并**在同一个受限 shell 内**运行：

| 探针（在受限 shell 内运行） | 结果 |
|---|---|
| `CreateProcessW` + `WaitForSingleObject`（无管道） | ✅ 正常 |
| `CreateProcessW` + stdout 管道 + `PeekNamedPipe`/`ReadFile` 抽取 + 等待 | ✅ 正常 |
| `CreateProcessW` + `CREATE_NO_WINDOW` | ✅ 正常 |
| `CreateProcessW CREATE_SUSPENDED` + `AssignProcessToJobObject` + `ResumeThread` + 等待 | ✅ 正常 |
| Python `subprocess.run(..., stdout=PIPE)` 捕获子进程 | ✅ 正常 |
| **真实 `ninja.exe` 执行一条规则** | ❌ **永久挂起** |

同时已排除：

* **不是编译器问题。** 直接 `clang -v -c`、`clang -v -Wl,-v` 链接，甚至运行 CMake 生成的 ABI 探针可执行文件，都瞬间成功。CMake 挂起期间，`CMakeCCompilerABI.c.obj` **已经生成**。
* **不是 clang 特有** —— `-DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=gcc` 挂在完全相同的行。所以**把 clang 换成 gcc 没有帮助**。
* **不是启动方的问题** —— 无论由 `pwsh`、`cmd.exe`、Python 还是原生 C 启动器创建，Ninja 都一样挂起。
* **不是 stdio 拓扑问题** —— stdout 指向控制台、文件、管道，以及 stdin 来自 `NUL`，全部挂起。
* **不是并行调度问题** —— 只有一条琐碎规则也挂起。
* **不是 CMake try_compile 设置问题** —— `-DCMAKE_TRY_COMPILE_TARGET_TYPE=STATIC_LIBRARY` 仍然挂起（卡在 `Check for working C compiler`）。
* **不是 MSYS2 PATH 污染** —— 把 `PATH` 缩减为 `C:\msys64\ucrt64\bin;C:\Windows\system32;C:\Windows` 后仍然挂起。
* Ninja 的**纯解析**路径一切正常（`ninja --version`、`ninja -t targets`、`ninja -t commands`），空 manifest 也会立刻以 `ninja: no work to do.` 退出。挂起严格发生在"确实执行了一条命令"之后。

### 同一 shell 中可观察到的相关沙箱故障

**（a）所有 MSYS2-runtime 程序被硬性破坏** —— 这与已记录的命名管道限制完全吻合：

```
$ C:\msys64\usr\bin\bash.exe --version
      0 [main] bash (14112) C:\msys64\usr\bin\bash.exe: *** fatal error
      - couldn't create signal pipe, Win32 error 5
exit code: -1073741502 (0xC0000142 STATUS_DLL_INIT_FAILED)
```

`make.exe`、`ls.exe`、`sh.exe` 表现完全相同。

**（b）MSBuild 的文件跟踪器**在受限 shell 中同样失败（此处仅作为佐证列出——它是另一个工具）：

```
TRACKER : error TRK0002: Failed to execute command: "...\link.exe" @...\MSBuildTemp...\tmp....rsp
Microsoft.CppCommon.targets(1196,5): error MSB6006: "link.exe" exited with code 2.
```

加上 `/p:TrackFileAccess=false` 后，**同一个构建就能成功**，这说明问题出在跟踪器的 IPC，而不是 `link.exe`。

这是同类问题的第三个 Ninja 级症状（另外两个：Ninja 的进程完成等待、命名管道被拒），且全部仅出现在受限 shell 中。

## 影响

对遵循标准 LLVM/Clang + CMake + Ninja 工作流的 Windows 用户影响很大：构建完全无法完成，没有任何诊断信息，用户可见的症状只是"CMake 卡在 Detecting C compiler ABI info"。目前没有任何 CMake 选项可以绕过。

## 建议的排查方向

README 已记录 `CREATE_NO_WINDOW` 会以 `0xC0000142` 崩溃，以及受限孙进程的管道 stdio 会以 EPERM 失败。Ninja 是纯原生二进制，使用的是**匿名**管道，本不该命中那条路径——但它却静默挂起，而且关键的是：**子进程已经执行完毕之后**才挂起。这指向 Ninja 用来观察**子进程退出**的那个 handle/IPC 对象，在受限令牌下被拒绝或永远不会被 signal。

值得排查：受限令牌针对 Ninja 用于子进程完成通知与管道 IPC 的那些对象的**默认 DACL**；或者若无修复方案，就在文档中明确"Windows 沙箱下不支持 Ninja"。相关的、已报告的 Windows 沙箱进程/控制台问题：[#1344](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/1344)、[#1564](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/1564)。

## 规避方案（当前已验证可用）

改用 **Visual Studio 生成器**替代 Ninja —— 它在沙箱下可以正常配置、构建和运行：

```powershell
cmake -S . -B build -G "Visual Studio 18 2026"            # MSVC
cmake -S . -B build -G "Visual Studio 18 2026" -T ClangCL # clang-cl
cmake --build build --config Release
```

两条路径都已在受限 shell 中端到端验证通过（配置 → 构建 → 运行产物 `.exe`）。

另一种方式是脱离 DSH 沙箱运行 Ninja（普通终端或其它 agent 宿主）。
