discussions.title: [Windows] Case-duplicate proxy variables in the child environment break PowerShell Env: provider
discussions.body:
# [Windows] Case-duplicate proxy variables in the child environment break PowerShell's `Env:` provider (`Get-ChildItem Env:` throws "An item with the same key has already been added.")

## Summary

On Windows, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-http-proxy` publishes both casings of each proxy variable (`http_proxy` **and** `HTTP_PROXY`) into the environment object handed to spawned children, so the child's Windows environment block contains case-duplicate names and PowerShell's case-insensitive `Env:` provider throws `An item with the same key has already been added.` — making `Get-ChildItem Env:` / `Get-Item Env:PATH` / `ls Env:` unusable inside the DSH shell tool.

## Environment

- DSH: `@deepseek-ai/dsh` **0.1.5-rc.1** (npm global install) — reproduced on this version.
- **Not fixed on `master` or on the latest release `dsh-v0.1.5-rc.2`** (verified 2026-09-12: `packages/util/http-proxy/src/policy.ts` is byte-identical on both refs and still declares both casings for every field).
- Node.js: v26.4.0. The defect is not Node-version specific — the duplicate originates in the plain JS env object handed to `spawn`, not in version-specific Node behaviour — so Node 24+ behaves the same.
- OS: Windows 11 Home (Chinese), build 26200, x64.
- Shell: **Windows PowerShell 5.1** (no PowerShell 7 / `pwsh` installed on this host).

## Steps to reproduce

1. Export any proxy variable in either casing, e.g.:
  
  ```powershell
  setx HTTP_PROXY http://127.0.0.1:7890
  ```
  
  (Any export mechanism works. No proxy actually needs to be listening — the variable merely has to exist. `HTTPS_PROXY`, `NO_PROXY` and the lowercase spellings trigger it identically.)
2. Close and reopen the terminal so the new value is present in the process environment block.
3. Start DSH:
  
  ```powershell
  dsh web
  ```
  
4. In the DSH session, run through the shell tool:
  
  ```powershell
  Get-ChildItem Env:
  ```
  

## Expected behaviour

`Get-ChildItem Env:` lists the environment variables of the spawned PowerShell process, as it does in any terminal outside DSH.

## Actual behaviour

```
PS> Get-ChildItem Env:
Get-ChildItem : An item with the same key has already been added.
At line:1 char:1
+ Get-ChildItem Env:
+ ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
    + CategoryInfo          : NotSpecified: (:) [Get-ChildItem], ArgumentException
    + FullyQualifiedErrorId : System.ArgumentException,Microsoft.PowerShell.Commands.GetChildItemCommand
```

`Get-Item Env:PATH` and `ls Env:` fail the same way. In the very same session the following both work, which isolates the fault to the `Env:` provider rather than to the environment block itself:

```powershell
$env:PATH                                                  # works
[System.Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('PATH')       # works
```

Impact: the agent's own PowerShell tool cannot enumerate environment variables. Any model-authored script that touches `Get-ChildItem Env:` fails, which triggers retries and stalls. This is a known Windows/PowerShell failure mode for duplicated case-variant names (upstream: PowerShell/PowerShell#6305).

## Root cause

1. `packages/util/http-proxy/src/policy.ts` declares **both casings** for every policy field:
  
  ```ts
  /**
   * The environment names each policy field owns, lowercase first — undici reads the lowercase name
   * first, so both casings are always written or cleared together.
   */
  export const POLICY_ENV_NAMES = {
    httpProxy: ['http_proxy', 'HTTP_PROXY'],
    httpsProxy: ['https_proxy', 'HTTPS_PROXY'],
    noProxy: ['no_proxy', 'NO_PROXY'],
  } as const
  ```
  
  On 0.1.5-rc.1 (and earlier) this constant lived in the sibling module `packages/util/http-proxy/src/install.ts`; it was moved to `policy.ts`, unchanged, on `master`. So on the reporter's version the same constant and the same `applyPolicyEnv` are in `install.ts`.
  
2. `applyPolicyEnv(policy)` in `install.ts` writes both spellings into `process.env`. On Windows this layer is harmless on its own, because Node's `process.env` folds names case-insensitively — which `writeProxyEnv()` in the same file already documents:
  
  ```ts
  // Snapshot EVERY name before writing any of them. Windows folds environment names case-insensitively,
  // so reading the uppercase spelling after writing the lowercase one would read back the value just
  // written and restore the policy instead of the user's environment.
  ```
  
3. But `proxyEnvironmentForChild()` returns a **plain JS object**, which *is* case-sensitive, and assigns one entry per spelling:
  
  ```ts
  const overlay: Record<string, string | undefined> = { NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY: '1' }
  for (const [field, names] of Object.entries(POLICY_ENV_NAMES)) {
    const resolved = policy[field as keyof typeof POLICY_ENV_NAMES]
    const named = field !== 'noProxy' && names.some(name => inherited[name] !== undefined)
    for (const name of names) overlay[name] = named ? inherited[name] : resolved
  }
  ```
  
  `overlay['http_proxy']` and `overlay['HTTP_PROXY']` are two distinct properties here.
  
4. `packages/util/subprocess/subprocess/src/index.ts` — `scrubbedParentEnv()` (published as `@deepseek-ai/dsh-subprocess/lib/index.js`) builds the child base with a plain object and then merges that overlay onto it:
  
  ```ts
  export function scrubbedParentEnv(): Record<string, string> {
    const env: Record<string, string> = {}
    for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(process.env)) {
      if (value !== undefined && !SENSITIVE_ENV_PATTERN.test(key) && !key.toUpperCase().startsWith(DSH_ENV_PREFIX)) env[key] = value
    }
    // restores each proxy name to what the user exported, undoing this process's own normalization —
    // `undefined` removes a name the user never set.
    for (const [name, value] of Object.entries(proxyEnvironmentForChild())) {
      if (value === undefined) Reflect.deleteProperty(env, name)
      else env[name] = value
    }
    return env
  }
  ```
  
  Enumerating `process.env` on Windows yields the user's spelling exactly once (e.g. `HTTP_PROXY`), while the overlay contributes `http_proxy` *as a new key of a case-sensitive object*. The object returned to `spawn` therefore carries **both** `HTTP_PROXY` and `http_proxy`.
  
5. Windows `CreateProcess` accepts case-variant duplicates in `lpEnvironment` and does **not** deduplicate them, so the PowerShell child really does receive two entries whose names differ only in case.
  
6. Windows PowerShell 5.1 implements `Env:` over a case-insensitive dictionary and throws `ArgumentException: An item with the same key has already been added.` when the second variant is inserted.
  

### Why this cannot be turned off

`runProfile()` in `apps/cli/src/profile-boot.ts` installs the proxy unconditionally:

```ts
const disposeProxy = await installProxyFromEnvironment(options.environment, (message) => {
  process.stderr.write(...)
})
```

That call happens **before** `composeProfile()` loads `cordis.patch.yml`, so a profile patch cannot prevent it. `dsh-http-proxy` is a plain library (its README states no mounting and no configuration are required), not a plugin line, so the loader's `disabled` mechanism does not apply. There is also no proxy-related `DSH_*` switch anywhere in the project (only `DSH_HOME`, `DSH_TELEMETRY_DISABLED`, `DSH_SNAPSHOT` and the internal `DSH_LAUNCH_ENVIRONMENT_KEY`).

### In-repo precedent for the fix

The sibling package already solves exactly this problem: `packages/util/launch-environment/README.md` states that "on Windows, names are folded to uppercase before storage so case variants cannot split precedence", and `packages/util/launch-environment/src/index.ts` implements it:

```ts
return process.platform === 'win32' ? name.toUpperCase() : name
```

`dsh-http-proxy`'s child overlay is the one path that bypasses that protection.

## Suggested fix

Any one of these resolves it; the first matches the precedent already in the repo:

1. **Emit a single spelling per platform in `proxyEnvironmentForChild()`.** Writing both casings exists only to satisfy undici's "lowercase wins" read order; on Windows the environment is case-insensitive anyway, so the duplicate buys nothing. Select the spelling by `process.platform` (uppercase on `win32`), or reuse the `dsh-launch-environment` folding rule instead of hand-rolling names.
2. **Fold/deduplicate in `scrubbedParentEnv()`.** When building the child env on `win32`, collapse keys case-insensitively so no upstream overlay can ever produce a duplicate. This is the more robust place, since `scrubbedParentEnv` is the single shared base for every spawner.
3. **Add an opt-out.** A `DSH_*` switch that suppresses proxy-environment publication to children would help as a stopgap — but it must be evaluated after `composeProfile()` so a profile patch can actually set it.

A regression test worth having: on `win32`, assert that `Object.keys(scrubbedParentEnv())` contains no two entries equal under `toUpperCase()`.

## Workaround

Clear every casing before starting `dsh`, e.g. via a wrapper script:

```powershell
Remove-Item Env:HTTP_PROXY,  Env:HTTPS_PROXY,  Env:NO_PROXY  -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Remove-Item Env:http_proxy,  Env:https_proxy,  Env:no_proxy  -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
dsh web
```

Note that the uppercase and the lowercase spelling each trigger the bug independently, so all six names must be cleared. Alternatively, use a terminal dedicated to DSH in which no proxy variable is exported.

discussions.title: [Bug][性能] 0.1.5-rc.2 Web UI 空闲态主线程占用约 50%、布局约 144 次/秒（≈每帧一次），拖拽窗口 resize 明显卡顿
discussions.body:
### 环境

| 项 | 值 |
|---|---|
| dsh | `0.1.5-rc.2`（Windows 桌面 Electron 封装，内核同 Web UI） |
| OS | Windows 11，1920×1080 @165Hz |
| GPU | Intel UHD + NVIDIA RTX 3050 Ti（已用 `GpuPreference=2` 强制独显；`glRenderer = ANGLE (NVIDIA …)`） |
| 硬件加速 | `gpu_compositing` / `rasterization` / `webgl` 均为 enabled |
| 动效 | Electron 启动参数已加 `force-prefers-reduced-motion`，`document.getAnimations()` 无运行中动画 |
| 插件 | 第三方插件较多（`@linxin666/dsh-web-all`、`@linxin666/dsh-client-ui-skin-center`、`@anionex/dsh-turn-rewind`、`@dsh-external/dsh-client-ui-skin-*`、`dsh-meme`、`dshmarket` 等 13 个前端插件） |

### 现象

1. **拖拽窗口边缘改变尺寸时明显卡顿**：窗口边界跟不上鼠标（"卡半天才调过来"），在 agent 流式输出期间更严重。
2. **空闲态页面仍持续工作**：无用户输入、无流式输出时，主线程占用仍有约 50%。
3. 用户体感：疑似 0.1.5 之后出现（此前版本无此体感）；切换皮肤/默认外观后体感一致。

### 实测数据（CDP 采集，均为无注入的干净测量）

**① `Performance.getMetrics`，10 秒窗口**

| 指标 | 值 |
|---|---|
| TaskDuration（主线程忙碌） | 5119 ms / 10000 ms = **51.2%** |
| ScriptDuration（JS） | 311 ms |
| RecalcStyleDuration（样式重算） | 289 ms（1572 次 → **0.18 ms/次**） |
| LayoutDuration（布局） | 410 ms（1453 次 → **≈145 次/秒**） |

布局在 10 秒内**均匀分布 ≈ 145 次/秒**，即**几乎每一屏幕帧都在布局**。

**② trace（`devtools.timeline`，6 秒）**：`Layout` 157 次、`UpdateLayoutTree` 143 次、`Paint` 113 次；无 `BeginMainFrame`/`DrawFrame` 事件。rAF 回调仅 144 次 / 6 秒（**24 次/秒**）——**布局频率（145/s）远高于 rAF 频率（24/s），说明布局不是 rAF 驱动的**。

**③ CPU Profile（8 秒）**：`(idle)` 4.5 s、`(program)` 3.5 s（原生渲染工作，非 JS）；JS 侧热点 `toBottom` 79.8 ms、`getBoundingClientRect` 58.6 ms、`closest` 11.6 ms。

**④ DOM 变更与强制布局**：MutationObserver 采样约 **30 次/秒** DOM 变更（多为 `data-chat-*`、`data-dsh-part`、`hidden` 属性切换）；hook `getBoundingClientRect` 测到约 **59 次/秒**。

### 已排除

- **GPU/硬件加速**：已确认启用且已切换独显 —— 排除。
- **CSS 无限动画**：reduce-motion 已生效，无运行中动画 —— 排除。
- **皮肤 CSS**：做了 A/B 对照（临时禁用皮肤的两张 `<style>` 表 10 秒，随后恢复）：主线程 **51.2% → 29.0%**。皮肤约占一半开销，**但禁用后仍有 29% 的持续占用**，故皮肤不是唯一原因。

### 猜测与提问

1. 布局频率≈屏幕刷新率、且每次 DOM 更新都伴随 `getBoundingClientRect` 读取 —— 怀疑存在**每帧强制同步布局（layout thrashing）**或 **ResizeObserver 反馈循环**。是否与长会话消息折叠使用 `hidden="until-found"` / `content-visibility` 有关？（参见 #6156）
2. 用户环境第三方插件较多，**无法完全排除插件影响**：恳请官方在**干净 profile（无第三方插件）**下验证是否可复现；如果干净环境不卡，我会把报告转给对应插件作者。
3. 0.1.5 是否有已知的渲染/布局循环相关改动？

### 相关讨论（先读过，避免重复）

- #6156 建议折叠工具与思考时真正卸载 DOM（`hidden="until-found"`）
- #1316 后台会话高速输出时交互延迟（mux 事件流无订阅过滤、无背压）
- #5205 Subagent timing 导致 Session 列表全量重建与 renderer 饥饿
- #3649 设置页滚动长列表卡顿（`backdrop-filter`）
- #5485 长上下文在输入框打字卡

---

**附：本机第三方插件的额外开销（供参考，非本报告主题，便于复现时对照）**

| 来源 | 现象 |
|---|---|
| `@linxin666/dsh-web-all` 的皮肤标记引擎 `applyToTree` | 每次 DOM 新增节点 → 对每条规则跑一次全树 `querySelectorAll` → 实测 **634 次/秒** |
| 同包 `syncHeight` | 实测 **59 次/秒** `getBoundingClientRect` |
| `dsh-web-all` 内置 skin-center + 独立 `@linxin666/dsh-client-ui-skin-center` | 疑似**重复加载**（两处都含同一套标记引擎代码） |

discussions.title: Cold forked Sessions show basename(cwd) instead of their own title in the session list
discussions.body:
### What happens

In the sidebar, a Session created by **fork** (or any seeded Session) is labelled with the workspace directory's basename instead of its own title **while it is not open**:

- cwd = the harness home → the row reads `.dsh`
- cwd = an SSH workspace anchor (`<home>/.dsh/ssh-workspaces/<id>`) → the row reads that workspace id, e.g. `6cd6bb63-2f1f-42a0-be86-5312b10dd51e`

Opening the Session labels it correctly, and it falls back to the wrong label once the Session goes cold again.

Reproduced on a real home with five forked Sessions whose cached titles are `项目代码修改建议审核 (2)`, `项目代码修改建议审核 (1)`, `询问能否显示当前目录 (1)` and `PD-1.PR：dsh-hardssh上market` — every one of them renders as `.dsh` or the anchor id. Verified against `master` (`5dda764`, the 0.1.5-alpha.1 line).

### Why

`packages/api/session-controller/src/list.ts` → `projectionsFor()`:

```ts
const block = session === undefined
  ? header.isSeeded
    ? undefined                      // ← seeded cold Session: no projection block at all
    : cache?.cachedSnapshot(header, SessionLogOffset(0))
      ?? cache?.cachedPredecessorTitle(header, SessionLogOffset(0))
  : this.ctx.sessionProjections.cachedSnapshot(session)
```

A forked Session is `isSeeded: true`. The Session-list path is deliberately metadata/cache-only and never opens a cold log body; the identity `cachedSnapshot` needs includes the exact `inheritedEventCount`, which a listing record (`SessionRecord`) does not carry — learning it costs exactly the per-Session read the listing avoids — so the guard returns `undefined`.

Without a projection block there is no `title`, and the browser falls back to the display-title projection `title ?? basename(cwd) ?? id`. The cached title **is** on disk (`storages/session_projcache/sessions/<id>.json` → `rows.title.val`); it is only unreachable from the list.

### Suggested fix (patch attached)

Serve the display-only `title` row from a record whose `createdAt`, `cwd`, and fork marker match the listed header — the same title-only `asOfSeq: -1` hint `cachedPredecessorTitle` already serves for predecessor formats. No seq-sensitive row becomes reachable without the exact identity, and the projection registry's per-row `ver` guard still screens the value.

Branch built on `master` (with the owning Agent Note and the regenerated Cordis catalog updated):

- branch: https://github.com/tiphareth0/deepseek-harness/tree/fix/cold-fork-session-title
- diff: https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/compare/master...tiphareth0:fix/cold-fork-session-title

Core of the change:

```diff
 // packages/api/session-controller/src/list.ts
       const block = session === undefined
         ? header.isSeeded
-          ? undefined
+          // A cold listing cannot complete a fork's lifecycle identity: the
+          // exact inherited cut it needs costs a per-session read. Serve the
+          // display-only title hint instead, so the row keeps its own name
+          // instead of falling back to the workspace directory's basename.
+          ? cache?.cachedListingTitle(header)
           : cache?.cachedSnapshot(header, SessionLogOffset(0))
             ?? cache?.cachedPredecessorTitle(header, SessionLogOffset(0))
         : this.ctx.sessionProjections.cachedSnapshot(session)
```

plus a new `SessionProjectionCache.cachedListingTitle(meta)` that returns the title row only (`asOfSeq: -1`), matching on `createdAt` / `cwd` / fork marker and accepting a current-or-older stored format stamp while refusing a newer one. `cachedPredecessorTitle` keeps its behavior and shares the private `titleHint` helper.

### Evidence

- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/session/session-projection-cache/tests packages/api/session-controller/tests --coverage --coverage.include='packages/session/session-projection-cache/src/index.ts' --coverage.include='packages/api/session-controller/src/list.ts'`
  → 767 passed / 1 failed; the failure is a Windows `EPERM symlink` fixture in `media-references.host.spec.ts` that reproduces on a pristine tree. Both changed files pass the per-file 100% coverage gate (no threshold errors).
- `pnpm run typecheck` → exit 0.
- `pnpm run doc-sync` → 32/34 gates; the two failures are that same Windows symlink check and a stale generated catalog (regenerated: `pnpm run gen-cordis-catalog`, now "97 generated file(s)/region(s) are up to date").
- New tests: a cache-level witness/mismatch matrix (other lifecycle, newer format, unseeded record, lineage-less record, incompatible row, missing record) and a cold-list assertion that a seeded row receives only the title hint and never a cut-0 snapshot.

(I understand this repository does not accept external pull requests, so I am reporting it here as CONTRIBUTING.md suggests.)

discussions.title: A reasoning-only turn is reported as `completed`: no answer, no tool call, and the raw reasoning is left on screen
discussions.body:
# A turn that produced only a `reasoning` block is treated as `completed` — no visible answer, no tool call, and the UI then leaves the raw reasoning on screen

Related: this is the uncovered half of the `2026-07-24-empty-model-response-is-retryable` fix. It is not the same as "rendering shows reasoning by mistake" (that part is correct) — the defect is that **a reasoning-only turn is never recognised as an empty response**, so nothing retries it.

## Environment

- DSH `@deepseek-ai/dsh` **0.1.5-rc.1** (Web profile, `dsh web`)
- Model: `deepseek-official / deepseek-flash`, `reasoningEffort: max`
- Windows 11 (Chinese), Windows PowerShell 5.1, Node v26.4.0
- Session that reproduced it: `session-71f620f9-…` — 1.54 MB compressed, 420 zstd frames, 4.19 MB decompressed JSONL

## Symptom

Repeatedly, a turn ends with **no assistant text and no tool call**. The conversation appears to "hang": the only thing on screen is the model's reasoning, and the collapsed think-row summary is frozen on whatever the last reasoning line happened to be (in my captures, always the literal string `**发。**`, which is the model's own shorthand for "about to call a tool").

Sending any further message resumes normally, which is the giveaway: **the turn was not aborted, it completed.**

## Hard evidence from the session log

```
seq 788  assistant/message  turn 20, step 2
         content = [ { type: "reasoning", text: <2705 chars> } ]      <-- single block, no text, no tool-call
         ... ends with: **好。** ... **发。** ... **嗯，不确定会不会又被用户说卡。我要快。** ... **发。**
seq 789  step/end
seq 790  turn/end  {"kind": "completed"}                              <-- no tool/call event in between
```

The same session contains **8** such messages with the identical shape — reasoning only, no `text`, no `tool-call` — at seq 511 / 529 / 597 / 741 / 775 / 788 / 806 / 814, every one of them ending in that same "about to send" phrase.

## Root cause

Two independent checks both miss this case.

**1. Empty-response detection only counts *zero blocks*, not *zero visible blocks***

`@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-deepseek` `lib/index.js` **L1239**:

```js
reason.kind === "stop" && order.length === 0
```

A `reasoning` block calls `open("reasoning")` and therefore participates in `order`. So a stop that carried only reasoning **is not empty by this test and is never retried**.

The intent is already documented in `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm` `lib/types/error.js`, where `EMPTY_RESPONSE_CODE` is annotated:

> an empty message **silently ends the turn with nothing for the user or the loop to act on**

The implementation's boundary (`order.length === 0`) is narrower than that stated intent.

**2. The agent loop only looks for tool calls**

`@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-loop` `lib/index.js` **L1115-1119**:

```js
if (finish.kind === "max-tokens") return { kind: "max-tokens" };
const toolCalls = message.content.filter((b) => b.type === "tool-call");
if (toolCalls.length === 0) return { kind: "completed" };   // <-- reached here
```

**Nothing inspects whether the message contained any visible text.** With no tool call it returns `completed`, the turn closes and control goes back to the user.

Note the ordering also rules out an output-budget explanation: the recorded termination is `completed`, **not** `max-tokens`, so `maxTokens` was not exhausted.

**3. Why the UI leaves the reasoning visible**

`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-chat` `lib/client.js`:

- `reasoningHidden` (≈ offset 152378) requires `turnProcess.spec.answerStep === data.step && spec.inlineReasoning && !open`. **Only an answer step hides its reasoning.** A step with no visible text is not an answer step, so `reasoningHidden === false` and the ReasoningRow renders as-is.
- `ReasoningRow` (≈ offset 143626) uses `latestLine(text)` for the collapsed summary while running — so it **always shows the last line**, which is exactly why every stalled turn I captured ended on the identical phrase.

So the visible symptom is a compound of (2) and (3): the loop accepts a contentless turn, and the UI then has no answer text with which to demote the reasoning into the collapsed process area.

## Suggested fixes

| # | Package / file | Location | Change |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-deepseek` `lib/index.js` | L1239 | Widen `order.length === 0` to "no **visible** block (text / tool-call)", so a reasoning-only stop is classified as `EMPTY_RESPONSE` and becomes retryable — matching the intent already stated in the `EMPTY_RESPONSE_CODE` comment |
| 2 | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-loop` `lib/index.js` | L1115-1119 | Before `toolCalls.length === 0 → completed`, add a branch for "no visible text and only reasoning": retry the step, or at minimum emit a user-visible notice, instead of ending the turn silently |
| 3 | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-chat` `lib/client.js` | `reasoningHidden` (≈152378), `ReasoningRow` summary (≈143626) | The `answerStep === data.step` requirement means a contentless step is the one case that most needs its reasoning collapsed; consider hiding reasoning whenever the step produced no visible text. The `latestLine` summary should also carry a truncation indicator so a half-sentence of thinking cannot be mistaken for an answer |
| 4 | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm` `lib/types/error.js` | `EMPTY_RESPONSE_CODE` | Align the comment and the implementation (comment describes the failure mode correctly; the check only covers zero blocks) |

## Notes / limitations, stated honestly

- `assistant/attempt` is not written for successful attempts, so the concrete `finish_reason` is not in the log. "Not max-tokens" is inferred from `turn/end = completed`.
- Session size is **not** established as a cause. Compaction defaults are `thresholdRatio: 0.8` with `DEFAULT_CONTEXT_WINDOW = 1e6`, i.e. ≈ 800k tokens; the affected sessions are ~4 MB decompressed, roughly 300–400k tokens by the token meter's 4-chars-per-token heuristic, and the event log contains **no** compaction event at all. Large context plausibly makes the failure more likely and certainly makes each step feel slower, but I cannot claim causality. Worth noting `dsh-compaction-basic`'s own README flags that 4-chars-per-token under-prices CJK text, so real Chinese sessions cross the threshold later than the heuristic suggests.
- `reasoningEffort: max` is a **high-suspicion but unproven** contributor: it lengthens reasoning and therefore raises the chance that the stream tails off right where a tool call was due. No controlled A/B was run. Lowering it to `high` is the practical mitigation until the loop is fixed.

## Reproduction recipe (for whoever picks this up)

Session files are multi-frame zstd — `zlib.zstdDecompressSync` returns only the first frame (~0.2 KB). Split on the frame magic `28 B5 2F FD` and decompress each frame separately; then look for `assistant/message` records whose `content` array has **no** `text` and **no** `tool-call` block, and read the following `turn/end` — it will say `completed`.

discussions.title: Feedback(0.1.5-rc.2): INVALID_ARGS 报错缺上下文——模型分不清缺的是哪一层参数,PTC 场景陷入连环错误重试(附补丁)
discussions.body:
## 现象

dsh 0.1.5-rc.2、PTC 模式(run_code)、GLM-5.3(第三方 Anthropic Messages 兼容端点)。长会话中模型发生参数漂移:run_code 调用的顶层 JSON 只带 `code`,`description` 被写进了程序文本内部(成了内层 `tools.bash({ ... })` 的参数)。

dsh 的校验**正确拒绝**了这些调用——schema 本身没有问题(模型可见 schema 与校验 schema 一致,`code`/`description` 均 required,pi-ai 严格解析也全过,排除了流截断)。问题在于**错误消息本身**:每次返回

```
Error: invalid arguments: missing required property "description"
```

之后,模型检查自己写的调用,发现内层工具明明有 `description`,于是得出"我有写"的结论,转而去修改毫不相干的措辞重试。该会话 11 步烧掉 8 步,最终报废,模型归纳出的"规律"(内外 description 措辞相同时触发)完全是错觉。

失败调用的线上原始样本(从会话记录解出,合法 JSON、非截断,顶层只有 `code`):

```json
{"code":"const r = await tools.bash({\n  command: \"mkdir -p fly-brain-playground && ...\",\n  description: \"准备果蝇项目工作目录\"\n});\nconsole.log(r.stdout, r.stderr);"}
```

## 根因

`ToolArgsError` 的消息只列出缺失属性,不说明:

1. 是**哪个工具**拒绝了参数;
2. 实际**收到了哪些顶层键**。

单层工具场景下这不痛不痒;但 PTC 场景存在两层同名参数(run_code 顶层的 `description` 与程序内层工具的 `description`),模型无法定位缺失发生在哪一层,只能在错误反馈回路里盲试。

## 建议修复(已在本地验证)

给 `ToolArgsError` 消息追加可选诊断上下文——拒绝调用的工具名 + 实际收到的顶层键:

```
invalid arguments: missing required property "description"; tool "run_code"; received top-level argument keys: [code]
```

改动面 `packages/core/tools/src/schema.ts`:

- `ToolArgsError` 构造器加可选 `context`(`tool` / `receivedKeys`),不传则消息与现状完全一致(subagent 等其他调用点零影响);
- `defineTool` 的 `execute` 抛出时带上 `{ tool: options.name, receivedKeys }`(顶层键排序后拼接);
- `tests/tools.spec.ts` 两处断言同步更新。

收到这种消息后,模型能立即看出"run_code 顶层只到了 code",一步修正,而不是循环。

## 环境

- dsh 0.1.5-rc.2(本地构建)
- provider:zai-coding-cn / glm-5.3(Anthropic Messages 协议,第三方端点)
- 该会话 8 次失败调用的原始 arguments 均为合法 JSON、仅缺顶层 `description`

discussions.title: DSH | Experience Map | Reuse verified Agent experience / 复用经过验证的 Agent 经验
discussions.body:
> **非官方社区插件，由社区成员独立开发和维护，不代表 DeepSeek 官方产品、审核或推荐。**

项目地址：[GitHub](https://github.com/alcheme-labs/dsh-experience-map) · [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-experience-map) · [v0.1.0-beta.3 Release](https://github.com/alcheme-labs/dsh-experience-map/releases/tag/v0.1.0-beta.3)

Experience Map 是一个面向 DeepSeek Harness 的本地优先经验插件。它要解决的是：同类任务每次执行路线不稳定，Agent 重复尝试已经失败过的步骤，造成额外模型调用、工具调用和 Token 消耗。

它会在任务完成后本地检查最近的 Session，把有证据支撑的 Procedure、Diagnostic、Preference、Fact 等建议按会话列出。用户明确保存后，建议才成为不可变、可版本化的 Experience；相同经验跨会话重复出现时只补充证据，不重复保存内容。新任务召回时还要通过作用域、前置条件、当前 Preflight、阈值和排名间隔检查，不确定就不匹配。

与 DSH 的集成方式：

- 作为标准 `dsh.bundle` 安装到现有 Web 或 headless Profile，不修改 DSH 源码。
- Web 端嵌入现有会话的“经验”标签页，并在“设置 → 插件”提供配置卡片。
- Host 负责唯一的 Experience 写入、保守召回、Plan、验证与结算；完整 Session、模型路由、工具和审批仍由 DSH 负责。
- 自动建议检测和自动召回默认开启，但保存、Plan 批准和工具批准相互独立；自动工具执行关闭。
- 自动检测、分组和默认召回无需外部模型。可选本地语义模型和外部 Candidate 提炼都由用户单独配置。

快速安装（npm 公开测试版）：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-experience-map@0.1.0-beta.3
dsh web
```

使用说明：[中文快速上手](https://github.com/alcheme-labs/dsh-experience-map/blob/main/docs/QUICKSTART.zh.md)

![Experience Map 界面](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/alcheme-labs/dsh-experience-map/main/docs/media/experience-map-overview.png)

收益证据：在一组短、配对的真实 DSH 任务中，批准并注入同一条匹配 Experience 后，观测到 provider token volume 降低 65.9%、工具调用减少 45.5%、模型步骤减少 46.2%。这只是一个任务族的观测值，不是平均值或节省承诺；任务、控制条件、去标识事件、计算方式和非主张均在[收益证据文档](https://github.com/alcheme-labs/dsh-experience-map/blob/main/docs/release/BENEFIT_EVIDENCE.md)中公开。

兼容性：DSH `0.1.5-rc.2`；Node.js `^22.19.0` 或 `>=24.0.0`；MIT License。

维护：杭州星原驱动科技有限公司 · OPC（超级个体）实践。

欢迎用真实、短任务体验后反馈：错误匹配、应该召回但未召回、Suggestion 不可理解、终端闭环和实际 Token/工具调用变化，都是我们最关心的问题。

## English summary

> **Unofficial community plugin, independently developed and maintained. It is not a DeepSeek product, review, or endorsement.**

Experience Map is a local-first experience-memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness. It helps an Agent reuse evidence-backed procedures, diagnostics, preferences, and facts instead of repeating failed exploration on similar tasks.

- Installs as a standard `dsh.bundle` in existing Web or headless Profiles; it does not modify DSH source code.
- Detects suggestions after completed Sessions and groups repeated evidence without saving duplicate Experiences.
- Saving remains an explicit owner decision. Recall is conservative and must pass scope, prerequisite, current-preflight, threshold, and ranking-margin checks.
- Automatic suggestion detection and recall are enabled by default; Plan approval and tool approval remain separate, and automatic tool execution is disabled.
- Default detection, grouping, and recall require no external model. Local semantic models and external enrichment are optional and independently configurable.

Install:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-experience-map@0.1.0-beta.3
dsh web
```

In one short paired DSH task family, approved Experience Context was associated with 65.9% lower provider token volume, 45.5% fewer tool calls, and 46.2% fewer model steps. This is one observed task family, not an average or a savings promise; the task, controls, de-identified events, calculations, and limitations are published in the repository.

Project: [GitHub](https://github.com/alcheme-labs/dsh-experience-map) · [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-experience-map) · [Quick start](https://github.com/alcheme-labs/dsh-experience-map/blob/main/docs/QUICKSTART.md)

Maintained by Alcheme Labs · OPC (one-person company) practice.

discussions.title: [Bug] dsh-client-resources 的 protocolOf 依赖 new URL().hostname，Edge 129 下文件预览显示“文件资源服务不可用”
discussions.body:
我在使用DSH时遇到了“文件资源服务不可用”的问题，经过和DeepSeek V4.1联合排查后得到了以下结论

# 上游问题报告：`dsh-client-resources` 的 `protocolOf` 在 Edge 129 上失效，文件预览显示「文件资源服务不可用」

> 复现版本：DSH CLI `0.1.5-rc.1`，客户端包 `0.1.5-rc.2`，Windows，Edge 129（Chromium 129）。

## 一句话

`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-resources` 的 `protocolOf()` 用 `new URL(address).hostname` 读取
`dsh-resource://` 地址的协议名。在 Edge 129 上，`dsh-resource:` 这类**非特殊 scheme**
的 authority 不会被解析进 `hostname`（落到了 `pathname`），于是 `hostname` 为空 →
`protocolOf` 返回 `undefined` → 所有文件地址被判为「没有 provider」→ 右侧栏文档预览
渲染 `resourceUnavailable`：「文件资源服务不可用。」

宿主侧一切正常，客户端不抛异常，所以这个故障**完全静默**。

## 复现步骤

1. 用 Edge 129 打开 DSH Web GUI（`http://127.0.0.1:3080`），进入任意会话。
2. 右侧栏 Files → 点开一个 `.md` 文件。
3. 预览区显示「文件资源服务不可用。」

控制台一句话即可定性：

```js
const u = new URL('dsh-resource://file/session/s1/a.md');
console.log(u.protocol, JSON.stringify(u.hostname), JSON.stringify(u.pathname));
```

| 环境 | 输出 |
| --- | --- |
| Edge 129（故障） | `dsh-resource: "" "//file/session/s1/a.md"` |
| 较新的 Chromium / Chrome（正常） | `dsh-resource: "file" "/session/s1/a.md"` |

对照实验（排除「只是 `dsh-resource` 的问题」）：

```js
new URL('foo://bar/baz').hostname   // Edge 129 → ""，pathname → "//bar/baz"
new URL('http://a/b').hostname      // Edge 129 → "a"（特殊 scheme 正常）
```

即：Edge 129 对**所有非特殊 scheme**都不把 `//host` 解析进 `hostname`。较新的 Chromium
行为符合 WHATWG URL 规范。

同一台机器、同一次会话中，宿主端 RPC 全部正常，说明不是服务端问题：

```
workspaceFiles/list      → ok
workspaceFiles/stat      → ok
workspaceFiles/readAll   → ok（返回该 .md 的正文）
```

## 根因链

```
new URL('dsh-resource://file/…').hostname === ""
  → protocolOf(address) === undefined
  → providers.get(undefined) === undefined
  → 记录被创建为 idle("none")
  → 预览分支 (state === undefined || selected === undefined) && meta.status === "none"
  → t("resourceUnavailable") → 「文件资源服务不可用。」
```

宿主端从未收到请求，所以服务端日志看不出任何异常。

原实现（`dsh-client-resources/lib/client.js`）：

```js
/**
 * The protocol key of one address: the host of a `dsh-resource://` URL, as the
 * URL parser reads it (lower-cased). …
 */
function protocolOf(address) {
  let parsed;
  try { parsed = new URL(address); } catch { return; }
  if (parsed.protocol !== `dsh-resource:`) return void 0;
  return parsed.hostname === "" ? void 0 : parsed.hostname.toLowerCase();
}
```

## 建议修复

改成纯字符串解析（语义等价：空 authority 仍返回 `undefined`，非 `dsh-resource:` 仍返回
`undefined`），不再依赖浏览器对非特殊 scheme 的 URL 解析行为：

```js
function protocolOf(address) {
  const match = /^dsh-resource:\/\/([^/?#]+)/i.exec(address);
  return match === null ? void 0 : match[1].toLowerCase();
}
```

同时 JSDoc 里「as the URL parser reads it」这句在改完后已不成立，建议一并改写。

这也与仓库自身其它位置的既有约定一致——它们都做字符串前缀解析，只有 `protocolOf`
走了 `new URL()`：

- `@deepseek-ai/dsh-util-workspace-path/lib/index.js:9`
  `const FILE_ADDRESS_PREFIX = "dsh-resource://file/";` + `parseFileAddress()` 纯字符串解析
- `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-sidebar-right/lib/client.js:1183`
  `const RESOURCE_SCHEME = "dsh-resource://";`
- `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-chat/lib/client.js:14`、`dsh-client-ui-sidebar-files/lib/client.js:136`、
  `dsh-client-ui-sidebar-documentpreview/lib/client.js:971` 各自复制了一份 `FILE_ADDRESS_PREFIX`

顺带建议：把「地址 ⇄ 协议 / 部件」的解析统一收进 `dsh-util-workspace-path`，消掉这几份
重复常量，这样将来只需要在一个地方保证解析健壮。

## 附带的可诊断性问题

客户端 cordis logger 只注册了内存环形缓冲 exporter（1000 条），没有 console sink；
而这条失败路径不抛异常。实测浏览器控制台干净、日志缓冲为 `{ "total": 0, "errs": 0 }`，
排查时完全没有线索——只有沿着 React fiber 手工取出 `resources` 服务实例、直接枚举
`providers` 才能定位。如果条件允许，建议在开发构建下补一个 console exporter，或对
「地址协议无 provider」这种状态发一条 debug 日志。

## 用户侧临时规避

- 换用较新的 Chromium 内核浏览器；或
- 给 `…/dsh-client-resources/lib/client.js` 打上上面那段替换。

注意：DSH 通常由 `npx @deepseek-ai/dsh` 启动，代码位于
`%LOCALAPPDATA%\npm-cache\_npx\<hash>\node_modules`，而 `~/.dsh/profiles/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/*`
是指向它的 junction。**每次更新 DSH 都会覆盖这份缓存，补丁随之失效**，需要重新打一次。

## English abstract

`protocolOf()` in `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-resources` derives the resource protocol
key from `new URL(address).hostname`. On Chromium 129 / Edge 129 the URL parser does
not populate `hostname` for non-special schemes such as `dsh-resource:` (the authority
ends up in `pathname`), so `new URL('dsh-resource://file/…').hostname === ""`,
`protocolOf()` returns `undefined`, every file address is recorded as
`idle("none")`, and the document preview renders `resourceUnavailable`
("文件资源服务不可用"). The host is never called and nothing is logged.

Repro: `new URL('dsh-resource://file/session/s1/a.md')` → `hostname === ""` on Edge 129,
`"file"` on newer Chromium. Suggested fix: parse the protocol from the string form
(`/^dsh-resource:\/\/([^/?#]+)/i`), matching `parseFileAddress()` in
`dsh-util-workspace-path`, which already avoids the URL parser.

discussions.title: [Bug] "Show in File Explorer" on Windows reveals the file in an invisible window (and never reveals non-ASCII paths)
discussions.body:
## Summary

`revealNativePath()` (used by the Web UI's delivery-card action **Show in File Explorer** /
在文件资源管理器中显示) fails on Windows in two independent ways:

1. **The Explorer window is created hidden.** The native runner always spawns children with
   `windowsHide: true`. Windows forwards that as `STARTUPINFO.wShowWindow = SW_HIDE`, and the
   `explorer.exe` window created for `/select,` inherits it — so the file **is** selected, but in
   a window that is never shown. The user sees "nothing happens" for every card.
2. **Percent-encoded file URIs break non-ASCII paths.** The target is built with
   `pathToFileURL()`, so a path containing Chinese/other non-ASCII characters becomes
   `file:///C:/...%E4%B8%AD...`. Explorer does not decode percent-encoded UTF-8 bytes for
   `/select,`: no window is created at all. Plain paths work.

Both are present on `master` today.

## Environment

* `dsh` 0.1.5-rc.1, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-native-command` 0.1.5-rc.2 (npx install), Node v24.20.0
* Windows 11 (10.0.26100), Explorer with tabs, several folder windows already open
* Web UI in Chrome; server on `http://127.0.0.1:3080`
* Source references below are from `master` (`packages/util/native-command/src/…`)

## Steps to reproduce

1. Produce a delivered file card (`present`) whose file exists — e.g. `…\dist\App.dll`.
2. Click the card's chevron → **Show in File Explorer**.
3. Observe: no Explorer window appears or is raised; the card just shows
   "Requested display in file manager" (the status line is replaced by the hover hint while the
   pointer is on the card).
4. Repeat with a file under a folder whose name contains Chinese characters: nothing happens at
   all, not even a hidden window.

Server-side is healthy, which I confirmed by driving the real routes with a locally minted
session cookie:

* `GET /api/present.host` → `{"available":true,"fileManager":"explorer"}`
* `POST /api/present.open?sessionId=…&seq=…&index=…&action=reveal` → `204`

## Evidence

### A/B on the child-process flag (same file, same argv)

| `execFile("explorer.exe", ["/select,", uri], …)` | observed |
| --- | --- |
| `{ windowsHide: true }` ← current code | Shell window exists and lists the file in `SelectedItems()`, but `IsWindowVisible(hwnd) == false`; foreground window stays with the browser/other app |
| `{ windowsHide: false }` | `IsWindowVisible(hwnd) == true`, window is shown with the file selected |

`windowsHide: true` is not merely "hide a console": on Windows it sets the child's
`STARTUPINFO.wShowWindow` to `SW_HIDE`, and the child's first top-level window inherits that show
state. `explorer.exe` is a GUI process, so there is no console to hide in the first place.

### Path shape matrix (fresh folder per case, `IsWindowVisible` + selection checked via `Shell.Application`)

| target built as | ASCII | space | comma | Chinese folder | Chinese filename |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `pathToFileURL(...)` file URI (current) | ok | ok | ok | **no window** | **no window** |
| plain path | ok | ok | **no window** | ok | ok |

The comment at `path-opener.ts:247` says the file URI exists to preserve commas and whitespace;
that intent is right for commas, but the URI form silently loses non-ASCII paths, and the
`windowsHide` flag loses every path.

## Suggested fix (minimal)

`packages/util/native-command/src/runner.ts` — let a caller opt out of the hidden show state:

```diff
 export type NativeCommandRunner = (
   command: string,
   args: readonly string[],
   signal: AbortSignal,
+  options?: { windowsHide?: boolean },
 ) => Promise<{ stdout: string; stderr: string }>
@@
  * @param signal - caller/connection lifetime; abort terminates the child.
+ * @param options - optional `windowsHide` override, defaulting to `true`.
  * @returns captured stdout/stderr on exit 0.
  */
-export const runNativeCommand: NativeCommandRunner = (command, args, signal) =>
+export const runNativeCommand: NativeCommandRunner = (command, args, signal, options) =>
   new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
     execFile(
       command,
       [...args],
-      { encoding: 'utf8', signal, windowsHide: true },
+      { encoding: 'utf8', signal, windowsHide: options?.windowsHide ?? true },
```

`packages/util/native-command/src/path-opener.ts` — keep the comma-safe URI only where it is
needed, and spawn the reveal visibly:

```diff
-    // Explorer parses commas itself; a file URI preserves commas and whitespace in the path.
-    const target = pathToFileURL(windowsPath, { windows: true }).href.replaceAll(',', '%2C')
+    // Explorer parses commas itself, so only a comma-bearing path needs the encoded file URI;
+    // it does not decode percent-encoded non-ASCII bytes, so every other path stays plain and
+    // reaches Explorer as a real UTF-16 argument.
+    const target = windowsPath.includes(',')
+      ? pathToFileURL(windowsPath, { windows: true }).href.replaceAll(',', '%2C')
+      : windowsPath
     try {
-      await run('explorer.exe', ['/select,', target], signal)
+      // `windowsHide` is inherited by the window Explorer creates; with it the file is
+      // revealed in an invisible window.
+      await run('explorer.exe', ['/select,', target], signal, { windowsHide: false })
```

Notes:

* The 4th parameter is additive, so existing injectable `run` fakes in the adapter tests keep
  working (they simply ignore it); the type in `runner.ts` needs the same optional field.
* `openWindowsPath()` (powershell `Invoke-Item`) keeps the default `windowsHide: true`; only the
  reveal gesture needs a visible window.
* A path containing **both** a comma and non-ASCII characters still has no fully safe form in
  this design; if you want full coverage, the quoted `/select,"<path>"` form via a
  `windowsVerbatimArguments` spawn would cover it, at the cost of more platform-specific code.

## Verification of the fix

I patched the installed `@deepseek-ai/dsh-native-command/lib/index.js` with the equivalent
change and re-ran the same probes by calling the patched `revealNativePath()` directly:

| path | result |
| --- | --- |
| `…\_fix_ascii\target.txt` | `visible=True`, selected `target.txt` |
| `…\_fix_中文\目标.txt` | `visible=True`, selected `目标.txt` |
| `…\_fix,a\target.txt` | `visible=True`, selected `target.txt` |

The Web UI gesture then behaves as expected after restarting the server (the host loads this
module at startup).

## Related (client-side, lower priority)

* `dsh-client-ui-deliverables`: the card's status line is hidden on `:hover`
  (`…:hover .secondaryText { display: none }`) and replaced with the "preview in sidebar" hint,
  so a 404/failure — shown exactly while the pointer is still on the card — is invisible.
* A delivery whose file was later deleted answers `404` and renders "Could not show in file
  manager. Try again."; "the file no longer exists" is not actionable by retrying, so a distinct
  message would help.

## 中文摘要

Web UI 交付卡片里的「在文件资源管理器中显示」在 Windows 上有两个独立缺陷（`master` 仍存在）：

1. `runNativeCommand` 对子进程固定传 `windowsHide: true`，Windows 会把
   `SW_HIDE` 传给 explorer 新建的窗口 —— 文件其实被选中了，但窗口从不显示，用户看到的就是
   “完全没反应”。实测 `windowsHide:false` 时 `IsWindowVisible=true`。
2. `revealNativePath` 用 `pathToFileURL()` 生成百分号编码的 `file:///…` URI 给
   `explorer.exe /select,`；Explorer 不解码百分号编码的非 ASCII 字节，任何含中文的路径连窗口
   都不创建（纯路径形式正常）。

建议的最小修复：给 `runNativeCommand` 增加可选 `windowsHide` 覆盖（默认仍为 `true`），并在
explorer 分支中：路径含逗号时继续用编码 URI（Explorer 会按逗号切分 `/select,` 参数），否则
用纯路径；调用时传 `{ windowsHide: false }`。上面的 diff 与验证结果见正文。

discussions.title: hooks-claude-code: a matcher written as "Bash" selects nothing, because the adapter matches the DSH tool name "bash"
discussions.body:
**Environment:** dsh `0.1.5-rc.1`, node `v22.22.0`, Linux.

A project-level `.dsh/hooks.json` in the Claude Code format, activated through a carrier bundle that inserts `@deepseek-ai/dsh-hooks-claude-code` with an absolute `configPath`:

```json
{
  "PreToolUse": [
    { "matcher": "Bash",
      "hooks": [ { "type": "command", "command": "python3 .dsh/hooks/gate.py", "timeout": 10 } ] }
  ]
}
```

**Expected:** the command runs before every shell tool call.
**Actual:** it never runs. No error, no warning, nothing in the log, and `dsh --profile web --dump-config` shows the row composed correctly.

**Root cause**, three verifiable facts:

1. The shell tool registers itself as `bash`, not `Bash`: `dsh-tool-bash` has `name: "bash"`.
2. The adapter hands the matcher the DSH tool name with no translation: `dsh-hooks-claude-code` builds the matcher query as `tool_name: exec.name`.
3. A pure-word matcher takes the dialect's LITERAL path, which compares strings exactly: `matchesMatcher` does `pattern.split("|").includes(query)` when `CLAUDE_LITERAL` (`/^[A-Za-z0-9_|]+$/`) matches.

So `"Bash"` is compared against `"bash"` and the whole group is skipped.

**Minimal reproduction:**

```js
import { matchesMatcher } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-hook-protocol';

matchesMatcher('Bash',      'bash', 'claude-code');  // false — expected true
matchesMatcher('bash',      'bash', 'claude-code');  // true
matchesMatcher('bash|Bash', 'bash', 'claude-code');  // true
matchesMatcher('[Bb]ash',   'bash', 'claude-code');  // true
```

**Impact, and why "silent" is the defect.** Claude Code's documented matcher for the shell tool is `Bash`, so a hooks file written from the documentation selects nothing on this adapter. The failure is invisible at every layer: the config parses, the plugin composes, the group never matches, and a `[ -f "$h" ]`-guarded command exits 1, which the protocol reads as "no decision".

Measured cost on our side: two pre-tool gates (one refusing a whole `pytest tests/`, one refusing an unlocked `pytest tests/contracts/`, 4,042 tests) were silently absent for as long as they existed. A five-minute suite ran unlocked beside another agent's suite and both doubled (9:13 against 4:48 isolated, and 13:20 for the suite beside it against a 7:05 baseline) before we noticed.

**Suggested fixes, any one of which closes it:**

1. Translate the tool name before matching (`bash` → `Bash`, and the same for the rest of the Claude Code vocabulary this dialect documents), so matchers written per those docs keep working.
2. Or make the literal comparison case-insensitive.
3. And in either case, warn when a `PreToolUse` group selected nothing in a session: a matcher that names a known Claude Code tool and matched no call is a wiring bug, and today it looks exactly like a gate with nothing to refuse.

**Workaround we ship:** `"matcher": "bash|Bash"`, which stays on the literal path and matches either spelling.

**Secondary observation, same family:** `@deepseek-ai/dsh-hooks-claude-code` declares no `dsh.bundle`, so listing it as a dependency composes its row in `--dump-config` while the hook process never starts; activation required a carrier bundle in the project. If that is intended, one line in the package README would save the next person the evening it cost us.

discussions.title: [缺陷] 会话面板内的插件模态无法逃离所在 pane 的层叠上下文（z-index 99999 输给兄弟 pane 的 z-index 8）
discussions.body:
### 摘要

插件渲染在会话区里的弹窗，无法盖住兄弟 pane 的内容。它写的 z-index: 99999 完全失效，于是另一个 pane 里一个 40px 宽、看不见的拖拽手柄（z-index: 8）会吃掉本该属于弹窗的点击。同一个元素在触屏上还会留下一条常亮的悬停指示条。

### 环境

- @deepseek-ai/dsh 0.1.5-rc.2（DSHA 安卓 App 内置，App 版本 0.1.5-rc2 / code 129）
- 安卓 16 平板，WebView 视口 1238×787 CSS px，devicePixelRatio 2.5
- pointer: coarse、hover: none（纯触屏）
- 涉及包：dsh-client-ui-conversation

### 复现步骤

1. 插件把一个 position: fixed 的对话框 + 遮罩渲染进 conversation.composer.dock 插槽（对话框 z-index: 99999，遮罩 99998）；
2. 打开这个对话框；
3. 点击落在 CSS x 366–406 区间内的任意控件 —— 那里正是 div.wSkVaW_widthHandle 的位置。

### 实际结果

点击被 div.wSkVaW_widthHandle 吃掉（40px 宽、position: absolute; z-index: 8），尽管对话框是 position: fixed; z-index: 99999 且在视觉上位于最上层。用户能感知到的现象是：「点那几个标签不灵敏，得点好几下」。

在该手柄中心用 document.elementsFromPoint 实测的绘制顺序（从最上层到最下层）：

div.dshadb_scrim      z:99998  fixed     <- 插件对话框的遮罩
div.EvIC1a_scroll     z:auto   static
div.EvIC1a_root       z:auto   relative
div.wSkVaW_viewArea   z:auto   static
div.wSkVaW_scrollBody z:auto   static
div.wSkVaW_body       z:auto   relative
div.wSkVaW_root       z:auto   relative

从两个元素各自向上找到最近的「自成层叠上下文的祖先」：

模态的上下文根 = div.dshadb_scrim（它自己的遮罩）
手柄的上下文根 = div.wSkVaW_body
=> 两者不在同一个层叠上下文

### 期望结果

一个 position: fixed 且 z-index: 99999 的对话框，应当绘制并命中测试于 z-index: 8 的 absolute 元素之上，并且不应被兄弟 pane 的内容遮挡。

### 推测的根因

dsh-client-ui-conversation 中有这样一条规则：

.pXSMma_body>*{ z-index:1; position:relative }

它让会话正文的每一个直接子元素都各自成为一个层叠上下文。于是渲染在 pane A 内部的 fixed 元素永远无法逃出 pane A，而 pane B（装着 .wSkVaW_widthHandle 的聊天 pane）整体绘制在 pane A 之上。对话框自己写多大的 z-index 都失去意义，只有各个 pane 的相对顺序在起作用。

### 建议的修法

- 方案 a：去掉 .pXSMma_body>* 上的 z-index:1（如需定位可保留 position:relative）。堆叠顺序由 DOM 顺序本来就能稳定保证。
- 方案 b：或者让「对话框类插槽」走 portal / 宿主自己的 overlay 层渲染（div.pI_x6G_overlayLayer 已经是这个角色），使插件不再继承 pane 的层叠限制。
- 方案 c（针对手柄本身，建议顺带做）：@media (hover: none){ [class*="widthHandle"]{ pointer-events: none } } —— 触屏上这个手柄本来就无从发现（没有 hover 提示、没有任何视觉），留着唯一可观测的效果就是吃掉点击；接了鼠标的平板（hover: hover）不受影响，官方拖拽照旧。

### 同一元素的第二个症状

.wSkVaW_widthHandle::after 是拖拽指示条（默认 opacity: 0，:hover / [data-dragging] 时为 1）。在 hover: none 设备上，触摸会留下 sticky hover，指示条被永久点亮，表现为一条来路不明的灰色竖条画在无关界面上。应当用指针能力查询把它关掉。

### 本地临时规避

本地一个纯 CSS 插件对 @media (hover: none) 施加了：

[class*="widthHandle"]::after { display: none !important; }
[class*="widthHandle"] { pointer-events: none !important; }

这能止住这一个手柄的症状，但结构性问题依旧存在 —— 任何在会话 pane 内渲染模态的插件都会中招。

discussions.title: [Bug][WSL2] dsh web freeze: sync reverse DNS in flock libc probe (missing excludeNetwork)
discussions.body:
## Summary

On WSL2, `dsh web` freezes a few seconds after startup: the port stays LISTENING but every HTTP request times out; CPU stays near 0% and the process never recovers.

The root cause is confirmed with `gdb` + instrumentation: the first session write-lease acquisition lazily loads `@deepseek-ai/node-addon-system`'s `flock.js`, whose libc probe calls `process.report.getReport()` **without** setting `process.report.excludeNetwork = true`. The report's network walk then performs a **synchronous** `getnameinfo()` (reverse DNS) on every open libuv TCP handle on the main thread. In this environment, PTR lookups for the proxy's fake-IP range (`198.18.0.0/15`) via the WSL DNS tunnel intermittently stall forever, so the main thread blocks forever and the entire event loop is frozen.

## Environment

- Windows 11 + WSL2; distro: Arch Linux; `.wslconfig`: `networkingMode=mirrored`, `dnsTunneling=true`, `autoProxy=true`
- Node.js: `v26.8.2`
- dsh: `0.1.5-rc.1` (global npm install, npm `latest`)
- `@deepseek-ai/node-addon-system`: `0.1.2` (npm `latest`; `^0.1.2` is also the range used by 0.1.5-rc.2 packages)
- Network: proxy in fake-IP mode active; forward DNS is fine, reverse DNS for fake-IP peers stalls

## Steps to reproduce

1. Run `dsh web` (default flags; browser handoff enabled).
2. Let the Web UI open; a session write lease is acquired.
3. Within ~15 s, every HTTP request to the bound port times out while the process remains alive (LISTENING, ~0% CPU, clean stdout/stderr). The process must be killed; Ctrl+C on the controlling terminal does not work while the main thread is stuck in the syscall.

Freeze also reproduces with `--no-open` as long as the UI is opened manually later; it does **not** occur if no session is ever opened.

## Evidence

### 1. Frozen main thread (gdb backtrace, taken 60 s into the freeze)

The main thread is blocked in a synchronous reverse-DNS lookup issued by the diagnostic report walker:

```
#0  ppoll () from /usr/lib/libc.so.6
#1  0x00007ffff6e44166 in ?? () from /usr/lib/libnss_resolve.so.2
#2  0x00007ffff6e2cf49 in _nss_resolve_gethostbyaddr2_r () from /usr/lib/libnss_resolve.so.2
#3  0x00007ffff6e2d78a in _nss_resolve_gethostbyaddr_r () from /usr/lib/libnss_resolve.so.2
#4  gethostbyaddr_r () from /usr/lib/libc.so.6
#5  getnameinfo () from /usr/lib/libc.so.6
#6  0x00007ffff7f63857 in ?? () from /usr/lib/libuv.so.1
#7  uv_getnameinfo () from /usr/lib/libuv.so.1
#8  node::report::WalkHandle(uv_handle_s*, void*, bool) ()
#9  uv_walk () from /usr/lib/libuv.so.1
#10 node::GetNodeReport(...) ()
#11 node::report::GetReport(...) ()
```

The main thread's kernel wait channel matches (`poll_schedule_timeout`), i.e. it is parked in `ppoll` inside `nss-resolve`, waiting on the systemd-resolved varlink socket, while all other threads are idle.

### 2. JS caller stack (captured by instrumenting `process.report.getReport`)

```
at loadBinding (.../node_modules/@deepseek-ai/node-addon-system/lib/flock.js:19:39)
at errno (.../node_modules/@deepseek-ai/node-addon-system/lib/flock.js:41:9)
at new Promise (<anonymous>)
at tryLockExclusive (.../node_modules/@deepseek-ai/node-addon-system/lib/flock.js:40:25)
at SessionWriteLease.acquire (.../node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-persistence-jsonl/lib/index.js:690:12)
at async Proxy.open (.../node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-persistence-jsonl/lib/index.js:2376:12)
at async raceAbort (.../@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-loop/lib/index.js:1406:10)
```

### 3. DNS behavior in the same shell

- `getent hosts 198.18.0.34` (a fake-IP peer with ESTAB connections at freeze time) → **times out** (intermittent: sometimes returns NXDOMAIN immediately, sometimes hangs indefinitely)
- `resolvectl query --type=PTR 198.18.0.34` → 8 s timeout
- `getent hosts 8.8.8.8` → returns `dns.google` in ~0.17 s

So the stall is specific to reverse lookups of fake-IP peers through the WSL DNS tunnel, and it is intermittent — which explains why the freeze happens reproducibly at startup here but not on every machine.

### 4. Fix verification

- With `process.report.excludeNetwork = true` forced via a `NODE_OPTIONS=--require` preload (**no source change at all**), the same `dsh web` (browser handoff on) stayed responsive for 90 s of continuous HTTP probes: **0 timeouts** (before the change: frozen ~15 s after startup).
- After patching `flock.js` exactly as suggested below, the same 90 s end-to-end test also stayed responsive with 0 timeouts.

## Suggested fix

`flock.js`'s `loadBinding()` should follow the same pattern `detect-libc` already uses (`detect-libc/lib/process.js`): temporarily set `excludeNetwork` while probing.

```diff
     let filename = 'system.node';
     if (platform === 'linux') {
         // Node's report types omit the libc field supplied by Linux reports.
+        // Skip the report's network walk while probing: it reverse-resolves every
+        // open socket synchronously, which can hang forever when PTR lookups stall
+        // (e.g. on WSL2 via the DNS tunnel for proxy fake-IP addresses).
+        const originalExcludeNetwork = process.report.excludeNetwork;
+        process.report.excludeNetwork = true;
         const report = process.report.getReport();
+        process.report.excludeNetwork = originalExcludeNetwork;
         filename = join(report.header.glibcVersionRuntime ? 'glibc' : 'musl', filename);
     }
```

Note the same latent pattern exists in `node-addon-native-custom-loader/lib/index.js` (last-resort libc detection calls `process.report.getReport()` unguarded, around line 279). It did not trigger in this repro (the `/proc` path resolved first), but it can hang the same way.

This is not WSL-specific in principle: any Linux environment where a connected peer's PTR lookup stalls (corporate DNS, VPN, fake-IP proxies) can freeze the whole event loop here, because the main thread blocks in `getnameinfo`. A missing `excludeNetwork` guard turns a diagnostic helper into a denial-of-service on the host process.

## Related

- https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/4755 shows a similar "event loop blocked, port keeps listening, CPU ~0" symptom on Windows + Node 22 (unresolved at the time of writing). Different platform and trigger point, so possibly a distinct root cause — but same observable failure class.

## 中文版摘要

**现象**：WSL2 下 `dsh web` 启动约 15 秒后卡死——端口仍在 LISTENING，但所有 HTTP 请求超时；CPU≈0%，进程不会恢复（主线程卡在系统调用里，连 Ctrl+C 都无效）。

**根因（已用 gdb + 调用栈验证）**：会话写入锁（`SessionWriteLease`）首次获取时懒加载 `@deepseek-ai/node-addon-system` 的 `flock.js`，其 libc 探测调用 `process.report.getReport()` 时**未设置 `process.report.excludeNetwork = true`**。Node 诊断报告的网络遍历会在主线程上对每个 TCP handle 执行**同步** `getnameinfo()` 反向 DNS。本机 WSL2（mirrored 网络 + DNS tunnel + 代理 fake-IP `198.18.0.0/15`）对 fake-IP 的 PTR 查询会间歇性永久挂起 → 主线程永久阻塞 → 整个事件循环冻结。

**证据**：gdb 栈显示主线程停在 `nss_resolve` 的 `ppoll`（由 `node::report::WalkHandle → uv_getnameinfo → getnameinfo` 触发）；JS 栈显示调用来自 `flock.js:19 → SessionWriteLease.acquire`；同 shell 下 `getent hosts 198.18.0.34` 超时而 `8.8.8.8` 秒回。

**验证**：仅用 preload 强制 `excludeNetwork = true`（不改任何源码），同样的 `dsh web` 连续 90 秒 HTTP 探测 0 超时（修复前 ~15 秒即卡死）；按上面的补丁修改 `flock.js` 后同样稳定。

**建议**：`flock.js` 参照 `detect-libc` 的既有写法加 `excludeNetwork` 保护；`node-addon-native-custom-loader` 存在同样的未保护调用。原则上这不止影响 WSL：任何「已连接对端 PTR 查询会卡住」的 Linux 环境（企业 DNS、VPN、fake-IP 代理）都可能因此冻结事件循环。

discussions.title: Windows Show in File Explorer can create an invisible window
discussions.body:
## Problem

On Windows, choosing **Show in File Explorer** from a presented-file card reports success, but Explorer can create a hidden window. The file exists and the Session declaration resolves to the correct absolute Host path, so repeated clicks appear to do nothing.

## Reproduction

1. Run `dsh web` on Windows.
2. Present an existing workspace file.
3. Open the file card menu and choose **Show in File Explorer**.
4. The card acknowledges the request, but no Explorer window becomes visible.

The Windows Shell enumeration showed Explorer windows with the requested file selected while `IsWindowVisible(hwnd)` returned `false`.

## Root cause

`revealNativePath()` launches `explorer.exe /select, <file-uri>` through the shared `runNativeCommand()`. That runner always passes `windowsHide: true` to Node `execFile`, including GUI applications. Explorer therefore receives the correct path but may create a suppressed application window.

## Proposed fix

Keep the shared runner hidden by default for PowerShell and other transient console commands, but use a narrow visible runner for the Explorer handoff. WSL path translation remains hidden; only `explorer.exe` uses `windowsHide: false`.

A tested implementation is available here:

- Commit: https://github.com/siegfly/deepseek-harness/commit/176738c62e
- Branch: https://github.com/siegfly/deepseek-harness/tree/fix/explorer-visible-reveal

## Verification

- 45 focused tests passed.
- Per-file coverage for `path-opener.ts` and `runner.ts`: 100% statements, branches, functions, and lines.
- Repository TypeScript checks passed.
- Repository lint passed.
- 33 of 34 `doc-sync` gates passed; the remaining pre-existing Windows-only documentation-site test requires symlink creation privileges (`EPERM`) and does not touch this package.
- The built `@deepseek-ai/dsh-native-command` artifact created a visible Explorer window whose selected item was the presented file.

The change also updates the bilingual package documentation and the existing implemented Agent Note that owns presented workspace files.
